Founded in 1924, the Foire de Savoie is far more than a traditional consumer fair. It stands as a prominent platform for regional culture, innovation, and quality of life. Every September, the Savoiexpo exhibition center transforms into a vibrant meeting point for curious visitors, enthusiasts, professionals, and entrepreneurs from across the region and beyond. Organized by Savoiexpo, a seasoned event organizer with extensive experience in large-scale public events, the fair uniquely combines the useful, the beautiful, and the memorable. Exhibitors from a wide range of industries present the latest trends and products – from household solutions, furniture, and leisure vehicles to garden design, interior concepts, and professional services. Local specialties, traditional craftsmanship, and culinary delights such as cheese, wine, and delicacies from the Savoy region take center stage alongside modern technologies and sustainable everyday solutions. The strong connection to the region is ever-present. The fair celebrates the essence of Savoyard life with cultural performances, artisan demonstrations, live music, and cooking competitions. Visitors can discover new leisure trends, explore topics related to health, beauty, and wellness, or engage in industry-specific networking and expert discussions. The program caters equally to families and professionals, traders, and business owners. With over 80,000 visitors annually, the Foire de Savoie ranks among the most important events of its kind in the Alpine region. It attracts a broad and diverse audience – from private individuals to decision-makers across sectors such as construction, tourism, and the food industry. The Savoiexpo exhibition center offers modern infrastructure and excellent accessibility. Conveniently located near the A43 motorway, the Chambéry-Challes-les-Eaux train station, and Chambéry-Savoie Airport, it provides ideal conditions for an event of this scale. The city of Chambéry itself – steeped in history, full of charm, and known for its high quality of life – adds to the unique appeal of the fair. For more than a century, the Foire de Savoie has stood for authenticity, inspiration, and connection. It is an event that brings people together, sparks enthusiasm, and remains a highlight year after year.

Tecno Fidta , short for "Tecnología de Alimentos Fidta", is an international trade fair for food technology. As one of the leading platforms in Latin America, it offers innovations and solutions in food processing. The event takes place every two years at the La Rural Convention & Exhibition Center in Buenos Aires. The fair is organized by Messe Frankfurt Argentina, a subsidiary of the globally active Messe Frankfurt, known for its expertise in industrial event management. Tecno Fidta attracts professionals from the entire food industry, including producers, engineers, and decision-makers, who are eager to learn about the latest trends and technologies. The fair's offerings encompass a variety of topics such as food processing, cold storage, automation and control systems, as well as laboratory and quality assurance equipment. Exhibitors present advanced machinery and devices, including meat grinders, pasteurizers, metal detectors, and specialized laboratory instruments. Services such as certification and hygiene control are also part of the portfolio. Tecno Fidta plays a significant role in the Latin American food industry, facilitating exchange and supporting the growth of the sector in the region. It reflects the dynamic character of Buenos Aires. Highlights of the fair include numerous informational events, conferences, training sessions, and workshops, providing participants with valuable insights and opportunities for professional development. Access to the centrally located La Rural Convention Center is facilitated by excellent infrastructure and transportation links. This makes it appealing for both international visitors and local participants to engage in this vibrant exchange. In summary, Tecno Fidta serves as an essential platform for professionals in the food industry to stay informed about the latest innovations and best practices, and to explore business opportunities in one of the world’s leading markets for food technology.

박람회설명:
WorldFood Moscow is one of the most important trade fairs for the food and beverage industry in Russia and across Eurasia. Since its launch in 1992, it has steadily gained significance and developed into a key industry gathering with international reach. Organized by the experienced event company ITE Expo International, the fair provides a platform for industry professionals to explore new products, market trends, and global developments in the food and beverage sector. As a strictly B2B event, the fair is exclusively geared toward trade visitors—particularly decision-makers and buyers from wholesale and retail, as well as representatives of the HoReCa sector (hotels, restaurants, cafés). The focus is not only on product presentations but also on concrete business deals, market expansion, and the establishment of long-term trade relationships. The clearly structured segmentation by product groups facilitates targeted networking between exhibitors and visitors—for example, in the areas of processed foods, fresh produce, fish and seafood, meat and poultry, beverages, and organic products. The product range covers all areas of modern nutrition—from frozen foods, canned goods, and convenience products to sweets, fresh fruit and vegetables, dried fruits and nuts, as well as premium meats, alternative protein sources, and ingredients for sushi. The beverage sector is equally diverse, featuring a wide selection of alcoholic specialties such as wine, beer, and vodka, alongside non-alcoholic drinks, teas, and coffees. Certified organic products play a special role—highlighted both in dedicated theme areas and integrated across various product segments. A key feature of the event is its extensive supporting program, which includes conferences, forums, and roundtable discussions offering practical insights and strategic knowledge for industry professionals. A particular highlight is the cooking marathon, where renowned chefs demonstrate their skills and showcase current gastronomic trends in live sessions. The venue is the Crocus Expo International Exhibition Centre in Krasnogorsk near Moscow—one of the most modern exhibition centers in Russia, offering excellent infrastructure and transport connections. The choice of this location underlines the fair’s ambition to be internationally oriented, efficiently organized, and focused on growth. Each autumn, it attracts a global professional audience aiming to strategically position their products in the Russian market. WorldFood Moscow has established itself as a leading trade event for the Eastern European food market—offering thematic diversity, a strategic outlook, and a clear focus on quality and international business. It is the ideal platform for companies looking to enter the Russian market or expand their presence there.

박람회설명:
The World AgriFood Innovation Expo (WAFI) is an international trade fair for innovations in the agricultural and food industries. It represents global progress and exchange in the fields of agriculture and nutrition. Serving as a central platform for professionals from business, science, and politics, the event takes place annually at the renowned Pinggu Jinhai Lake International Convention & Exhibition Center in Beijing, China. This venue is distinguished by its strategic location and state-of-the-art infrastructure. Organized by the China Agricultural University International Conference Center, WAFI offers a valuable opportunity for industry experts, investors, and innovators to exchange insights on the latest developments and present groundbreaking solutions to global challenges in agriculture and food production. The expo focuses on cutting-edge topics such as artificial intelligence and digital technologies, which set new standards for efficiency in food production. Additionally, biotechnology plays a key role in advancing agricultural progress through targeted genetic optimization. Innovative food technologies, nutrition, and health are also central themes, aiming to establish sustainable and healthy dietary practices worldwide. Moreover, solutions for livestock farming and aquaculture are highlighted, demonstrating how modern technologies can enhance efficiency and sustainability. Other key discussions revolve around resilience and sustainability in agriculture and food systems, particularly in response to climate change. Political and regulatory frameworks, support for smallholder farmers, gender equality in the industry, and financing models for innovation also feature prominently. WAFI showcases groundbreaking products and services, including smart farming systems, sustainable packaging solutions, alternative proteins, vertical farming methods, and novel food technologies. International companies present their latest advancements, while start-ups have the opportunity to attract investors for their visionary projects. The expo is closely tied to China's economic and technological development in the agricultural and food sectors, highlighting the country's innovative strength. A prestigious highlight of the event is the WAFI Innovation Award, which honors companies that revolutionize the future of global food production with their products and technologies. Expert panels, podium discussions, and interactive workshops provide visitors with valuable insights and extensive networking opportunities. WAFI brings together a wide range of exhibitors, including technology companies, agricultural enterprises, food producers, start-ups, research institutions, and policymakers. The primary visitors include professionals from agriculture, food production, retail, logistics, finance, and technology, creating a unique platform for exchange among visionaries, innovators, and decision-makers. The venue, the Pinggu Jinhai Lake International Convention & Exhibition Center, is known for its modern architecture and scenic surroundings. With excellent connectivity, the exhibition center is easily accessible from both Beijing International Airport and the city center. The well-developed infrastructure makes WAFI an essential event for the future of the agricultural and food industries.

CHEFEX India is a highly specialised B2B trade fair that has established itself as a central platform for the entire value chain of the hospitality, foodservice, food processing and food retail sectors in North India. Held annually at Parade Ground in Sector 17, Chandigarh, the event is organised by the PHDCCI Chamber of Commerce and Industry. This long-established Indian chamber is one of the country’s most influential business associations and uses CHEFEX India to promote innovation, connect markets and, in particular, facilitate access to new business opportunities for small and medium-sized enterprises. The exhibition covers a broad spectrum, ranging from advanced food technology and professional kitchen equipment to complete solutions for catering infrastructure and large-scale kitchens. This is complemented by areas such as cold chain management, packaging and logistics, security systems, hygiene solutions and digital technologies for the HoReCa sector. At the same time, the “Retail & Distribution” segment showcases a wide range of ready-to-consume products—from baked goods, dairy and frozen foods to spices, organic products and premium agricultural produce. Specialised solutions for off-site catering, including tents, décor and mobile equipment, also form part of the exhibition. CHEFEX India is distinguished by its clear focus on practical business applications. Exhibitors include companies from food production, engineering, packaging, catering supplies, security technology and logistics. The event is specifically targeted at a professional audience, including procurement professionals from hospitality and foodservice, operators of large-scale kitchens, caterers, retailers and distributors, food-sector start-ups, as well as institutional decision-makers and representatives of public bodies. This creates a highly relevant environment for sourcing, partnerships and market entry. A key strength of the event lies in its role as a strategic showcase for the rapidly growing North Indian market. Chandigarh, a modern planned city and economic hub of the Punjab–Haryana region, provides an ideal setting and serves as a nexus between industry, agriculture and urban consumption. The exhibition reflects this dynamic by highlighting trends such as sustainable food production, efficient supply chains and technological innovation. The programme is further enhanced by live demonstrations, expert presentations and industry-specific networking formats that support knowledge exchange and business development. In addition to its strong content profile, the event benefits from its accessible location: Parade Ground in Sector 17 is situated in Chandigarh’s central business district and is easily reached both from Chandigarh International Airport and via a well-developed road and rail network. In this way, CHEFEX India combines subject-matter depth with logistical convenience.

The “Herbstpartie Kloster Kamp” is a public fair held annually in September, meticulously organized since its inception in 2021 by Reno Müller Veranstaltungen GmbH & Co. KG. As an experienced event organizer known for hosting markets at historic locations such as Schloss Eller and Burg Trips, Reno Müller brings a distinctive signature to each of his events, marked by attention to detail and a strong sense of quality. The venue is the impressive Kloster Kamp in Kamp-Lintfort, the first Cistercian monastery in the German-speaking world. Steeped in history and set within a particularly scenic landscape, the monastery grounds provide a stunning backdrop for the event. Nestled within the artistically designed Baroque terraced gardens, which date back to around 1700, the fair unfolds in a setting reminiscent of the grandeur of Potsdam’s Sanssouci Park. Visitors stroll through a variety of garden rooms, including a Paradise Garden created for the 2020 State Garden Show, adding yet another layer of enchantment to the experience. At the heart of the fair lies a curated selection of high-quality arts and crafts, unique handmade pieces, and carefully chosen culinary delights. Offerings include finely crafted ceramics, handmade jewelry, exquisite textile art, leather goods, and woodwork, as well as painting, graphic art, and floral autumn arrangements. Culinary specialties are equally impressive: regional cheeses, artisanal honey, fine oils and vinegars, premium spirits, and a wide array of teas and spices invite guests to sample and savor. Many visitors also use the fair as a source of inspiration for stylish early Christmas shopping. It is this combination of exclusive offerings, relaxed atmosphere, and the extraordinary setting that makes the Herbstpartie Kloster Kamp a truly special event—ideal for those who appreciate the exceptional. Thoughtful services such as a purchase depot, free cash withdrawals at the information point, a dedicated service team, and a complimentary shuttle bus from a designated parking area to the venue enhance the overall experience. The fair appeals to both private individuals and professional visitors, offering not only high-quality products but also a culturally enriching excursion into the region. Elegant piano music, a charming beer garden atmosphere, and the inspiring surroundings of the monastery create an ambiance that far surpasses the expectations of a traditional arts and crafts market—an experience for the senses, a celebration for the soul, and a meeting place for people of taste.

Mer & Vigne Paris is a celebration of the senses – a feast for gourmets that showcases the French art of living in its most indulgent form. The event is organized by Mer & Vigne SARL, an experienced company that has dedicated itself for many years to curating high-end culinary exhibitions with passion and expertise. The fair stands out for its clear focus on fishing, agriculture, viticulture, and artisan food production. This unique combination appeals not only to discerning food lovers, but also to professionals from the hospitality industry, gastronomy, wine trade, and artisanal food sectors. It serves as a lively platform for exchange and connection – a place where producers, artisans, and connoisseurs come together to discuss trends, innovations, and evolving tastes. The curated selection includes fresh seafood, handcrafted specialties from various French regions, rare wines, and selected European products, tailored to meet the expectations of a demanding audience. Paris, as the capital of fine taste, provides the ideal setting for this event, which is part of a nationwide series of fairs. Despite its wide reach, each Mer & Vigne edition retains a strong local character. In Paris, the Hippodrome de Vincennes, with its elegant atmosphere and convenient accessibility – by car or public transport – offers a fitting backdrop for this gastronomic gathering. A particular highlight of the fair is its competitions and awards, which recognize outstanding products and creative presentations. These accolades not only enrich the visitor experience but also underscore the event’s role as a benchmark of quality in French gastronomy. Mer & Vigne Paris is part of a broader series of exhibitions held throughout France. Each fair maintains its local identity while drawing a nationwide audience. In this way, Mer & Vigne Paris is far more than a marketplace – it is an authentic reflection of French culinary culture. It is a valuable destination for industry professionals, unique in its thematic depth, and uncompromising in its commitment to quality. For those who truly wish to taste and experience France, this event is not to be missed.

The LebensArt event in Raguhn-Jeßnitz is a unique public fair dedicated to a conscious, tasteful, and stylish lifestyle—set in a culinary and cultural atmosphere with exceptional flair. Organized by Das AgenturHaus GmbH, known for its high-quality experiential formats across Germany, the venue is ideally chosen: the baroque Schloss Altjeßnitz, surrounded by a vast historical estate park. This impressive setting offers not only a stunning backdrop but also space for relaxation, deceleration, and inspiration—including one of the largest baroque hedge mazes in Europe. Once a year, the castle ensemble transforms into an elegant platform for national and international exhibitors who present their carefully selected products in white pagoda tents, on manicured lawns, and inside historic buildings. LebensArt is not a conventional trade fair, but rather an elegant countryside outing with the character of an event and a wealth of enjoyable moments. The event covers a broad range of themes—from gardening, living, and lifestyle to art, fashion, and cuisine—all with a focus on quality, sustainability, and craftsmanship. Visitors can expect a thoughtfully curated selection: seasonal plants, creative home décor, handcrafted one-of-a-kind pieces, sustainable fashion, and natural cosmetics. This is complemented by regional and organic foods, delicacies from artisanal producers, and specialties such as cold-pressed oils, honey, and spices. A special feature of LebensArt is its supporting program, which transforms a visit into a memorable experience. Live music, including performances by singer and guitarist Tomasz Gaworek, demonstrations by artisans, tastings, and personal consultations with exhibitors ensure plenty of interaction and entertainment. A photo booth with lovingly designed sets and a stilt walker in a Rococo costume add charming touches to the atmosphere. Families benefit from daily childcare services. Practical services are also available, including a pick-up and delivery service for purchased goods and guidance on cashless payment options. Since there is no ATM on site, visitors are advised to bring sufficient cash. Whether as a day out in the countryside, a source of inspiration for your home, or a culinary journey through hand-picked specialties, LebensArt in the Altjeßnitz estate park is a quality-driven event concept that invites you to stroll, linger, and discover—within an ambiance as extraordinary as the fair itself.

The Icelandic Fisheries, Seafood & Aqua Exhibition, known briefly as "IceFish", exemplifies Iceland's pioneering role in the global fishing industry. The country's clean waters and sustainable fishing practices make it the perfect host for this trade fair. The biennial frequency of the expo allows exhibitors to fully develop and present their latest innovations and technologies, making it particularly appealing to visitors. IceFish covers a wide range of topics, from aquaculture equipment and automation technologies to navigation and communication systems, safety equipment, and fish-finding devices. The expo offers a broad platform for the latest developments in ship design, processing equipment, specialized software, and management systems for the maritime industry. A standout feature of IceFish is its comprehensive representation of industry-relevant topics, supplemented by the participation of consultants, educational institutions, and government agencies. Workshops and presentations by leading industry experts provide valuable insights and promote the exchange of knowledge and best practices. IceFish serves as a central hub for sharing innovations, networking, and promoting sustainable practices in the global fishing industry. With its depth of expertise and the variety of products and services exhibited, it regularly sets new standards and attracts both professionals and exhibitors alike, making it one of the leading fairs of its kind on the global stage.

The China Homelife South Africa Expo is an international trade fair with a clear focus: it showcases the diversity, innovation, and quality of Chinese products in South Africa, creating a prominent platform for trade and exchange between China and the African market. The event takes place at the renowned Gallagher Convention Centre in Johannesburg, one of South Africa’s leading exhibition venues. Each year, the Expo opens its doors to both trade visitors and consumers. It is organized by Zhejiang Meorient Commerce & Exhibition Inc., a globally experienced trade fair organizer, in close cooperation with a local partner in South Africa. The Expo highlights products and solutions from key sectors such as construction, mechanical engineering, textiles and apparel, household goods, consumer electronics, furniture, interior decoration, and gift items. Covering everything from industrial equipment to contemporary everyday products, the event positions itself as a professional marketplace for high-quality goods “Made in China.” The China Homelife South Africa Expo is specifically designed for businesses seeking new suppliers or trading partners. It connects exhibitors and buyers directly, with a strong emphasis on fostering long-term business relationships. As such, it serves as an effective platform for importers, wholesalers, retailers, and professionals from the construction, interior design, textile, and electronics industries. Visitors benefit from the opportunity to engage directly with manufacturers, examine product samples, and gain first-hand insights into quality, pricing, and delivery conditions. One of the Expo’s key contributions lies in its support of South Africa’s economic development. It facilitates local companies’ access to global supply chains, promotes product diversity, and helps stabilize prices across various sectors. Small and medium-sized enterprises also benefit from the chance to explore new business models and establish valuable contacts. The Expo is part of an internationally recognized exhibition series held successfully in multiple countries, adding to its global credibility and reach. The Gallagher Convention Centre in Midrand – conveniently located between Johannesburg and Pretoria – offers modern infrastructure, spacious exhibition halls, and professional event management, ensuring a smooth and productive visit. In summary, the China Homelife South Africa Expo is an exceptional opportunity for anyone interested in high-quality Chinese products and in exploring new business prospects within a dynamic international environment.

The Expoalimentaria in Lima is a trade fair for the food, beverage, and gastronomy sectors. "Expoalimentaria" represents a specialist trade show that covers significant areas such as food and beverages, containers and packaging, machinery, equipment, technology and innovation, and international trade services. It is held annually in Lima, the vibrant capital of Peru, at the Jockey Exhibition Centre . The fair typically takes place in September. Since being established by the organiser, Adex, Expoalimentaria has consistently grown in significance. With its comprehensive expertise in trade fair organisation and industry knowledge, Adex aims to highlight the strengths of the Peruvian food industry on a global scale. Peru has become a prominent player in the global food industry, with agriculture at its core. The country is proud to be a "strategic supplier to the world", a distinction it owes to its unique microclimate, which supports a vast range of species. Peru is held in high esteem not only in South America but also globally for its competitiveness and business-friendly environment. It's essential to note Peru's leading roles in producing and exporting products like specialty coffee, cochineal, quinoa, fishmeal, fish oil, and asparagus. Expoalimentaria primarily focuses on the display of food, beverages, and culinary accessories. International exhibitors from diverse sectors attend the fair to introduce their latest products, identify new business avenues, and showcase their innovative concepts. In conclusion, the Jockey Exhibition Centre in Lima stands out not just for its state-of-the-art facilities but also for its outstanding accessibility. Seamlessly blending tradition with the future of the food industry, it offers the perfect backdrop for Expoalimentaria.

The Tallinn FoodFair (TFF) was established in 1993 and today stands as an international expo, serving as a vital hub for trade opportunities in the food industry. Every autumn, it attracts professionals to the impressive Unibet Arena in Tallinn, the capital of Estonia. Hosted by Profexpo OÜ , over the years, TFF has evolved into the leading industry event for food professionals in Estonia. It provides a platform where experts from various sectors - from hotels and restaurants to retailers, importers, and producers - converge, network, and exchange the latest trends and innovations. The fair offers an extensive insight into Estonian food, showcasing a broad range of products and services, including new product lines. This makes TFF an indispensable event for international buyers interested in premium Estonian products. Here, they can directly meet the producers, gaining a genuine feel for the quality and diversity of the offerings. A highlight of the fair includes numerous professional competitions involving chefs, bartenders, confectioners, and a pizza master championship. Moreover, presentations by industry experts, tastings, HoReCa seminars, conferences, and even non-alcoholic cocktail championships and wine samplings are held, appealing to both food professionals and hotel industry specialists. Exhibitors represent a myriad of industries, including food production, packaging, logistics, warehousing, and transportation. Engineering and technology firms also display smart IT solutions for supply chain management. The fair emphasizes the Estonian food industry and spotlights the nation's best products and innovations. The Unibet Arena in Tallinn, which hosts TFF, is a contemporary expo center and easily accessible. As Estonia's capital, Tallinn also boasts numerous cultural and historical sites that visitors can explore alongside the fair. Thus, attending TFF is not just a professional endeavor but also a culturally enriching experience.

The POLAGRA Fair, a leading annual event in the food industry, takes place at the Poznan International Fair Grounds in Poznań, Poland. Organized by mtp GRUPA, it encompasses three main sectors: FOOD, FOODTECH, and HORECA. These segments offer a diverse array of products and services, ranging from everyday food items to advanced technologies for food processing and equipment for the gastronomy and hospitality industries. As a significant cultural event, POLAGRA provides an excellent platform for business development and networking, deeply rooted in Polish hospitality. It plays a central role in promoting the Polish food industry and showcasing global trends and innovations. In the FOOD ZONE, visitors will find a comprehensive selection of fresh and processed foods, including meats, fish, dairy products, and a variety of grain products, complemented by organic and eco-friendly products. The HORECA ZONE focuses on equipment and services for the hospitality industry, offering state-of-the-art kitchen technology and complete solutions for hotels and restaurants. The FOODTECH ZONE features advanced machinery and technological equipment specifically developed for the needs of the food processing industry, from packaging systems to quality assurance devices. Highlights of the fair include the Polish Culinary Cup, a prestigious competition that honors the culinary skills of Poland's finest chefs, and the Acanthus Aureus competition, which recognizes outstanding architectural and graphic design in exhibition stands. Both competitions highlight the creativity and dedication of the participants and set new standards in the industry. The fair attracts thousands of professionals from various fields, including gastronomes, hotel managers, chefs, and technology experts. The venue is ideally located and easily accessible via international transport links. In Poznań's dynamic atmosphere, POLAGRA offers every visitor an inspiring experience, marked by a comprehensive and specific presentation of the food industry.

FERAMUR – The Official Craft Fair of the Region of Murcia – is a long-standing yet forward-looking trade fair for artisanal craftsmanship held annually in the southern Spanish city of Lorca. Its name stands not only for the region’s official craft fair, but also for a vibrant forum showcasing Spanish craftsmanship with broad national appeal. The event takes place at the modern IFELOR Exhibition Centre – Institución Ferial de Lorca . This innovative venue is centrally located and equipped with contemporary infrastructure, providing ideal conditions for both professional and public events. The fair is organized by Recinto IFELOR, a well-established institution specializing in trade fair and event management, with a strong focus on promoting regional industries. FERAMUR positions itself not merely as a sales platform, but as a cultural event that brings together tradition, creativity, and artisanal skill. Visitors can discover a rich and diverse selection of handcrafted works that vividly reflect the variety and depth of Spanish craftsmanship. Exhibitors range from family-run workshops to renowned artisans from across Spain. The fair highlights both traditional and modern techniques, brought to life through live demonstrations and interactive activities. The event program is further enriched by cultural attractions such as competitions, fashion shows, and concerts, all of which emphasize FERAMUR’s regional character and contribute to a dynamic visitor experience. FERAMUR attracts a diverse audience: industry professionals from the trade and arts sectors, craft enthusiasts, families, tourists, and local residents alike. All visitors are offered high-quality products and authentic insights into the region’s cultural heritage. In doing so, FERAMUR builds a bridge between local craftsmanship and international interest. A key element of the fair’s significance lies in its close ties to the culture and history of Murcia – particularly to the city of Lorca, renowned for its rich architectural and artisanal heritage. The exhibition grounds are easily accessible by car and public transport and are located just minutes from Lorca’s historic city center. A visit to FERAMUR thus becomes not only an encounter with the world of artisanal craftsmanship, but also an opportunity to experience one of the region’s most culturally significant cities – a rewarding destination for visitors from both Spain and abroad.

The "GrillGut" is not just a name, but a synonym for quality and passion for everything to do with grilling. The abbreviation of the trade fair name underlines the central importance of grilled goods and everything that goes with them. Every year in October, the "GrillGut" opens its doors in Bremen. What can visitors expect at the GrillGut? It is a combination of a sales fair, the Bremen State Grill Championship and a BBQ event, organized by M3B GmbH. The main topics of the trade fair are diverse and cover almost all aspects of grilling: from different types of grills such as charcoal, gas, Kamado and pellet grills to smokers, wood-fired ovens and Dutch ovens. Outdoor kitchens, smokers, charcoal as well as knives, accessories and supplies are also presented. Visitors also get their money's worth in terms of culinary delights, as meat shops and suppliers of oils, spices, ribs and sauces are represented on site. The event takes place in the open-air area of ​​the Bremen trade fair, a renowned venue that is easily accessible by public transport or car. In conclusion, the GrillGut trade fair in Bremen is a must for all grill lovers and offers an experience that goes far beyond mere grilling. It is a feast for the senses, a meeting place for like-minded people and a place where passion for good food and community come together.

The GOOD LIFE Fair is Japan’s premier exhibition for sustainable and mindful lifestyles—far more than a conventional product showcase. Its name represents a holistic concept: living healthily, consuming organically, thinking openly, and engaging in dialogue—everything that defines a good life today. The event is aimed at people who seek to live consciously, responsibly, and with a focus on the future—both on a personal and societal level. Held once a year at the renowned Tokyo Big Sight exhibition center, the fair is organized by the long-established media group The Asahi Shimbun Company , known for its strong journalistic values. That same commitment to quality, social relevance, and innovation is reflected throughout the event. The GOOD LIFE Fair uniquely combines pressing social issues with a positive outlook on life. At its core are themes such as sustainable consumption, health, well-being, and responsible lifestyle choices. It demonstrates how environmental awareness, social responsibility, and personal needs can be harmoniously integrated into everyday life—inspiring, practical, and always held to a high standard. The range of topics spans sustainable architecture, plant-based nutrition, organic cosmetics, mental health, future-proof fashion, and innovative business models. Exhibitors showcase a wide array of products and services, including eco-friendly food production, regional cuisine, nature-based beauty products, green living concepts, sustainable mobility solutions, and educational or coaching offers. The program is further enriched by workshops, expert talks, interactive formats, and a diverse culinary lineup—from tastings to themed food experiences. A particular highlight is the SDG Market, where companies and organizations present their contributions to the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Equally noteworthy is the special exhibition "New Perspectives – Manabi Expo," which focuses on education, social innovation, and civic engagement. Exhibitors primarily represent sectors such as food, health, wellness, interior design, fashion, tourism, technology, education, and sustainable entrepreneurship. The audience is equally diverse, ranging from conscious consumers to professionals from retail, hospitality, and wellness, as well as decision-makers from business, education, and the public sector. The fair clearly appeals to individuals actively seeking sustainable alternatives—whether for their private lives or professional practice. The venue, Tokyo Big Sight, is located in the vibrant Odaiba district and is well-connected to the public transport network, with direct access via the Yurikamome Line and various bus and ferry routes. With its striking architecture and modern infrastructure, it offers the perfect setting for an event that aims to broaden horizons and enrich the lives of its visitors—in practical, inspiring, and forward-thinking ways.

The HerbstZeit is a stylish public fair held every October at the MESSE BREMEN exhibition grounds and organized by the experienced M3B GmbH. Designed as an “indoor country outing”, it blends the natural, cozy atmosphere of an autumn excursion with the advantages of an all-weather indoor event—a combination that clearly sets it apart from other fall or lifestyle fairs. At its heart, the event aims to provide visitors with a sensory experience that is aesthetically inspiring, culinarily indulgent, and creatively stimulating. Guests can expect a lovingly curated setting with natural materials, pagoda tents, cozy retreat areas, and thematic decorations that exude a warm and inviting autumnal charm. The range of offerings is broad yet carefully selected. Showcased are regional and seasonal delicacies such as cheese, honey, apples, jams, and pumpkin specialties, complemented by high-quality crafts, fall gardening ideas, Advent and Christmas decorations, as well as fashion, jewelry, and accessories. The culinary experience is enhanced by food trucks and street food vendors, inviting guests to sample and linger. Regional focus and quality are key—both in the products offered and the overall concept of the event. A varied supporting program enriches the fair. Visitors can participate in workshops such as wreath making, pottery, or crafting for Advent. Cooking shows featuring regional chefs and a charming live music program further elevate the atmosphere. HerbstZeit is not merely a marketplace—it is a space for inspiration, connection, and creative expression, ideal for those wishing to welcome the cooler season in style and with all their senses. A special highlight is the simultaneous hosting of three additional themed fairs under the roof of MESSE BREMEN: TrauZeit for couples in love or engaged, GrillGut for barbecue enthusiasts, and Kreativ+Spiel for fans of crafts and games. With just one ticket, visitors gain access to all four events—an appealing bonus that adds even more value to the experience. Altogether, HerbstZeit is more than just a fair—it is an experience that brings together indulgence, craftsmanship, creativity, and relaxation in a stylish setting. Located in the heart of the Hanseatic city of Bremen, it is easily accessible both regionally and from further afield, offering a welcome escape from everyday life in an atmosphere that invites discovery, enjoyment, and lingering.

BioSüd is an annual trade fair for the organic sector and has been firmly established within Germany’s organic industry since its inception in 2009. The name not only reflects the fair’s core focus on organic products and sustainable innovations but also emphasizes its regional orientation toward southern Germany, particularly Bavaria and the adjoining Alpine regions. Organized by Matthias Deppe und Wolfram Müller OHG , the event draws on many years of experience and in-depth industry knowledge to offer a platform that holds a unique position within the sector. The venue is the Augsburg Exhibition Center, which transforms once a year into a vibrant meeting point for organic retailers, health food stores, organic supermarkets, foodservice providers, bulk purchasers, and other key industry players. At the heart of the event are premium organic foods and natural cosmetics, all certified to strict organic standards. The fair presents a comprehensive cross-section of the organic value chain – from regional specialties produced by beekeepers, cheesemakers, and wineries to innovative new products such as fermented drinks and plant-based formulations. Established brands meet emerging start-ups, fostering a dynamic exchange between tradition and innovation. A varied supporting program featuring lectures, workshops, forums, and panel discussions addresses the most pressing issues in the sector. Topics include certification processes, supply chain challenges, soil health, carbon offsetting, and legal frameworks for organic agriculture, as well as market developments, pricing structures, and the integration of organic policy into broader political decision-making. Direct dialogue between producers, retailers, industry experts, and policymakers creates space for practical solutions and encourages sustainable partnerships. Exhibitors primarily come from the organic and health food retail sectors, as well as the organic foodservice industry. A wide range of regional producers rounds out the offering. The fair is attended exclusively by trade visitors – including independent retailers, restaurateurs, wholesalers, and representatives from associations, media, and government – all united by a shared goal: to further develop an ecologically and socially responsible organic industry. BioSüd is part of a nationwide network of trade fairs, which also includes BioOst (Leipzig), BioWest (Düsseldorf), and BioNord (Hamburg). Together, these events form a strong network for the organic trade in Germany – regionally rooted and nationally connected. With its modern infrastructure, central location, and excellent accessibility via train, highway, and public transport, the Augsburg Exhibition Center provides the ideal setting for a trade fair of this scale. Combined with the cultural appeal and historical significance of the city, attending BioSüd becomes not just a business engagement, but an inspiring experience in its own right.

360 Food Syria is much more than a traditional trade exhibition – it serves as the key showcase for the entire food industry in Syria. With its holistic concept, the event offers a comprehensive 360-degree perspective on the sector’s full value chain: from agriculture and food processing to packaging, hospitality and logistics. The name reflects not only a symbolic commitment to this all-encompassing view, but a concrete focus on presenting the full spectrum of products, technologies and innovations shaping the industry. The event is organised by EVEX Events , a leading event management company based in Riyadh, renowned for delivering high-calibre international trade fairs. Drawing on its extensive experience, EVEX brings to Damascus – specifically to the Damascus Fairgrounds – a format tailored to meet the specific needs of the Syrian market, both in terms of content and execution. 360 Food Syria provides a highly specialised platform for industry professionals operating in food and beverages, HoReCa, food technology, agriculture and sustainability. Exhibits range from dairy products, oils, snacks and grains to meat and poultry, baked goods and organic foods. These are complemented by the latest technologies in packaging, processing, ingredients, food safety, cold chain management, automation and robotics. A particularly forward-looking feature of the show is the Sustainability & Innovation zone, which addresses key issues such as eco-friendly packaging, waste reduction, recycling, renewable energy and alternative protein sources. This segment not only offers valuable insights into current market developments but also helps drive progress towards a more resilient and future-proof food security landscape in the region. Exhibitors represent a broad cross-section of industries – including food producers, agricultural businesses, machinery manufacturers, packaging specialists, logistics providers and suppliers of kitchen and catering equipment. The visitor profile is equally diverse and includes buyers, traders, producers, restaurateurs, hoteliers, and decision-makers from industry, commerce and public institutions. As a strictly trade-only event, 360 Food Syria ensures high-quality networking and targeted knowledge exchange. The venue – Damascus Fairgrounds – enjoys a strategic location in the Syrian capital and is easily accessible by car and public transport. The spacious exhibition site offers modern infrastructure, expansive display areas and a professional setting designed to foster successful business relationships.

The LebensArt Autumn Market in Basthorst, commonly referred to simply as the "LebensArt Autumn Market," is a distinguished event set against the scenic backdrop of Gut Basthorst in the bustling metropolitan region of Hamburg. Held annually in October, the market is timed perfectly to coincide with the radiant splendour of autumn. This market owes its inception to the esteemed AgencyHaus GmbH, a firm celebrated for its exceptional prowess in orchestrating premier events and exhibitions. The LebensArt Autumn Market epitomises a harmonious fusion of artisan craftsmanship, modern design, and gastronomic pleasures. Its core themes encompass handmade fashion, exquisite jewellery, top-tier interior decor, and visually captivating art pieces. At this market, local artisans and designers proudly display their newest inventions spanning fashion, jewellery, silverware, porcelain, and other accessories. Moreover, attendees can unearth vintage furniture gems and draw inspiration from the avant-garde interior designs on show. A standout feature of this fair is its pronounced focus on culinary adventures, allowing guests to savour global delicacies and select beverages. The exhibitors hail from diverse domains, spanning fashion, jewellery design, furniture craft, and the arts. Predominantly, the fair attracts individuals from these sectors, in addition to art, garden, and design aficionados who are on the hunt for fresh inspirations and singular items. Additionally, the LebensArt Autumn Market is a notable member of a suite of "LebensArt" events curated by AgencyHaus GmbH at various exclusive venues. This event series is characterised by its one-of-a-kind ambience and elite product range. To conclude, Gut Basthorst stands as an unparalleled setting for the LebensArt Autumn Market, radiating historical allure and natural splendour. This idyllic estate, steeped in history, melds culture, nature, and tradition in a way that's truly unique. Enclosed by awe-inspiring landscapes that include verdant expanses, ponds, and woodlands, it offers visitors not just a sanctuary for peace and repose, but also countless avenues for leisurely strolls and exploration. Positioned within the metropolitan confines of Hamburg, it's handily accessible via car or public transport.

Autumn Magic at Burg Ohrdruf is much more than a traditional trade fair – it is a sensory experience that takes place every year in golden October on the picturesque grounds of Burg & Park Ohrdruf in Thuringia. Organized by Arcos GmbH, this exceptional event is dedicated to celebrating the refined pleasures of autumn and delights visitors with an impressive blend of nature, craftsmanship, culinary highlights, and lifestyle. Once a year, the historic setting of Burg Ohrdruf – including the castle courtyard, interior rooms, and expansive park – transforms into an atmospheric stage for carefully selected exhibitors from across Germany. With a clear focus on quality and authenticity, Autumn Magic presents a seasonally curated world of themes: from autumnal plant varieties such as perennials, roses, and herbs to exclusive garden decorations made from ceramic, wood, or weathered steel, and one-of-a-kind handmade items in fashion, jewelry, and traditional crafts. Live demonstrations, such as glassblowing and knife sharpening, offer hands-on insights into artisanal work. Food lovers will also find plenty to enjoy: regional specialties, aromatic balsamic creations, oven-fresh flatbreads, and many other culinary delights invite guests to taste and linger. Autumn Magic at Burg Ohrdruf appeals not only to garden enthusiasts, decoration lovers, and gourmets, but also attracts professionals from the fields of horticulture, floristry, interior design, gastronomy, and artisan craft. The historic Burg Ohrdruf – idyllically situated on the outskirts of Ohrdruf in the heart of Thuringia – offers a unique atmosphere with its parkland and adjacent lake. As a former residence, it maintains a strong connection to the region’s cultural and gardening heritage. The event blends harmoniously into the townscape and enhances Ohrdruf’s touristic appeal well beyond state borders. Autumn Magic at Burg Ohrdruf is easily accessible by car, with designated parking areas available. Public transportation also offers a convenient and relaxed journey. Visitors can expect a fair designed with great attention to detail – a place where autumn reveals its most beautiful sides.

Mer & Vigne Strasbourg in Eckbolsheim is a sensory experience for anyone eager to discover and savor French gastronomy at its finest. Its name – derived from the French words Mer (sea) and Vigne (vine) – symbolically reflects the event’s two central themes: premium seafood and exquisite wines. Twice a year, the Zénith de Strasbourg in the Alsatian town of Eckbolsheim transforms into a vibrant meeting place for gourmets, culinary professionals, and producers from across Europe. Organized by Mer & Vigne Lyon, a seasoned event coordinator renowned for its commitment to quality and authenticity, the fair has earned a firm place in France’s culinary landscape. Each edition creates a platform that blends strong regional roots with an international outlook. At its core lies the harmony between artisanal food craftsmanship, sustainable agriculture, traditional fishing, and passionate viticulture. Visitors can look forward to a refined selection of delicacies—from freshly caught oysters and Breton scallops to air-dried hams and homemade foie gras, complemented by fine wines from Alsace, Burgundy, and Bordeaux. This diverse culinary offering is further enriched by specialties from other European regions, making Mer & Vigne Strasbourg a melting pot of cultural and gastronomic variety. The fair holds special significance for the Strasbourg region. It provides local producers and family-run businesses with a stage to showcase their creations to a wide audience, boosts regional tourism, and highlights the culinary richness of Alsace. A particular highlight is the award ceremonies honoring outstanding products and innovative concepts—celebrating quality, creativity, and passion. Exhibitors represent sectors such as fishing, agriculture, winemaking, and artisanal food production. Trade professionals from the hospitality, gastronomy, retail, and fine food industries meet here with discerning visitors in search of something exceptional. The result is an inspiring forum for networking, discovery, and culinary education. Mer & Vigne in Eckbolsheim is part of a successful event series held in various cities across France. Each location brings its own regional character, yet all share the same ambition: to unite Europe’s finest products on a unique marketplace for the senses. The venue, the modern and architecturally striking Zénith de Strasbourg, impresses with its excellent accessibility—whether by car, tram, or from neighboring countries. Situated in Eckbolsheim, just a few kilometers from the city center, it provides the perfect setting for a fair that captivates both mind and palate.

GASTRO SWEET FEST is far more than a traditional trade fair – it’s a multisensory experience that puts the sweet side of gastronomy center stage, combining professional expertise with broad public appeal. The name says it all: GASTRO SWEET FEST stands for gastronomy, confectionery, and a vibrant festival atmosphere – blending culinary diversity with a premium business-to-business offering. As an annual highlight in the Czech trade fair landscape, the event takes place at the renowned PVA Expo Praha in Prague. It is organized by the experienced event company ABF, a.s., known for high-quality trade and consumer exhibitions throughout the Czech Republic. The fair targets both industry professionals and food enthusiasts: from experts in gastronomy, hospitality, bakery, confectionery, food production, and retail to technical suppliers and curious gourmets from the general public. Exhibitors represent a wide range of sectors – from artisanal chocolatiers and specialty coffee roasters to POS system providers and designers of modern bistro concepts. Whether confectionery, baked goods, fine foods, coffee, wine, cocktails, or digital gastronomy solutions – visitors can expect not only products but also tailored services, educational opportunities, and high-level business inspiration. A distinctive feature of GASTRO SWEET FEST is its strong connection to Czech culinary culture. Local stars from the patisserie and barista scenes showcase their skills live on an interactive stage – up close and personal. Themed zones such as “Čokofest”, a dedicated coffee area, a wine lounge, and creative dessert food trucks offer an immersive experience for all the senses. The festival is further enhanced by a professional B2B area featuring a conference program where industry players exchange ideas, explore partnerships, and discuss current trends. VIP lounges, interview zones, and autograph sessions with renowned industry figures contribute to the exclusive atmosphere. Visitors and exhibitors alike benefit from one of Central Europe’s most modern exhibition centers: PVA Expo Praha – easily accessible by public transport, with ample parking and comprehensive infrastructure for international guests. GASTRO SWEET FEST is the perfect meeting point for anyone inspired by the sweet side of life and looking to spark new business opportunities.

In conclusion, PALMEX Indonesia is not only a showcase for the latest advancements in the palm oil industry but also a central platform for experts to share knowledge, establish partnerships, and collaboratively shape the future of this essential sector. For all those involved in or interested in the palm oil industry, it's an indispensable event.

Engage Trade Africa (ETA) is an international B2B trade fair and business platform dedicated to strengthening commercial relationships between African companies and international suppliers. The event is exclusively open to trade visitors and is held annually at the Durban Exhibition Centre in Durban, South Africa. The event is organised by Catalyze, an agency specialising in international trade, business networking and trade promotion. The company designs tailored programmes and trade events that bring together businesses, buyers and key decision-makers. At the heart of Engage Trade Africa is a carefully curated Hosted Buyer Programme, which connects selected buyers and exhibitors over several days through one-to-one business meetings, networking events, industry workshops, and visits to companies and production facilities. This approach fosters long-term business relationships and creates tangible trading opportunities that extend well beyond the exhibition itself. The exhibition focuses on the Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) sector, showcasing a broad range of everyday consumer products. Exhibits include food and beverages, cosmetics, manufacturing raw materials, textiles, apparel, and decorative and design products. The offering is complemented by exhibitors from the medical, wellness, pharmaceutical, household goods and accessories sectors. Trade visitors gain a comprehensive overview of current market trends, innovative products, new suppliers and international business opportunities. Engage Trade Africa plays an important role in promoting African international trade by connecting companies from across the continent with global manufacturers, exporters, importers and investors. Durban, the economic hub of South Africa's east coast, provides an ideal setting for the event. The city is home to one of Africa's largest and most important container ports and ranks among the continent's leading trade and logistics centres. Its well-developed infrastructure makes Durban an attractive venue for international trade events while providing convenient access to Africa's rapidly expanding markets. Key features of the exhibition include its exclusive Hosted Buyer Programme, individually arranged B2B meetings, and practical visits to companies and production sites. The primary focus is on facilitating new business opportunities and building sustainable long-term partnerships. Exhibitors primarily represent the food and beverage, consumer goods, cosmetics, textiles, apparel, pharmaceutical, medical, wellness, household goods, and manufacturing and supply industries. The event attracts international buyers, trading companies, importers, exporters, wholesalers, retailers, distributors, as well as senior executives and decision-makers responsible for trade, manufacturing and procurement. The venue is the centrally located Durban Exhibition Centre, situated close to both the city centre and the harbour. King Shaka International Airport is approximately 30 to 40 minutes away by car. With excellent transport links, a wide range of nearby hotels and comprehensive visitor services, the venue provides an ideal environment for international exhibitors and trade professionals.

The Fruit Attraction is one of the most significant international trade fairs for the fruit and vegetable sector, held annually at the Feria de Madrid, Spain's capital. Every October, this prestigious event becomes a hub for professionals across the fruit sector's entire value chain. It gathers producers, marketers, distributors, retailers, and other industry experts to explore the latest trends, innovations, and technologies. Spain ranks amongst the top producers and exporters of fruits and vegetables in both Europe and globally. Staples such as citrus fruits, olives, grapes, tomatoes, and peppers, vital for many nations, are predominantly sourced from Spain. The tradition of cultivating fruits and vegetables is deeply ingrained in Spanish culture. Various regions and communities in Spain have preserved unique varieties and cultivation techniques passed down through generations. Over the past few decades, the sector has made significant investments in research and development. These investments aim to enhance productivity, champion sustainable farming practices, and elevate product quality. Of late, there's been a pronounced emphasis on adopting sustainable farming techniques, with the objective of minimising the ecological footprint and preserving biodiversity. This shift is apparent in the rising number of farms that are both organic and environmentally-conscious. The Fruit Attraction occupies several halls within the Feria de Madrid, enabling exhibitors, both national and international, to present their products and services to a diverse audience. The event's scope isn't limited to the buying and selling of fresh produce. It also includes the introduction of machinery, technologies, packaging solutions, and other services pertinent to the fruit industry. Furthermore, the Fruit Attraction emphasises the exchange of knowledge and networking. A comprehensive program of lectures, seminars, and workshops ensures participants are updated on current market insights, consumer trends, and sustainable farming approaches. In essence, the Fruit Attraction at the Feria de Madrid isn't merely a trade fair. It serves as an expansive platform, consolidating stakeholders from the fruit and vegetable sector, fostering business collaborations, and offering a unique lens through which one can observe the nuances of this vibrant market.

The "Alimentaria FoodTech" is an international trade fair specializing in technologies, machinery, and ingredients used in the food and beverage industry. Since its establishment in 1984 by Alimentaria Exhibitions S.A., it has become a key event in this sector. The fair is held at the Gran Via Venue of Fira de Barcelona in Spain and takes place every three years. The name "Alimentaria FoodTech" reflects the focus of the fair: "Alimentaria" pertains to all aspects of food, while "FoodTech" emphasizes the focus on technology and innovation in the food sector. This event serves as a central meeting point for professionals from the food and beverage industry, covering a wide range of topics including food processing, ingredients, packaging, Industry 4.0, food safety, refrigeration technology, as well as handling, storage, and logistics. Exhibitors present a variety of products and services. These include equipment and machinery for food processing and preservation, technological solutions for automation and digitalization of production processes, and consumables for food safety and hygiene. The fair is not only locally significant for Barcelona and Spain but also holds international relevance, offering comprehensive insights into the latest trends and innovations in food technology. A special highlight of the Alimentaria FoodTech are the various activities and competitions focused on innovation and research. These include the FoodTech Innovarena, the Ingrenova area, and the awarding of the FoodTech Innova and Emprende Awards, which support research and entrepreneurship in the industry. The fair attracts exhibitors and visitors from different segments of the food and beverage industry, including manufacturers, suppliers, distributors, and professionals from research and development. Visitors have the opportunity to learn about the latest technologies and innovations and to establish business contacts. Finally, it is worth mentioning that the venue, the Gran Via Venue of Fira de Barcelona, is easily accessible due to its excellent transport connections. Located in one of Europe's most dynamic cities, it makes the fair particularly attractive to international visitors. Thus, the Alimentaria FoodTech not only offers a platform for professional exchange and business opportunities but also the chance to experience the cultural diversity and hospitality of Barcelona.

The OLMA , officially known as Olma Messen St. Gallen , is the largest and most popular public fair in Switzerland, with its origins dating back to 1943. The Olma Messen St. Gallen AG not only acts as the organizer of this impressive fair but is also involved in the planning and execution of other significant events in the region. Located in the heart of St. Gallen, a city steeped in history and agricultural tradition, the fair takes place annually in October and spans an exciting eleven days. Throughout this period, a broad range of topics related to agriculture and nutrition are showcased. This includes animal exhibits, animal demonstrations, special displays, and information booths. Moreover, visitors have the opportunity to taste, try out, compare, and purchase a wide variety of products and services from areas such as living, construction, machinery, and many others. A particular highlight of the fair are the captivating animal presentations, special exhibitions, and an entertaining program of events. Not to be forgotten is the annual appearance of the guest canton, which consistently brings variety and fresh impulses. With around 650 exhibitors occupying a total area of over 49,000 square meters, OLMA attracts more than 350,000 visitors each year. The fairgrounds where the OLMA takes place are not just a central hub for events in St. Gallen but are also easily accessible and boast modern infrastructure in a city rich in tradition. In conclusion, the OLMA in St. Gallen is not merely a fair, but a vibrant folk festival that brings together people from various sectors and interest groups year after year. It serves as a place of exchange, learning, and celebration amidst the picturesque backdrop of St. Gallen.

The "agrofood West Africa" is a prestigious trade fair. It serves as a central platform for business and networking in the fields of agriculture, livestock farming, food technology, beverages, and packaging in West Africa. The fair is held biennially and changes its location to reach a wide audience from various regions of West Africa. The "agrofood West Africa" is organized by Fairtrade Messe und Ausstellungs GmbH & Co. KG, a company known for hosting high-quality fairs and exhibitions. The main themes of the fair are diverse and cover areas such as agriculture, livestock farming, food and beverage technology, and hospitality. Exhibitors present products and services in the categories of "Agro", "Food + Bev Tec", "Ingredients", and "Food + Hospitality". The range of offerings includes equipment for livestock, fish, and poultry farming, storage systems, feeding equipment, and grain systems, as well as irrigation systems, dairy processing equipment, and veterinary syringes. Additionally, food processing machines, bottling plants, slaughterhouses, cooling and freezing facilities, and packaging machines are showcased. Food ingredients such as flavors, butcher's raw materials, sauces, cocoa butter, dyes, distillates, enzymes, vitamins, and minerals are also presented, along with products and services for the hospitality industry, kitchen appliances, and hotel and restaurant equipment. The fair is of great significance to the West African region as it promotes the exchange of technology and expertise in the agricultural industry and brings together foreign exporters and local importers. Highlights of the fair include high-profile conferences and events featuring over 50 international speakers. The exhibitors come from various sectors such as agricultural machinery, food processing, beverage industry, and hospitality. The main visitors are professionals from these sectors, particularly decision-makers, importers, and technology providers looking for new products, services, and business opportunities. The "agrofood West Africa" is part of a series of fairs that contribute to fostering exchange and growth in the respective regions. In conclusion, it should be mentioned that the fair locations are easily accessible depending on the site, and visitors can expect a variety of local attractions and amenities. The changing locations offer the fair a unique opportunity to explore different cities and exhibition centers in West Africa while simultaneously establishing valuable business contacts.

The highlights of the fair are undoubtedly the weekend specials "infa creative" and "infalino," as well as "infa regional" over two weekends. They offer visitors specialized shopping and experiential worlds and are a draw for both young and old every year. The Hannover exhibition grounds, with their modern architecture and spacious areas, serve as the venue for this impressive event.

BioNord is an annual trade fair for organic food, natural cosmetics, and health products. Since its inception in 2004, it has been held at Messe Hamburg. The event is organized by Matthias Deppe und Wolfram Müller OHG , a company known for creating high-quality, topic-specific platforms for the organic trade for over two decades. Each autumn, Hamburg becomes a key meeting point for the organic industry. BioNord is tailored to a professional audience, including natural food retailers, health food stores, organic supermarkets, independent retailers, the foodservice industry, and large-scale consumers. It showcases innovative products, services, and forward-thinking concepts. At its core are organic food and natural cosmetics that meet strict ecological standards and are certified according to the guidelines of the Bundesverband Naturkost Naturwaren (BNN) or the Reformhaus eG. What sets BioNord apart is its depth of content. The fair is more than just a venue for product presentation—it is a platform for dialogue. Expert talks, discussion forums, and educational campaigns address key industry topics such as sustainable packaging, resource-efficient supply chains, zero-waste shopping, and current trends in the organic sector. This creates a space for exchange, strategic inspiration, and the development of new ideas. Alongside well-known national brands, numerous regional producers, dairies, wineries, and beekeepers are represented, adding an authentic, artisanal touch to the event. The exhibition is further enriched by a dedicated area called “ReformWelt,” which features high-quality health products. This allows BioNord to serve not only the organic trade but also the health product sector and organic gastronomy. BioNord is part of a nationwide family of trade fairs, which includes BioSüd in Augsburg, BioWest in Düsseldorf, and BioOst in Leipzig. Together, these events cover the full geographic spectrum of the German organic trade—but BioNord remains distinctive thanks to its strong regional ties to Northern Germany. Messe Hamburg, with its modern infrastructure, provides ideal conditions for trade visitors from across the country. Centrally located and easily accessible by public transport, highway, or air, it offers a convenient and inspiring setting. Attending BioNord means more than visiting a trade fair—it means becoming part of a movement that connects quality, responsibility, and innovation.

FiT Japan is the country’s premier trade fair for food ingredients, additives, and technological advancements in the food industry. Held annually at the renowned Tokyo Big Sight exhibition center, it brings together national and international experts to showcase the latest trends and innovations in flavor, quality, and sustainability within the food sector. The event is organized by Informa Markets Japan Co., Ltd. , a globally recognized leader in trade fairs and business platforms. The unique significance of FiT Japan lies in its focused approach to technologies and solutions that not only enhance taste but also ensure product quality throughout the entire value chain. As the only exhibition in Japan dedicated specifically to the functional impact and technological evolution of food ingredients, FiT Japan serves as a key meeting point for product developers, buyers, R&D departments, and decision-makers in the global food and beverage industry. FiT Japan covers a broad yet clearly defined range of topics, spanning from food additives such as sweeteners, flavorings, natural colorants, gelling and acidifying agents to natural ingredients like grains, legumes, herbs, fermented products, and alternative raw materials. Cutting-edge technologies for the sensory evaluation of taste, texture, aroma, and appearance are also featured – including aroma analyzers, texture measurement devices, colorimeters, and specialized software for taste testing. A particular highlight is the dedicated area for fermented ingredients, where the health benefits and flavor-enhancing potential of fermented raw materials are placed in the spotlight. Complementing this is a forward-looking special exhibition on alternative materials, addressing challenges such as resource scarcity and rising raw material costs. Exhibitors represent the entire food production value chain – from raw material manufacturers and technology providers to service partners in contract manufacturing and OEM. Visitors primarily include professionals from product development, quality assurance, research, and procurement – both from Japan and international markets. The event is aimed at key decision-makers in food processing, beverage production, distribution, and retail. As part of the global "Fi" (Food Ingredients) event portfolio – with sister shows in Europe, China, and Southeast Asia – FiT Japan is not only a leading event in Japan but also an integral part of the international food industry network. It plays a vital role in advancing the global food sector, with a particular emphasis on the Asian market and Japan’s strong innovation capabilities. Tokyo Big Sight, Japan’s largest and most modern exhibition complex, is conveniently accessible from both Haneda International Airport and central Tokyo. Situated in the heart of this dynamic metropolis and global innovation hub, FiT Japan provides the ideal platform for dialogue on the future of food.

The Mer & Vigne Annecy-le-Vieux fair is a unique showcase of French culinary culture. Held annually at the Espace Rencontre in the charming town of Annecy-le-Vieux, it invites visitors into a world of gastronomic discovery. The name—derived from the French words “Mer” (sea) and “Vigne” (vine)—is more than a title; it reflects the fair’s essence: the celebration of maritime delicacies paired with fine wine. Organized by the experienced Mer & Vigne SARL, the event has built a strong reputation through high-quality fairs dedicated to French gourmet culture. The timing in autumn is deliberate—when regional products reach their peak and the variety of fresh ingredients is at its richest. The fair showcases seafood specialties, artisanal products, and a wide selection of French wines. Carefully chosen delicacies from other European regions add a rich international dimension, making the event a meeting point for gourmets and professionals from both France and abroad. Yet Mer & Vigne is more than just a gourmet fair. It strengthens regional food craftsmanship, supports local producers, and highlights the culinary heritage of Savoy. Competitions and awards honor outstanding achievements in taste, craftsmanship, and innovation. Exhibitors represent sectors such as fishing, agriculture, winemaking, and artisanal food production. The audience includes professionals from gastronomy, trade, and manufacturing, as well as passionate food enthusiasts seeking unique experiences. As part of a nationwide event series, Mer & Vigne brings the richness and diversity of French culinary art to various regions, combining strong local ties with broad national appeal. The Espace Rencontre provides the perfect setting: modern facilities, excellent transport connections, and a location nestled between the Alps and Lake Annecy—an ideal backdrop for a celebration of the senses. Those looking to experience French cuisine in all its depth and excellence will find here a place where quality, authenticity, and passion come together.

Aux Vignobles! is an annual wine and gourmet fair that stands out for its combination of regional authenticity, professional expertise, and direct contact with producers. It caters to both industry professionals and private wine enthusiasts and takes place in several French cities, including Chartres, Angers, Biarritz, and Brest. In Chartres, the event is held at the Parc Expo l’Illiade – a well-connected exhibition center offering ideal conditions for tastings, conversations, and sales. The fair is organized by GL Events Exhibitions Opérations, a renowned event organizer based in Brest, known for many years of experience in staging high-quality consumer exhibitions in the fields of gastronomy and fine living. Formerly known as “Salon Vins & Gastronomie”, the event has been rebranded and conceptually refined to better reflect its focus and identity. At its heart are French wines from the country’s most renowned wine regions – including Bordeaux, Burgundy, Beaujolais, the Rhône Valley, Languedoc, Loire, Sud-Ouest, Provence, and Champagne. The fair serves as a platform for authentic wine experiences, offering visitors the opportunity to meet independent winemakers (“vignerons indépendants”), taste their products, and purchase directly on-site – with no middlemen, full traceability, and expert advice. This direct-to-consumer approach, known as “direct producteur”, is a key feature, enabling not only attractive pricing but also a personal connection to the people behind the wines. Special emphasis is placed on sustainable and certified cultivation methods. Organic wines and wines bearing the HVE (Haute Valeur Environnementale) certification demonstrate that quality and environmental responsibility can go hand in hand. The fair also places importance on wine tourism, which is gaining popularity. In addition to information about the wines, visitors are inspired with ideas for traveling to the producers’ regions and discovering the origins of the wines firsthand. Aux Vignobles! is much more than a traditional wine fair – it offers a multisensory experience. Discovering new grape varieties, comparing different terroirs, and engaging in personal exchanges with winemakers turn the visit into a unique journey of discovery. The experience is further enhanced by a selection of regional delicacies such as cheeses, cured meats, and other specialties that perfectly complement the wines. With its blend of high-quality offerings, expert guidance, direct access to producers, and a genuine French lifestyle atmosphere, “Aux Vignobles!” sets itself apart from conventional trade fairs. Appealing to both connoisseurs and newcomers, it impresses with regional diversity and transparency – and, with its clear focus on enjoyment, knowledge, and connection, has become an unmissable event for anyone wishing to experience French wine culture up close.

The SIAL Paris, a biennial trade fair first held in 1964, is recognized as the world's leading food exhibition. Exclusively for professionals in the food industry, it takes place in even-numbered years each October at the prestigious Paris-Nord Villepinte Exhibition Center. Organized by Comexposium, one of the world's leading event organizers, the fair underscores the significance and global influence of the SIAL. As a global platform, SIAL Paris offers a unique opportunity to explore the latest innovations and trends in the food industry. Exhibitors from around the world showcase a wide range of products—ranging from frozen foods and ready-made meals to organic goods and specialty products for specific dietary needs, such as gluten-free or dietetic foods. Special emphasis is placed on sustainability and sustainable development, which are becoming increasingly important. Companies focusing on these aspects receive particular attention, making the fair a crucial platform for forward-looking business practices. Among the highlights of the exhibition is the In-Food Centre, where semi-finished products, ingredients, and equipment for food processing are showcased. Another key attraction is the "La Cuisine" area, which draws visitors with live culinary demonstrations, a VIP restaurant, and a culinary photo exhibition. Located near Paris, the Paris-Nord Villepinte Exhibition Center provides excellent infrastructure and is easily accessible, making it an ideal venue for international visitors. With a comprehensive range of topics and products, SIAL Paris sets the standard in the food industry, offering an unparalleled opportunity for professionals to network, learn, and be inspired.
