Founded in 2002, the National Women's Show is a semi-annual trade fair designed especially for women, focusing on a broad spectrum of female interests and needs. It is organized by the National Event Management Inc. and distinguishes itself with a diverse and vibrant mix of various thematic areas. The fair takes place in two different locations in Ottawa: at the Ernst & Young Center in the fall and at the Shaw Center in the spring. Both venues provide a platform for numerous products and services, spanning the fields of food and wine, fashion, health, as well as wellness and beauty. The offerings range from conventional to organic and natural cosmetics, skincare, and fragrances from classic and new brands, through professional makeup, haircare, and nail care products, to high-quality styling tools such as straighteners, curling irons, and hair extensions. In addition to focusing on physical products, the travel and experience section also presents a variety of offers like golf, fitness clubs, adventure sports, and spa retreats. Therefore, the fair addresses women of all age groups and industries and provides relevant content for both private individuals and professional visitors from the beauty, wellness, and health sectors. The fair not only creates a unique shopping experience but also an opportunity for learning and discovery. A special highlight includes the learning and culinary phases, where experts talk about various topics such as financial planning, health, or vacation, and renowned chefs share their skills and knowledge. Additional musical performances, dance studios, and fashion shows make the event an experience for all senses. However, the National Women's Show is not only present in Ottawa. It is part of a series of events that also take place in other Canadian cities like Toronto, Montreal, Calgary, and Quebec City. Thus, the fair contributes to bringing together companies and products from various regions and industries of the country and therefore also represents an important networking platform. The fair offers an unparalleled opportunity for companies and brands to directly engage with their target group, present products, and receive direct feedback. Both local and supra-regional exhibitors are present, making the fair an important event for the entire industry in Canada. In conclusion, it's worth noting that the National Women's Show is a significant event for the female population and the companies operating in the themed industries. Ottawa, as the capital of Canada, not only offers impressive locations with the Ernst & Young Center and the Shaw Center but also excellent accessibility and a myriad of opportunities to experience Canadian culture and hospitality. Visitors and exhibitors thus enjoy not only a comprehensive fair but also a charming city with a diverse offering.

The Moncalvo Truffle Fair, an annual truffle event, is a staple on the cultural calendar of Moncalvo, a picturesque tourist town in Piedmont. Established in 1955, it has since grown into one of the leading events in the region, bringing together the best of culinary delights and cultural experiences. Moncalvo, situated in Piedmont, has a deep historical and cultural connection to truffles. Piedmont, especially its hilly and wooded areas, is renowned for its abundant production of truffles, with the White Truffle of Alba being especially famous. However, areas like Moncalvo also have a long tradition in truffle hunting and processing. Being a part of Piedmont, Moncalvo lies in a region that offers favorable climatic and geological conditions for truffle growth. The mixture of limestone soil, regular rainfall, and the cover of deciduous forests creates an ideal environment for truffles. The Moncalvo Truffle Fair is held annually on the last two Sundays of October. The central venue is Piazza Carlo Alberto, the vibrant heart of Moncalvo. This square, rich in history and charm, becomes the stage for a fair that blends the character of a market with a touch of festivity. Behind this event is the Comune di Moncalvo, the local municipality, which proudly and passionately maintains this tradition, ensuring its growth and prosperity year after year. The fair primarily celebrates the culinary treasure that is the truffle, but it also extends to other edible fungi and regional specialties. Visitors can look forward to a selection of cheese, wine, baked goods, and many other delicacies from the region. Besides purchasing fresh truffles and other delights, visitors also have the opportunity to taste these specialties. This offers a fantastic chance to truly experience the flavors and tastes of Piedmont. A special highlight of the fair is the award ceremony for the best truffle of the year, a competition that brings together the best truffle hunters and suppliers from the region. What sets the Moncalvo Truffle Fair apart from other events is its combination of top-tier culinary experiences with folkloric performances set against the picturesque backdrop of a small Italian town. Not only do locals flock to the fair, but it also attracts many tourists. Many travel agencies even offer specialized gourmet trips to the Truffle Fair, targeted specifically at food connoisseurs. The Moncalvo Truffle Fair is an experience – a tribute to the rich culinary and cultural tradition of Piedmont. For anyone wanting to experience authentic Italy, this event is a must-attend date on the calendar.

Saudi Aquaculture is the leading trade fair for the aquaculture industry in Saudi Arabia and forms an integral part of the renowned Saudi Agriculture, which has been the flagship event for agriculture, livestock, and food processing in the Middle East for over four decades. Held annually at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Centre (RICEC) – a state-of-the-art venue that combines international standards with regional relevance – the event is organized by Riyadh Exhibitions Company Ltd., one of the country’s foremost trade show organizers. Exclusively designed for industry professionals, the event provides a comprehensive overview of the entire aquaculture value chain – from breeding and processing to marketing and logistics. It targets decision-makers, investors, aquaculture operators, and political and economic stakeholders involved in building a sustainable, locally rooted seafood and fisheries sector in Saudi Arabia. At its core, the fair showcases advanced technologies and innovations tailored to the region’s specific climatic and ecological conditions. A particular highlight is the presentation of Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS) – closed-loop systems that drastically reduce water consumption, enabling sustainable fish farming far from coastal areas. The exhibition also features automated feeding systems, premium fish feed, cutting-edge hatchery technology, and specialized solutions for genetic optimization and breeding. Another key focus is aquaculture health and disease management. The fair presents a wide array of vaccines, pharmaceuticals, diagnostic tools, and digital monitoring systems. These are complemented by modern biosecurity concepts aimed at preventing disease outbreaks and ensuring both animal welfare and production reliability. In the areas of processing, packaging, and logistics, Saudi Aquaculture offers a broad range of solutions – including automated filleting and slaughtering systems, innovative packaging technologies such as Modified Atmosphere Packaging (MAP), and intelligent cold chain logistics for domestic and international markets. Sustainability and environmental management are also central themes. Featured technologies include advanced water treatment systems, alternative feeds based on insects or algae, and tools for measuring and reducing environmental impact. In a region where water and natural resources are particularly scarce, the event provides concrete answers to some of today’s most pressing challenges. With its clear focus on innovation, efficiency, and sustainability, Saudi Aquaculture is more than just a trade fair – it is a strategic platform supporting the transformation of Saudi Arabia’s food production landscape. It serves as an annual gathering point for thought leaders, investors, and pioneers shaping the future of aquaculture in the Middle East.

The China-Portuguese-Speaking Countries Economic and Trade Expo (C-PLEX) is an internationally oriented trade fair that has established itself as a key platform for economic and trade exchange between China and Portuguese-speaking countries. Held annually at the prestigious Venetian Macao Resort Hotel Convention & Exhibition Center, the event takes place in a state-of-the-art exhibition venue located in the heart of Macao, renowned for its excellent infrastructure, global accessibility, and role as a bridge between East and West. C-PLEX is organized by the Macao Trade and Investment Promotion Institute in collaboration with Macao Expo Group Co., Ltd. Together, they create an environment that fosters sustainable economic cooperation. The expo combines in-depth specialization with a broad thematic scope. It focuses on forward-looking sectors such as cross-border e-commerce, renewable energy, agriculture, food production, professional services, and the blue economy—a field that encompasses marine resources, maritime innovation, and sustainable use. Showcased are both traditional goods and highly innovative products and services from China and nine Portuguese-speaking countries, including Brazil, Angola, Portugal, and Mozambique. C-PLEX stands out for its clear focus and unique positioning: it is the only event of its kind worldwide dedicated exclusively to economic collaboration between China and the Lusophone world. Companies, investors, government representatives, and industry professionals from a wide range of sectors—from trade, logistics, and IT to agribusiness and sustainable technologies—use the expo strategically for business development, market insight, and networking. Exhibitors range from established corporations and dynamic start-ups to government institutions and chambers of commerce. The trade fair is complemented by a diverse supporting program that includes investment forums, industry meetings, matchmaking sessions, and advisory services. These formats are specifically designed to support market entry and the development of joint projects in partner countries. International visitors can easily access the venue via Macao International Airport or by high-speed ferry from Hong Kong. The Venetian Macao Resort Hotel also offers premium accommodation, modern conference facilities, and a wide array of leisure options—all under one roof—creating ideal conditions for productive exhibition days and long-term business success. 개최장소(베뉴): Palais des Congrés et des Expositions
박람회설명:
Once a year, the Palais des Congrès et des Expositions in Saint-Brieuc, in the heart of Brittany, transforms into a gathering place for true connoisseurs. Aux Vignobles! – formerly known as “Salon Vins & Gastronomie” – is a unique French fair dedicated to wine, gastronomy, and regional specialties. Held every autumn, the event attracts both professionals and private enthusiasts from across the country, all united by their passion for quality, taste, and authentic craftsmanship. The fair is organized by GL Events Exhibitions Opérations, based in Brest, a seasoned organizer of high-quality consumer exhibitions. With “Aux Vignobles!” they succeed in bringing together the diversity of France’s wine and culinary culture in one place – an ideal opportunity to discover and experience the richness of the country’s terroirs. The offerings range from wines from all major regions, such as Bordeaux, Burgundy, Provence, and the Loire Valley, to exquisite delicacies including cheese, charcuterie, chocolate, and foie gras. The selection is complemented by organic products and goods from sustainable agriculture, often certified with environmental labels such as HVE – a clear commitment to responsibility toward both the environment and consumers. A defining feature of the fair is the direct contact with producers. Visitors can taste on-site and purchase their discoveries immediately, often at particularly attractive prices. This closeness between producer and consumer lends authenticity to the event and fosters trust. For those who wish not only to taste but also to immerse themselves in the culture of wine, “Aux Vignobles!” offers inspiring insights into oenotourism – a blend of wine, culture, and the experience of landscapes. Thematic tours, such as a dedicated organic route, guide visitors through the diverse offerings and provide a structured way to explore the fair. Despite its national scope, each edition – including the one in Saint-Brieuc – retains its own identity with a regional focus. The fair thrives on local character, French hospitality, and the shared enthusiasm for fine flavors. With just one admission ticket valid for the entire duration, visitors are free to experience the event at their own pace – whether through a leisurely exploration or by returning to discover new favorites.

The Good Food & Wine Show Brisbane is an annual culinary event that has established itself as a special highlight for food lovers and connoisseurs. Since joining the national event series in 2005, it has been held at the Brisbane Convention & Exhibition Centre (BCEC), a modern venue located in the heart of South Bank – the city’s cultural and gastronomic hub. With its excellent infrastructure and central location, the BCEC provides the perfect setting for a show that combines fine food and drink with entertainment, education, and direct encounters with producers. The show was first launched in Melbourne in 2001 and quickly developed into a nationwide success. Today, it forms part of a series of events also hosted in Sydney, Melbourne, and Perth. It is organized by Diversified Exhibitions Australia, an experienced event company specializing in both trade and consumer formats, with a focus on connecting industries, opening up markets, and showcasing innovation. The Good Food & Wine Show Brisbane appeals to both passionate consumers and industry professionals. Rather than serving primarily as a sales platform, it presents itself as a multisensory experience that celebrates food, drink, and culinary culture. At its core are the opportunities to connect directly with producers, experience culinary processes live, and gain knowledge in an engaging and entertaining way. One of the show’s main attractions is the series of live cooking demonstrations featuring well-known Australian chefs. These sessions not only showcase culinary skill but also offer audiences practical tips and personal insights into each chef’s philosophy. Another highlight is the Wine & Beverage Zone, where visitors can taste premium wines, craft beers, ciders, and spirits while speaking directly with winemakers and producers. The focus goes beyond individual products, highlighting entire wine regions such as the Barossa Valley, Margaret River, McLaren Vale, and the Granite Belt, each with its own geographic, cultural, and tourism identity. The event also features a wide selection of street food, gourmet products, cheese, chocolate, and delicacies. Guests can enhance their experience by joining paid masterclasses and workshops led by experts, covering topics such as wine pairing, cocktail making, and advanced cooking techniques. Visitors also have the chance to meet culinary personalities in person, collecting autographs and photos during post-show meet-and-greets. A distinctive element of the show is the strong involvement of food artisans and producers, who share insights into their craft, explain production processes, and communicate the philosophy behind their products. This direct exchange creates an authentic experience and emphasizes the event’s focus on quality, regional identity, and innovation. More than just a consumer fair, the Good Food & Wine Show Brisbane is an interactive celebration of taste that brings together gastronomy, learning, and entertainment at a high level – an annual highlight for anyone who not only enjoys food and drink, but also wants to understand, experience, and share them.

The ZUGER MESSE in Zug is an institution, recognized as the largest and most successful autumn exhibition for trade and commerce in Central Switzerland. Since its inception in 1962, it has continuously evolved, becoming today an impressive showcase of products and services spanning a wide array of sectors. Organized by Messe Zug AG, it takes place annually in October at the Stierenmarktareal exhibition grounds, a venue ideally suited for such a major event due to its expansive space and excellent connectivity. The extensive range of the fair includes topics such as health, beauty, wellness, culture, tourism, sports, leisure, and much more. The offerings span from the latest fashion trends, jewelry, and accessories to everything related to living, kitchen, bathroom, and household, extending to construction, renovation, and multimedia. Various associations, political parties, and institutions also utilize this platform to present themselves to a broad audience. A special highlight of the ZUGER MESSE is the daily performances in the show hall. Visitors can be delighted and surprised by fashion shows, Dixie matinees, and many other attractions. These varied presentations spotlight the products and services, offering a unique experience that appeals to all the senses. For those arriving by car, there are several parking options available, including the Siemens parking garage and Siemens North. A convenient shuttle service ensures a smooth transfer between the parking facilities and the exhibition grounds. In summary, the ZUGER MESSE is not just a simple exhibition but an experience. Its unique selling point lies in the combination of a vast array of products and services, captivating presentations, and the unique atmosphere created by blending tradition and modernity. It's a must-visit for anyone wishing to experience the best of trade and commerce in Central Switzerland.

More than just a trade fair, VIMAR is a vibrant platform that celebrates and promotes the diversity and excellence of Andalusia’s wine and seafood industries—an unmissable event for professionals and enthusiasts alike.

The Gastrónoma is a renowned Mediterranean Gastronomic Fair, held annually at the Feria de Valencia in Valencia. The fair is organized by Feria Valencia. As the most prominent event of its kind in this region, it revitalizes and strengthens the entire value chain of gastronomy. Here, innovative products and services ranging from machinery and equipment for the food industry to the finest culinary creations and beverages are presented. In conclusion, it should be emphasized that the Feria de Valencia, with its modern infrastructure and accessibility, is the ideal venue for such a prestigious event. Valencia itself, with its rich history and culture, provides the perfect backdrop for a fair that celebrates the finest culinary offerings of the Mediterranean.

FoodTech in Herning is a pivotal meeting point for innovations in the food industry and the largest trade fair for Scandinavian food manufacturers and their suppliers in Northern Europe. This trade fair, exclusively for industry professionals, takes place biennially in the fall and lasts three days. Since its inception in 1997, FoodTech has established itself as an international platform that provides professionals with exclusive insights into the latest developments and technologies. The event is held at the MCH Messecenter Herning, one of Denmark's leading exhibition centers, equipped with modern facilities and flexible space configurations, ideal for large-scale events of this nature. FoodTech focuses on specialized areas such as machinery for food processing and packaging solutions, showcasing advanced trends, including 3D printing technology in the food sector. A highlight of the fair is the International Food Contest, a competitive platform that rewards quality and innovation in the food industry. The program is complemented by the IFC Water Congress, which addresses issues of water and energy, and also features industry-specific lectures and tours. Another standout is the Danish 3D Printing Championship, which challenges the creativity and technical skills of participants. With its comprehensive offerings, FoodTech reaffirms its role as a key driver of progress and networking in the food industry, positioning itself as a unique event tailored specifically to the needs of the sector. It is an indispensable event for anyone interested in the future of food technology and production.

WorldFood Ukraine is the leading trade fair for food and beverages in Ukraine. It takes place annually at the International Exhibition Center (IEC) in Kyiv, the country's capital, and is organized by Premier Expo – a seasoned organizer of international trade exhibitions. The event is exclusively aimed at trade visitors and serves as a key platform for companies, producers, traders, distributors, retailers, and industry experts from across the food and beverage sector in Eastern Europe. Its distinctive profile stems from a holistic concept that goes beyond a traditional product showcase. In addition to presenting current trends and innovations, the fair features a diverse supporting program with expert talks, seminars, workshops, tastings, and business events. These formats specifically address the current challenges and opportunities within the industry. A highlight of the event is the annual “Novelty Alley”, where new products that have not yet reached the market are presented exclusively. This area offers visitors early insights into developments that could shape future market dynamics – a real advantage for innovation-driven businesses. Technological innovations also play a central role. Topics such as packaging, logistics, raw materials, ingredients, retail solutions, shopfitting, IT systems, and marketing services are firmly integrated into the event. This comprehensive approach maps the entire value chain – from production to the point of sale – and attracts a wide range of participants, including service providers and technology suppliers. Thanks to its in-depth content, clear focus on trade professionals, and strategically advantageous location in Kyiv, WorldFood Ukraine serves as an international hub for business development, industry networking, and market analysis in the Eastern European region. With its emphasis on innovation, quality, and business growth, it is far more than a trade fair – it is a pivotal meeting point for decision-makers in the food industry seeking new impulses, partnerships, and opportunities for expansion.

The Cibus Tec in Parma is among the most significant and long-standing exhibitions in the field of food technology. Since its inception in May 1939, it has established itself as a staple on the calendar for international professionals. The fair is organized by Koeln Parma Exhibitions Srl, a joint venture between the renowned Koelnmesse GmbH and Fiere di Parma SpA. "Cibus" is the Latin word for "food" or "meal". When combined with "Tec", short for "technology", the name "Cibus Tec" translates to "Food Technology". The event's name, therefore, reflects its focus and specialization on technologies and solutions for the food industry. Cibus Tec typically operates on a triennial cycle, attracting a wide, international professional audience. Attendees seek information on the latest technologies and solutions related to the harvesting, processing, and packaging of foods like vegetables, fruits, and dairy. But the exhibition offers more than just product showcases. Numerous conferences and summit meetings provide a platform for international experts to reflect upon and discuss current market situations, future trends, and challenges. A distinctive feature of the exhibition is its location in the district of Parma, known for its high concentration of food and technology companies. This regional grounding in a technologically and economically important area lends the exhibition particular significance. The Fiere di Parma exhibition grounds not only offer ample space for such a vast showcase but also boast modern infrastructure that delights exhibitors and visitors alike. Every time the gates of Cibus Tec open, visitors are greeted by an impressive array of products and services from the food technology sector, always mirroring the industry's current trends and needs. In conclusion, Cibus Tec in Parma isn't merely an exhibition; it's also a platform for innovation, knowledge transfer, and networking – a place where the future of food technology takes shape.

Agro2Food is an annual trade fair held in the heart of Ukraine, firmly established as a key platform for the food processing and agricultural industries. With its clear thematic focus, it serves as a central meeting point for decision-makers, innovators, and professionals across the entire food value chain. The event is organized by Premier Expo, one of Ukraine’s leading trade fair organizers with an international outlook. Hot Pots World is a specialised international trade fair dedicated entirely to the global hot pot industry and its full value chain. As a clearly B2B-focused platform, it is designed for decision-makers seeking market-ready solutions, new suppliers and scalable business models. The event takes place at the renowned Bangkok International Trade & Exhibition Centre (BITEC) in Thailand—a strategically chosen hub for Southeast Asia’s rapidly expanding markets. It is organised by Baobab Tree Event Management Co. Ltd., an experienced operator with a strong track record in international food and hospitality formats. The company is known for developing targeted industry platforms that go beyond product showcases to facilitate tangible business opportunities. What sets Hot Pots World apart is the depth of its content. The exhibition spans the entire hot pot supply chain—from premium ingredients such as high-grade beef, specialised vegetable varieties and innovative protein alternatives, through to differentiated soup bases, sauces and complementary beverage concepts. A particular emphasis is placed on product innovation tailored to emerging consumer segments, especially Generation Z in Southeast Asia. Alongside this, the event features advanced kitchen technologies, including automated preparation systems, robotics for foodservice operations and digital tools designed to enhance restaurant efficiency. Packaging and sustainability form another core pillar of the exhibition. Visitors can explore commercially viable solutions for eco-friendly packaging, as well as scalable takeaway and delivery concepts. In doing so, the event directly addresses the growing demand for sustainable business models across the entire supply chain. This is complemented by dedicated formats covering foodservice, franchising and expansion, bringing together investors, restaurant operators and international buyers to support efficient market entry strategies across the ASEAN region. The visitor profile is equally targeted, comprising restaurant chain operators, franchisors, importers, wholesalers and strategic investors, all focused on forging partnerships and closing deals. As such, Hot Pots World functions not only as an innovation platform but also as a highly focused marketplace for growth. BITEC offers state-of-the-art facilities, excellent connections to Bangkok’s public transport network, and convenient access from both the international airport and the city centre—reinforcing the global ambitions of Hot Pots World.

Aux Vignobles! is a vibrant experience for connoisseurs, born from the “Salon Vins & Gastronomie”, an annual event that draws wine lovers and industry professionals to Rennes. As part of a nationwide series with over 40 editions throughout France, the fair is among the most renowned platforms for showcasing French wine culture and regional gastronomy. It is organized by GL events Exhibitions – Division VIN & GASTRONOMIE, based in Brest, one of the country’s leading trade show organizers in the field of culinary arts and lifestyle. Held at the Rennes Parc Expo, a modern exhibition center with excellent transport connections and spacious halls, the event brings together winemakers from all major French wine regions. They present their wines in person – from traditional classics and organic vintages to innovative creations like craft beers and regional discoveries. This direct interaction with the producers creates an authentic, almost familial atmosphere, making the fair a truly special experience. For many attendees, this personal connection is precisely what brings them back year after year. But it’s not just about wine: “Aux Vignobles!” transforms into a “marketplace of flavors”, where selected regional specialties – from artisan cheeses and cured meats to fine foods and sweet delicacies – invite visitors to taste and purchase. The variety of high-quality, small-scale products, far removed from industrial mass production, appeals to both discerning food lovers and professional restaurateurs, reflecting the French passion for authenticity and quality. A standout feature is the temporary gourmet restaurant “Le Cépages”, created exclusively for the fair. Here, guests enjoy à la carte dishes expertly paired with wines featured at the event. The culinary offering is further enhanced by an educational program of workshops and masterclasses, providing in-depth insights into grape varieties, terroirs, and sensory analysis – a must for anyone looking to deepen their understanding of wine. For more relaxed moments of indulgence, the “L’Echanson” area offers live music, a convivial atmosphere, and a good glass of wine to round off the fair experience. Aux Vignobles! in Rennes is far more than a typical consumer fair – it’s an encounter with French terroir in all its diversity. Authentic, inspiring, and full of flavor, it offers a unique opportunity to meet producers, receive expert advice, and discover new culinary experiences – all in one place that has become a favorite annual meeting point for food and wine enthusiasts as well as industry professionals.

박람회설명:
The "Salon Vins et Terroirs Toulouse" expo is a significant event in the world of wine and gourmet foods, with a focus on the culinary treasures of the region. The expo's name can be translated as the "Wine and Terroirs Salon of Toulouse", where "Terroirs" is a French term denoting the unique combination of climate, soil, and landscape that characterizes a specific wine-growing area. This biannual expo takes place at the esteemed MEETT - Parc des Expositions et Centre de Conventions in Aussonne, France. Organized by "Toulouse expo", the "Salon Vins et Terroirs Toulouse" not only showcases a remarkable selection of wines to its visitors but also offers a wide array of agricultural products, emphasizing its deep connection to the region and its significance for the local economy. A primary feature of the expo is gourmet products, which represent the diversity and quality of the French culinary scene. Highlights of the event include a wine-tasting workshop by Art of Wines, a Food Court, a farmer's market, and a gourmet bookstore. Special events, such as wine auctions, are a major draw for both exhibitors and attendees. Wine is an integral part of French culture and identity. Through its presentations, the expo accentuates this aspect and celebrates this culture. The majority of exhibitors hail from the wine and gourmet food industry, catering to both professionals in the field and enthusiasts alike. The Haute-Garonne region, where the exhibition takes place, benefits from its location within the expansive wine territory of Southwest France, boasting a rich wine tradition and history. The Fronton wine region, situated north of Toulouse, is particularly renowned for its grape variety called Négrette. This grape imparts red and rosé wines with a distinctive flavor, characterized by notes of violets, red fruits, and occasionally a hint of licorice. To the east of Toulouse, the Gaillac wine region has a storied history that dates back to Roman times. It is recognized for producing a variety of wine styles, including sparkling wines, dry white wines, red wines, and the sweet "Vin de Voile". Duras, Braucol, and Loin de l'Oeil are typical grape varieties of this region. Other noteworthy wine regions in Southwest France include Madiran and Pacherenc du Vic-Bilh. In conclusion, the MEETT - Parc des Expositions et Centre de Conventions in Aussonne impresses not only with its modern architecture but also its easy accessibility. The town of Aussonne itself offers a picturesque setting, making it the perfect place to unwind after an eventful day at the expo.

The fair provides a crucial platform for the presentation and exchange of innovations and trends in these sectors. In conclusion, the Enercare Centre in Exhibition Place in Toronto is not only easily accessible but also serves as a symbolic venue that highlights the significance of this long-standing fair. It embodies a success story that bridges the past and present by celebrating and promoting products from the East. It was originally founded in Berlin in 1991 to provide a new platform for presenting and marketing products from the former GDR that had fallen into oblivion. Located in the picturesque ega-Park Erfurt, known for its rich botanical diversity and as a cultural landmark of the city, the "Christmas Ostpro" offers an atmospheric backdrop for exhibitors and visitors alike. The park complements the fair's theme with its natural beauty, creating an environment that contributes to the contemplative mood of the Christmas season. The fair itself is a tribute to the products of the former GDR, bringing their charm and nostalgia to a wider stage. It was established to enable a renaissance for these unique items that had once been forgotten. With an impressive range of products, from traditional foodstuffs to crafts, clothing, and technical devices, the "Christmas Ostpro" highlights the cultural and commercial significance of these items. A special focus of the fair is on the Christmas theme. Exhibitors offer everything the heart desires to enrich the holiday season: handmade decorations, regional culinary delights, toys, and much more that traditionally characterizes the Christmas period in the new federal states. This thematic focus not only creates a festive atmosphere but also promotes awareness and appreciation for regional specialties. Over the years, the "Christmas Ostpro" has established itself as a mecca for lovers of Eastern products. By reviving iconic brands and emphasizing authenticity and tradition, the fair has succeeded in becoming a phenomenon of cultural renaissance. It has not only brought many products back to store shelves but also fostered a strong regional consciousness that is invaluable in today's globalized world. Visitors to the fair have the exclusive opportunity to immerse themselves in a vibrant historical narrative conveyed through the exhibited products and the passionate stories of the exhibitors. As a consumer fair, the "Christmas Ostpro" is accessible to everyone, offering an interactive, enriching experience that goes beyond mere purchasing. It is a place of learning, celebration, and recognition of the cultural treasures that East Germany has to offer.

The 'Les Automnales' is an annual autumn fair that traditionally takes place in November in Le Grand-Saconnex, near Geneva, hosted by Palexpo SA, a leading company in organizing such large-scale events. This fair, one of the most eagerly anticipated events in the region, is a festive haven that brings color and joy to the gray autumn days. Les Automnales is not just a fair but a vibrant festival aimed at bringing together people of all ages - families, friends, colleagues, and individuals. The event's motto is 'fun, friendly, and interactive.' It provides a unique platform for around 400 retailers to showcase their latest products and services. These range from culinary delights and wines to innovative technological gadgets and home decorations. It's a paradise for enthusiasts, foodies, wine lovers, shopping aficionados, and the curious of all stripes, where even pets are welcome. Among the highlights of the fair are interactive workshops, live demonstrations, educational seminars, and a host of recreational activities aimed at promoting learning, discovery, and fun in a lively and welcoming atmosphere. It's a place where wonder-struck eyes, joyful laughter, and the thrill of discovery fill the halls. The event is held at the renowned Palexpo Geneva, a fair and convention center. Its proximity to Geneva Airport and the connected train station makes it especially accessible to international visitors. Furthermore, Palexpo has direct motorway access to neighboring countries France, Italy, Germany, and other regions of Switzerland, simplifying logistics for exhibitors and visitors significantly.

FISCH&FEINES is a trade fair in Bremen dedicated to sustainable enjoyment and takes place every year in November. Since its founding in 2008, it has developed into the most important event for lovers of high-quality, handcrafted and natural products in the northwest. The trade fair is organized by M3B GmbH, which is committed to providing a platform for over 200 producers and retailers who present their selected foods to an enthusiastic audience. Only products that meet the strict quality criteria of FISCH&FEINES and do not contain any artificial flavors, chemical additives or flavor enhancers are admitted to the trade fair. A wide variety of products and services are offered at FISCH&FEINES. The range of products on offer ranges from fresh fish and seafood to a variety of delicatessen products such as cheese, meat, sausage, jams, chutneys, herbs, spices, salts and dairy products to fruit and vegetables. Drinks lovers will also get their money's worth with a selection of coffee, tea, wine, sparkling wine, beer and spirits. The exhibition offering is rounded off by a selection of cooking accessories, kitchen equipment and various services and informative offers. The focus is on the presentation of regional specialties, traditional manufacturing processes and high-quality products that are free of artificial additives. This trade fair is not only a feast for the senses, but also promotes awareness of sustainable consumption and supports smaller producers in making their passion and craft accessible to a wider audience. Overall, FISCH&FEINES is an indispensable event for connoisseurs and anyone interested in a sustainable lifestyle. It offers a unique opportunity to discover new taste experiences, be inspired by culinary innovations and talk directly to the producers. The CRAFT BEER EVENT has been taking place as part of FISCH&FEINES since 2014. Craft breweries from all over Germany and the Netherlands show that beer can have a lot of flavor. The ReiseLust holiday fair and caravan bremen also take place parallel to FISCH&FEINES, offering visitors an even more comprehensive experience.

The "Salon du BON" is a public fair dedicated to the world of gastronomy, wine, and culinary delights. The name "Salon du BON" reflects the fair's aim to emphasize the outstanding aspects of gastronomy – "BON" meaning "good" or "high quality". It takes place annually at the Grande Halle de la Villette in Paris, a location known for its cultural diversity and significance in the French capital. The Salon du BON is organized by JPC EVENTS in cooperation with renowned chef Thierry Marx and Bon Magazine, also initiated by Marx. The fair's objective is to bring haute cuisine closer to a wide audience. It serves as a platform for esteemed chefs, local producers, and culinary artisans to present their products and services. The main themes of the fair include the art of table setting, quality products, culinary expertise, gastronomic experiments, the art of beverages, and equipment. The fair has a strong connection to the city of Paris, considered one of the world's gastronomic capitals. It offers visitors the opportunity to participate in high-quality tastings, attend entertaining workshops, and meet experts from the culinary world. The exhibitors come from various industries, including gastronomy, viticulture, and culinary crafts. The Salon du BON attracts a broad spectrum of visitors, from experienced gourmets to newcomers in the world of gastronomy. In conclusion, the Grande Halle de la Villette in Paris is not only easily accessible but also possesses a rich history and impressive architecture, which contribute to the overall experience of the fairgoers. Therefore, the Salon du BON is a must-visit for anyone looking to explore the diverse and exquisite world of gastronomy.

The National Women's Show, established in 2002, is an annual trade fair specifically for women, focusing on a broad spectrum of female interests and needs. It's organized by the National Event Management Inc. and is characterized by a diverse and vibrant mix of various thematic areas. The show takes place at the Metro Toronto Convention Centre in Toronto. This venue provides a platform for numerous products and services in the realms of food and wine, fashion, health, as well as wellness and beauty. The offerings range from conventional to organic and natural cosmetics, skincare, fragrances from both classic and new brands, professional make-up, haircare, and nail care products, to high-quality styling tools such as straighteners, curling irons, and hair extensions. In addition to focusing on physical products, the event's travel and experience section also showcases a variety of offerings such as golf, fitness clubs, adventure sports, and spa retreats. Thus, the show appeals to women of all age groups and industries and offers relevant content for both private individuals and professional visitors from the beauty, wellness, and health sectors. The show not only creates a unique shopping experience but also offers opportunities for learning and discovery. A special highlight includes the educational and culinary segments where experts discuss topics ranging from financial planning and health to vacations, and renowned chefs share their skills and knowledge. Additionally, musical performances, dance studios, and fashion shows make the event a sensory delight. The National Women's Show is not exclusive to Toronto. It's part of a series of events that also occur in other Canadian cities like Ottawa, Montreal, Calgary, and Quebec City. As such, the show plays a pivotal role in bringing together businesses and products from various regions and sectors across the country, serving as an essential networking platform. The show presents an unparalleled opportunity for businesses and brands to engage directly with their target audience, showcase their products, and receive immediate feedback. Both local and national exhibitors participate, making the show a key event for the entire industry in Canada. In conclusion, it's worth noting that the National Women's Show is a significant event for the female population and companies operating in the highlighted sectors. Toronto, with the Metro Toronto Convention Centre, not only offers an impressive venue but also boasts excellent accessibility and numerous opportunities to experience Canadian culture and hospitality. Visitors and exhibitors not only enjoy a comprehensive trade fair but also the charm of a vibrant city with a plethora of offerings.

The “ Mer & Vigne ” fair, held at the elegant venue La Palmeraie in La Tour-de-Salvagny, is an impressive tribute to the French way of life and the country’s rich culinary heritage. The name of the event – “Mer” meaning sea and “Vigne” meaning vine – highlights its central themes: exquisite seafood and fine wines from France’s renowned wine regions. As part of a nationwide event series, Mer & Vigne combines regional charm with national recognition. Held twice a year, the autumn edition is especially popular – a time when nature and cuisine reveal their full abundance. The fair is organized by Mer & Vigne SARL, an experienced event company known across France for its high-quality culinary events. Just a few kilometers from Lyon, La Tour-de-Salvagny offers a welcoming atmosphere that attracts gourmets and food lovers from near and far. At its core, the fair showcases products from the fields of fisheries, agriculture, and viticulture. Visitors can explore a wide range of offerings, from freshly caught seafood and artisanal delicacies to carefully selected wines from some of France’s most prestigious wine-growing regions. International specialties complement the assortment, adding a cosmopolitan flair to the event. A key focus of the fair is the support of regional producers. They are given a platform to present their high-quality products to a broad audience. Competitions and awards recognize excellence and creativity, creating special highlights throughout the event. The diversity of exhibitors reflects the rich culinary traditions of France. Alongside industry professionals, the fair also appeals to a wide audience of fine food enthusiasts in search of authentic products and new taste experiences. Thanks to its convenient location, Mer & Vigne is easily accessible for visitors from across France. La Tour-de-Salvagny lies approximately 15 kilometers from Lyon’s city center and is well connected via the A6 and A89 motorways. The town itself offers a picturesque setting, with views of the nearby golf course and surrounding landscape. La Palmeraie de la Tour is a popular venue for a variety of events – from weddings and corporate gatherings to trade fairs such as “Mer & Vigne.” With its tropical-inspired ambiance and versatile layout, it provides an ideal setting for special occasions. Mer & Vigne is a true feast for the senses – a place where tradition meets innovation, and where local character blends seamlessly with international flair to create a unique and memorable experience.

The Marjolaine Fair in Paris, an annual event held in November, is an exhibition that, since its inception in 1976, has served as a platform for organic farming, sustainable development, natural well-being, and social enterprises. Organized by the SPAS Organisation de salons, this fair gathers a multitude of experts, producers, and craftsmen who advocate for ecological and sustainable practices. The fair takes place in the picturesque Parc Floral in Paris, a green oasis that acts as the perfect backdrop for an event dedicated to environmental protection and the promotion of a sustainable lifestyle. The Parc Floral is more than just a place of beauty and tranquility; it's also a hub for cultural and ecological events, making this fair a truly special occasion. Marjolaine takes pride in being the largest organic event in France, spotlighting various sectors and themes. The core areas of the show include crafts and fashion, with a particular focus on eco-friendly materials and practices. The food sector, a vital facet of the fair, has expanded to accommodate new players in the organic food industry. Another highlight is the organic wellness sector, which, with its range of ecological products and services, adds a new allure to the home living area. The fair also features a hall exclusively reserved for associations, serving as a forum and lecture space where knowledge, ideas, and innovations are shared. The central themes of the fair encompass food, wine, health, beauty, fashion, decor, well-being, gardening, tourism, ecology, and home. The Marjolaine Fair is furthermore a place of learning and inspiration. It offers workshops, lectures, and demonstrations that assist visitors in making informed decisions about their lifestyle. Each year, the fair presents new highlights and special features, keeping it fresh and relevant for both returning and new visitors. From the quality of the products displayed to the information and awareness it promotes, the Marjolaine Fair is at the forefront of the ecological and sustainable movement in France.

The Pasar Malam is a unique exhibition that brings the vibrant spirit of Asia to the Netherlands in its own distinct way. The term "Pasar Malam" originates from Indonesian and translates to "Night Market", even though the event doesn't exclusively take place in the evening. This exhibition, a tribute to Asian culture and specifically to the Indian and Moluccan communities, is held at the Expo Rijswijk De Broodfabriek in Rijswijk, a dynamic venue known for hosting diverse events. With a biannual frequency, typically in the fall and spring, Pasar Malam opens its doors to visitors not only from the Netherlands but from all over the world. Behind the organization is Expo Rijswijk, an institution that has made a name for itself by hosting numerous events, always ensuring a rich and immersive experience for attendees. The main theme of the exhibition is the comprehensive representation of Asian cultures. This encompasses a wide range of products and services, from traditional Asian handicrafts, clothing, and jewelry to culinary delights. A special emphasis is placed on alternative therapies such as massages, spiritual readings, and healing, with clairvoyants and mediums also offering their services. Rijswijk itself plays a crucial role as the host city, bridging the gap between the Netherlands and the diverse Asian cultures. This is reflected in the selection of exhibitors, stemming from various sectors, with both local and international backgrounds. The exhibition is not just a gathering place for the general public but also attracts professionals from the fields of gastronomy, commerce, arts, and alternative therapy. Highlights of the exhibition include vibrant cultural performances, music, and dance acts, as well as occasional competitions celebrating cultural diversity. In conclusion, the Pasar Malam in Rijswijk is more than just an exhibition. It offers visitors a deep dive into the warmth and colorful splendor of Asia. The venue, Expo Rijswijk De Broodfabriek, impresses not just with its historical significance but also with its accessibility and modern amenities. Easily reachable by public transport or by car, it welcomes visitors to a world of discovery and cultural exchange.

Here, visitors can discover the diverse aspects of a plant-based lifestyle, from milk and meat alternatives to superfoods and vegan sweets to fashionable clothing and accessories. Vegan cosmetic products and innovative projects are also part of the extensive range. A central point of the VeggieWorld in Munich is the direct interaction with the manufacturers. Visitors have the opportunity to have personal discussions and find out in detail about the ingredients and health benefits of the products. This interaction is particularly valuable for making conscious decisions about one's own lifestyle. A highlight of the fair is the supporting program, which consists of lectures, cooking shows and interactive workshops. These events are free for all fair visitors and offer an excellent opportunity to learn more about the vegan lifestyle and experience it in practice. The VeggieWorld Munich is therefore not only a meeting place for like-minded people, but also a source of information that opens the doors to a more sustainable lifestyle for visitors.

The "White Label World Expo" is an international trade show specializing in white-label and private-label products. It offers a platform for the latest innovations and trends in online retail and e-commerce. Held annually at the ExCeL in London, it attracts thousands of professionals, entrepreneurs, online sellers, and retailers from around the world. White-label products are generic goods or services produced by a manufacturer and then sold to various retailers or businesses. These businesses market and sell the products under their own brand and packaging. The actual producer remains in the background, not directly associated with the end customer. White-label products offer advantages for both the manufacturer and the marketing company: manufacturers benefit from steady sales of their products, while marketing companies enjoy lower development costs and a faster time to market. Organized by Fortem International Ltd., the White Label World Expo covers a wide range of topics relevant to the e-commerce industry, including product sourcing, online sales, marketing strategies, and customer service. The expo showcases a variety of products and services in areas such as home and kitchen, apparel, footwear, jewelry, pet supplies, health and household, beauty and personal care, food and beverages, toys and games, technology and electronics, vape, and office supplies. The White Label World Expo not only provides insights into the latest products and services but is also closely linked to the dynamic atmosphere and innovative spirit of London. The city serves as an ideal meeting point for entrepreneurs and professionals at the forefront of e-commerce development. A highlight of the expo is the diverse seminars, product presentation areas, and the e-market research center. The Innovation Awards recognize companies that have made a significant impact in the world of product sourcing and white-label trade, while the Industry Awards honor exhibitors who stand out for their particularly innovative and leading products in the online retail market. Exhibitors at the expo come from a variety of industries, highlighting the diversity and breadth of the offerings. The main target audience of the expo includes online sellers, retailers, entrepreneurs, and distributors from the respective industries. The White Label World Expo is part of a series of expos held at various locations worldwide, each with its own local character and specialties. In conclusion, ExCeL London is not only a world-renowned exhibition center but also impresses with its excellent accessibility and modern facilities. Its central location allows visitors and exhibitors to experience the vibrant city life and unique attractions of the city while participating in one of the most significant expos in their industry.

The "JAPAN'S FOOD EXPORT FAIR" (JFEF) is an annual trade fair for importers, wholesalers and buyers of Japanese food and beverages, held at the Tokyo Big Sight in Tokyo. Once a year, "Aux Vignobles!" invites visitors on a delightful journey through the rich wine and culinary traditions of France. This combined trade and public fair, with a clear focus on wine, gastronomy, and terroir, takes place at the Centre des Expositions in Le Mans. The name – roughly translated as “To the Vineyards!” – symbolizes the experience that awaits: direct encounters with winemakers, authentic regional products, and a deep dive into French culture of taste and craftsmanship. Organized by GL Events Exhibitions Opérations, based in Brest, the event is part of a series of similar fairs curated across northwestern France by this experienced exhibition organizer. Le Mans – widely known for its motorsport heritage – also benefits from its proximity to renowned wine regions such as the Loire Valley. Each autumn, it becomes a unique gathering place where local residents, wine enthusiasts, tourists, and professionals from the hospitality, gastronomy, and retail sectors come together to discover, taste, and purchase regional quality products directly from the producers. At the heart of the fair is French wine in all its diversity: from classic appellations and rare grape varieties to sustainable viticulture, current trends in oenology, and offers from the wine tourism sector. Many exhibitors also present travel experiences linked to their wineries – ranging from on-site tastings to overnight stays among the vines. A standout feature of the fair is the "Parcours BIO" – a dedicated route through the exhibition hall spotlighting organic wines and sustainably certified products, including those carrying the HVE (Haute Valeur Environnementale) environmental label. This focus underlines the event’s strong commitment to transparency, sustainability, and regional identity. The exhibition is further enriched by free tasting workshops, where experts share their knowledge of aromas, growing regions, and terroirs, allowing visitors to deepen their understanding of wine. In addition to wine, Aux Vignobles! features a curated selection of fine delicacies – including cheese, cured meats, chocolate, honey, tea, and more. Most exhibitors come from the fields of viticulture, agriculture, gourmet food production, and tourism. More than just a sales exhibition, "Aux Vignobles!" serves as a vibrant showcase of French culinary culture – a space for direct exchange between producers and the public, and a stage for quality, authenticity, and emotion. The venue – the modern Centre des Expositions Le Mans – is located just a few kilometers from the city center and is easily accessible by car or public transport. Thanks to its strong connection to the French rail network, the fair is also convenient for regional and national visitors. Anyone wishing to experience French wine culture in all its richness will find at "Aux Vignobles!" in Le Mans a unique and valuable opportunity to taste the best of France’s regions – where people and pleasure come together.

Launched in 2013, Foodex Saudi is a prestigious international trade fair for the food and beverage industry. The fair is organized by Reed Sunaidi Exhibitions, a leading company in the events sector that always strives to provide a smooth and enriching experience for all participants. The range of topics covered at Foodex Saudi is wide and includes beverages, food technology and machinery, canned goods, meat and dairy products, confectionery, poultry and game, chilled and fresh frozen products, among others. With this diverse offering, the fair attracts a wide range of exhibitors, from major industry leaders to specialty manufacturers. The main visitor group is made up of professionals from the food and beverage industry, who can look forward to a number of highlights, including film screenings, seminars and the opportunity to meet celebrity chefs. 전시회명: Middle East Organic & Natural Products Expo
박람회설명:
The "Middle East Organic & Natural Products Expo" is a renowned international trade fair in the Middle East, specializing in natural and organic products. It takes place annually at the Dubai World Trade Center (DWTC), under the patronage of the Ministries of Health, Environment, and Water of the United Arab Emirates. The fair is organized by Global Links Exhibition Organisers & Conferences LLC, a leading organizer in the region. The fair serves as a central hub for presenting and discovering the latest trends in the fields of food & beverages, beauty & cosmetics, health & wellness, agriculture & environment, as well as sustainable living. It provides a platform where manufacturers, traders, and consumers meet to explore the latest products and services in these sectors. A particular focus is on the connection to the city of Dubai and the United Arab Emirates, which are seen as centers for sustainable development and innovation in the region. The expo supports this trend by promoting local and regional businesses and inviting international brands to showcase their latest organic and natural products. Highlights of the fair include the "Organic Super Kitchen" area, where top chefs prepare gourmet dishes from organic ingredients, the "Organic Beauty Lounge" for natural cosmetics, and the "Health & Wellness Studio". Other special areas are the "Tea & Coffee Pavilion" and the "Halal Pavilion", offering a variety of certified products. The "Middle East Organic & Natural Products Expo" is accompanied by the introduction of new products, a matchmaking program, as well as scheduled meetings and key conferences focusing on various aspects of the organic and natural product industry. Notable are the "Organic and Natural Conference" and the "Traditional Complementary and Alternative Medicine Conference" (TCAM). The "Organic and Natural Conference" offers a mix of presentations, panel discussions, and roundtable talks on topics such as organic and natural trends, vegan and plant-based products, clean beauty, natural cosmetics, tea and coffee, honey, nutraceuticals, dietary supplements, probiotics, sustainable living, and environmental practices. The "Traditional Complementary and Alternative Medicine Conference" (TCAM) is a significant forum for medical professionals in the Middle East and Africa, focusing on holistic treatment and medicine. Participants here can discuss and learn about the best treatment approaches, therapies, and medications to improve patient outcomes. Exhibitors come from various industries, including food production, cosmetics, healthcare, and agriculture. The main visitors are professionals from these sectors, including traders, retailers, HORECA experts, wholesalers, and exporters, who utilize the fair to inform themselves about the latest trends and certification standards and to establish business contacts. Finally, the Dubai World Trade Center is highlighted as the venue for the fair. It is a globally renowned trade and conference center, easily accessible by various means of transportation and serving as a hub for international business in the region.

UzProdExpo is the leading international trade fair for the food and beverage industry in Uzbekistan. It is regarded as the most important platform for innovation, technology, and business development in the Central Asian region. The event is held annually in autumn at the renowned UEC Uzexpocentre, located in the heart of Tashkent, the capital of Uzbekistan. Organized by IEG Uzbekistan (International Expo Group) – a seasoned event organizer specializing in professional trade fairs across the region – UzProdExpo benefits from strong partnerships with national and international industry associations as well as government institutions. This collaboration ensures the high quality and relevance of the event and reinforces its role as a flagship economic initiative for Uzbekistan. The trade fair focuses on the latest technologies and solutions for food and beverage processing, packaging, storage, and logistics. Covering the entire industry value chain – from raw material handling and production lines to refrigeration, quality control, and IT systems – UzProdExpo places particular emphasis on sustainable production methods, advanced packaging technologies, and automated plant solutions. The range of exhibits is extensive: attendees can explore cutting-edge systems for processing meat, fish, dairy, grains, oilseeds, fruits, and vegetables. The fair also showcases complete production lines for confectionery, bakery goods, and beverages. Packaging technology is another core theme, featuring PET blow molding machines, shrink-wrapping systems, labeling, and capping solutions. The exhibition offering is further complemented by foodservice equipment, refrigeration and automation technology, control and measuring devices, as well as semi-finished and finished products – including frozen foods, baby food, sports nutrition, and halal-certified goods. UzProdExpo attracts a broad professional audience – from manufacturers and processors to wholesalers, retailers, investors, food technologists, restaurant chains, and logistics experts. The diversity of exhibiting companies is equally wide-ranging, representing sectors such as machinery and equipment manufacturing, packaging, retail, IT, and food logistics. This unique mix makes the fair a highly targeted business platform with clearly defined audiences and measurable added value. Beyond its economic relevance, UzProdExpo also plays a cultural role for Tashkent and Uzbekistan as a whole. As a showcase for the national food industry and a magnet for international market leaders, the event strengthens the country’s economic profile and promotes export opportunities. The Uzexpocentre, with its modern facilities and central location, provides ideal conditions for a successful exhibition. Easily accessible via international flights, the local transport network, and nearby hotels, it offers exhibitors and visitors a professional setting and short distances – perfect for intensive networking and productive business meetings. UzProdExpo is more than just a trade fair – it is the heartbeat of Uzbekistan’s food and beverage industry.

Rice Tech Show Nigeria is a leading fair in the field of rice processing technologies. The main visitors are professionals from the rice industry, farmers, investors, and decision-makers from agricultural companies. The Food Packaging Expo is a specialist trade fair dedicated to modern packaging solutions for the food industry and is open exclusively to trade visitors. It covers the entire food packaging value chain, from packaging materials and ready-to-use packaging to machinery and automated production processes, quality control, product protection and sustainable circular economy solutions. The event takes place at PTAK Warsaw Expo in Nadarzyn, near Warsaw, and is organised by Ptak Warsaw Expo Sp. z o.o. The exhibition centre is one of Poland’s leading venues for international trade fairs and regularly hosts a wide range of industry-specific events. The Food Packaging Expo focuses on key areas of modern food packaging, including packaging and materials, ready-to-use packaging, packaging machinery and automation, safety and quality control, traceability and smart packaging, as well as technologies for extending shelf life and protecting products. The requirements of the EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) and the transition towards a functioning circular economy are also becoming increasingly important. The event therefore addresses not only how food can be packaged safely, but also how businesses can make their packaging processes more efficient, digitalised and sustainable. Exhibitors showcase ready-to-use food packaging, films, cartons and other packaging materials, alongside components and closures, packaging machinery, robotics and automation systems. The range of solutions also includes packaging printing technologies, smart labelling, identification and traceability systems, as well as quality control and inspection equipment. Laboratories and certification bodies provide information on safety and compliance services, while technology providers present solutions designed to extend food shelf life and improve product protection. Recycling companies, circular economy solution providers, packaging designers and implementation partners complete the range of exhibitors. A key feature of the programme is the industry conference for food manufacturers and producers of ready-to-use packaging. It focuses on specific commercial and technical challenges facing the sector, including how to extend product shelf life safely and improve the efficiency of packaging processes. Another major topic is how existing packaging portfolios can be adapted to meet PPWR requirements without unnecessarily compromising product profitability. The Food Packaging Expo is aimed primarily at professionals and senior decision-makers from the food and beverage industry. Visitors include food manufacturers, production managers, packaging developers, quality managers, buyers, technologists and engineers, as well as professionals responsible for sustainability, compliance and supply chain management. The event gives trade visitors the opportunity to compare packaging materials, machinery, automation systems and other technologies from different suppliers in one place. It also provides a platform for establishing new business contacts and discussing solutions to current regulatory, technological and commercial challenges. PTAK Warsaw Expo is located in Nadarzyn, south-west of Warsaw. Its proximity to the Polish capital and major transport routes makes the exhibition centre easily accessible to both domestic and international trade visitors. The venue provides an ideal setting for professional exchange between manufacturers, technology providers, decision-makers and business partners from Poland and across Europe.

BIOEXPO Warsaw is an internationally oriented trade fair for organic food and ecological products. It has established itself as the central platform for the organic industry in Central and Eastern Europe. The name of the fair – "BIO" for organic, "EXPO" for exhibition, and "Warsaw" as the host city – clearly reflects its thematic and regional focus. The event is held annually at the Ptak Warsaw Expo, one of the most modern and largest exhibition centers in Central Europe, located in Nadarzyn near Warsaw. It is organized by Ptak Warsaw Expo Sp. z o.o., an experienced trade fair organizer with a diverse portfolio of industry events. The fair targets producers, traders, distributors, buyers, start-ups, and professional visitors from sectors such as agriculture, retail, gastronomy, science, and politics. At its core are certified organic products and sustainable innovations. The exhibition features a wide range of offerings including fresh and processed organic foods, beverages, natural cosmetics, eco-friendly cleaning products, sustainable packaging solutions, modern agricultural technologies, and zero-waste products. The range is complemented by services related to organic certification, logistics, and export. A central highlight of the event is the conference program, which includes the Poland Bio Congress. Here, leading experts, thought leaders, and policymakers discuss current developments, including market trends, regulatory frameworks, and scientific insights. The forum also gives space to innovative approaches from emerging companies. Thanks to its convenient location, the fair is easily accessible both from Warsaw Chopin Airport and via highways and public transportation. BIOEXPO Warsaw is not only a key meeting point for the international organic industry, but also a reflection of the growing ecological awareness in Poland – a country that is increasingly establishing itself as a significant player in the global organic market.

The expoSE & expoDirekt, annual fairs taking place every November, represent an outstanding platform within the agricultural sector. They are considered leading trade fairs for asparagus and berry production as well as for the direct distribution of agricultural products. The expoSE, established in 1996 and initially located in Bruchsal, found its permanent home at the Karlsruhe Trade Fair Centre starting in 2003. Its founding was initiated by the Association of South German Asparagus and Strawberry Growers e.V. (VSSE), which not only represents the interests of producers but also acts as a catalyst for innovations and progress in the industry. The fair is characterized by its comprehensive presentation of products and services essential for the cultivation and distribution of asparagus and berries. This includes machinery, plant protection products, fertilizers, and packaging solutions. The expoDirekt complements this range with products and services for the direct marketing of agricultural produce, including marketing concepts, cash register systems, and marketing strategies. The fairs offer a unique opportunity to establish business contacts and exchange information on the latest trends and scientific findings. Exhibitors and visitors can meet at a high-caliber forum where competent consultants from various institutions are ready to answer questions and discuss the implementation of scientific findings in practice. Another highlight of the expoSE & expoDirekt is the extensive congress that takes place parallel to the fair. Here, participants gain insights into current research results and market developments and can further their education in workshops and seminars. The Karlsruhe Trade Fair Centre in Rheinstetten, the venue, provides ideal conditions for exhibitors and visitors with its modern infrastructure and central location. Easily accessible and equipped with a wide range of services, the location significantly contributes to the success of the fair duo.

The "Food Safety & Hygiene Expo" is a leading trade fair for innovative technologies in food safety and hygiene. As an integral part of the renowned Food Factory Technology Week, it takes place annually in Tokyo and is organized by RX Japan Ltd. The expo showcases the latest advancements in the food hygiene industry and is designed for professionals who must uphold the highest standards in quality and safety. The event focuses on cutting-edge hygiene technologies that are crucial for ensuring safety in the food and beverage industry. Given Japan’s increasingly stringent regulations—such as the mandatory HACCP implementation and the 2021 revision of the Food Sanitation Act—the expo plays a vital role in the industry. Visitors can expect a highly specialized exhibition featuring AI-powered inspection systems, state-of-the-art analysis and monitoring equipment, video surveillance and access control solutions, as well as HACCP-compliant technologies. Additionally, the event highlights advanced cleaning and sterilization technologies alongside specialized hygiene and sanitation materials. These innovations are essential for producers, quality control professionals, and hygiene managers. A key highlight of the "Food Safety & Hygiene Expo" is its live demonstrations, expert presentations, and extensive networking opportunities. International exhibitors from sectors such as food technology, mechanical engineering, and hygiene products present their latest innovations, offering industry professionals hands-on insights into pioneering solutions. The expo attracts not only leading companies from Japan but also numerous participants from across Asia and beyond. The event’s primary audience consists of professionals from the food and beverage industry, particularly those working in quality assurance, production management, hygiene, and facility maintenance. Additionally, decision-makers from hospitality, retail, and logistics sectors attend to explore innovative hygiene management solutions. The "Food Safety & Hygiene Expo" serves as a premier platform for exchanging industry expertise, discovering innovations, and fostering international business opportunities.

The "Food Factory Technology Week" in Tokyo is Japan's leading trade fair for food technology and food safety . It is aimed at professionals in the food industry who are looking for innovative, practical, and future-oriented solutions for the production, processing, and quality assurance of food. The venue is Tokyo Big Sight, a modern exhibition center where the event takes place annually. The exhibition is organized by RX Japan Ltd. , one of Asia’s largest and most experienced trade show organizers, renowned for its industry-focused, highly specialized events. Food Factory Technology Week brings together two dedicated exhibitions under one roof: one focused on automation and digitalization of production processes, the other on hygiene and food safety. This combination makes the event unique in its format and positioning within the Asian market. The event’s relevance stems from its clear focus on the pressing challenges currently facing the food industry. Topics such as the growing shortage of skilled labor, the need for increased efficiency, and compliance with international standards such as HACCP are at the core of the exhibition. It showcases highly specialized technologies and tailored solutions that address the specific needs of modern food production. Exhibitors represent a wide range of sectors, including mechanical engineering, software development, hygiene and cleanroom technology, logistics, and consulting. The primary audience consists of key decision-makers in the food industry, such as production managers, quality assurance professionals, R&D teams, plant designers, and representatives from major retail chains and food brands who are looking to stay up to date with the latest technological advancements. Food Factory Technology Week is part of a nationwide exhibition series held at various locations across Japan, each focusing on different aspects of manufacturing technology. As such, it not only contributes to the ongoing development of Japan’s food industry but also positions itself as a key innovation driver for the broader Asia-Pacific region. For companies seeking cutting-edge technologies, practical solutions, and new international business opportunities in the field of food technology, Food Factory Technology Week offers a valuable and future-ready platform.
