The Kenya Expo is an annual international multi-sector trade exhibition held at the Kenyatta International Conference Centre (KICC) in Nairobi. It is recognised as one of the leading business platforms for companies, investors and trade professionals seeking opportunities in Kenya and the wider East African market. The exhibition is organised by the INEXPO GROUP, an international exhibition organiser that provides companies with access to emerging African markets through a portfolio of specialised trade fairs and business exhibitions held in various countries. Staged annually, the Kenya Expo offers an ideal environment for establishing new business partnerships, expanding export opportunities and gaining valuable insights into the latest market trends. The exhibition covers virtually every major sector of the Kenyan economy. Its key focus areas include agriculture, food and beverages, confectionery, manufacturing, printing and packaging technology, construction, infrastructure, real estate, energy, paints and chemicals, hardware and tools, the automotive industry, healthcare, medical technology, consumer goods, fashion and textiles, beauty and cosmetics, networking and cabling technology, innovation and digital transformation, as well as education and vocational training. Exhibits include agricultural products, food and beverages, packaging solutions, industrial products, machinery, construction materials, solar technologies, electric vehicles, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, software, FinTech and AI solutions, telecommunications equipment, furniture, consumer goods, and services related to education, real estate and infrastructure. By showcasing the complete value chains of numerous industries, the exhibition provides businesses with direct access to one of Africa's fastest-growing markets. The Kenya Expo plays an important role in Kenya's economic development, as the country serves as East Africa's commercial hub, a leading logistics centre and a regional technology powerhouse, often referred to as the "Silicon Savannah". Nairobi acts as a strategic gateway for companies seeking to expand into neighbouring markets such as Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Ethiopia and South Sudan. One of the exhibition's defining features is its outstanding networking opportunities, bringing together manufacturers, importers, exporters, investors, government representatives and buyers. The event focuses on facilitating new business partnerships, promoting investment opportunities, and showcasing innovative products and technologies. Exhibitors represent virtually every segment of industry, commerce and the service sector, ranging from agriculture, food production and manufacturing to construction, energy, healthcare, information technology, education, telecommunications and consumer goods. Key visitor groups include manufacturers, wholesalers and retailers, importers, exporters, investors, project developers, procurement professionals, engineers, architects, public sector representatives, and senior decision-makers from industry, commerce and government. Located in the heart of Nairobi, the Kenyatta International Conference Centre (KICC) is one of Africa's most renowned convention and exhibition venues. It offers modern facilities and enjoys a prime location close to government institutions, hotels and the city's central business district. The venue is approximately 20 to 30 minutes by taxi from Jomo Kenyatta International Airport (JKIA) and is easily accessible via the city's main transport routes, providing excellent conditions for international exhibitors and trade visitors alike.

Since its inception in 2024, the “ Food und Feines ” trade fair has stood for culinary discovery and a refined culture of enjoyment – authentic, regionally rooted, and globally open-minded. Each year, Messe Stuttgart welcomes a discerning audience passionate about new taste experiences, creative cuisine, and sustainable nutrition. Organized by Landesmesse Stuttgart GmbH, the event offers a carefully curated platform for producers, culinary professionals, and conscious consumers alike, shaped by a strong sense for quality and innovation. The Food und Feines presents itself as a showcase of culinary diversity. While the spotlight is on regional specialties from Baden-Württemberg – including beloved classics like Maultaschen, cheese, and artisan sausages – the fair also opens the door to international delicacies. Visitors can explore the culinary riches of the Levant, the Mediterranean, Asia, and South America, bringing global food traditions to life. Complementing this selection are fine coffee and confectionery specialties rarely found outside gourmet roasteries or international markets – from frozen yogurt to premium chocolate from Dubai. Beverages are given equal attention. A thoughtfully selected range of wines, beers, spirits, and non-alcoholic creations invites exploration. The focus is on craft and authenticity, with offerings such as small-batch beers, naturally brewed lemonades, regional brandies, and international whiskies. A stylishly designed area is dedicated to tobacco and cigar culture, featuring curated accessories and expert advice. The overall experience is further enhanced by high-quality lifestyle products for the modern home, including elegant tableware, kitchen tools, and culinary literature that inspire stylish enjoyment at home. The fair places a strong emphasis on sustainability, slow food, and mindful consumption. Expert panels and discussion formats highlight pressing topics such as regional value creation, fair production, and resource-conscious nutrition. A particular highlight are the live cooking shows with renowned chefs who share insights into global food trends – from Asian street food and African spice culture to traditional bread baking and BBQ. These sessions offer not only culinary inspiration, but also fresh perspectives on food and enjoyment. Exhibitors represent sectors such as artisanal food production, gastronomy, beverage manufacturing, fine food retail, kitchen equipment, and lifestyle. The event is tailored to gourmets, food lovers, industry professionals from retail, hospitality, and gastronomy, as well as trend-conscious home cooks. In this way, “Food und Feines” builds a unique bridge between craftsmanship, culinary culture, and responsible food practices – true to the spirit of the Stuttgart region, known for its rich and forward-thinking culinary landscape. Modern Messe Stuttgart, located directly at the airport and perfectly connected to the transport network, provides the ideal setting. Bright, spacious halls, well-designed lounge areas, and short walking distances ensure a pleasant visitor experience. For those who value enjoyment grounded in quality, diversity, and integrity, “Food und Feines” is a true culinary highlight in the southern German trade fair calendar.

Launched in 2013, Foodex Saudi is a prestigious international trade fair for the food and beverage industry. The name "Foodex" symbolizes an in-depth exploration of the food industry - from product development to delivery to the consumer. The fair is held once a year in Riyadh and Jeddah. The fair is organized by Reed Sunaidi Exhibitions, a leading company in the events sector that always strives to provide a smooth and enriching experience for all participants. The range of topics covered at Foodex Saudi is wide and includes beverages, food technology and machinery, canned goods, meat and dairy products, confectionery, poultry and game, chilled and fresh frozen products, among others. Particular emphasis is placed on niche products, diet products, gourmet items, organic products and health foods. With this diverse offering, the fair attracts a wide range of exhibitors, from major industry leaders to specialty manufacturers. The main visitor group is made up of professionals from the food and beverage industry, who can look forward to a number of highlights, including film screenings, seminars and the opportunity to meet celebrity chefs. The fair also offers platforms such as the Salon Culinaire, a professional cooking competition, the Chocolate Art Salon, dedicated to art and sculpture made of chocolate, the Mocktail Bar mixology competition, where bartenders can showcase their creativity in non-alcoholic cocktails, as well as a live kitchen and a business match program.

FRUIT POLAND is an international trade fair that has focused on fruit cultivation and related industries since its inception in 2023. It is held annually at the Ptak Warsaw Expo in Nadarzyn , a suburb of Warsaw, and has established itself as a central meeting point for professionals in the fruit cultivation and food industries. The name of the fair underscores its focus on fruit products and its roots in Poland. The renowned company Ptak Warsaw Expo Sp. z o.o. serves as the organizer, known for its expertise in organizing trade fairs. FRUIT POLAND addresses topics such as the cultivation and processing of fruit, technologies in fruit cultivation, plant protection, fertilizers, storage methods, and trading strategies. The fair showcases a wide range of products and services. These include seedlings for fruit trees and bushes, fruit cultivation machinery and tools, accessories for fruit cultivation, plant protection products, fertilizers, and modern cultivation technologies. It plays an important role for the city and the country by bringing together Polish and international companies and positioning Poland as a significant player in the fruit industry. Highlights of FRUIT POLAND include competitions, award ceremonies, and educational discussions led by recognized experts. Exhibitors come from various sectors, including fruit cultivation, agriculture, plant protection, and fruit processing. The main visitors to the fair are fruit growers, producers, farmers, representatives of processing and packaging companies, and scientists. The Ptak Warsaw Expo impresses with its modern facilities and good accessibility. It is located near Warsaw's international airport and is easily accessible by both public transport and car. Overall, FRUIT POLAND offers a significant platform for knowledge exchange, networking, and business development for all stakeholders in the fruit sector.

Established in 1991, the Peterfood Trade Fair is an international exposition for food and food technology and is among the most significant culinary events in St. Petersburg. The name "Peterfood" is a combination of "Peter", referring to the city of St. Petersburg, and "food". The fair takes place annually at the prestigious ExpoForum Convention & Exhibition Centre in St. Petersburg and is organized by the Convention & Exhibition Company Imperia-Forum Ltd. The fair showcases a wide range of products and services, including confectionery and baked goods, meat and dairy products, snacks, frozen foods, beverages, tea, coffee, as well as ecological and bio-based products. Areas such as food technology, equipment, and glass packaging are also highlighted. Exhibitors from food manufacturing, beverage production, and food technology present themselves to a diverse audience that includes both professionals and amateur cooks. The Peterfood Trade Fair serves not only as a showcase for food and technologies but also as a platform for initiating business connections. Manufacturers have the opportunity to negotiate product deliveries to regional and national retail chains, marketplaces, and restaurants, making the fair a central meeting point for the food industry in Russia. The event also offers a series of seminars, workshops, and conferences where industry experts share their knowledge and experiences. Highlights include award ceremonies for industry competitions such as "Innovative Product", "Our Brand", "Choice of Chains", and the "Peterfood Technology Award". Exhibitors represent various sectors of the food industry and gastronomy. The main visitor groups come from retail, gastronomy, and food production. The ExpoForum Convention & Exhibition Centre in St. Petersburg, easily accessible via various modes of transportation, provides impressive infrastructure for exhibitors and visitors, along with the opportunity to explore the cultural attractions of the city of St. Petersburg. In conclusion, the Peterfood Trade Fair is an indispensable event for anyone working in the food and technology sectors, looking to stay informed about current trends and establish new business contacts. The impressive ExpoForum and the picturesque city of St. Petersburg make participation in the fair an unforgettable experience.

The China Homelife Indonesia Expo is an internationally oriented trade fair focusing on high-quality Chinese products and manufacturers. Held annually in the heart of Jakarta, the event takes place at the JIExpo Jakarta International Expo – one of Southeast Asia’s most prominent exhibition centers, known for its modern infrastructure and excellent transport links. As part of a global exhibition series hosted in major cities worldwide, the Expo is designed to strengthen trade between China and international markets. In Jakarta, it serves as a central platform for direct engagement between Chinese exporters and buyers from Indonesia and the broader ASEAN region, thus fostering stronger economic ties. Organized by Zhejiang Meorient Commerce & Exhibition Inc., a globally experienced trade fair organizer, in cooperation with local partners, the event benefits from a combination of international expertise and strong regional market access. This ensures a high level of professionalism and deep industry knowledge. The exhibition focuses on products in the fields of household goods, consumer products, gifts, home décor, building materials, machinery, industrial equipment, textiles, apparel, office supplies, and pet products. Special emphasis is placed on innovative technologies and new product developments that are particularly relevant to the Indonesian and ASEAN markets. Buyers, wholesalers, importers, and trade professionals gain targeted insights into market-ready products and current trends – with direct access to manufacturers. The Expo is not only a showcase of Chinese manufacturing excellence but also a key meeting point for professionals across retail, wholesale, e-commerce, construction, interior design, mechanical engineering, fashion, electronics, and logistics. Interested end consumers are also welcome, broadening the event’s reach and visibility. Highlights include live product demonstrations, networking events, and business matchmaking programs that facilitate direct connections between suppliers and potential partners. These offerings make the China Homelife Indonesia Expo a highly effective tool for entering new supply chains and establishing business relationships with China. As Indonesia’s economic hub, Jakarta provides the ideal setting for an event of this scale. The centrally located JIExpo is easily accessible from both the airport and the city center, offering optimal conditions for national and international visitors alike. More than just a product showcase, the China Homelife Indonesia Expo is a strategic platform for advancing international trade relations, a stage for innovation, and a vibrant marketplace for economic opportunity.

The FOOD & LIFE event in Munich is a prestigious consumer and sales fair dedicated entirely to the themes of food, drink, and enjoyment. Established in 2004, the fair has been organized by GHM Gesellschaft für Handwerksmessen mbH and, since the spring of 2023, takes place twice a year. It has established itself as Germany's largest meeting point for culinary excellence, attracting visitors interested in high-quality, artisanal delicacies. The fair offers an impressive variety of products and services. Ranging from small manufacturers with regional specialties to producers of sustainable organic products, the selection is diverse. It includes spreads, baked and confectionery goods, fine and health foods, fish, meat and sausages, beverages and spirits, spices, herbs, vinegar, oil, coffee, tea, dairy products, eggs, fruits, and vegetables. This culinary abundance makes the fair a paradise for gourmets and lovers of good taste. A distinctive feature of FOOD & LIFE is the presentation by passionate distillers, brewers, coffee roasters, chocolatiers, and butchers, who showcase their products and their production processes. Celebrity chefs demonstrate their skills on live stages, making the fair an interactive and educational experience. The venue, Messe München, provides an ideal platform for this event. With its modern infrastructure and accessibility, it is a suitable setting for showcasing the diverse culinary world.

Interpoma , the unique trade fair for the apple industry, is held every two years at the Fiera di Bolzano in picturesque Bolzano. It provides a specialized platform for the production, storage, and marketing of apples. The name "Interpoma" is derived from the Latin words "inter" (between) and "pomum" (apple), symbolizing international exchange within the industry. In late autumn, the Fiera di Bolzano transforms into a hub for technology and sustainability as Messe Bozen AG gathers experts, producers, and enthusiasts from around the world. Bolzano's significance as a historic apple-growing region in South Tyrol underscores the fair's relevance to the area and provides an ideal setting for the event. Interpoma focuses on topics such as technological advancements in apple cultivation, sustainable farming methods, digital innovations, and genetic developments in apple breeding. These specific areas of focus make the fair an indispensable meeting point for professionals in the apple industry. At the fair, the latest machinery, advanced cultivation techniques, and innovative products are showcased, with "The Orchard of the Future" as a special exhibition presenting future trends and technologies in apple cultivation. The Interpoma Congress, production tours, and the prestigious Interpoma Award for outstanding technologies and sustainability initiatives are other highlights that attract numerous professionals and interested parties. The fair serves as a magnet for a wide range of industry representatives, from agricultural engineers and farmers to researchers and marketing specialists. It offers professionals in the apple industry the opportunity to learn about the latest developments and expand their networks. Due to its excellent transport connections both nationally and internationally, Bolzano is easily accessible and serves as an attractive meeting point in the heart of Europe. In summary, Interpoma is more than just a fair; it is a pivotal event that significantly shapes the future of the apple industry. Visitors and exhibitors can look forward to a unique opportunity that will benefit them both commercially and technologically.

The Halal Expo is a leading international trade fair specializing in products and services that comply with the halal regulations of traditional Islamic law. Serving as a platform for experts, traders, and entrepreneurs from the global halal industry, it offers a comprehensive overview of the variety of halal-certified goods. The event takes place at the Istanbul Expo Center, one of Istanbul's most eminent exhibition and convention centers. The fair is biennial, strategically scheduled to align with the business cycles of the participating industries. The fair is organized by Discover Events Uluslararası Fuar Organizasyonları A.Ş., a company specializing in international fairs and exhibitions. Key topics at the Halal Expo include halal food and beverages, their processing and packaging, HORECA (Hotel-Restaurant-Café), organic and traditional products, cosmetics and personal care products, as well as pharmaceuticals. It also covers areas such as Islamic financial services, media, public institutions, halal certification, education, halal tourism and accommodation, health tourism, textiles, as well as authentic and cultural clothing. The Halal Expo fosters a special connection with Istanbul and Turkey, a country known for its long history in trade and its strategic position as a bridge between continents. The fair not only contributes to the local economy but also positions Istanbul as a central hub for the halal industry. A particular highlight of the Halal Expo includes associated conferences and the World Halal Summit, where leading suppliers and industry experts gather to discuss the latest trends and exchange knowledge. Exhibitors range from food production to cosmetics, fashion, financial services, and educational institutions. The main audience for the fair includes buyers, manufacturers, importers, exporters, wholesalers, retailers, and investors. In addition, it attracts academics, chefs, and media representatives. In conclusion, the Istanbul Expo Center stands out not just for its excellent accessibility and modern facilities as the venue for the Halal Expo but also for its central location in Istanbul. This makes it easily accessible by public transport as well as by car, making it an ideal location for an event of international scale and significance.

The Ethno Food & Drink Fair is an annual event first held in 2006. It takes place at the Belgrade Fair in Belgrade, Serbia, and is renowned for showcasing and promoting ethnic foods and beverages. The name of the fair reflects its focus on traditional, ethnic products. The fair is organized by Beogradski sajam, a prominent exhibition company. It annually provides a platform for manufacturers and suppliers of foods and beverages made using traditional recipes. Moreover, the main themes of the fair cover a wide range of products and services, including special equipment and packaging for these items. The Ethno Food & Drink Fair holds special significance for Belgrade and Serbia as it highlights traditional products while offering insights into the culinary culture and heritage of the region. It plays a key role in branding and marketing local products and contributes to the promotion of tourism. One of the highlights of the fair is the "Ethno Food & Drinks – Brand of Serbia" award. This accolade is presented by a panel of expert judges who evaluate the quality of the exhibited goods. Additionally, the Food & Drink Fair fosters knowledge exchange and the further education of participants. In the showcase area of the event, whether in the Ethno Court or at the exhibitors' stands, region-specific and sometimes forgotten dishes are presented and tasted, helping to acquaint visitors with the flavors and customs of various eras and regions. Exhibitors come from various sectors, including food production, gastronomy, and equipment manufacturing. The main visitors include shops, restaurants, hotels, large retail chains, and individuals interested in traditional products. The Belgrade Fair is a centrally located and easily accessible venue in Belgrade, offering an ideal platform for the presentation and promotion of traditional products and services.

The "Mer & Vigne" fair, which first opened its doors in 1996, vividly represents the French art de vivre and the pinnacle of culinary craftsmanship. The name of the fair is derived from the French words "Mer" for sea and "Vigne" for vine, indicating the event's focal themes: maritime gastronomy and viticulture. It is hosted in the striking Parc des Expositions in Tours, a city renowned for its culinary delights and as a gateway to the famous Loire Valley, celebrated far beyond its boundaries. Mer & Vigne takes place annually and attracts numerous visitors, especially in the autumn months when the harvest reaches its peak of freshness and quality. It is organized by Mer & Vigne SARL, a company renowned for hosting first-class culinary events. The main themes of the fair encompass seafood and agriculture, supplemented by the diverse sector of wine production. The range of products and services offered extends from fresh seafood and handcrafted regional delicacies to exquisite wines from various regions of France. This selection is complemented by specialities from other European countries, making Mer & Vigne an internationally esteemed meeting point for gourmets and connoisseurs. The significance of the fair to the city of Tours and the surrounding region cannot be overstated. It promotes local producers and spotlights the outstanding quality of the regional French cuisine. Highlights of the event include competitions and award ceremonies that honor the creativity and quality of the exhibitors. The exhibitor spectrum covers fisheries, agriculture, viticulture, and the food craft industry. The primary visitors are professionals from these sectors as well as aficionados of refined French cuisine. Mer & Vigne is part of a series of fairs held nationwide across France. Each individual event is characterized by its local flavor while simultaneously attracting a national audience. The Parc des Expositions de Tours impresses not only with its aesthetic ambiance but also with its excellent transport connections. This accessibility makes it easy for visitors from all over France and abroad to attend the fair. Thus, the Mer & Vigne fair is an indispensable event for all those who wish to experience the diversity and excellence of French gastronomy up close – a celebration for both the mind and the palate.

The trade fair Aux Vignobles! , whose name evokes a symbolic invitation to the vineyards of France, is much more than a traditional wine exhibition. It serves as a vibrant showcase of French lifestyle and regional diversity – a platform that brings together wine and gastronomy, craftsmanship and passion, tradition and innovation in a uniquely enjoyable way. Each autumn, it opens its doors at the Parc des Expositions de la Beaujoire in Nantes – a modern exhibition center with excellent transport connections and optimal conditions for both exhibitors and visitors. Organized by GL Events Exhibitions Opérations , based in Brest, Aux Vignobles! is part of a series of regional trade and public events held throughout northwestern France. Its aim is to foster a close connection between producers and consumers. The name speaks for itself: the fair invites attendees to explore the full richness of France’s wine-producing regions and engage directly with the people who, with expertise and dedication, create wine and culinary specialties. The event’s thematic focus is clear, relevant, and practical: it centers on wine, gastronomy, organic farming, and wine tourism. Visitors are taken on a sensory journey through both renowned and lesser-known wine regions of France – with the opportunity not only to sample fine wines but also to purchase them directly from the winemakers. The offering is further enhanced by a curated selection of gourmet delicacies – from artisanal cheeses, chocolates, and cured meats to teas, spices, and other specialties of French cuisine. Special emphasis is placed on organically produced goods, highlighted through a dedicated themed trail called the "Parcours BIO". This guided route offers orientation for those specifically interested in sustainably and responsibly produced foods. Another forward-looking focus is the topic of environmental and quality certifications – particularly the “HVE – Haute Valeur Environnementale” label, awarded to farms that meet high environmental standards. This certification reflects the growing importance of sustainable agriculture and resource-conscious production – issues that are increasingly relevant not only for industry professionals but also for the wider public. Wine tourism also plays a key role at the fair: exhibitors present experiences, travel options, and immersive activities related to wine production – from visits to historic wineries to culinary routes through France’s gourmet regions. Exhibitors primarily come from the fields of viticulture, fine foods, agricultural production, and tourism. The audience includes both professionals – such as sommeliers, restaurateurs, and retailers – as well as private visitors with a passion for quality products, expert advice, and fair pricing. Aux Vignobles! creates a space for exchange, tasting, and direct purchasing – without intermediaries, directly from producer to connoisseur. With its clear positioning as a discovery fair for premium regional products, Aux Vignobles! sets itself apart from standardized food or tourism events. It offers a unique platform for conscious enjoyment, sustainable consumption, and authentic encounters – an experience that makes France’s deeply rooted wine and culinary culture truly tangible. The Parc des Expositions de la Beaujoire in Nantes – a city known for culture, innovation, and quality of life – provides the ideal setting for the event. Easily accessible by public transport or car, the venue ensures a pleasant and seamless experience for all attendees. For anyone wishing to experience the culinary soul of France in concentrated form, a visit to this autumn fair is a must on the seasonal event calendar.

Located in the heart of the spa park, surrounded by impressive buildings, the market creates a festive and welcoming atmosphere. This backdrop gives the market a distinctive charm, making it an appealing destination during the Advent season. The market stalls are carefully selected to offer a wide range of gluten- and lactose-free products. Special attention is paid to the quality and diversity of the products, ensuring that every visitor finds something to suit their taste. A visit to the market is recommended not only for its unique culinary offerings but also for the warm and inviting atmosphere it exudes. The market provides a rare opportunity to celebrate in an environment that is consciously tailored to the needs of people with specific dietary restrictions. In conclusion, the Sasbachwalden Bischenberg Gluten-Free Christmas Market is not just a feast for the senses, but also a symbol of inclusion and consideration for people with food intolerances. It offers a unique experience that is unparalleled in the Christmas market landscape.

The Vánoční trhy Praha fair, also known as the Prague Christmas Market, is an annual event deeply rooted in Czech culture. The name "Vánoční trhy" translates to "Christmas Market", reflecting the festive atmosphere and spirit of the holiday season. Traditionally held in December, the fair takes place at several locations, including the historic Wenceslas Square in Prague. Wenceslas Square, known as Václavské náměstí in Czech, is among the most famous and historically significant squares in the Czech Republic. Since the Middle Ages, it has been a central hub of public life in Prague and has witnessed many pivotal events in Czech history. The square is distinguished by its impressive architecture, ranging from Neoclassicism to Modern styles, and is home to the Saint Wenceslas monument and the National Museum. Initiated by Taiko, as., the fair focuses on traditional Czech crafts, local specialties, and festive entertainment. Exhibitors from crafts, gastronomy, and local small industries offer a wide range of products and services, including handmade ceramics, jewelry, wood carvings, Christmas ornaments, and traditional Czech foods like mulled wine, Trdelník (a traditional sweet pastry), goulash, and roasted sausages, as well as a variety of Christmas decorations. The market features a rich cultural program with music, dance, and performances by local and international artists. The Prague Christmas Market is popular not only among the city's residents but also attracts tourists from around the world. In addition to Wenceslas Square, the Vánoční trhy Praha is held at other locations such as the Old Town Square, Na Příkopě, and the Republic Square. Each of these markets boasts a unique atmosphere. A highlight of the market is the annually erected, beautifully decorated Christmas tree, serving as a symbolic centerpiece. Wenceslas Square, as one of the main venues, is easily accessible and offers a picturesque setting that harmoniously blends into the cityscape. The Vánoční trhy Praha is a significant cultural event, offering deep insights into Czech Christmas traditions and attracting visitors from all over the world.

The Wirsberg Advent Market, an event full of romance and tradition, takes place every year on the first Sunday of Advent. The market stalls are set up around the market square and the town hall square. The market is organized by the municipal administration, which creates an unforgettable experience each year with its expertise and competence. A highlight of the market is the medieval association, which sets up its camp at the town hall square. Visitors can watch the blacksmith at work and purchase hand-forged artworks. A diverse stage program provides musical and festive entertainment, ranging from Christ Child and little angels to music performances and a visit from Saint Nicholas. The culinary variety is impressive: from different variations of mulled wine and children's punch to Jagertee, mulled gin, and non-alcoholic beverages, there is something for every taste. Culinary delicacies like bratwurst, steaks, Angus burgers, baked Leberkäse, Viennese sausages, goulash from the goulash cannon, grilled cheese sausages, soups, fish sandwiches, smoked goods, homemade waffles, roasted almonds, and much more satisfy hunger and offer a true feast for the senses. Wirsberg itself, historically significant, also offers interesting sights beyond the market. Attractions such as the ruins of the Heilings Church near Neufang: The ruin is the freestanding front wall of the former pilgrimage church from the 15th century and offers an insight into medieval architecture and history. Or the protected market square ensemble: This includes a historic half-timbered town hall and the Wappenrose fountain. The market square itself is a place steeped in history, reflecting the local architecture and culture. The picturesque surroundings also invite exploration tours, perfectly complementing a visit to the Advent Market. In conclusion, this market is not only a place for shopping and entertainment but also a meeting point where community and Christmas joy are celebrated. It is a must-visit for anyone wanting to experience the special atmosphere of a traditional German Christmas market.

Oman AgroFood is the leading international Trade Exhibition for Agriculture, Food and Fisheries in the Sultanate of Oman. Held annually in Muscat at the Oman Convention & Exhibition Centre (OCEC), the event has evolved into a vital platform for innovation, trade, and knowledge exchange. It is organized by IFP – International Fairs & Promotions Lebanon, a renowned trade fair organizer with many years of experience in the Middle East and a clear vision for the sustainable development of regional industries. What sets Oman AgroFood apart is its comprehensive focus on key sectors such as crop cultivation, agri-technology, aquaculture, food processing, packaging, livestock, and animal health. The solutions showcased are both highly relevant and innovative. From state-of-the-art agricultural machinery, seeds, and crop protection products to hydroponic systems for urban farming, smart irrigation technologies, animal feed, and automated fish farming systems – the exhibition presents a highly specialized range of technologies and services that cater to both traditional operations and modern agritech enterprises. A particular emphasis is placed on forward-looking developments related to the Internet of Things (IoT), artificial intelligence, robotics, and renewable energy in the agricultural sector. The food industry is also a central theme, with topics such as processing, preservation, refrigeration, cold chain logistics, organic products, halal foods, and industrial packaging solutions. Core issues such as food safety, traceability, and sustainability are firmly embedded in the event’s profile. A standout feature of the exhibition is the series of live demonstrations, technical workshops, and expert panels, where innovations are not only presented but also discussed and evaluated. Exhibitors represent a wide spectrum of industries – including agricultural machinery manufacturers, food processors, aquaculture businesses, packaging companies, veterinarians, laboratories, feed producers, tech start-ups, and providers of cloud-based and sensor-driven solutions. The event also attracts a high-caliber audience: farmers, supermarket buyers, investors, government representatives, food manufacturers, agronomists, logistics providers, and key decision-makers from across the Middle East, Africa, Asia, and Europe attend Oman AgroFood to network, explore new business opportunities, and stay informed about the latest industry trends. The venue – the Oman Convention & Exhibition Centre in Muscat – offers modern infrastructure, spacious exhibition areas, and excellent accessibility. Located just minutes from Muscat International Airport and well connected to the city’s transportation network, it is surrounded by hotels, restaurants, and cultural landmarks – making it an ideal setting for international trade visitors and inspiring professional encounters.

AGRIMAT ( Indonesia Agriculture Machinery, Accessories & Tools Expo ) in Surabaya is Indonesia's leading trade fair for agricultural machinery, accessories, and advanced technologies. This annual event, organized by Wakeni PT Wahana Kemalaniaga Makmur, takes place at the Grand City Expo in Surabaya. The fair serves as a platform for exchanging expertise and promoting sustainable agricultural practices tailored to the specific needs and challenges of the Indonesian agricultural economy. AGRIMAT focuses on modern and innovative solutions in agricultural technology. Highlights include the presentation of agricultural machinery and technologies, the promotion of sustainable practices, educational offerings through expert lectures and workshops, and support for the export opportunities of Indonesian agricultural products. The fair showcases a variety of products, including agricultural machinery, tractors, planting machines, irrigation technology, greenhouse technology, seeding equipment, forestry equipment, harvesting tools, garden tools, workwear, hand tools, water management solutions, pesticides, fertilizers, and fresh produce such as fruits and vegetables. The conferences and seminars, where experts from around the world share their knowledge and discuss the latest trends, are particularly noteworthy. These elements make AGRIMAT an indispensable event for professionals from agricultural technology, agribusiness, agricultural equipment manufacturing, and related industries. As an important meeting point for manufacturers, local and international buyers, and professionals from the agricultural industry, the fair helps position Indonesian agriculture on the global stage and expands business opportunities both locally and internationally. The fair's accessibility via local and international transport routes makes AGRIMAT an attractive option for participants from all over the world. In summary, AGRIMAT offers not just a fair, but a comprehensive experience aimed at shaping the future of agriculture through innovation, education, and international collaboration.

Fresh Africa is the leading trade fair for fresh produce in North Africa and a highly specialized industry platform held annually at the Egypt International Exhibition Center (EIEC) in Cairo. It represents the combined quality and diversity of African agricultural and fresh products – with a clear focus on export, trade, and innovation. The event is organized by IFP Egypt, an experienced organizer of international trade fairs. With Fresh Africa, the company has created a targeted platform that is practical, unique, and highly relevant to the industry. The fair is aimed at professional visitors from the retail and wholesale food sectors, import and export businesses, as well as decision-makers in gastronomy, hospitality, and food processing. Fresh Africa takes place once a year. As a regionally anchored event, it plays a key role in driving Egypt's agricultural sector and serves as a gateway to the markets of Africa and the Middle East. At the heart of the fair are fresh agricultural products such as fruits, vegetables, herbs, spices, legumes, and grains. The product range includes citrus fruits, grapes, strawberries, dates, and pomegranates, as well as potatoes, peppers, tomatoes, green beans, spring onions, and sweet potatoes. Aromatic herbs such as mint, coriander, basil, and rosemary are also featured. The offering is rounded out by dried beans, sesame, fava beans, and other oilseeds. Special emphasis is placed on convenience and organic products that meet growing international demands for sustainability and healthy nutrition. A particular highlight of the fair includes expert forums, product presentations, and innovation awards that recognize new varieties, cultivation methods, and packaging solutions. Exhibitors primarily come from the fields of agriculture, food processing, packaging, logistics, and trade – both from Egypt and abroad. The fair attracts professional visitors from over 20 countries, providing a unique platform for transcontinental networking and market entry into Africa and the Arab world. The venue – the Egypt International Exhibition Center in New Cairo – impresses with its modern infrastructure, strong international connectivity, and central location. The exhibition grounds are less than 30 minutes from Cairo International Airport and offer a professional setting for exhibitors and visitors to establish successful business relationships in a fast-growing economic region.

Mer & Vigne Le Port-Marly is far more than a traditional consumer fair. It invites visitors to experience the essence of French lifestyle at its most delightful. The name – derived from the French words Mer (sea) and Vigne (vine) – represents an event devoted with exceptional care and quality to maritime gastronomy and viticulture. The venue for this exclusive culinary experience is Les Pyramides, a stylish events center in Le Port-Marly, picturesquely situated between Paris and Versailles. Its elegant setting and excellent accessibility make it a perfect meeting place for food lovers. Each autumn, at the peak of the culinary season, the fair opens its doors to connoisseurs, professionals, and curious visitors eager to explore the rich diversity of French and European gourmet products. It is organized by the experienced company Mer & Vigne SARL, renowned throughout France for hosting high-quality gastronomic exhibitions. At the heart of the event are products from the sea, agriculture, and wine production – carefully curated by exhibitors from the fishing industry, wine trade, farming, and artisanal food sectors. Visitors can look forward to a refined selection of fresh seafood, handcrafted delicacies, and distinctive wines from all corners of France. These are complemented by specialties from other parts of Europe, giving the fair a truly international gourmet character. More than just a showcase of culinary excellence, the fair also serves as a platform for competitions and awards that recognize outstanding creativity and quality. These highlights draw additional attention and enhance the appeal of the event for both attendees and exhibitors. In addition to private enthusiasts, the fair attracts professionals from the gastronomy, retail, and tourism sectors – individuals who value authenticity and the quality of traditional products. As part of a series of fairs held under the Mer & Vigne banner in various French cities, the event plays a key role in making regional specialties accessible to a broader audience while preserving their local charm. With Les Pyramides as its venue, the fair not only offers an elegant backdrop but also benefits from modern infrastructure and excellent transport links, ensuring easy access from Paris, surrounding regions, or abroad. Mer & Vigne Le Port-Marly is a must for anyone wishing to immerse themselves in the fascination of French cuisine – an experience that is refined, inspiring, and truly unique.

The China Homelife UAE Expo is an international trade fair with a clear B2B focus. It serves as a specialized and professional platform for commerce between China and the MENA region. Held annually at the prestigious Dubai World Trade Centre (DWTC), the expo benefits from being located at the central hub of the exhibition industry in the Gulf region. The event is organized by Zhejiang Meorient Commerce & Exhibition Inc. , a seasoned and globally active trade show organizer based in China. In collaboration with regional partners, the company is building a worldwide network of professional trade fairs—among them, additional China Homelife Expo editions in countries such as Poland, South Africa, and Mexico. The Dubai edition plays a key role in this network. Thanks to its strategic location, it provides access to markets in the Middle East, Africa, and South Asia, lending the event significant economic importance. China Homelife UAE Expo offers a structured platform for direct engagement between importers, wholesalers, and more than 3,000 carefully vetted Chinese manufacturers. The product range covers essential demand sectors—from construction and machinery components to textiles, furniture, household goods, office supplies, renewable energy solutions, and mother, baby, and children’s products. The fair is precisely aligned with current market trends and industry-specific needs. The participating companies represent a broad industrial spectrum. At the same time, the expo targets a highly specialized professional audience—especially buyers, importers, and traders actively seeking reliable sourcing options for Chinese products. A distinguishing feature of China Homelife UAE Expo is its holistic approach: beyond showcasing products, the event promotes professional exchange and business initiation. Formats such as business matchmaking, product demonstrations, and market analysis offer added value and foster long-term partnerships. As part of a global exhibition series, the event enhances the international visibility of Chinese enterprises and serves as a sustainable bridge between East and West. The venue at the Dubai World Trade Centre is centrally located, well connected by public transport (Metro station: "World Trade Centre"), and surrounded by hotels, restaurants, and cultural attractions—ensuring a convenient and rewarding trade fair experience. China Homelife UAE Expo is far more than a conventional trade show—it is a unique opportunity to experience the Chinese market firsthand and position oneself at the heart of global procurement flows.

The Winter FancyFaire is more than a traditional trade show. It serves as a vibrant meeting point for the North American specialty food scene, bringing together thought leaders, producers, retailers, and trendsetters from across the industry. Organized by the renowned Specialty Food Association, Inc. (SFA), the event takes place annually in winter, rotating between various cities across the United States. At its core, the Winter FancyFaire showcases the defining developments shaping the future of specialty foods – from sustainable product concepts and innovative preparation methods to strategic brand building. Curated selections highlight products across fine foods, beverages, functional nutrition, plant-based innovations, clean-label solutions, and other culinary trends. Innovation, taste, and craftsmanship are seamlessly interwoven throughout the exhibition. Signature formats such as the First Taste Table offer buyers focused tasting experiences, while the interactive Discovery Kitchen features top chefs from the U.S. West Coast demonstrating real-world applications of new products. Positioned as a discovery platform for industry professionals, the Winter FancyFaire offers targeted opportunities to explore emerging brands in the Debut District , engage with category-specific themes in dedicated pavilions, or experience exceptional packaging design in the curated Spotlight Shoppe . The event is tailored to a specialized audience: retail buyers, culinary professionals, distributors, foodservice experts, trend scouts, and media representatives – all looking for the next big ideas in the specialty food market. A highlight of the event is the presentation of the prestigious sofi Awards, honoring outstanding product quality and innovation. In addition to Gold Awards and the coveted Product of the Year title, the recently introduced Timeless Taste Award celebrates products with lasting appeal and flavor excellence. These accolades are considered a benchmark in the U.S. specialty food industry and provide recipients with significant market visibility. As part of the year-round FancyFaire series – which also includes a summer edition – the Winter FancyFaire has become a key fixture in the industry calendar. It is more than a showcase of products; it is a catalyst for ideas and innovation that drive the entire world of gourmet and specialty foods forward – year after year.

The Baker Technology Fair (BTF) is a specialized business-to-business trade show dedicated to India’s dynamic and fast-growing bakery, confectionery, and snack industry. Known by its acronym “BTF,” the event serves as an exclusive industry forum, bringing together cutting-edge solutions and forward-looking technologies in the realm of baked goods and sweet treats. The Baker Technology Fair takes place twice a year, alternating between the cities of Codissa and Bangalore, and brings together India's experts, manufacturers, suppliers and service providers, offering a comprehensive overview of current market trends, product innovations and sustainable production processes. The event is organized by Synergy Exposures & Events India Pvt. Ltd. , an experienced trade fair organizer focused on industry-specific formats with strong market and sector relevance. Over the years, BTF has established itself as a key platform for the Indian bakery and confectionery sector. It promotes professional exchange, facilitates business networking, and supports innovation processes. Thematically, the fair covers a broad spectrum—from modern baking technology, automation, and digital process control to eco-friendly packaging solutions, sustainable raw materials, food-safe production, and hands-on professional development. Developments in both artisanal and industrial sectors, as well as the influence of Industry 4.0, are also specifically addressed. Particular attention is given to the integrated thematic areas of "Innovative Ingredients" and "Food Packaging," which explore new ingredient concepts and packaging trends—both critical factors for maintaining competitiveness in the industry. The fair is further enriched by the “Bakers Knowledge Sharing Forum,” which features expert talks, panel discussions, and workshops aimed at facilitating targeted knowledge transfer and providing practical insights for professionals and decision-makers. The range of exhibitors spans all key segments of the industry: from bakery equipment manufacturers, technology providers, and raw material suppliers to packaging innovators and hygiene and quality assurance solution providers. Visitors mainly include representatives from bakeries, the broader food industry, gastronomy businesses, and supply chains—decision-makers in search of concrete solutions, partnerships, and new expertise. Each event venue is selected for its modern infrastructure, strong transport connectivity, and location in economically vibrant metropolitan regions. With access to airports, expressways, and urban transit networks, the fair is easily accessible both nationally and internationally. With its clear professional focus, high level of innovation, and strategic relevance, the Baker Technology Fair has become an essential flagship event for all those committed to actively shaping the future of India’s bakery and confectionery industry.

The READY FOOD Poland Expo is an international trade fair in Poland dedicated to ready meals, convenience food and modern food-to-go solutions. Held at Ptak Warsaw Expo in Nadarzyn, near Warsaw, the event is aimed at both trade visitors and a wider audience interested in the latest developments and trends in the food sector. It is organised by Ptak Warsaw Expo Sp. z o. o., which hosts numerous specialised trade fairs for a wide range of industries at its Nadarzyn venue. The READY FOOD Poland Expo covers the entire value chain for readily available, commercially and industrially produced food. Exhibits include chilled and frozen ready meals, heat-and-eat products and convenience foods, as well as takeaway meals, lunch boxes, salads, sandwiches and other food-to-go concepts. The range also encompasses healthy, functional and sustainably developed products. In addition, the fair showcases solutions for efficient production and marketing, including food processing and production technologies, contract manufacturing, packaging solutions, shelf-life extension methods, food safety, refrigeration and cold-chain systems, transport and logistics. Equipment and solutions for retail outlets, foodservice businesses and points of sale are also represented. In this way, the event brings together food products with the technologies and services required for their safe, cost-effective and efficient production and distribution. Exhibitors primarily come from the food and beverage industry, convenience food and ready-meal manufacturing, catering and foodservice, as well as the food technology, packaging, refrigeration, logistics and retail equipment sectors. Manufacturers and suppliers of production machinery are also represented, alongside contract food manufacturers producing goods for third-party brands. The event is particularly aimed at buyers and decision-makers from the food retail sector, retail chains, restaurants and chain catering, catering companies, hotels, foodservice and vending, as well as food manufacturers and product developers. Visitors can compare products and technologies directly, discover new suppliers and establish business contacts for manufacturing, procurement and distribution. A key professional feature of the event is the READY FOOD FACTORY LAB, an accompanying conference focusing on the development and scaling of successful convenience food products. It combines insights into consumer behaviour and distribution channels with issues relating to production, technology and logistics. Topics include developing products for retail, foodservice and vending, scaling up production processes safely, adopting new technologies and expanding distribution networks. The knowledge shared therefore spans the entire process, from initial product and category concepts through to stable, full-scale production. The event takes place at Ptak Warsaw Expo in Nadarzyn, south-west of Warsaw, one of Poland’s leading exhibition and event centres. Its location within the Warsaw metropolitan area, with access to major transport routes and proximity to Warsaw Chopin Airport, makes the venue easily accessible to both domestic and international visitors. The READY FOOD Poland Expo thus serves as a specialised meeting place for companies seeking insights into the products, technologies and business models shaping the growing market for ready meals, convenience food and food-to-go solutions in Poland and beyond.

DairyTech in Krasnogorsk near Moscow is a leading international trade fair for the dairy and meat industry, held annually in January. NEW LABEL POLAND is Poland’s leading industry event, dedicated with precision and innovative drive to private labels, modern consumer goods trends, and technological solutions. The name “NEW LABEL” symbolizes the fair’s core mission: a leap into new brand worlds – the development of future-oriented products and the creation of unique customer experiences through private labels, packaging technology, and product design. The event serves not only as a marketplace but also as a strategic forum actively shaping the transformation of the consumer goods industry. The venue is the prestigious PTAK Warsaw Expo in Nadarzyn – Poland’s largest and most modern exhibition center, located just a few kilometers from Warsaw. The event is organized by Ptak Warsaw Expo Sp. z o. o. , renowned for high-quality trade fairs with international appeal and outstanding logistical infrastructure. At the heart of NEW LABEL POLAND are the latest developments and trends in the sectors of fresh products, frozen foods, shelf-stable groceries, confectionery, baked goods, and both alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages. Also strongly represented are health and functional foods, personal care and cosmetic products, household chemicals, baby and child care items, pet supplies, as well as pioneering innovations in packaging, labeling, and private label technologies. The fair is not only a comprehensive product platform but also a showcase for technological solutions – from smart packaging and automation to digital private label management. NEW LABEL POLAND brings together manufacturers, retail chains, suppliers, and decision-makers from across Europe – spanning the food and beverage industry, drugstore and cosmetics sector, and wholesale and retail trade. Special focus is placed on professional visitors from the private label segment, including product developers, buyers, packaging specialists, and retail brand strategists. As such, the fair functions as a highly specialized, internationally oriented B2B networking event. A true highlight is the presentation of innovative products, where outstanding private label developments and breakthrough technologies are recognized and awarded. With its strong focus on the Central European market and deliberate positioning in economically dynamic Poland, the fair also acts as a bridge between Western and Eastern Europe. It highlights Poland’s strategic role in the production, development, and trade of consumer goods. The PTAK Warsaw Expo is conveniently located near the capital city of Warsaw and is easily accessible via the S8 expressway or by shuttle service from Chopin Airport and the city center. With state-of-the-art infrastructure, expansive exhibition halls, and comprehensive business facilities, the venue offers ideal conditions for both exhibitors and visitors.

The A\FAIR trade fair in Augsburg is a diverse experience-oriented event held annually at the Augsburg Exhibition Center. It is organized by the Augsburger Schwabenhallen Messe- und Veranstaltungsgesellschaft mbH. The name "A\FAIR" stands for "Augsburg Fair" and highlights the regional connection to the Bavarian metropolis. The fair brings together a wide range of topics, offering exciting insights and interactive experiences for both trade visitors and the general public. A key feature of A\FAIR is the presentation of regional specialties, products, and services from Bavaria and beyond. In the "Region & Heimat" and "Home & Delight" sections, visitors can discover culinary delicacies, admire handcrafted products, and try out innovative household items. Leisure and tourism offerings also play a significant role, with associations and organizations introducing new hobbies and showcasing attractive excursion destinations in Bavaria and the surrounding areas. A particular highlight is the interactive experience zones, where visitors can immerse themselves in different thematic areas. The "Entertainment A\REA" offers captivating performances such as acrobatic dance shows, magic acts, and fashion shows. The "Health A\REA" focuses on health and well-being, while the "Impulse A\REA" provides inspiring lectures on tourism, gastronomy, and fitness. Sports enthusiasts can take part in guided workouts in the "Fitness A\REA," while the "Travel A\REA" presents sustainable travel options. Food lovers will enjoy the "Live-Cooking A\REA" and the "Cook-your-own A\REA," where top chefs demonstrate their skills and visitors can actively participate. Several major events take place alongside the fair. These include "intersana," a trade show for health innovations; "Immobilientage," focusing on construction and housing; "CREATIVMESSE," catering to DIY enthusiasts; and "VOLT FUTURE MOBILITY," dedicated to pioneering mobility solutions. The A\FAIR trade fair serves as a key meeting point for exhibitors from sectors such as tourism, leisure, gastronomy, health, fitness, craftsmanship, mobility, and real estate. It appeals to a broad audience, from families and culinary enthusiasts to trade visitors and industry experts. With its strong regional focus and emphasis on sustainable, forward-thinking products, it supports the local economy and reinforces Augsburg’s role as a hub for innovation and trade fairs. The Augsburg Exhibition Center boasts a modern infrastructure and excellent accessibility. Thanks to its well-connected transport links, both by car and public transportation, visitors from across Germany can travel conveniently and enjoy a unique trade fair experience.

The International Confectionery Fair (ISM) is a leading global trade fair specializing in confectionery and snack items . Since 2014, the highlight of the fair has been the ISM Award ceremony, which honors outstanding achievements in the confectionery and snack industry. The fair's concept is complemented by special shows and forums, such as the New Product Showcase for new products and the Innova Market Insights for new product trends. The ISM is not just a place for direct business contacts but also a showcase for consumer-oriented, innovative ideas and concepts that shape the future of the industry. The fair is held on the grounds of the Cologne Fair , a modern and accessible venue offering ideal conditions for exhibitors and visitors. With its long history, extensive offerings, and role as a trendsetter, the ISM is an indispensable event for all players in the confectionery and snack industry.

The Ethio Chamber International Trade Fair is Ethiopia’s premier platform for international business relations, innovation, and sustainable development. Organized by the Ethiopian Chamber of Commerce and Sectoral Associations , this annual trade fair, held at Exhibition Center in the heart of Addis Ababa, brings together national and international industry leaders, investors, and trade professionals. Exhibitors showcase not only raw commodities but also processed goods and innovative agricultural solutions that strengthen domestic value chains. The fair connects small-scale farmers with international markets, promotes investment in agri-tech and packaging, and supports initiatives for food security. The textile and apparel industry, one of Ethiopia’s most dynamic export sectors, is represented through locally grown cotton, modern manufacturing technologies, and sustainable materials. Designers, manufacturers, and global buyers meet here to explore business opportunities, set trends, and elevate production standards. In the field of information and communication technology, Ethiopia presents itself as an emerging hub of digital transformation. Start-ups, software developers, fintech firms, and digital service providers showcase innovations that are reshaping the country’s economic landscape. Particular attention is given to youth-led enterprises, investments in digital infrastructure, and education initiatives in artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and coding. The construction sector also demonstrates its innovative capacity: from housing developments and sustainable building materials to digital tools for project management, the fair offers a comprehensive overview. It fosters connections between international investors and local stakeholders, while highlighting large-scale infrastructure projects and sustainable urban development. A key highlight of the event includes targeted business matching sessions, investor forums, and industry panels that encourage collaboration and foster new partnerships. The fair serves not only as a marketplace but also as a catalyst for innovation and change. Exhibitors represent a diverse range of enterprises — from multinational corporations and local start-ups to artisan-driven businesses. Visitors primarily include business professionals, investors, government representatives, and actors from development organizations. Addis Ababa , the host city, is not only Ethiopia’s capital but also the political and economic hub of East Africa. Exhibition Center  offers easy access via public transportation, taxis, and nearby hotels. Situated close to key government offices, corporate headquarters, and international institutions, the venue provides an ideal setting for global networking. The Ethio Chamber International Trade Fair is more than just an exhibition — it is a showcase of Ethiopia’s economic future and an open invitation to the world to be part of its progress.

Overall, FRUIT LOGISTICA is an indispensable event for all players in the fruit trade, from producers and traders to logistics experts.

TASTE by Pitti Immagine Srl is more than just a fair; it is an annual culinary festival held at the Fortezza da Basso in Florence. Showcasing outstanding products from the food and wine scene, TASTE captivates with its uniqueness and its deep connection to Italy’s rich culinary culture. Over 700 exhibitors, including 100 new additions, showcase their latest products and services from the world of gastronomy. TASTE not only stands for "taste" but also symbolizes the sampling of high-quality culinary products and promotes research and innovation in this field. The event attracts professionals from the food and beverage industry, as well as gourmets and food enthusiasts in search of exceptional culinary experiences. The exhibition is divided into several areas: TASTE TOUR offers a journey through top culinary and oenological products, providing special tasting experiences. TASTE SPIRITS highlights Italian spirit producers and presents small, specialized companies with unique stories. TASTE TOOLS displays, in addition to food, lifestyle products that enhance the culinary enjoyment. The UNICREDIT TASTE ARENA serves as a forum for discussions on current food industry topics, featuring meetings, debates, and masterclasses by experts. A special feature of TASTE is its connection to the city of Florence, a center of culture and gastronomy. The Fuoriditaste program deepens this connection by hosting thematic tastings and presentations at selected locations in the city in the evening. The exhibitors, ranging from small artisan businesses to large manufacturers, make TASTE a must-attend for industry insiders. Lastly, it is noteworthy that Fortezza da Basso is not only a historically significant location in Florence but also easily accessible, making it the ideal venue for an internationally important event like TASTE. This event promises a comprehensive experience for all who are passionate about culinary innovations and trends.

HORECA Baleares is the leading trade fair for the hospitality, gastronomy, and catering sectors in the Balearic Islands – a key industry event held annually at the Palma Arena (Consorci Velòdrom Illes Balears) in Palma de Mallorca. Organized by Todo Eventos de las Islas, a regionally rooted event organizer specializing in high-quality industry platforms, HORECA Baleares has established itself as a format that highlights trends, shares knowledge, and promotes professional exchange. As the annual meeting point for the industry, the fair brings together brands, producers, distributors, and professionals to showcase innovative and forward-looking solutions for the hotel and gastronomy sectors. It does not merely add to the list of trade shows – it stands out as the platform in the Balearics, uniquely combining regional identity, culinary creativity, and economic foresight. Key topics include innovation and digitalization, sustainable gastronomy concepts, regional products – such as fresh fish from the Balearic Sea – as well as targeted professional development in areas like marketing, business succession, and human resources. Exhibitors come from across the industry: food production, beverage distribution, kitchen technology, IT services, furniture design, cleaning solutions, and training – everything modern hospitality and gastronomy businesses need. The audience consists primarily of decision-makers, buyers, professionals, and entrepreneurs from hotels, restaurants, bars, catering companies, and tourism businesses across all Balearic Islands. A true highlight of the fair are the culinary competitions – including the creative “Tartar Gourmet” contest and the show-cooking challenge “Cocina con Pescado Popular”, where local fish varieties take center stage in gourmet cuisine. These live events make the fair not only informative but also emotionally engaging and experience-driven – a genuine USP within the national trade show landscape. HORECA Baleares is part of a regional trade fair series – tailored both in content and geography – authentically reflecting the specific characteristics of the Balearic market. It directly addresses regional needs, from tourism-driven business models to local supply chains and Spanish regulatory requirements. The Palma Arena – a modern, light-filled venue close to the city center – offers ideal conditions for both exhibitors and visitors. It is easily accessible by public transport, car, or taxi, and is located just minutes from Palma de Mallorca Airport. For those looking to engage with the industry at the heart of the Mediterranean, gain fresh insights, and network with like-minded professionals, HORECA Baleares is the trade fair of the year.

The SIPRHO, an acronym for "Salon des Plages, Hôtellerie et de la Restauration," is an international trade fair focusing on the hospitality and catering industries. Held every year in February at Montpellier Exhibition Center in Pérols, it first took place in 2010. The fair encompasses a wide range of themes essential to the hospitality industry. This includes beaches, bars, restaurants, hotels, as well as food and beverages. Additionally, furniture, decoration, tableware, kitchen and dining room equipment, hotel supplies, and hygiene products are central. Textiles, services, training, and the design of beach and outdoor areas are also significant. A distinctive feature of the SIPRHO is the variety of products and services specifically designed for the hospitality industry. The fair serves as a platform where exhibitors can showcase their latest products and trends, from food and beverages to restaurant furniture and gastronomic services. It thus offers a window into innovation and an opportunity for industry experts and marketing professionals to share valuable insights and advice. The fair is enriched by interactive events such as a bartender competition, cooking demonstrations, and wine tastings. These contribute to a dynamic and inspiring atmosphere, allowing visitors to engage directly with products and services. The venue, the Montpellier Exhibition Center in Pérols, close to Montpellier, with its modern infrastructure and proximity to the Mediterranean coast, provides an ideal setting. This makes it an attractive destination for international visitors and exhibitors. In summary, the SIPRHO fair in Pérols near Montpellier presents an outstanding opportunity for hospitality professionals to stay informed about the latest trends, network, and prepare for the upcoming summer season.

Vitafoods India is a specialized trade fair accompanied by a conference, dedicated to the rapidly growing industry of dietary supplements, functional foods, and health-focused nutrition. Since its launch in 2023, it has established itself as a key industry platform in India. The event is held annually at the Jio World Convention Centre (JWCC) in Mumbai – one of Asia’s most advanced venues, offering excellent infrastructure and direct connections to hotels, the international airport, and the city center. Vitafoods India is organized by Informa PLC, a global leader in trade exhibitions, conferences, and industry intelligence, headquartered in London. As part of the international Vitafoods event series, it plays a strategically important role within the global health and nutrition network. The focus of the exhibition is on science-backed innovations and current market trends across the entire value chain of the nutraceutical and functional food industry. Exhibitors showcase their latest developments in raw materials, ingredients, dietary supplements, functional foods and beverages, botanical extracts, packaging, processing technologies, laboratory analytics, as well as research and development. A highlight of the event is the Innovation Zone, where groundbreaking product innovations and technological advancements are unveiled for the first time. The event attracts industry professionals from across India and increasingly from international markets – including manufacturers, suppliers, distributors, scientists, product developers, marketing specialists, regulatory experts, and decision-makers from the fields of nutrition, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, food technology, and healthcare. The accompanying conference provides in-depth insights into regulatory developments, scientific research, market analysis, and supply chain solutions. It promotes knowledge sharing and strengthens the industry’s capacity for innovation. India is considered one of the fastest-growing markets in the field of health-focused nutrition. A strong demand for natural products, Ayurvedic formulations, and modern health solutions is driving this trend. Vitafoods India responds to these developments by offering a platform that connects local market potential with global innovation. The exhibition experience is further enhanced by networking events, interactive formats, and special features such as product showcases and expert panels – offering ideal opportunities for building business relationships and staying attuned to industry developments. The Jio World Convention Centre, located in the central Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC), reflects the high standards of the event. It is easily accessible – whether by car, train, or from the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport, which is just around 20 minutes away.

The Lisbon Food Affair is a specialized trade fair and has established itself as Portugal’s leading platform for the food, beverage, gastronomy, and food technology sectors. Its name stands for a three-part exhibition concept encompassing the areas of Food & Beverage, Horeca, and Technology. The event is held at the renowned exhibition center Feira Internacional de Lisboa (FIL) in the Portuguese capital, Lisbon, where it takes place at irregular intervals. Organized by Feira Internacional de Lisboa, the Lisbon Food Affair sees itself not merely as a product showcase, but as a central industry platform. It offers professionals the opportunity to tap into the Portuguese market, explore business opportunities, and establish international connections. The fair actively promotes exchange between local producers and international partners and targets trade visitors from the fields of retail, gastronomy, hospitality, manufacturing, and technology, who are keen to stay informed about current developments and trends. The spotlight is on three closely interlinked thematic areas: Food & Beverage , featuring a diverse range of products – from olive oil, fish, meat, dairy, and canned goods to innovations in food development; Horeca , focusing on equipment, design, technology, and services for the gastronomy, hospitality, and catering sectors; and Technology , showcasing cutting-edge machinery, equipment, packaging solutions, refrigeration systems, quality control technologies, laboratory services, and logistics solutions tailored for the food industry. The Lisbon Food Affair not only offers direct access to the Portuguese market but also holds a unique position within the country. As the only trade fair of its kind, it brings together the entire value chain of the sector under one roof. It is particularly attractive to international companies seeking to use Portugal as a gateway to Southern European or Portuguese-speaking markets. A key component of the fair is its wide-ranging supporting program. Live cooking shows with renowned chefs, themed workshops, expert conferences, networking events, and business meetings turn the trade fair into a dynamic platform for exchange, product presentation, and direct business deals. Exhibitors include companies from the food and beverage production sector, mechanical and plant engineering, gastronomy and hospitality equipment, technology and software, as well as consulting services. Visitors primarily consist of industry professionals specifically seeking new products, innovative solutions, and business partners. The venue, located in the modern Parque das Nações district, lies directly on the banks of the River Tagus and is easily accessible by public transport and via Lisbon’s international airport, which is just a few minutes away. The surrounding area also offers numerous gastronomic and cultural attractions – the perfect setting for a trade fair that unites culinary excellence, advanced technology, and high-level business networking.

The BioFach in Nuremberg, established in 1990, is recognized as the world's leading trade fair for organic products and serves as the core of the organic industry. Organized by NürnbergMesse GmbH, this industry gathering takes place every February and acts as a central meeting point for manufacturers, traders, and decision-makers in the organic product world. The fair is distinguished by its stringent certification: All presented organic food must be certified according to the EU Organic Regulation or the guidelines of IFOAM – the International Federation of Organic Agriculture Movements, which also serves as the patron of BioFach. This quality control emphasizes BioFach's commitment to authenticity and sustainability in the organic food sector. A key component of the fair is the BIOFACH Congress, which has established itself as a fixed part of the program. Here, experts convene to discuss the latest findings, trends, and developments in the organic industry. This congress offers a unique platform for knowledge transfer, networking, and the exchange of ideas. BioFach also extends beyond the food industry. In conjunction with Vivaness, the leading fair for natural cosmetics and wellness, it presents a comprehensive spectrum of organic products and services. This makes the fair an attractive destination for a highly qualified, international professional audience. The fair takes place at the Nuremberg Exhibition Center, a modern and accessible exhibition center providing optimal conditions for exhibitors and visitors from around the world. The Nuremberg Exhibition Center is known for its spacious exhibition halls and excellent infrastructure, enabling participants to present their products and services in an appealing environment. In summary, BioFach in Nuremberg is not only a showcase for certified organic food and natural cosmetics but also a vibrant forum for innovations, trends, and the exchange of expert knowledge. With its decades-long history and commitment to quality and sustainability, BioFach sets standards in the organic industry and remains an indispensable meeting point for professionals from around the globe.
