CATEX , short for Catering Exhibition, is the largest trade fair for gastronomy and hospitality in Ireland, first held in 1965. It takes place annually at the RDS Simmonscourt Pavilion in Dublin, organized by the Irish Foodservice Suppliers Alliance (IFSA) in cooperation with EventHaus Ltd. This event brings together leading industry experts to discuss the latest trends and innovations. The fair is characterized by a wide range of topics, from product and service innovations to energy savings and waste management, extending to sustainability efforts. Visitors can experience the introduction of new technologies and sustainable practices that reflect current industry trends. Additionally, CATEX provides an excellent platform for networking with industry leaders and peers. A highlight of the fair includes national competitions such as the National Coffee Championships and the Chef Ireland Culinary Competitions. These events, along with the IFSA Awards, honor exceptional achievements and advancements in efficiency and sustainability. With more than 270 exhibitors from various sectors of the gastronomy and hospitality industries—from commercial kitchen equipment suppliers to food producers and hospitality service providers—CATEX serves as a significant industry meeting point. The primary audience includes professionals such as hotel managers, restaurant owners, and catering companies. The fair is of great importance not only to the city of Dublin but also to the entire country of Ireland, as it serves as a crucial meeting place for the local and international hospitality industry. The RDS Simmonscourt, with its central location and excellent infrastructure, provides the ideal venue for such a large and diverse event as CATEX. As one of the city’s leading venues, it ensures excellent transport links, contributing to the success of this important industry fair.

By facilitating the exchange of innovative solutions, Nepal Dairytech helps improve food safety and strengthen the competitiveness of Nepalese dairy products in both domestic and international markets. A key highlight of the fair is the series of expert conferences, where industry leaders discuss the latest trends and challenges in dairy production. Additionally, innovative products and processes are recognized and awarded to promote technological advancements in the sector. Exhibitors at Nepal Dairytech represent various industries, including machinery and equipment manufacturing, dairy processing, animal husbandry, feed production, packaging technology, and quality control. The primary visitors include dairy farmers, dairy processors, food manufacturers, investors, and key decision-makers from the agriculture and food industries. The Chitwan Expo Center in Bharatpur offers an ideal infrastructure for the event and is easily accessible due to its central location. The event is held annually at the Chitwan Expo Center in Bharatpur and is organized by Nepal Agritech Pvt. Ltd. in collaboration with Futurex Trade Fair and Event Pvt. Ltd.
Nepal Dairytech focuses on modern technologies and solutions for milk processing, quality control, and sustainable production and management methods. Visitors gain insights into innovative machinery and processes that enhance efficiency and hygiene in milk processing. Special emphasis is placed on new quality control techniques that improve the safety and nutritional value of dairy products. Additionally, the latest developments in dairy farming are showcased, providing farmers with opportunities to enhance their production through sustainable methods.
The fair serves as a platform for the presentation of milk processing equipment, pasteurization systems, cheese and butter production technologies, and packaging solutions. Moreover, it features feed, animal health products, and services related to quality assurance, laboratory technology, and cold chain logistics. This diversity makes Nepal Dairytech an essential event for industry professionals looking to stay updated on the latest technologies and explore new business opportunities.
The dairy industry plays a crucial role in Nepal’s economy and food security. Many small-scale farmers rely on milk production as their primary source of livelihood, while dairy products form an essential part of the Nepalese diet and contribute to combating malnutrition. By facilitating the exchange of innovative solutions, Nepal Dairytech helps improve food safety and strengthen the competitiveness of Nepalese dairy products in both domestic and international markets.
A key highlight of the fair is the series of expert conferences, where industry leaders discuss the latest trends and challenges in dairy production. Additionally, innovative products and processes are recognized and awarded to promote technological advancements in the sector.
Exhibitors at Nepal Dairytech represent various industries, including machinery and equipment manufacturing, dairy processing, animal husbandry, feed production, packaging technology, and quality control. The primary visitors include dairy farmers, dairy processors, food manufacturers, investors, and key decision-makers from the agriculture and food industries.
The Chitwan Expo Center in Bharatpur offers an ideal infrastructure for the event and is easily accessible due to its central location.  With excellent transport connectivity and numerous accommodation options, Nepal Dairytech is easily accessible for both national and international visitors.
The Nepal Dairytech will take place on 3 days from Thursday, 18. February to Saturday, 20. February 2027 in Bharatpur.

ScotHot is Scotland’s premier trade fair for food, beverages, hospitality, and tourism. Held every two years at the SEC Scottish Events Campus in Glasgow, it has established itself as an essential platform for industry professionals since its inception in 1974. The name ScotHot , short for Scottish Hospitality , highlights the event’s strong focus on the gastronomy and tourism sectors. The trade fair is organized by 365 Events, a renowned event management company specializing in exhibitions for the hospitality, gastronomy, and food industries. ScotHot showcases a wide range of products and services. Alongside high-quality regional foods and both national and international beverages, the fair presents cutting-edge kitchen technologies, hotel and restaurant supplies, and digital solutions tailored to the industry. Manufacturers, suppliers, and service providers from the food production, gastronomy, hospitality, beverage, and tourism sectors use this platform to introduce their latest products to a professional audience. A defining feature of ScotHot is its deep connection to Scottish culture and economy. The fair actively supports regional producers, offering them a platform to present their artisanal specialties through events such as the Scottish Regional Foods Market. Additionally, the Great Taste Market, organized by the Guild of Fine Food , showcases award-winning food products from Scotland and beyond. Beyond the exhibition spaces, ScotHot features an extensive supporting program that includes expert talks, interactive formats, and competitions. The STA Spotlight Stage, curated in collaboration with the Scottish Tourism Alliance , focuses on key industry topics, offering insights into market trends, discussing challenges, and presenting forward-thinking concepts. The Liquid Academy Live section is dedicated to beverage innovations, where sommeliers, bartenders, and industry professionals unveil their latest creations and share their expertise. A particular highlight is the Caledonian Bartenders Cup, in which 24 Scottish bartenders compete for the prestigious title. Another major attraction is the Scottish Culinary Championships, where over 250 chefs compete in various disciplines to showcase their culinary skills. Visitors can not only witness thrilling live competitions but also admire impressive edible artwork in the Culinary Art Exhibition. The event is further enriched by the ScotHot Innovation Awards, which recognize the industry’s most groundbreaking products and set new benchmarks for future developments. ScotHot is aimed at professionals from the hospitality, gastronomy, food production, beverage, and tourism industries. Restaurant owners, hotel directors, caterers, retailers, and investors attend the event to network with leading experts, establish valuable business connections, and discover pioneering trends shaping their industries. The SEC Scottish Events Campus in Glasgow is one of the UK’s most modern exhibition venues and is easily accessible by both public transport and car. The city itself is known for its vibrant culinary scene, striking architecture, and rich cultural landscape, making it the perfect location for a trade fair dedicated to hospitality, gastronomy, and innovation.

The Apimell in Piacenza is an internationally trade fair, specializing in beekeeping, bee products, and related equipment. The name "Apimell" is derived from the Latin terms for bee ("Apis") and honey ("Mel"), which epitomize the essence of this event. Hosted by Piacenza Expo SpA at the Piacenza Expo, this annual event holds a steadfast position in the calendars of numerous professionals within the beekeeping industry. It attracts exhibitors from a wide range of areas: from technologies for setting up beehives, equipment for honey extraction and wax processing, to specialized beekeeping tools. The diversity of products, from polyfloral honey and royal jelly to innovative devices, makes Apimell a truly impressive event. The Apimell is deeply connected to the city of Piacenza and to Italy as a whole, serving as one of the most significant platforms for the country's beekeeping sector. Beyond product displays, it also functions as an information hub where visitors can stay updated on current trends and future outlooks. This is facilitated by a top-tier conference program, organized in collaboration with leading associations from the beekeeping realm, such as FAI, UNAAPI, ANAI, and APAP. A particular highlight is the presentation of natural hive products, used in nutrition, cosmetics, and medicine. The main attendees of Apimell include professional beekeepers, bee enthusiasts, and experts from related fields. In conclusion, it's worth noting that the Piacenza Expo is a modern exhibition center, easily accessible and offering top-notch facilities for both exhibitors and visitors. Piacenza itself, a city rich in culture and history, offers an array of attractions and experiences beyond the trade fair.

Foodex Japan, an international trade fair for the food and beverage industry as well as the gastronomy sector, is held annually at the impressive Tokyo Big Sight, one of the largest exhibition centers in Tokyo. Foodex Japan is a vital part of the Japanese economy, serving as a platform for both international and local exhibitors to present their latest products and services. In conclusion, Foodex Japan is more than just a showcase for the latest products and services in the food and beverage industry; it is a central meeting point for professionals from around the world. The venue, Tokyo Big Sight, is easily accessible due to its modern and spacious facilities, providing an excellent environment for this prestigious event.

The IHE Inter Health Expo is an annual trade fair and one of the most significant B2B events for the healthcare industry in China. With its thematic depth, strategically favorable location in one of China’s most dynamic economic hubs, and clear focus on professional attendees, the IHE Inter Health Expo is an essential platform for companies looking to enter the Chinese healthcare market or expand their international business opportunities.

The "Food Pack Asia" is a trade fair focusing on the food processing and packaging industry. Since its inception in 2009, it has become a key meeting point for professionals from various sectors, including hospitality, catering, and retail. Organized by the Digiview Advertising Group, the fair takes place annually at the modern Bangkok International Trade & Exhibition Center (BITEC), near Bangkok's port and international airport. Food Pack Asia covers a wide range of topics, including food processing machinery, mixing, cutting, and grinding technologies, refrigeration systems, ice machines, and freeze-drying techniques. There is a special focus on automation, robotics, and the latest inspection systems used in food production. The fair also offers insights into pharmaceutical technology, showcasing pharmaceutical machinery, packaging, and tabletting equipment. Another key aspect of the fair is the introduction of OEM solutions for dietary supplements, herbs, and cosmetics. Laboratory and testing technology, including microbiological analyses and various measuring instruments, are also essential components of the exhibition. In beverage technology, the fair displays a variety of equipment and technologies necessary for beverage production and packaging. For the hotel and restaurant equipment sector, cleaning materials, commercial kitchen devices, and catering equipment are presented. Packaging and printing technology, a core theme of the fair, includes solutions for packaging, labeling, and printing. In addition, a wide range of foods and beverages, from bakery and confectionery products to non-alcoholic drinks and organic products, are exhibited. The fair provides not only a platform for product and service presentations but also for workshops, seminars, and conferences discussing topics like industry standards and new technologies. Thus, Food Pack Asia offers excellent opportunities for direct exchange and networking with potential business partners, as well as exploring new markets.

The China (Guangzhou) International Nutrition Healthy Food and Organic Products Exhibition (CINHOE) is an annual trade fair that has become one of Asia’s leading platforms for healthy nutrition, functional foods, and organic products since its inception in 1999. Organized by Guangzhou Yi Fan Exhibition Co., Ltd., a seasoned trade show organizer specializing in the health and food sectors, CINHOE offers a focused stage for industry professionals from around the world interested in the latest developments and innovations in health foods and organic products. The event takes place at the China Import & Export Fair Complex in Guangzhou, Asia’s largest and most advanced exhibition center. Formerly known as the Guangzhou International Convention and Exhibition Center, this impressive venue symbolizes China’s economic and technological progress and provides state-of-the-art facilities ideal for hosting a trade fair of international standing. CINHOE is more than just an exhibition—it serves as a central meeting point for the global health and wellness industry. Every year, it attracts thousands of professionals, including manufacturers, distributors, retailers, and industry experts. The exhibition covers a wide yet clearly structured range of topics, with a strong focus on functional foods, dietary supplements, traditional Chinese health products, medical nutrition, organic foods, natural products, weight management solutions, and sports nutrition. This is complemented by nutraceutical ingredients, healthy sweeteners, functional raw materials, as well as cutting-edge packaging and production technologies, quality management systems, and e-commerce solutions for international trade. Key highlights of the event include product launches and service innovations from international exhibitors, interactive exchanges within national pavilions, and targeted networking opportunities. The exhibition features dedicated thematic zones that spotlight trends such as clean-label nutrition, ecological agriculture, and probiotics in cosmetics. By combining industry trends with scientific research and practical applications, CINHOE has become an indispensable platform for decision-makers in the field. With over two decades of experience and growing international relevance, CINHOE is recognized as a key driver for a sustainable future in the global health and nutrition industry.

VIV Asia is an international trade fair for animal protein production and food processing in Asia. The name "VIV" stands for "VIV worldwide" and is part of a global trade fair platform covering the entire value chain from feed production to food processing. The event takes place every two years at the renowned Bangkok International Trade & Exhibition Center (BITEC) in the Thai metropolis of Bangkok. Thanks to its strategic location in the heart of Asia, it serves as a central platform for professionals from around the world to exchange knowledge, discover innovations, and establish business connections. As one of the most significant trade fairs for the livestock and food industries in Asia, VIV Asia is organized by VNU Exhibitions Europe, a leading organizer of international trade fairs. The exhibition covers a broad spectrum of topics, including animal production and husbandry, feed production, animal health, veterinary services, and food processing. It provides a unique opportunity to explore the latest technologies, innovations, and services shaping the future of the animal protein industry. International and regional exhibitors from Europe, America, Asia, and the Middle East showcase a comprehensive range of products and services, from feed ingredients and additives to breeding and hatching technologies, agricultural production, and food technology, as well as IT and automation solutions. Logistics, cold chain management, media, consultancy, and laboratory technology are also well represented. This diversity makes the fair an essential platform for companies operating along the entire livestock value chain. The exhibition attracts a high-caliber audience from livestock farming, feed production, food processing, trade, and research sectors. Visitors benefit from the opportunity to connect with new business partners, engage with industry leaders, and discover innovative solutions for their companies. Bangkok itself is not only a major economic center but also a city with excellent infrastructure and international connectivity. Kulinar Tulln is the most significant gourmet fair in Lower Austria, attracting food enthusiasts, gastronomy professionals, and lovers of fine cuisine to the picturesque town of Tulln on the Danube each year. As a public fair, it welcomes everyone passionate about high-end cuisine, innovative food trends, and exclusive wines. Organized by Messe Tulln GmbH, the event is held at a modern exhibition center, offering excellent accessibility and ideal infrastructure for a delightful culinary experience. The focus of Kulinar Tulln is the diverse world of gastronomy, food, and kitchen culture. Visitors can explore regional specialties, international delicacies, fine wines and spirits, organic products, as well as innovative kitchen tools and cooking appliances. The fair is not only a unique opportunity to discover new flavors but also provides exciting insights into the latest trends in the food and gourmet industry. A special highlight is the Cooking Arena, where renowned top chefs and award-winning "Hauben" chefs showcase their culinary skills live, creating exclusive dishes. Hauben chefs are outstanding culinary masters recognized by the prestigious Austrian restaurant guide Gault&Millau, which awards them one or more Hauben (French: toque, chef’s hat). These chefs set new gastronomic standards with their innovative creations and commitment to the highest product quality. Visitors have the opportunity to learn directly from the professionals, try out new recipes, and draw inspiration from their expertise. Another highlight is the wide range of wine tastings, where guests can sample exquisite regional wines as well as international top selections. Running alongside Kulinar Tulln is "pool + garden Tulln", an exhibition dedicated to stylish outdoor living. The combination of a gourmet fair and a garden expo creates a unique experience for those who appreciate both culinary delights and exclusive outdoor living. With its diverse offerings, top-tier program, and exceptional atmosphere, Kulinar Tulln is an unmissable event for anyone who enjoys the art of fine dining with passion.

Lähiruoka & Luomu is a trade fair in Finland specializing in regional and organic food. The name is derived from the Finnish terms "Lähiruoka" (regional food) and "Luomu" (organic products), symbolizing high-quality, sustainable nutrition. As an integral part of the renowned Kevät Messut, this unique fair takes place annually in spring at the Messukeskus Helsinki, offering visitors the opportunity to explore the diversity of Finnish small-scale producers and sustainable food. The fair is organized by Messukeskus Helsinki, Finland's largest trade and convention center. Thanks to its central location and excellent infrastructure, it provides optimal conditions for exhibitors and visitors alike. The event highlights key topics such as regional food production, organic farming, and sustainable nutrition trends. It offers deep insights into a responsible food culture, bringing together producers, retailers, restaurateurs, and consumers. The fair serves as a platform for exchanging ideas on current developments in the food industry and discovering new products. The product range is diverse, spanning from artisanal meat and dairy products to grain-based foods, root vegetables, and traditional specialties, as well as innovative protein sources such as hemp. The fair also features organic ice cream, preserved foods, and canned goods. In addition to opportunities for tasting and purchasing products, the event offers a varied program, including cooking demonstrations, expert lectures, and workshops. Visitors receive valuable tips on sustainable nutrition and gain insights into organic certifications, eco-friendly production methods, and fair trade practices. A particular highlight of the fair is the presentation of the "Vuoden lähiruokateko" award ("Local Food Action of the Year"), which honors outstanding initiatives promoting regional food. This competition raises awareness of sustainable production and provides small businesses with a platform to showcase their innovations. The fair attracts exhibitors from various sectors, including organic farmers, local producers, gourmet food retailers, gastronomy businesses, and food technology companies. It also serves as a valuable networking platform for retailers, restaurant owners, and professionals in the food industry, facilitating new business opportunities. The main visitors include environmentally conscious consumers, professionals from the hospitality industry, and key decision-makers in the food sector. Lähiruoka & Luomu has established itself as a key event in Finland’s trade fair calendar, making a significant contribution to raising awareness of sustainable nutrition. As an integral part of Kevät Messut, it benefits from a broad audience and synergies with other thematic fairs in the areas of gardening, home living, and outdoor activities. Messukeskus Helsinki, the venue of the event, is not only Finland’s most important exhibition center but also conveniently accessible. It is well connected by public transport and easily reachable by car. Its central location in the Finnish capital makes it an ideal destination for both national and international visitors looking to be inspired at one of Northern Europe’s most modern exhibition venues.

VeggieWorld Düsseldorf, as a part of the largest international trade fair series, is entirely dedicated to the vegan lifestyle. It attracts not only the general public but also professional visitors interested in the latest developments and products in the vegan sector. Organized by Wellfairs GmbH, it has established itself as a central platform to highlight the joy and diversity of plant-based living. A wide range of products and services is presented: from dairy and meat alternatives to superfoods and sweets, as well as beverages, clothing, accessories, and cosmetics. Furthermore, sustainability, conscious living, and health are in focus, without neglecting the entertainment value. The fair takes place in the Böhler area in Meerbusch near Düsseldorf, which stands out for its attractive location and excellent accessibility. This creates the ideal setting for an exchange in a pleasant atmosphere and the discovery of the latest vegan trends. A key feature of VeggieWorld Düsseldorf is the direct contact between visitors and manufacturers, allowing for first-hand information about products. Visitors can sample products and stock up on vegan foods and ingredients, often at attractive fair prices. The supporting program offers additional value through a diverse range of lectures, cooking shows, and workshops, available free of charge. These provide insights into the vegan lifestyle, practical tips, and inspiration through the creativity of the vegan community. As part of an international fair series held in Germany and Switzerland, VeggieWorld Düsseldorf emphasizes the growing importance of the vegan lifestyle. It offers a platform for the exchange of ideas, the promotion of sustainable living, and the presentation of the latest products and services in veganism. Organized by Wellfairs GmbH, VeggieWorld stands for quality, innovation, and commitment to a sustainable future.

The "TISCH & TAFEL" fair in Fellbach, not far from Stuttgart, takes place every April and is organized by M&S Messebau & Service GmbH. It has established itself as a significant meeting point for enthusiasts of culinary and living culture. The fair combines gastronomy, drink culture, living, and interior design into an extraordinary experience. Exhibitors present a carefully selected range of products of the highest quality, convincing not only with their characteristics but also with their unique backgrounds. The selection ranges from handmade kitchen and decorative items to extensive living furniture, inviting visitors to immerse themselves in the world of sophisticated living. At the culinary stands, a variety of delicacies tempts attendees, from spirits and spreads to wines and gourmet foods. Additionally, the fair's program includes exclusive cooking shows by renowned chefs and a variety of tastings to satisfy every taste. A characteristic element of "TISCH & TAFEL" is its venue, the Alte Kelter in Fellbach. This historic site, located in the heart of Fellbach and close to the state capital Stuttgart, gives the fair a special atmosphere. The Alte Kelter impresses not only with its imposing architecture and history but also with its excellent public transport connections. For drivers, ample parking is available near the Max-Graser-Stadium. Hosted by M&S Messebau & Service GmbH, "TISCH & TAFEL" reflects the organizers' passion and commitment to creating a platform where exquisite products from the realms of culinary and living culture are showcased. The fair serves as an interface between tradition and innovation, promoting exchange between local producers and an interested audience. As an annual highlight in April, it attracts visitors interested in current trends and innovations in the quality of life and living.

The Bar & Restaurant Expo (BRE) is a leading trade show for the hospitality and beverage industry in North America, held annually at the renowned Las Vegas Convention Center (LVCC). As a key meeting point for industry experts, entrepreneurs, and decision-makers, the expo serves as a platform for innovation, networking, and professional development. Organized by Questex Media LLC, the BRE attracts professionals from across the sector, including restaurateurs, bartenders, restaurant owners, suppliers, and technology providers from around the world. The event focuses on forward-thinking trends and solutions that shape the future of the hospitality industry. Attendees gain insights into the latest beverage trends, from innovative cocktail creations to alcohol-free alternatives that are transforming the market. In the field of food innovation, creative menu concepts and emerging culinary trends take center stage, while cutting-edge kitchen equipment ensures efficient operations. Digital management software helps optimize business processes, while innovative marketing strategies enhance customer engagement and drive revenue growth. Workforce training is also a key component, aimed at improving service quality and team expertise. Another highlight is the focus on design and operational equipment. Stylish furniture and innovative interior concepts set new standards for restaurants and bars, while hospitality technologies enhance the guest experience. The expo also provides an ideal platform for expanding supplier networks and establishing valuable industry connections. Sustainability plays an increasingly important role, with eco-friendly concepts and resource-efficient business practices prominently featured. Interactive highlights such as live demonstrations, tastings, competitions, and award ceremonies make the Bar & Restaurant Expo a dynamic and engaging experience. It brings together leading suppliers from the beverage industry, hospitality equipment, technology, design, and professional training sectors. The event is tailored to a specialized audience, including bar owners, restaurateurs, hotel managers, investors, and industry professionals. Las Vegas as a venue further underscores the significance of the expo. The city is not only known for its vibrant nightlife and world-class hospitality scene but also serves as a hub for innovative restaurant concepts. The Las Vegas Convention Center, one of the most modern exhibition venues in the U.S., offers a prime location with excellent accessibility—whether by air via Harry Reid International Airport, public transportation, or car. The Bar & Restaurant Expo is more than just a trade show—it actively shapes the future of the hospitality industry, offering professionals valuable insights, inspiration, and practical solutions for business success.

Confex is considered a leading trade fair specializing in technologies for the chocolate and confectionery industry. The name "Confex" – an abbreviation for "Confectionery Expertise" – reflects the expertise in confectionery manufacturing. Held annually at the Timiryazev Exhibition Centre in Moscow, the fair brings together the latest technological innovations and advances in confectionery production. The organization of the fair is managed by Gefera Media Ltd, a renowned company in the event industry known for its high-quality fairs. Confex plays a pivotal role in the confectionery industry by gathering leading minds – from executives and decision-makers to opinion leaders – from across the sector. The fair offers a wide range of topics: from equipment and technologies for confectionery manufacturing to ingredients, raw and auxiliary materials, as well as packaging technologies. Additionally, services and solutions relevant to the production of confectionery and chocolate are presented. Other topics include shop construction, quality control, as well as cleaning and hygiene techniques. Production accessories for baked goods are also showcased. The fair not only strengthens the local industry but also serves as an international forum, attracting experts and enthusiasts from around the world. Special highlights are master classes, conferences, and seminars led by industry experts, providing insights into market trends, export strategies, and trading methods. The range of exhibitors at Confex is diverse: it extends from manufacturers of technologies and equipment to suppliers of ingredients and raw materials. The main visitor group consists of top managers, technologists, and professionals from confectionery companies, chocolate manufacturers, as well as representatives from retail and the HoReCa segment.

Go to Volume – or GOTOVO for short – is more than just a trade fair: it is the only event in Russia dedicated exclusively, strategically, and with a forward-looking approach to the rapidly growing market for ready meals and semi-finished food products. This makes it a central platform for innovation, growth, and efficiency in the convenience food industry. Each year, the renowned Timiryazev Exhibition Centre in Moscow opens its doors to host GOTOVO. The fair is organized by Gefera Media Ltd , a well-established player in the Russian trade show sector, known for its expertise in delivering economically relevant topics in focused and professional formats. GOTOVO is clearly and precisely positioned: the spotlight is on technological solutions, ingredients, packaging concepts, and machinery for the industrial production, processing, and marketing of ready-to-eat and semi-finished food products. The exhibition covers a wide range of themes – from frozen foods and pre-cooked meals to fully integrated kitchen systems for automated preparation. On display are both international and Russian technologies for vegetable and meat processing, pasta production, cutting and portioning, cooking systems, packaging solutions, as well as cooling, heating, hygiene, and sanitation systems used in food manufacturing. The fair targets a highly professional audience: industry experts from the food sector, purchasing decision-makers from retail chains, restaurateurs, manufacturers of semi-finished products, and investors in the convenience segment attend GOTOVO to forge new business contacts, explore product innovations, and experience future-oriented production solutions in action. Exhibitors represent sectors such as mechanical engineering, packaging technology, ingredient and additive manufacturing, refrigeration and climate control, logistics, as well as start-ups that reflect emerging food trends. A particular highlight of the event is the series of live demonstrations and innovation showcases, where new products are tested and presented in realistic production environments. Thanks to its excellent transport connections, the Timiryazev Exhibition Centre offers the ideal setting for networking, product demonstrations, and knowledge exchange at the highest professional level. Conveniently accessible from both the city center and Moscow’s international airports, the venue serves as a prime meeting point for industry leaders from Russia, Europe, and Asia.

The Snack Show ranks among Europe’s leading trade fairs for contemporary snacking concepts, quick-service dining and the out-of-home food market. As part of an international portfolio, it attracts senior decision-makers from across Europe and further afield. Paris as the host city reinforces this global positioning. The Snack Show positions itself both as a trend barometer and as a business hub. Exhibits include aperitifs, sweet snacks, ice cream and desserts, bread and baked goods, pasta, salads, sandwiches, sauces, meat and charcuterie products, dairy, frozen foods and international specialities. The offer is complemented by a comprehensive drinks segment covering tea, matcha, energy drinks, juices, natural soft drinks, syrups and lemonades. Non-food categories are equally prominent, with packaging solutions, labelling, disposable and reusable tableware, and tabletop accessories reflecting the growing importance of sustainable and functional presentation formats in the out-of-home sector. The event is primarily targeted at operators of quick-service restaurants, bakeries, coffee shops and chain catering businesses, as well as catering companies, hoteliers, retailers, petrol station and travel retail operators, investors and franchisors. The combination of a global city, state-of-the-art exhibition facilities and a fast-growing foodservice market makes the Snack Show a key date in the calendar for anyone looking to shape the future of Europe’s snacking and quick-service sectors.

The International Food & Drink Event (IFE) is one of the UK’s leading trade shows for the food and drink industry. Held annually at the prestigious ExCeL London, the event transforms the modern exhibition venue in East London into a key meeting point for decision-makers, buyers and brands from around the world. It is organised by Montgomery International Ltd., an experienced British exhibition organiser with a strong international outlook and extensive industry connections. IFE spans the full breadth of the food and drink sector, structured into clearly defined product areas. These include vegan and plant-based products, speciality and artisan foods, chilled and frozen lines, ambient grocery, and wholesale ranges. Health-focused, organic and naturally positioned products also feature prominently. International pavilions showcase culinary concepts from around the globe, creating tangible import and distribution opportunities within the UK market. The show is further enhanced by a dedicated start-up area for emerging brands, a specialist cheese pavilion for premium dairy products, a “free-from” zone for allergen-free and specialist formulations, and a business support hub offering guidance on growth strategies and market entry. In addition, technological innovation, packaging solutions and specialist services for manufacturing, logistics and retail form an integral part of the exhibition. Exhibitors represent virtually every segment of the food and drink industry: producers of ready meals, meat and seafood, bakery products, snacks, confectionery and spices, alongside drinks manufacturers ranging from spirits and soft drinks to low- and no-alcohol propositions. The line-up also includes organic producers, innovative food tech companies and international brands seeking to expand into the UK market. IFE is strictly a trade-only event. Buyers from major retail chains, wholesalers, distributors and importers, as well as foodservice operators, hospitality professionals, product developers and category managers, attend to source products, monitor market developments and build strategic partnerships. A comprehensive programme of seminars, trend briefings and panel discussions provides in-depth insights into consumer behaviour, sustainability requirements and current market trends in the UK and beyond. ExCeL London offers a modern infrastructure, expansive exhibition halls and excellent transport links. Located in the revitalised Royal Docks area, it is directly connected to the public transport network, including the Elizabeth Line and the Docklands Light Railway, and is just minutes from London City Airport. As such, IFE provides not only a commercially relevant marketplace but also a logistically convenient platform for companies looking to succeed in the global food and drink sector.

ANUGA Select Brazil is an international trade fair for food and beverages and ranks among the leading business platforms for the food and drink industry in South America. Held annually in April at the Centro de Convenções – Distrito Anhembi in São Paulo, the event brings together producers, importers, distributors, service providers and senior decision-makers with a clear commercial focus. Its purpose is to generate tangible business opportunities, assess market potential and build long-term partnerships. Rather than serving as a straightforward product showcase, the fair positions itself as a strategic hub for innovation, knowledge exchange and international networking. The event is organised by Koelnmesse Organização de Feiras Ltda., the Brazilian subsidiary of Koelnmesse, one of the world’s leading trade fair organisers in the food sector. In addition to its Cologne base, Koelnmesse delivers further ANUGA formats in high-growth markets such as Asia and the Middle East, creating a global network that gives exhibitors direct access to international sales markets. The exhibition presents a broad yet clearly structured product range, including bakery and confectionery, alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, dairy products, frozen foods, fine foods, fresh fruit and vegetables, canned and ambient goods, as well as organic and health products. The offering is complemented by retail and point-of-sale solutions, along with services for the grocery retail and foodservice sectors. In doing so, the event covers the entire value chain — from production and processing through to distribution and in-store presentation. A strong emphasis is placed on trends, innovation and market intelligence. ANUGA Select Brazil addresses key issues such as sustainable production, transparent supply chains, new product development, clean-label strategies and shifting consumer preferences. It provides in-depth insights into consumer behaviour across Latin America, set within a broader international context. Specialist forums, conference sessions and networking formats equip industry leaders with strategic input for business development. Exhibitors represent sectors including dairy, organic food production, beverages, foodservice, import and export, as well as related service industries. Trade visitors include professionals from grocery retail and wholesale, hospitality, catering, distribution and food processing. The fair is therefore firmly targeted at a qualified B2B audience with defined purchasing and investment intentions. São Paulo’s role as host city underscores the event’s economic significance. As Brazil’s largest city and principal commercial and financial centre, it serves as a gateway to the Latin American food market. Brazil itself is one of the world’s leading agricultural and food producers. The Centro de Convenções – Distrito Anhembi is among the country’s most established exhibition and convention venues. Modern infrastructure, extensive exhibition space and convenient access to international airports and major transport links ensure straightforward travel for trade visitors from Brazil and abroad. ANUGA Select Brazil combines global exhibition expertise with in-depth regional market knowledge. As part of an international trade fair portfolio, it fosters cross-market synergies and provides companies with a focused platform to showcase innovation, strengthen business relationships and actively shape the future of the food system.

Vinitaly is far more than just a wine fair—it is the epicenter of the global wine industry and an indispensable platform for professionals and businesses seeking to deepen their expertise, establish new connections, and explore fresh business opportunities.

Foodex Manufacturing Solutions is one of the United Kingdom’s leading trade exhibitions for the food and drink manufacturing industry. Open exclusively to trade visitors, the event provides a comprehensive overview of the latest developments across the entire food production value chain, from processing and packaging through to logistics, automation and sustainable manufacturing solutions. The exhibition takes place at the National Exhibition Centre (NEC) in Birmingham, one of the UK’s largest and most advanced exhibition venues. Foodex Manufacturing Solutions is held annually and organised by William Reed Ltd., a respected British media and events company specialising in the food, beverage and hospitality sectors. Drawing on the organiser’s extensive industry expertise, the event has established itself as a key meeting place for decision-makers, manufacturers, technology providers and industry professionals. The exhibition focuses on food processing solutions, packaging technologies, intralogistics, and digital and automated production systems. Visitors can explore the latest manufacturing and process technologies, including equipment for mixing, cutting, heating and cooling food products, as well as quality assurance and hygiene management systems. The event also showcases innovative packaging machinery, sustainable packaging solutions, coding and marking technologies, and end-of-line and palletising systems. Additional areas of focus include logistics and supply chain solutions, traceability systems, and warehousing and materials handling technologies for the food industry. Emerging technologies such as robotics, artificial intelligence, Industry 4.0 applications, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and data-driven process optimisation are also strongly represented. Sustainability is another key theme, with exhibitors presenting energy-efficient production methods, resource-saving technologies, circular economy concepts and solutions designed to reduce carbon emissions throughout manufacturing and logistics operations. The exhibition covers a broad range of industry sectors, including meat processing, bakery production, dairy manufacturing, beverage production, fresh foods and seafood. Reflecting this diversity, exhibitors range from machinery and plant manufacturers to packaging specialists, automation providers, software developers, logistics companies and quality management service providers. Key visitor groups include production managers, plant and operations managers, engineers, technicians, quality managers, procurement professionals and senior executives from across the food and drink industry. The event also attracts professionals from the packaging, logistics, retail and research sectors, who attend to discover new technologies, gain insights into market trends and develop valuable business connections. Highlights of the exhibition include live demonstrations of advanced processing and packaging technologies, expert-led conference sessions and presentations showcasing innovative concepts for the factory of the future. The NEC provides a first-class exhibition environment with direct access to the UK motorway network, Birmingham International railway station and Birmingham Airport, which is located adjacent to the venue. This excellent transport infrastructure ensures that Foodex Manufacturing Solutions is easily accessible to both domestic and international visitors, providing an ideal platform for business development, networking and the exchange of forward-looking industry ideas.

The " Food & Drink OEM Matching Expo ", commonly referred to as the OEM Expo , is an annual trade fair held at Tokyo Big Sight in Tokyo. Hosted by Japan Food Journal Co., Ltd., it has established itself as an essential platform for professionals in the food and beverage industry who specialize in the development and production of private labels and OEM products. OEM stands for "Original Equipment Manufacturer", which in this context refers to the production of products under a brand name that does not belong to the manufacturer. Therefore, the fair provides an excellent opportunity to gain deep insights into private label production and establish direct business relationships. The expo covers topics such as processed foods, fresh produce, confections and desserts, spices and sauces, dietary supplements, and beverages, including alcoholic drinks. Additionally, consulting services and analytical devices and systems are presented, enabling participants to explore all aspects from product development to quality control. Exhibitors come from various sectors of food production and related services, ranging from large international corporations to specialized small businesses. The main audience for the fair includes decision-makers in the industry, such as purchasers, product developers, and marketing professionals, making the event a key meeting place for networking and industry insights. Access to the venue, Tokyo Big Sight, is facilitated by its central location and excellent transportation links, including train and bus connections. The modern facilities and impressive architecture of the convention center attract thousands of visitors each year and create an inspiring environment for exhibitions and networking.

The Future Rice Fair is a pioneering trade fair dedicated to the future of rice cultivation and the development of innovative rice-based products. Since its inception in 2022, it has established itself as a key platform for exchanging insights on current developments and trends in the rice industry. Held annually at the prestigious Tokyo Big Sight, Japan’s largest exhibition and convention center, the fair welcomes industry professionals from around the world. Organized by Japan Food Journal Co., Ltd., a leading media group in the food industry, the Future Rice Fair brings together producers, traders, and experts to discuss the future of rice and showcase innovative solutions. A core objective of the fair is to drive transformation in the rice industry and unlock new market potential. The focus is on pioneering cultivation methods, sustainable and technological solutions for rice production, and innovative processing and marketing strategies. Companies and start-ups present cutting-edge technologies, optimized rice varieties, sustainable packaging concepts, and creative rice-based products for the foodservice and retail sectors. The Future Rice Fair attracts exhibitors from various fields within the food industry, including rice producers, food technology providers, packaging companies, and manufacturers of specialized rice processing equipment. For professionals in gastronomy, trade, and food production, the fair serves as a valuable hub for discovering new business opportunities and networking with industry peers. A particular highlight of the fair is the expert seminar, where industry leaders share practical insights and strategies for overcoming current challenges and tapping into new markets. Complementing this, networking events and expert panels provide in-depth analyses of industry trends and best practices. The Future Rice Fair is part of FABEX, a leading trade fair platform for the foodservice and gastronomy industries. This close integration offers visitors an extended range of opportunities and additional synergies with other events in the food sector. The choice of Tokyo as the venue highlights the deep cultural and dietary significance of rice in Japan. Tokyo Big Sight is not only a state-of-the-art exhibition center with first-class infrastructure but also highly accessible via public transport. Visitors can conveniently reach the venue via the Yurikamome and Rinkai Lines, which connect the exhibition grounds directly to the city center. Moreover, the vibrant metropolis of Tokyo offers a rich culinary and cultural experience, making a visit to the fair an immersive and holistic event.

GASTROTARGI SMAKKi has established itself as a major trade fair for the gastronomy and HoReCa industry (Hotels, Restaurants, Cafés, and Catering). It serves as a central platform for innovation, knowledge exchange, and business development. The concept of the fair is clearly tailored to the needs of industry professionals. International diversity is also showcased in the national pavilions, where top chefs and producers present culinary specialties from around the world. This global aspect strengthens the fair’s international appeal and highlights Poland’s role as a hub for innovation in the European gastronomy scene. Its modern infrastructure and excellent public transport connections ensure a smooth experience for both domestic and international participants. For anyone wanting to stay at the forefront of the HoReCa industry, GASTROTARGI SMAKKi is a must-attend event.

Fair Handeln is Germany’s leading trade fair for fair trade and global responsibility – an inspiring meeting point for all those committed to a more just and equitable world. The name not only stands for "fair trade" in a literal sense but also symbolizes a clear commitment to ethical consumption, ecological responsibility, and international engagement. The event is organized annually by Landesmesse Stuttgart GmbH, one of the country’s most renowned trade fair organizers. The modern venue, located directly at Stuttgart Airport, provides an easily accessible platform for exchange, inspiration, and business networking. Once a year, the Stuttgart Trade Fair Centre transforms into a showcase of sustainable practices, where companies, NGOs, start-ups, and professional visitors from various industries come together. Fair Handeln focuses on key topics such as fair consumption, development cooperation, sustainable finance, tourism, and future-oriented fashion. Fairly produced food, eco-friendly textiles, fine artisanal goods, innovative financial services, and sustainable travel options meet a highly engaged audience from both the professional sector and civil society. The fair is particularly relevant for stakeholders from retail and wholesale, development cooperation, tourism, and finance, as well as for politically engaged individuals, educational institutions, and socially conscious consumers. A diverse supporting program – including expert talks, panel discussions, workshops, the state conference on development cooperation, and hands-on activities – ensures that the visit is not only informative but also interactive and engaging. Thanks to its direct connection to the airport, the A8 motorway, and the S-Bahn lines S2 and S3, the venue is easily accessible both nationally and internationally. The combination of strong content, a clear mission, and excellent infrastructure makes Fair Handeln a key event for anyone dedicated to shaping a fair, sustainable, and forward-looking world.

The “ Halal Africa ” exhibition is a specialised international trade fair and B2B platform dedicated to the rapidly expanding halal economy across the African continent. The term “halal”, derived from Arabic, means “permissible” in accordance with Islamic law. It has evolved into a key benchmark of quality and trust that now extends far beyond the food sector and shapes a wide range of industries. The event is organised by Inkanyezi Event Organisers (Pty) Ltd., an experienced provider focused on economically relevant industry platforms in Africa. It is held at the modern Qurtuba Convention Center in the commercial hub of Sandton, one of South Africa’s leading financial and business districts. In terms of content, “Halal Africa” spans the entire halal industry value chain, going well beyond traditional food exhibitions. Key areas include halal-certified food and beverages, along with their production, processing and export. The exhibition also showcases cosmetics and personal care products based on natural and ethically sourced ingredients, as well as pharmaceuticals, nutraceuticals and healthcare solutions that comply with halal standards. One of the most dynamic segments is Islamic finance, encompassing Sharia-compliant financing, investment and insurance models, attracting both investors and financial institutions. The exhibition further highlights innovative concepts in halal tourism and hospitality, including Muslim-friendly hotels, travel services and foodservice solutions tailored to the needs of a growing global market. Logistics and packaging solutions also play a central role, particularly in relation to traceability, compliance and international supply chains. In addition, certification bodies and providers of quality assurance and standardisation services are represented, underscoring their importance for the credibility and market acceptance of halal products. Exhibitors come from a wide range of sectors, including food production, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, financial services, tourism, logistics and certification. The visitor profile is equally diverse, comprising buyers, distributors, investors, government representatives, certification authorities and entrepreneurs from trade, manufacturing and services, all seeking new partnerships and market access. Highlights of the event include high-level conferences, practical panel discussions and targeted networking formats designed to facilitate exchange and support tangible business outcomes. The venue itself offers excellent conditions: the Qurtuba Convention Center features modern infrastructure, professional facilities and close proximity to international hotels as well as O. R. Tambo International Airport, which is approximately 30 minutes away. This ensures the exhibition is ideally positioned—both strategically and logistically—to welcome international visitors efficiently and foster successful business connections.

InterFood Krasnodar is a specialized annual trade fair dedicated to food, beverages, and packaging technology. It has established itself as a key industry platform in southern Russia. Organized by MVK – International Exhibition Company, one of the country's leading trade fair organizers with extensive experience in hosting international exhibitions and conferences, InterFood provides industry professionals with an opportunity to explore the latest developments in the food and beverage sectors and connect with experts, manufacturers, suppliers, and decision-makers. The event takes place at Expograd Yug in Krasnodar, a modern exhibition and congress center known for its innovative infrastructure. The venue offers ideal conditions for showcasing new products, technologies, and services, making it one of the most important locations for trade events in southern Russia—further underscoring the fair’s significance. Access to InterFood is restricted to trade professionals only. This focused approach encourages practical, in-depth exchanges between exhibitors and buyers. A standout feature is the integrated negotiation center, where manufacturers and suppliers present their products directly to senior buyers and category managers from major retail chains and distributors—a unique format that enables efficient, high-level networking. With its thematic depth, clear focus, and recurring annual format, InterFood Krasnodar is an essential platform for professionals looking to stay ahead of industry trends, discover innovative products, and build valuable business connections—at one of Russia’s most dynamic hubs for the food and beverage industry.

The RHEMA is a significant regional trade fair in Altstätten, focusing on commerce, crafts, industry, agriculture, tourism, and gastronomy. Since its founding, the fair has become an integral part of the region's event culture. The organizer of the RHEMA is Rhema Altstätten AG, an experienced company specializing in organizing trade fairs and events in the region. The RHEMA Rheintal Fair takes place every year and is divided into two weekends , attracting thousands of visitors from eastern Switzerland and neighboring countries. The fair offers a wide range of topics and products from various industries, including commerce, crafts, industry, agriculture, tourism, and gastronomy. The focus is on regional and national products, services, and innovations. Highlights of the fair include a diverse supporting program with live music, culinary tastings, expert lectures, and interactive activities for the whole family. RHEMA is known for its unique atmosphere, created by the combination of entertainment, information, and shopping opportunities. Overall, RHEMA in Altstätten provides an attractive event that offers a special experience for both locals and visitors from the surrounding area.

The Mannheim May Market is Germany’s largest regional trade fair and one of the country’s most historic events of its kind. Established in 1613, when Elector Palatine Johann II of Zweibrücken granted the city of Mannheim the right to hold a market, the May Market has grown from a simple horse market into a modern, diverse consumer fair deeply rooted in the region’s identity. Every year in May, the fairgrounds next to the equestrian stadium transform for eleven days into a bustling hub, attracting over 1,400 exhibitors and around 350,000 visitors from the local area and beyond. The Bakery Showcase is a trade fair and conference for the bakery and confectionery industry in Canada. It takes place annually and alternates between the two Canadian cities of Montreal and Toronto. Founded in 1965, the Bakery Showcase has since developed into a major industry event. It is organised by the Baking Association of Canada (BAC), a national body representing the interests of the bakery and confectionery sector. The BAC’s membership spans the entire industry, including bakeries, suppliers, wholesalers, retailers, educational institutions and other organisations. The association places strong emphasis on keeping its members informed about the latest trends and technologies, while also providing opportunities for networking and professional development. The exhibition features a comprehensive range of products and services, including raw materials, baking equipment, packaging, services and technologies. Exhibits cover ingredients such as flour, sugar, yeast, fats, chocolate, fruit and nuts, as well as a variety of flavourings and fillings. The event also showcases ovens, dough mixers, portioning equipment, refrigeration and freezing systems, and bread and cake slicing machines. In addition, it presents a wide array of packaging solutions for bread, cakes, pastries and other baked goods, including environmentally friendly and sustainable options. Further offerings include solutions for decoration and presentation, cleaning and sanitation, and food safety in the bakery and confectionery sector, as well as bakery design and planning services, and marketing and sales support. The event focuses on innovation, sustainability and quality. Highlights include live product demonstrations, expert-led presentations and hands-on workshops. The Bakery Showcase provides trade visitors with an excellent opportunity to keep abreast of the latest industry developments while building valuable professional connections.

SIAL Canada is one of Canada’s leading trade shows for the food, beverage, and hospitality sectors, serving as a central meeting point for professionals across this dynamic industry. The name SIAL – Salon International de l’Alimentation – highlights the event’s international focus and its specialization in food-related innovation. Since its inception in 2001, the trade show has become a major driver of innovation, commerce, and exchange within the North American agri-food sector. Held alternately in Montreal and Toronto each year, SIAL Canada brings together all key players under one roof. It is organized by the renowned Comexposium Group, one of the world’s largest trade show organizers with an extensive portfolio of international events. The Canadian edition is part of a global network that includes flagship shows in Paris, Jakarta, and Abu Dhabi. A defining feature of SIAL Canada is its clear thematic structure, divided into three focus areas: SIAL Food, SIAL Grocerant, and SIAL Packaging. SIAL Food covers the entire food production spectrum – from fresh products and beverages to niche categories such as baby food, frozen goods, and functional ingredients. SIAL Grocerant explores the growing intersection between foodservice and retail, emphasizing cutting-edge kitchen equipment, payment technologies, and service solutions. SIAL Packaging focuses on innovative and sustainable packaging concepts, logistics, and technological advancements across the supply chain. In addition to a broad product offering – ranging from cheese and olive oil to high-tech packaging – the trade show provides space for knowledge exchange, industry dialogue, and inspiration. It serves as a platform for Canadian producers, international brands, start-ups, retailers, foodservice professionals, and importers to identify trends, build business relationships, and strengthen their market presence. Deeply rooted in the Canadian market, SIAL Canada reflects the country’s cultural diversity, spirit of innovation, and commitment to sustainability. At the same time, it offers international companies a gateway to enter the North American market. One of SIAL Canada’s standout features is its range of competitions that spotlight the industry’s innovative spirit. The SIAL Innovation Award honors forward-thinking product ideas, the Olive d'Or recognizes the world’s finest olive oils, and the International Cheese Competition showcases the best in global cheesemaking. Additional highlights include a pitch contest for start-ups and the “SIAL To Go” format, which offers practical insights into current market developments. The event attracts a wide professional audience – from manufacturers and distributors to institutional foodservice experts – creating a highly specialized network designed for business success. Alongside the extensive exhibition, a conference program provides in-depth analysis and discussion of key industry topics. Whether at the Palais des Congrès de Montréal or the Enercare Centre in Toronto, both venues offer modern infrastructure, excellent accessibility, and are situated in vibrant urban environments. With international airports, convenient public transit links, and thriving culinary scenes, they provide the ideal setting for a trade fair that is more than just an exhibition: SIAL Canada is an experience, a marketplace of ideas, and a bridge between local markets and global opportunities.

The NCCAL EXPO – Nigeria Cold Chain & Agro-Logistics Expo is West Africa’s leading trade fair for temperature-controlled supply chains and modern logistics solutions in the agricultural and food sectors. Held annually at the prestigious National Cereal Research Institute (NCRI) in Ibadan, Nigeria, the event is organised by CEMS Nigeria , one of the region’s foremost exhibition companies, specialising in industry-focused trade shows that drive innovation, partnerships and investment. More than just a conventional trade fair, NCCAL EXPO serves as a dedicated industry platform with a sharp focus on cold chain technology, temperature-controlled logistics, and sustainable solutions for the food and agriculture industries. Key themes include cutting-edge developments in cold chain infrastructure, refrigerated transport, smart packaging, IoT-enabled tracking and supply chain systems, as well as renewable energy solutions for off-grid refrigeration. The healthcare and pharmaceutical sectors are also prominently represented with specialised cold chain systems for vaccines and medical products. The exhibition stands out for its dynamic mix of product showcases, live demonstrations and a high-level supporting programme. Conferences, workshops and expert panels provide in-depth insights into market trends, financing options, regulatory frameworks, and technological challenges—particularly within the Nigerian and broader West African context. Exhibitors span a broad spectrum: from manufacturers of refrigeration units, specialised vehicles, packaging technologies and solar solutions, to providers of software, logistics services and applied research. Attendees include professionals and decision-makers from agriculture, food production, retail, logistics, government bodies, investment firms, technology providers, and NGOs with an interest in sustainable supply chains. The venue—NCRI Ibadan—is not only a leading centre for agricultural research, but also well connected in terms of infrastructure. It is easily accessible via Ibadan Airport or by road from Lagos. A range of nearby hotels and visitor services ensure a convenient and comfortable exhibition experience. NCCAL EXPO is the must-attend event for anyone looking to establish or expand temperature-controlled supply chains in West Africa—bringing together innovation, sustainability, and practical market-driven solutions.

The Food & Drink Processing Expo (FDP Expo) is India’s leading trade fair dedicated to the innovative food and beverage processing industry. Organized by Synergy Exposures & Events India Pvt. Ltd., it reflects the sector’s strong commitment to innovation, sustainability, and technological excellence. The fair takes place twice a year, with the venue rotating between two major cities in South India: the CODISSIA Trade Fair Complex on Avinashi Road in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, and the Palace Ground in Bengaluru, Karnataka. This strategic rotation ensures exhibitors and visitors have optimal access to the key industrial hubs of South India’s food and beverage sector. The FDP Expo showcases a broad spectrum of themes, from advanced food processing and automation technologies to beverage production and innovative packaging solutions. Exhibits include comprehensive systems for brewing, bottling, and the processing of dairy products, juices, and both alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages. Additionally, the event highlights the latest developments in refrigeration and cold chain logistics, featuring technologies that support the efficient storage and transport of perishable goods. A core focus of the expo is on safety and quality control, covering testing equipment, laboratory technologies, and international standards such as HACCP and ISO. Sustainability and waste management are also central themes, with an emphasis on energy-efficient production methods and solutions for reducing and recycling food waste. Ingredients and additives—including functional components, clean-label products, organic ingredients, and preservatives—are also key areas of interest. Digitalization and Industry 4.0 are prominently featured, with presentations on innovative IoT solutions, data analytics, and artificial intelligence applications designed to optimize food production. Beyond the technical exhibits, the expo also hosts expert-led seminars and tailored B2B meetings. These formats offer valuable opportunities for professionals to network, exchange knowledge, forge strategic partnerships, and explore forward-looking business opportunities. The FDP Expo is open exclusively to trade visitors aged 18 and above, attracting key decision-makers, technology specialists, and procurement professionals from sectors such as dairy, fruit and vegetable processing, spices, poultry, and grain and millet industries. Both venues are well-connected and offer a professional, comfortable, and inspiring environment for attendees. In short, the Food & Drink Processing Expo (FDP Expo) is India’s premier platform for tailored solutions and cutting-edge innovations in the food and beverage industry, playing a vital role in driving the sector’s continued growth and transformation.

InterFood Astana is an international trade fair held annually, with a clear focus on the food and beverage industry. With its clear focus on industry professionals, comprehensive thematic offering, and both regional and international relevance, InterFood Astana has become a key meeting point for anyone active in the food and beverage sector or looking to enter new markets—a firmly established date in the industry's annual trade fair calendar.

The Landpartie Grafenberg is an annual lifestyle and experiential fair focused on high-quality products, artisanal craftsmanship and inspiring ideas for the garden, home and culinary enjoyment. It is specifically aimed at visitors who appreciate individuality, regional character and a refined way of living. The event takes place at Düsseldorf-Grafenberg Racecourse in Düsseldorf. Its expansive, park-like setting creates a distinctive atmosphere and clearly sets it apart from conventional indoor exhibition formats. Held once a year, the fair has established itself as a firm fixture in the regional events calendar since its launch in 2021. It is organised by Reno Müller Veranstaltungen GmbH & Co. KG, a specialist event company that runs a range of similar country fairs, garden shows and seasonal events across Germany, applying a proven concept to a variety of distinctive venues. In terms of content, Landpartie Grafenberg offers a broad yet carefully curated mix of themes. The focus is on stylish living, sophisticated garden design, leisure and lifestyle, complemented by fashion, accessories and gourmet specialities. Exhibitors showcase premium garden furniture, planting concepts, decorative one-off pieces, handcrafted jewellery, as well as regional and international delicacies. Emphasis is placed on quality, sustainability and thoughtful design. In addition, services such as garden planning, interior design concepts and personalised lifestyle consultancy are available, making the fair both a source of inspiration and a practical resource for visitors’ own projects. The event has a strong regional character, bringing together local producers and artists while attracting visitors from across the Rhineland and beyond. KG in close cooperation with an Iranian partner company, effectively combining international reach with in-depth local market expertise. This breadth and depth make the fair particularly valuable for industry professionals, as it delivers practical solutions to real-world industrial challenges while showcasing current technological trends. The event is closely linked to Iran’s economic development, particularly in the field of food supply and processing, which plays a crucial role given the country’s population size and ongoing industrialisation. It acts as an interface between international manufacturers and local companies seeking to modernise their production processes. Highlights include live demonstrations of advanced machinery, product innovations, and a wide range of networking opportunities designed to initiate and strengthen business relationships. Exhibitors represent sectors such as mechanical engineering, packaging technology, food production, automation and industrial supply. Visitors are primarily drawn from the food and beverage industry, retail, hospitality, and import-oriented businesses. The trade fair Iran food ingredients is a highly specialised industry platform for food additives, raw materials and functional ingredients. Since its launch, it has established itself as a key meeting point for Iran’s food processing industry. As part of a broader exhibition network, it is aimed specifically at trade visitors seeking innovative solutions across the entire food production value chain. The event takes place at the Tehran International Exhibition Center, the country’s largest and most important exhibition venue. Held annually, the fair benefits from Tehran’s strategic role as Iran’s economic and industrial hub. It is organised by fairtrade Messe und Ausstellungs GmbH & Co. KG in close cooperation with its Iranian partner Palar Samaneh Co., with additional support from government bodies such as the ministries of agriculture and economic affairs. This international collaboration underpins the event’s dynamism and high quality standards. In terms of content, the exhibition covers a wide spectrum. Its core focus is on functional ingredients such as enzymes, vitamins, minerals and microbial cultures, alongside technical additives including emulsifiers, stabilisers, antioxidants and preservatives. The offering is complemented by specialised products such as flavourings, fragrances, plant extracts, fruit and vegetable concentrates, and semi-finished products for further processing. Niche segments, including fat replacers, propellants and innovative sweeteners, are also represented, providing a comprehensive overview of current industry developments and trends. A particular strength lies in its co-location with the leading trade fairs Iran agro, Iran food + hospitality and Iran food + bev tec. This combination creates strong synergies between agriculture, processing technology and the marketing of finished products, making the event a central hub for business deals and strategic partnerships. Exhibitors include companies from food chemistry, agribusiness, biotechnology, as well as the beverage and confectionery sectors. Visitors are predominantly industry professionals and decision-makers from production, procurement, research and development, and wholesale. The exhibition reflects the growing importance of the Iranian food market, driven by a young population, rising demand and increasing industrialisation. In addition to showcasing product innovations, it also facilitates knowledge transfer through expert discussions, presentations and networking formats, even though competitions and award ceremonies are not a primary focus. Finally, the event stands out not only for its content but also for its infrastructure. The Tehran International Exhibition Center offers modern exhibition halls, good transport links and close proximity to key economic institutions in the city. The venue is easily accessible by road as well as from the international airport, making the fair an attractive meeting point for both national and international stakeholders.

HOFEX is one of Asia’s most prominent and long-established trade fairs for food, beverages, and the hospitality industry. Since its launch in 1988, it has taken place every two years at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre—a modern venue located on Victoria Harbour, known for its impressive architecture and state-of-the-art facilities that provide an ideal setting for international exhibitions. The event is organized by Informa Markets, a global leader in trade shows and B2B events, with a portfolio of over 500 events across approximately 40 countries. Short for “Hospitality and Food Exhibition”, HOFEX is exclusively open to trade professionals. It serves as a central platform for hoteliers, restaurateurs, specialty retailers, investors, and key decision-makers in the food and hospitality sectors. The exhibition covers a broad range of topics aligned with current industry trends. Its core focus includes premium food and beverages—such as gourmet products, baked goods, confectionery, coffee, tea, wine, and spirits—as well as kitchen technology, packaging solutions, tableware, serviceware, and innovative hospitality technologies. Sustainable and digital solutions play a key role, particularly in addressing challenges like reducing plastic and food waste, enhancing automation, and adapting to shifting guest expectations. Looking ahead, HOFEX also supports the development of future talent in the hospitality sector. Expert forums and panel discussions present strategies for attracting and retaining Generation Z, including flexible work models and alternative career paths. Networking and knowledge-sharing are also key components of the event. The ProWine Hong Kong Wine Forum brings together international wine experts, while the Hong Kong International Culinary Classic features competitions such as the MEAT CHALLENGE, showcasing culinary excellence. HOFEX is evolving into a dynamic hub for innovation, business development, and knowledge exchange in the Asian food and hospitality industries. It is the ideal destination for those looking to stay ahead of industry trends, forge valuable connections, and gain fresh inspiration for the future.

Iran food + hospitality is an internationally oriented trade fair for food, beverages and hospitality that has grown into the largest industry platform of its kind in Iran since its inception. Held once a year at the Tehran International Exhibition Center, it attracts trade visitors from both Iran and abroad who are specifically seeking business opportunities in the Iranian market. The event is organised by fairtrade Messe und Ausstellungs GmbH & Co. KG in cooperation with Iran’s Palar Samaneh Co., with the support of government institutions, particularly from the agricultural and economic sectors. This partnership gives the exhibition particular significance as a bridge between international exporters and Iranian importers, positioning it as a strategic gateway to a dynamic and growing market. In terms of content, the fair covers a broad spectrum: from traditional food categories such as baked goods, dairy products, meat, fish and frozen foods, to beverages, confectionery, and organic and health foods, as well as specialised segments including hot drinks and ice cream.
