Together, this creates a holistic snapshot of the industry, bringing together producers, service providers and technology suppliers alike. A key strength of “Iran food + hospitality” lies in its concurrent staging with the trade fairs “Iran agro”, “Iran food ingredients” and “Iran food + bev tec”, generating strong synergies. Visitors benefit from a concise overview of innovations across the entire food production and processing value chain, while exhibitors can expand their reach in a targeted way. The event serves not only as a showcase platform, but also as a driver of trends, innovation and investment. Exhibitors come from a wide range of sectors—from the food industry to mechanical engineering and packaging technology through to catering equipment—and meet a professional audience from trade, import and export, hospitality, foodservice, as well as institutional buyers and decision-makers. Finally, “Iran food + hospitality” stands out not only for the depth of its content but also for its location: the modern exhibition grounds in northern Tehran are well connected in terms of infrastructure and easily accessible from both the international airport and the city centre, making participation efficient and attractive for international visitors.

The National Women’s Show is one of Canada’s largest consumer exhibitions, specifically tailored to women with an interest in lifestyle and personal development. In Montréal, it takes place annually at the prestigious Palais des congrès de Montréal, where, for one weekend, the contemporary convention centre is transformed into an interactive showcase combining retail, information and live entertainment. The event is organised by National Event Management Inc., an experienced Canadian trade show producer specialising in high-footfall consumer events. In addition to Montréal, the National Women’s Show is staged in major cities including Toronto, Ottawa and Calgary, creating a strong national platform for brands and service providers seeking to engage directly with female audiences. Positioned as the “Ultimate Girl’s Day Out” with genuine substance, the show spans a broad range of sectors: fashion, accessories, jewellery and beauty, alongside health, wellness and fitness, as well as careers, education, financial planning, travel and food and drink. Visitors can trial new skincare products, receive professional styling advice, discover innovative fitness concepts or take part in wine and culinary tastings. The Culinary Stage hosts live cooking demonstrations, while the Fashion Stage presents the latest trends in professionally produced runway shows. The programme is further enhanced by talks and workshops on personal development, work–life balance and career change, often delivered by successful entrepreneurs and industry experts. Exhibitors represent sectors including fashion and textile design, cosmetics and beauty, health and wellness services, tourism, fitness, finance and education, as well as food and beverage. Many companies use the show as a test-market platform, presenting new products directly to a discerning and commercially attractive audience. At the same time, smaller regional brands from Québec benefit from increased visibility and direct engagement with consumers. As such, the event not only generates economic impact but also supports Montréal’s creative and service industries. The audience comprises women of all ages – from young professionals and entrepreneurs to those balancing careers and family life – who are interested in emerging trends, self-improvement, networking and experiential retail. In addition, professionals from retail, beauty, coaching and event management attend to gain market insights and develop business contacts. Montréal’s role extends beyond that of host city. As one of Canada’s leading cultural hubs, with a vibrant fashion, culinary and creative scene, it provides a fitting backdrop for an event that embodies inspiration, diversity and innovation. The Palais des congrès de Montréal is centrally located in the downtown core, directly connected to the metro (Place-d’Armes station) and easily accessible from Montréal–Trudeau International Airport and the main railway station. Its modern facilities, distinctive coloured glass façade and proximity to hotels, restaurants and key attractions further enhance the venue’s appeal. In summary, the National Women’s Show in Montréal is far more than a conventional consumer exhibition. It is a nationwide platform for trends, dialogue and empowerment, delivering tangible value to its visitors year after year.

The AOBE – Asia Outdoor Kitchen & Barbecue Equipment Expo in Guangzhou is an international trade and consumer exhibition dedicated to the barbecue, grilling and outdoor cooking industry, with a particular focus on trade visitors. The event is organised by Guangdong Grandeur International Exhibition Group, an experienced exhibition organiser with an extensive network across Asia and many years of expertise in developing international industry platforms. AOBE takes place at the Canton Fair Complex (China Import and Export Fair Complex) in Guangzhou, one of China’s largest and most important exhibition venues. Guangzhou is one of the country’s leading economic, commercial and manufacturing centres and is located in the economically powerful Pearl River Delta, within the Guangdong–Hong Kong–Macao Greater Bay Area. The region is home to a particularly high concentration of manufacturers, suppliers, exporters and international trading companies. AOBE – Asia Outdoor Kitchen & Barbecue Equipment Expo covers the entire value chain of the modern barbecue and outdoor cooking industry. The exhibition showcases barbecue and cooking equipment including gas, charcoal, pellet and electric grills, smokers and modular outdoor kitchen systems. The product range also encompasses professional outdoor kitchen equipment such as hobs, ovens, refrigeration systems and extraction solutions. Other exhibits include fuels, cleaning and safety products, as well as smart control and energy-saving technologies, ranging from precision temperature control to energy-efficient and solar-assisted solutions. Another key area is ingredients, seasonings, marinades, sauces and other speciality food products developed for the international barbecue market. This culinary dimension adds a sensory and inspirational element to the exhibition alongside its strong technical focus. The event also presents services for the planning, refurbishment and operation of barbecue restaurants, together with digital point-of-sale systems, ordering solutions and franchise concepts. As such, the exhibition is aimed at manufacturers, distributors, hospitality operators and systems providers alike. Exhibitors include companies specialising in barbecue and kitchen equipment, outdoor living, energy technology, food production, catering equipment, chain restaurant concepts and smart technologies. Trade visitors primarily come from specialist retail, wholesale and retail distribution, restaurants and foodservice, the hotel and catering sectors, as well as companies involved in importing, exporting, distribution and the planning of outdoor kitchens and hospitality concepts. Alongside new products and market launches, one of the exhibition’s distinguishing features is its programme of industry-specific presentations and live demonstrations. These highlight craftsmanship, technological innovation and international barbecue culture. In this way, AOBE promotes exchange between international brands, Chinese manufacturers and regional markets while supporting the continued development of the barbecue and outdoor cooking industry across Asia. Guangzhou provides an especially attractive setting for the event. The Canton Fair Complex offers modern, high-capacity exhibition infrastructure, extensive exhibition space and facilities designed to accommodate major international events. Guangzhou also benefits from excellent international air connections via Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport, as well as efficient transport links across the metropolitan area and to other major commercial centres within the Greater Bay Area. AOBE therefore combines a professional trade-show environment with one of China’s most dynamic manufacturing, commercial and innovation hubs. Modern exhibition facilities, excellent international accessibility, a strong industrial base and close proximity to a large network of manufacturers and suppliers create ideal conditions for sourcing, business development, technology partnerships and sustainable international expansion.

Held annually at the NEC Birmingham—one of the UK’s largest and most modern exhibition centres—the event benefits from excellent transport links, spacious exhibition areas, and state-of-the-art infrastructure, offering ideal conditions for both visitors and exhibitors. The HFE JAPAN – Health Food Exposition & Conference – is one of Japan’s leading trade fairs for health-promoting foods, dietary supplements, and functional ingredients. Since its launch in 2001, it has become a key meeting point for industry professionals seeking insights into the latest innovations, scientific research, and market trends in the health and nutrition sectors. Held annually at Tokyo Big Sight – a striking, modern exhibition center in the heart of the Japanese capital – the event draws a highly specialized audience. Japan is known for having one of the highest life expectancies in the world. Particularly notable is the island of Okinawa, home to many centenarians. This phenomenon is often attributed to the Japanese lifestyle, diet, social structure, and healthcare system. The exhibition reflects these themes, focusing on functional foods, natural ingredients, and evidence-based dietary supplements that contribute to the long and healthy lives of many Japanese people. HFE JAPAN is organized by Food Chemical Newspaper Inc., a leading trade publisher specializing in food chemistry and health-related industries, recognized for its in-depth sector knowledge and extensive professional network. Attendance is restricted to industry professionals, reinforcing the event’s high-level focus and attracting decision-makers, experts, and innovation leaders. At the core of the event are health foods, dietary supplements, functional and organic products, as well as diet and beauty solutions. The exhibition also covers technologies for quality assurance, packaging, and analysis. Alongside products such as vitamins, minerals, amino acids, and herbal extracts, the fair addresses regulatory standards, certification processes, and international research developments. A key benefit of the event is its concurrent scheduling with IFIA JAPAN – the International Food Ingredients & Additives Exhibition and Conference. This close coordination creates synergies between functional ingredients and food additives, enabling a broader and more dynamic professional exchange. International manufacturers, suppliers, research institutions, and trading companies showcase innovative products, forward-looking solutions, and market-relevant services. Expert presentations and networking events provide further opportunities for strategic partnerships and new business ventures. More than just a trade fair, HFE JAPAN is a specialized platform for knowledge and commerce, designed for those shaping the future of healthy nutrition.

The Thaifex Anuga Asia is an international trade fair for food, beverages, catering, food technology, and hotel and restaurant supplies. It is organized by Koelnmesse Co., Ltd. and held annually at the IMPACT Exhibition Center in Nonthaburi. The fair has established itself as a central meeting point for the food and beverage industry in Asia, reflecting the dynamic development of this sector. The name "Anuga" originates from "Allgemeine Nahrungs- und Genussmittel-Ausstellung" (General Food and Beverage Exhibition) held in Germany, emphasizing the international significance of this fair. Thaifex Anuga Asia focuses on a wide range of areas, including coffee and tea, various beverages, fine food, food service, food technology, frozen food, fruits and vegetables, meat, rice, seafood, and confectionery. The fair also showcases current trends such as alternative meat proteins, franchise models, functional foods, Halal products, organic goods, plant-based proteins, and sustainable production methods. The fair is particularly known for its innovative special zones, such as the Future Food Market, Halal Market, and Organic Market, which highlight specialized products. It attracts professionals from hotels, restaurants, supermarkets, food manufacturing, and many other sectors who are looking to discover new products, further their education, and establish business contacts. Highlights of Thaifex Anuga Asia include numerous competitions and workshops that enrich the program and offer valuable insights and networking opportunities to participants. The IMPACT Exhibition Center as the venue boasts modern infrastructure and, due to its proximity to Bangkok, is easily accessible, making it an ideal location for international events. Overall, Thaifex Anuga Asia plays a crucial role in promoting exchange and the development of the food industry, both in Thailand and on an international level.

박람회설명:
Biofach China is the leading trade fair for organic food and sustainable products in China and ranks among the most important industry events in Asia. Since its inception in 2007, it has established itself as a platform for quality, innovation, and sustainability. Every year, the Shanghai New International Expo Centre (SNIEC) opens its doors to trade visitors from around the globe who come to the heart of Shanghai to explore the latest developments in the organic sector. The event is organized by NürnbergMesse China Co., Ltd., a subsidiary of the globally active NürnbergMesse Group, which hosts trade fairs worldwide with a strong focus on sustainability. Biofach China is considered the most important Asian branch of the international Biofach family, which includes events in Germany, India, South America, and Saudi Arabia. The trade fair focuses on organic food and beverages, natural cosmetics, eco-friendly non-food products, and sustainable technologies. Its offerings include fresh organic produce such as fruits, vegetables, meat, and dairy products, as well as frozen foods, gourmet items, plant-based alternatives, snacks, confectionery, and beverages—from juices to organic wine. The product range is complemented by natural cosmetics, ecological cleaning products, sustainable textiles, household goods, and technical solutions for processing, packaging, and logistics. A key feature of Biofach China is its role as a hub connecting international manufacturers, Chinese trading partners, and a growing number of environmentally conscious consumers. This exchange takes place not only at the exhibition booths but also through a comprehensive supporting program. Conferences, workshops, and seminars provide a platform for dialogue on regulatory updates, innovative packaging solutions, and trends in regenerative agriculture. Exhibitors primarily come from the fields of food production, agriculture, natural cosmetics, packaging and processing technology, as well as service sectors such as certification and research. Visitors include specialized retailers, restaurateurs, importers, buyers from major retail chains, journalists, and institutional representatives—from both China and abroad. With its dedicated focus on the Chinese market and integration into a global trade fair network, Biofach China serves as a key meeting point for all stakeholders involved in shaping the organic market in Asia. SNIEC, one of Asia’s most modern exhibition venues, is conveniently located in the economically dynamic Pudong District of Shanghai. It is easily accessible via Pudong International Airport, public transportation, and numerous hotels in the immediate vicinity.

Food 4 Future – Expo FoodTech is a trade fair dedicated to innovation in the food and beverage industry. Since its debut in 2021, it has brought together international decision-makers, thought leaders, startups, and technology pioneers each year at the Bilbao Exhibition Centre (BEC) in Barakaldo, near Bilbao. The name "Food 4 Future" symbolizes the fair’s core mission: promoting forward-thinking solutions across the entire food value chain with a focus on technological progress, sustainability, and economic viability. The event is organized by NEBEXT (Next Business Exhibitions), an experienced host of future-focused B2B events. Food 4 Future stands out for the depth of its thematic focus. It addresses current challenges and opportunities in modern food systems—from alternative protein sources such as plant-based meat, algae, and insects to AI-driven production, smart packaging, and carbon-neutral supply chains. It showcases how automated and digitalized food production is becoming a reality, and how technologies like blockchain, biotechnology, and personalized nutrition are enhancing consumer safety and health. A key component of the event is its comprehensive conference program. The Food 4 Future World Summit brings together more than 450 international experts from science, industry, and policy. Across a wide range of presentations and discussion formats, topics include smart manufacturing, regenerative food systems, and disruptive business models. A particular highlight is the FoodTech Startup Forum, which gives emerging companies a platform to present their groundbreaking ideas—often in direct proximity to potential investors, especially through the FoodTech Investment Forum. Additional program elements include the Packaging 4.0 Congress, guided technology tours, and targeted networking opportunities. The trade fair attracts a diverse professional audience, including food producers, agricultural and aquaculture companies, as well as providers in packaging, logistics, and technology. Retailers, investors, and policy makers are also represented. Experts from R&D, executive management, procurement, production, and quality assurance gain valuable insights for strategic partnerships and future innovations. With its clear positioning as a platform for future-oriented food technologies, Food 4 Future – Expo FoodTech has established itself as a showcase for the industry and a driving force for sustainable transformation in Europe. The choice of venue is deliberate: the BEC is one of Spain’s most advanced exhibition centers, offering excellent connections to the airport, highway network, and public transport. It is located near the dynamic city of Bilbao, itself a symbol of successful structural change and technological innovation.

The Südwest Messe in Villingen-Schwenningen is one of the largest and most traditional regional trade fairs in southern Germany. Since its founding in 1950, it has evolved into a key platform for innovation, information, and exchange. The name "Südwest Messe" not only refers to its geographic location in the southwest of Germany but also stands for economic diversity, regional strength, and the direct connection between exhibitors and visitors. Each year, the exhibition grounds in Villingen-Schwenningen transform for several days into a vibrant hub for regional and supraregional trade fair activity. Organized by SMA Südwest Messe- und Ausstellungs-GmbH, the event benefits from decades of experience and a well-designed concept that delivers high value for both exhibitors and attendees. The fair offers an exceptionally broad range of themes. Its topics span from construction, energy, and sustainable modernization to household, living, lifestyle, health, and sports – and further to fashion, travel, mobility, and garden and agricultural technology. This thematic diversity turns the fair into an impressive showcase of modern-day lifestyles. Visitors not only discover innovative products and services, but can also test, compare, and purchase them directly on site – an immediate and immersive experience that has become increasingly rare. A particular focus is placed on regional providers who present practical solutions to today’s and tomorrow’s challenges. Their offerings are complemented by established companies from a wide array of industries, including construction, agriculture, energy, mobility, and consumer goods. The fair holds great economic importance for Villingen-Schwenningen and the surrounding region. It attracts numerous consumers and trade visitors from across southern Germany every year – including craftspeople, retailers, architects, and healthcare professionals. The modern exhibition grounds are conveniently located and easily accessible by car, train, or public transportation. Embedded in a city known for its high quality of life, the fair not only offers insights into current developments but also delivers an experience that goes far beyond the scope of a traditional trade fair visit. The Südwest Messe – a place where innovation, regional identity, and immersive experiences come together in a unique way.

개최장소(베뉴): MCEC - Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Center
박람회설명:
The Good Food & Wine Show is one of Australia’s most prominent public exhibitions dedicated to culinary excellence. Since its inception in 2001, it has served as a key platform for indulgence, innovation, and exchange within the Australian food and beverage industry. Today, the name represents far more than just fine food and wine—it embodies a comprehensive experience centered around premium gastronomy, exclusive tastings, and the latest gourmet trends. Each year, the show opens its doors at the Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Centre (MCEC)—Australia’s largest and most modern event venue, located on the banks of the Yarra River in the heart of Melbourne. The event is organized by Spectapular Enterprises Pty Ltd, an experienced event management company specializing in the creation of impactful, brand-defining experiences. At the heart of the exhibition is the theme of indulgence, with a focus on food, wine, spirits, hospitality, kitchen technology, and culinary tourism. Visitors can look forward to a diverse program that includes live cooking demonstrations by renowned Australian chefs such as Alastair McLeod, themed masterclasses on chocolate, cheese, or gin, and over 300 carefully curated exhibitors. The show features everything from artisanal delicacies to cutting-edge kitchen solutions. Particularly popular are experiences such as the guided Wine Selectors Tasting Rooms , chocolate journeys led by pastry chef Kirsten Tibballs, and exclusive martini workshops with tailored food pairings. A standout highlight is the Good Food Village —a bustling market hall featuring select producers and artisanal makers—as well as the Cheese Corner , which showcases the diversity and creativity of Australian cheesemaking. The event appeals to a wide audience: from hobby chefs and gourmet enthusiasts to industry professionals in hospitality, retail, and tourism. At the same time, it serves as a stage for Australia’s culinary identity, illustrating how vibrantly the industry has evolved as both a creative and economic driving force. The Good Food & Wine Show is not limited to Melbourne; it is part of a national event series that also includes cities like Sydney, Brisbane, and Perth. This makes it the premier traveling culinary exhibition in Australia. Visitors can expect an immersive, high-quality experience featuring VIP offerings, interactive tastings, and expert insights—all within an atmosphere that brings the joy of food and drink to life in a unique way. The MCEC impresses with its central location, excellent public transport connections, and state-of-the-art infrastructure. As a cultural and culinary capital, Melbourne provides the perfect backdrop for an event that seamlessly blends gastronomy, lifestyle, and innovation.

ProPak MENA (Processing and Packaging Middle East and North Africa) is an internationally recognized trade fair for the food and beverage industry. Since its inception in 2012, it has been held annually at the Egypt International Exhibition Center (EIEC) in Cairo. The event is organized by Informa Exhibitions Egypt, a global leader in trade shows and conferences known for creating innovative industry platforms with international reach and regional relevance. Serving as a central hub for processing, packaging, and logistics solutions, ProPak MENA offers comprehensive insights into technological advancements and strategic trends shaping the food industry across Egypt, North Africa, and the Middle East. The exhibition highlights forward-looking production and packaging technologies, sustainable materials, automation, and digital innovations – including Artificial Intelligence and the Internet of Things – alongside measures for quality assurance and food safety. The fair adopts a highly practical approach. In addition to the exhibition area showcasing cutting-edge machinery and innovative packaging solutions, professional visitors can benefit from an extensive supporting program. This includes workshops, certified training courses (offered by organizations such as UNIDO and the World Packaging Organisation), and expert conferences. Key topics include pressing industry challenges such as circular economy, CO₂ reduction, and hygiene standards. A distinctive feature of ProPak MENA is its commitment to diversity – particularly through dedicated initiatives promoting women in the food and beverage sector. The event also offers exclusive networking formats such as VIP business matchmaking, as well as export promotion programs designed to help local companies access international markets more effectively. It targets a qualified professional audience: manufacturers, engineers, packaging specialists, and decision-makers from sectors such as production, mechanical engineering, logistics, and wholesale attend the fair to initiate business deals and exchange knowledge. As part of the international ProPak trade show series – with additional locations across Asia, South America, and other regions – ProPak MENA is the leading platform of its kind for Africa and the Middle East. It plays an active role in supporting Egypt’s economic development and enjoys broad backing from government bodies. By connecting local businesses with global market leaders, it fosters the modernization of regional industry. The EIEC in Cairo impresses with its modern infrastructure, excellent transport links, and versatile exhibition spaces. Its central location ensures convenient access from both the international airport and the city center, creating ideal conditions for both domestic and international exhibitors and visitors. With its clear regional focus, global orientation, and technological specialization, ProPak MENA has established itself as the leading trade fair for the future of food processing and packaging in the MENA region.

Belagro is the leading agricultural trade fair in Belarus and has been held annually since its inception in 1990. As both an international trade and public exhibition, it serves as a central platform for exchange among farmers, technology providers, researchers, investors, and industry professionals from around the world. Organized by JSC Minskexpo, a well-established and reputable trade fair organizer specializing in international B2B formats, the event aims to showcase innovative developments and promote knowledge transfer within the agricultural sector. The venue is the Minsk International Exhibition Centre, a modern exhibition complex with state-of-the-art infrastructure. It is located in an economically significant area known for its international orientation and technological capabilities. Belagro is the centerpiece of the Belarusian Agroindustrial Week and attracts more than 60,000 professionals and interested visitors each year. It offers a comprehensive overview of the entire value chain of the agricultural and food industry—from primary agricultural production through processing to packaging. A particular focus is placed on modern agricultural technology and machinery, including tractors, harvesting equipment, seeders, and irrigation systems. Other key areas include livestock farming, veterinary medicine, crop production, as well as seeds, crop protection, stable technology, and milking systems. The exhibition also thoroughly covers food production—from dairy and meat processing to packaging solutions and quality assurance. Additional themes include renewable energy, sustainability, bioenergy, and modern forestry. One of the highlights of the fair is the live demonstrations of innovative technologies, where machines and processes are presented under real-world conditions. The event also offers numerous networking opportunities and insights into the latest industry trends. Supported by the Ministry of Agriculture and Industry and the National Academy of Sciences of Belarus, Belagro has established itself as the country's most important trade fair platform for agriculture and food—practical, comprehensive, and specialized.

The Warsaw FOOD Expo is a significant international food fair and one of the most important industry events in Poland. Serving as a platform for exchange among food manufacturers, traders, restaurateurs, café owners, hotel representatives, catering company owners, and many other professionals from the food industry, the fair promotes business and networking. Drink Tech Expo Poland in Nadarzyn is the country’s leading trade fair for beverage and liquid food production technologies. It serves as a key platform for innovation, investment and industrial advancement. As a trade-only event, it is specifically geared towards decision-makers, production managers, process technologists and product developers pursuing concrete investment or modernisation projects. The event is organised by Ptak Warsaw Expo Sp. z o. o., one of Central and Eastern Europe’s leading exhibition organisers. It takes place at the modern PTAK Warsaw Expo exhibition centre in Nadarzyn, near Warsaw. Its location in the economically strong Warsaw metropolitan area underlines the event’s national and international significance: Poland is one of Europe’s most dynamic production hubs for beverages and food, acting as a vital link between Western and Eastern European markets. The exhibition covers the entire value chain for liquid food production – from raw material processing and mixing technologies through filling and pasteurisation systems to packaging, capping and dosing solutions. Exhibits include technologies for soft drinks such as water, juices and functional beverages, as well as equipment for beer, wine, spirits and ready-to-drink products. The scope is further extended to solutions for soups, broths, sauces, edible oils, liquid fats, infant and medical liquid nutrition, protein shakes, sports drinks, coffee and tea specialities, and energy and isotonic beverages. A particular focus is placed on functional ingredients, additives and innovative formulation components for liquid applications, alongside water treatment and process water management systems – critical to product quality, sustainability and cost efficiency. A central feature of the event is the co-located Liquid Food & Beverage Congress. As a high-level industry forum, it addresses technological innovation, automation, digitalisation, energy efficiency and sustainable production concepts. Manufacturers, suppliers, research institutions and industry experts come together for targeted knowledge transfer and professional exchange. The combination of exhibition and specialist congress positions Drink Tech Expo Poland as a practice-oriented information and investment platform. Exhibitors represent the machinery and plant engineering sector, packaging technology, process and automation engineering, water and environmental technology, ingredients and raw materials, as well as quality control, laboratory and hygiene technology. Visitors include beverage producers, dairies, liquid food manufacturers, breweries, distilleries, private label manufacturers, contract packers, investors and senior procurement professionals from across the food industry. The result is a clearly structured B2B environment with a strong focus on business outcomes. PTAK Warsaw Expo is one of the largest exhibition and congress centres in Central Europe, offering modern halls, extensive exhibition space and robust infrastructure. Nadarzyn benefits from excellent road connections around Warsaw, with Warsaw Chopin International Airport and the city centre within easy reach. Drink Tech Expo Poland combines technological innovation with a professional exhibition setting, making it a key meeting point for shaping the future of beverage and liquid food production.

FOOMA JAPAN – The International Food Processing Technology Exhibition – is Asia’s leading trade fair for food processing technology and a key fixture on the calendar of international industry experts. Organized by the Japan Food Machinery Manufacturers' Association, a prominent industry body, the exhibition is held annually at Tokyo Big Sight, Japan’s premier convention center in the capital city of Tokyo. Bringing together the entire value chain of food processing under one roof, FOOMA JAPAN showcases cutting-edge technological innovations. Exhibits include state-of-the-art processing machinery, automation and robotics solutions, and digital systems for quality management, traceability, and production efficiency. The spotlight is on future-oriented themes such as sustainability, food safety, artificial intelligence, the Internet of Things (IoT), and the digital transformation of all processes—from packaging and storage to logistics, analysis, inspection, and hygiene. A special highlight of the event is the FOOMA Award, which honors groundbreaking technological advancements with the potential to transform the industry. The exhibition concept also features a Startup Zone and an Open Innovation platform, offering emerging companies and visionary thinkers the opportunity to bring fresh momentum to the market. FOOMA JAPAN’s significance goes far beyond a product showcase. As an international forum for knowledge exchange and business networking, it attracts numerous industry professionals and decision-makers from all sectors of the food industry each year. Global companies also attend to explore cutting-edge Japanese technology and forge new business relationships—making the event an ideal gateway to the Asian market. Despite its global reach, FOOMA JAPAN remains deeply rooted in its origins. It actively promotes the export of Japanese technology, supports domestic companies in their international expansion, and demonstrates Japan’s innovative strength on the global stage. Tokyo Big Sight, Japan’s largest and most advanced exhibition venue, provides the perfect setting. It stands not only as a symbol of technological excellence but is also conveniently connected to Haneda Airport and public transportation. In this way, FOOMA JAPAN is much more than a trade fair—it is an international innovation hub for anyone looking to shape the future of food processing.

ProPak Asia is Asia’s premier trade exhibition for industrial processing and packaging. As an annual industry gathering, it plays a pivotal role for companies aiming to expand in the Asian market. The name “ProPak” stands for “Processing and Packaging”, highlighting the exhibition’s focus on two critical industrial sectors: the processing and packaging of food, beverages, pharmaceuticals, and consumer goods. The event takes place at the IMPACT Exhibition Center in Nonthaburi, near Bangkok. Bangkok, as the economic center of Southeast Asia, offers a dynamic environment for business development and international cooperation. The exhibition is organized by Informa Markets, one of the world’s largest trade show organizers with extensive industry expertise. Over the years, ProPak Asia has evolved into a central platform for innovation, business networking, and knowledge exchange. The exhibition is structured into several specialized zones, representing the entire industrial value chain – from processing and packaging technologies to laboratory solutions, cold chain logistics, and sustainable packaging concepts. A strong emphasis is placed on environmentally friendly and carbon-neutral technologies, giving the event a forward-looking, sustainable orientation. The accompanying conference program offers in-depth insights into current industry topics for professional visitors. Formats such as the Beverage Executive Talk, Future Food Corner, and Packaging Design Clinic foster dialogue among experts, innovators, and decision-makers. In the Lab & Test Theatre, new developments in quality control are showcased. Prestigious industry awards such as the WorldStar, AsiaStar, and ThaiStar Packaging Awards recognize outstanding achievements and stimulate creative innovation within the sector. Exhibitors primarily come from the fields of mechanical engineering, food processing, pharmaceuticals, logistics, and automation. They present cutting-edge solutions tailored to the specific needs of Asian markets. The exhibition attracts a broad international audience – from executives of global corporations to medium-sized enterprises, start-ups, and investors from manufacturing, research, and trade. ProPak Asia sees itself not only as a platform for innovation but also as a key hub for sustainable business development in one of the world’s most dynamic growth regions. With its efficient infrastructure and good connections to Bangkok-Don Mueang Airport and the public transportation network, the IMPACT Exhibition Center in Nonthaburi offers ideal conditions for a successful trade fair presence. Its proximity to Bangkok itself gives the event additional strategic weight through its economic strength and innovative power. Thus, ProPak Asia is far more than a trade fair – it is the gateway to the future of industrial processing and packaging in Asia.

The "Good Life Show", first held in 2024, is an international trade fair focusing on food, beverages, sustainable life products, and well-being. Abbreviated as "GLS," this fair targets an audience interested in nutrition, health, wellness, and environmental protection, aiming for a more conscious lifestyle. Organized by Live Events Africa (Pty) Ltd., GLS takes place annually at the Cape Town International Convention Centre in Cape Town. This location underscores Cape Town's role as an international hub for sustainable development and innovation. The fair's main themes include plant-based foods and beverages, natural and organic products free from chemical additives, animal testing, or synthetic ingredients, as well as offerings for a life without dietary restrictions, known as "Free-from." This category showcases foods and products free from allergens, gluten, or other ingredients commonly causing dietary limitations. Additionally, SustainEx focuses particularly on innovative and high-quality sustainable products ranging from beverages, beauty care, household appliances, clothing, accessories, to wellness products. A highlight of the fair is the "Good Life Kitchen," where international and local top chefs present their creations and demonstrate simple methods for healthy, delicious, and sustainable recipes. Visitors have the opportunity to participate in selected demonstrations and enjoy sample tastings. The Good Life Show attracts a wide range of visitors, including retailers, gastronomes, local merchants, exporters, and interested consumers. It serves as a platform for exchanging knowledge and experiences among industry experts and offers networking opportunities. Other highlights include lectures and panel discussions by experts in culinary arts, nutrition science, and sustainability, interactive master classes, and yoga sessions. These events offer both entertaining and educational elements, enabling direct interaction with exhibitors. The Good Life Show is part of a series of fairs dedicated to sustainability and conscious consumption. The Cape Town International Convention Center, located in the heart of Cape Town, is ideal for this event due to its central location and modern, environmentally friendly facilities.

Food Matters Live London is an international B2B trade event dedicated to innovation across the food, beverage, nutrition and nutraceutical industries. It showcases the latest developments, emerging technologies and innovative solutions shaping the future of food, nutrition and health. Aimed primarily at industry professionals, the event provides a platform for knowledge exchange, product development and building new business relationships. Food Matters Live London takes place at Olympia London, one of the capital’s long-established exhibition and event venues. Organised by Food Matters Live Ltd., the event is held annually, typically over two days in June. In addition to London, Food Matters Live also takes place in Rotterdam. The event focuses on the intersection of food innovation, health, nutrition, consumer trends and product development. Key areas include Food & Consumer Trends, Positive Nutrition and Functional Food, innovative ingredients and New Product Development (NPD), taste, colour and sensory science, as well as emerging technologies for research and development. Particular attention is given to metabolic health, gut health and the microbiome, dietary fibre, personalised nutrition, women’s health, sustainable ingredients and the use of artificial intelligence in new food product development. A central theme is how companies can create products that successfully balance health, sustainability, taste, convenience and competitive pricing. Exhibitors showcase innovative ingredients, functional foods and beverages, flavours, natural and functional colours, and solutions for texture and formulation. Other areas include prebiotics and probiotics, dietary fibre, botanical ingredients, algae, functional dairy products and a range of bioactive compounds. The exhibition also features technologies and services supporting product development, research, quality assurance, manufacturing and commercialisation. It is therefore particularly relevant to companies looking to develop new formulations, optimise existing products or translate emerging consumer and nutrition trends into commercially viable products. A key feature of the event is “Tastes of Better”, where international ingredient suppliers present new ingredients, applications and product concepts. Tastings and practical demonstrations give industry visitors the opportunity to experience new flavours, textures, colours and formulations first-hand and discuss them directly with the development teams behind them. Roundtables and masterclasses complement the programme, providing further opportunities for industry exchange and knowledge sharing. “NutraConnect” adds a dedicated area focused on nutraceuticals and health ingredients. Key topics include prebiotics, probiotics, dietary fibre, botanical ingredients, functional dairy, algae and novel bioactive compounds. Masterclasses and “Meet the Buyer” sessions are designed to connect suppliers directly with product developers and buyers. The Private Label Pavilion provides an additional focus on private-label products, new product concepts, formulations, manufacturing capabilities and market-ready solutions addressing current health, consumer and market trends. Exhibitors are drawn primarily from the food and beverage industry, the ingredients and raw materials sector, nutraceuticals and supplements, food technology, research and development, private-label manufacturing and specialist service providers. Food Matters Live is aimed particularly at product developers and NPD teams, R&D specialists, nutrition and innovation professionals, buyers, quality professionals and decision-makers from food, beverage and nutraceutical companies. Its strong B2B focus clearly distinguishes the event from consumer-facing exhibitions. Olympia London further reinforces the international character of Food Matters Live. The historic exhibition venue in West Kensington is one of London’s best-known event locations and is easily accessible by public transport, particularly via Kensington (Olympia) station. Food Matters Live therefore combines an international platform for food innovation with the advantages of London as one of Europe’s leading business and exhibition centres.

MyFoodTech is an annual trade fair and an integral part of the Malaysia International Food & Beverage (MIFB) Trade Fair . It is dedicated entirely to the future of food and beverage technology. The name "MyFoodTech" not only stands for "Malaysia Food Technology" but also embodies the ambition to position Malaysia as a leading hub for innovative FoodTech solutions. The event is organized by Constellar Exhibitions Malaysia Sdn Bhd, a company with extensive experience in hosting international trade exhibitions. The fair takes place each summer at the Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre (KLCC), one of Southeast Asia’s most advanced venues, located in the heart of Malaysia’s capital. It is exclusively open to trade professionals and provides a highly specialized platform for decision-makers from food production, technology development, commerce, and gastronomy. What sets MyFoodTech apart is its clear focus on forward-looking themes: from state-of-the-art production systems and robotics to AI-driven applications, smart packaging solutions, and sustainable technologies, as well as alternative proteins such as insect protein, cultivated meat, and plant-based innovations. The event showcases not only technical innovation but also practical research, visionary ideas, and tangible approaches to promoting sustainability, food safety, and digitalization across the entire value chain. Key areas of focus include smart manufacturing, the integration of IoT in production processes, and blockchain technologies that enhance transparency and efficiency in the food industry. The beverage sector is also prominently featured, with innovative brewing, filling, and packaging solutions, along with functional and health-oriented drinks. Start-ups and research institutions benefit from targeted support programs and presentation formats that foster innovation, collaboration, and market access. Exhibitors represent diverse industries, including machinery and equipment manufacturing, automation, packaging technology, biotechnology, and food science, as well as research and development. Visitors – producers, technologists, traders, restaurateurs, and buyers – come from both domestic and international markets, all with a strong interest in future-ready solutions for food production. MyFoodTech is more than just a stand-alone event; it is part of the established MIFB series, which has become the leading B2B platform for the F&B sector in Southeast Asia. It serves not only as a marketplace for business development but also as a catalyst for innovation and economic growth in Malaysia – a country actively investing in technological advancement and sustainable food systems. Thanks to its central location, the KLCC is easily accessible – by car, public transport, or from Kuala Lumpur International Airport. Situated near the iconic Petronas Towers, the venue symbolizes progress and hospitality, making it the ideal setting for a trade fair that plays an active role in shaping the future of the global food landscape.

The Wright County Fair , established in 1870, is an annual event held on the picturesque Wright County Fairgrounds in Howard Lake, Minnesota. Organized by the Wright County Agricultural Society, the fair showcases the region's agriculture and crafts, attracting visitors primarily from the fields of agriculture, horticulture, and livestock breeding. The fair's extensive program ranges from livestock exhibitions and artisanal presentations to modern entertainment offerings. Visitors can discover a variety of products and services, including crops, preserves, baked goods, quilts, and photography. Highlights include animal exhibitions—from dairy cattle, beef, pigs, sheep, and horses to exotic animals—as well as competitions such as the demolition derby, tractor races, and the popular barbecue contest. Deeply rooted in the Wright County community, the fair promotes agricultural education and highlights the efforts of local 4-H youth groups. Every summer, it provides a platform for residents to showcase their products and skills and win valuable prizes. The main visitors are from the sectors of agriculture, livestock breeding, horticulture, and education. The fair is more than just a local event; it attracts people from across Minnesota and beyond, becoming an integral part of the region's culture and economy. The Wright County Fairgrounds are easily accessible via local transport networks and provide a backdrop that reflects the traditions and community spirit of Howard Lake. Combining education, entertainment, and competition, the Wright County Fair is an indispensable event for anyone wanting to experience the rural heart of Minnesota.

The Olmsted County Fair , held annually in Rochester, Minnesota, is an event that attracts visitors from both urban and rural areas. Strategically located at the Olmsted County Fairgrounds , the fair celebrates the region's rich agricultural tradition and strengthens community spirit. Traditionally hosted in the summer, it is organized by the Olmsted County Agricultural Association. The focus of the fair is on agriculture and rural life. Visitors can expect an impressive array of products and services, ranging from prize-winning livestock to lush crops and flowers, as well as fresh fruits and vegetables. Crafts, hobbies, and culinary delights are also featured. This wide range of products showcases the diversity and richness of regional agriculture and provides exhibitors with a platform to present their goods and innovations to a broad audience. Competitions, in which the best exhibits are awarded in various categories, are an integral part of the fair. They encourage competition among participants and contribute to the quality and diversity of regional products. The fair also offers an ideal opportunity to learn more about local agriculture, expand knowledge, and make direct contacts with producers. The main visitors to the fair are farmers, artisans, local families, hobby gardeners, and food enthusiasts. The Olmsted County Fair not only attracts local guests but also visitors from neighboring areas who appreciate the cultural and economic significance of the event. The fair is easily accessible and has ample parking and well-equipped facilities. This makes it an ideal meeting place for exhibitors and visitors to showcase their products and expand their networks. In this idyllic setting, visitors can discover new things, celebrate the community, and experience the vitality of Olmsted County firsthand. Overall, the Olmsted County Fair is a vivid example of how a fair can serve as a showcase for regional products and a gathering place for the community. It affirms the event's deep roots in the values and traditions of the region.

The " Food Manufacturing Indonesia " is a leading annual trade fair specializing in the food and beverage manufacturing industry. Thus, Food Manufacturing Indonesia significantly contributes to the advancement of the global food and beverage industry.

The Scott County Fair is organized annually by the Scott County Agricultural Society and traditionally takes place on the last weekend of July at the Scott County Fairgrounds in Jordan, MN. This fair is much more than a local event; it serves as a central platform for culture and education, highlighting agricultural expertise and the rural heritage of Scott County. At the Scott County Fair, visitors can experience a unique combination of education and entertainment. Major attractions include robotics, classic car shows, music concerts, and a variety of ranch rodeo events. The "Miracle of Birth Center" offers unforgettable insights by allowing visitors to witness the birth of lambs, calves, and other livestock up close. This center not only serves educational purposes but also strengthens the connection of the fair to local agriculture and animal breeding. Exhibitors primarily represent the agriculture, automotive, and education sectors. By showcasing the latest technologies and services, the fair covers a wide spectrum of interests, attracting a diverse audience including families, local farmers, technology enthusiasts, and education experts. Highlights of the fair include various competitions and award ceremonies, such as the bean bag tournament, creative arts, and the strongman competition. Particularly, the classic car, truck, and tractor show, with its awards for the top three vehicles, draws many visitors. The fair city of Jordan is easily accessible via various transportation links. The picturesque setting and well-equipped venues make the Scott County Fair an attractive destination for visitors from across the country. In summary, the Scott County Fair not only offers opportunities for learning and experience but also serves as a meeting place for people with a wide range of interests from different industries.

개최장소(베뉴): São Paulo Expo Exhibition & Convention Center
박람회설명:
Fi South America (“Food Ingredients South America”) is the leading trade fair for food ingredients and innovative solutions in the food and beverage industry in Latin America. Since its inception in 1996, the event has evolved into a key industry meeting point and takes place annually at the modern São Paulo Expo in São Paulo. As part of the international Fi event series, organized by Informa Markets—a trading division of London-based Informa PLC—Fi South America stands for innovation, networking, and professional orientation in the field of food ingredients. With its clear focus on health-oriented, natural, and plant-based ingredients, Fi South America occupies a unique position in the South American market. Every year, it attracts both international and regional exhibitors and professionals, providing a specialized platform for companies to showcase their latest developments. The range of offerings extends from vitamins, minerals, and functional ingredients to plant-based proteins, clean label products, as well as gluten-free and allergen-free solutions. This portfolio is complemented by classic ingredients such as sweeteners, texturizers, natural flavors, colorants, and certified organic raw materials. The event sees itself as a driving force for innovation across the entire industry value chain. Elements such as guided innovation tours, trend-based tasting areas, the Plant-Based Experience for plant-based nutrition trends, and the Sustainability Experience for sustainable circular economy are integral parts of the concept and offer genuine added value. Exhibitors include leading ingredient manufacturers, food safety and quality experts, suppliers of new process technologies, as well as service and logistics providers. The main visitors are professionals and executives from procurement, development, production, and quality assurance within the food and beverage sector, as well as from related industries such as pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, and dietary supplements. The São Paulo location adds extra significance to the event: The city is considered South America’s economic and innovation hub and has a major influence on both the regional and global food industry. The São Paulo Expo offers state-of-the-art infrastructure and is centrally located, with excellent connections to public transport and the international airport. Visitors benefit from the city’s vibrant culture and diverse culinary and leisure offerings, experiencing Fi South America as the most important meeting point for trends, networking, and business in the South American ingredients community.

Palmex Thailand is Asia’s leading trade exhibition dedicated entirely to the palm oil industry. The name “Palmex” – short for “Palm Oil Expo” – clearly reflects the event’s focus on technologies, products, and services across the entire palm oil value chain. The exhibition takes place at the CO-OP Exhibition Centre in Surat Thani, a key industrial hub in southern Thailand and a central location for the country’s palm oil sector. The venue offers modern infrastructure and is easily accessible for industry professionals from both domestic and international markets. The event is organized by Fireworks Trade Media Pte Ltd., a globally recognized trade fair organizer based in Singapore, renowned for its high-quality, industry-specific exhibitions. Held annually, Palmex Thailand has firmly established itself as a key meeting point for experts, researchers, manufacturers, and investors across the palm oil industry. The exhibition highlights technological innovations spanning the entire production process – from processing and packaging to storage, automation, and digital solutions. Among the showcased technologies are advanced EFB processing machines, decanter centrifuges, pump systems, biofuel production equipment, oilseed crushers, filtration systems, compressors, packaging machinery, and intelligent automation and control systems. The exhibition is further enriched by suppliers of electric motors, sensors, conveying systems, valves, and scientific institutions focused on sustainable nutrient management. A central feature of Palmex Thailand is its accompanying program of professional events, including seminars, conferences, and panel discussions that explore current trends, challenges, and opportunities within the industry. Business matchmaking sessions, technology presentations, and exclusive networking formats facilitate meaningful exchanges among participants. Exhibitors represent a wide range of sectors – including mechanical engineering, energy, automation, packaging, chemicals, and environmental technology – all with direct or indirect ties to the palm oil industry. The event primarily targets professionals from the palm oil sector: engineers, plant managers, manufacturers, investors, academics, and decision-makers from both the political and economic spheres, all of whom share an interest in sustainable development, increased efficiency, and international cooperation. Palmex Thailand is part of a broader series of international palm oil exhibitions held across other key Southeast Asian markets, each tailored to the specific needs of its region. Palmex Thailand is more than just a showcase for innovation and technology transfer; it is also a significant economic driver for Surat Thani and the surrounding region. With its modern infrastructure, spacious exhibition areas, and comprehensive services for both exhibitors and visitors, the CO-OP Exhibition Centre provides the ideal setting for this specialized event. Palmex Thailand offers the perfect platform for all those looking to actively shape the future of the palm oil industry.

The Good Food & Wine Show (GFWS) is one of Australia’s premier public exhibitions for food, wine, and gourmet experiences. It attracts food enthusiasts, wine connoisseurs, and industry professionals alike. Since its debut in Perth in 2008, it has impressed visitors each year with a diverse range of high-quality products, engaging live experiences, and opportunities for personal interaction. The event is held at the Perth Convention & Exhibition Centre (PCEC) – a modern venue in the heart of the city, well-connected by public transport. The show is organised by Spectapular Enterprises Pty Ltd, an experienced event management company that has created a platform through the GFWS that successfully combines culinary culture, innovation, and economic momentum. The event is far more than a traditional food fair. It showcases the culinary diversity of Australia and serves as a meeting point for the national gourmet community. Exhibits include fine wines, spirits, craft beers, premium food products, and kitchen innovations – from handcrafted delicacies to modernist cuisine and specialty items from small, independent producers. Over 200 exhibitors from renowned regions such as Margaret River, the Barossa Valley, and the Clare Valley invite visitors to exclusive tastings. Interactive masterclasses, curated food pairings, and dynamic live cooking shows featuring renowned Australian chefs turn the visit into a truly immersive experience. A highlight for many is the Kleenheat Kitchen stage, where top chefs demonstrate their skills while actively involving the audience – regardless of whether they are beginners or professionals. The event also offers the chance to speak directly with producers and discover the stories behind the products – a personal element that sets the show apart. Exhibitors represent sectors including food and beverage production, hospitality, tourism, kitchen technology, and retail. The audience is equally diverse, ranging from food-loving private visitors to professionals from the restaurant, hotel, and retail industries. The Perth edition is part of a nationwide event series that also takes place in cities such as Melbourne, Brisbane, and Sydney – each tailored to the local culinary scene. The Good Food & Wine Show is more than a culinary event – it’s a cultural highlight for Perth. It boosts tourism, supports the regional economy, and places Australia’s food and wine culture at the centre of a platform celebrated both nationally and internationally. With its central location at the Perth Convention & Exhibition Centre, just a short walk from the Swan River and easily accessible by train, bus, or car, the GFWS is the perfect destination for a flavourful weekend in Western Australia. For those seeking something special, this is the place – focused, diverse, and rich in personal experiences.

A major highlight of the exhibition is the variety of product presentations and expert talks, which spotlight current developments and groundbreaking innovations. Alongside food and beverage manufacturers, exhibitors include companies from packaging design and technology, refrigeration and storage solutions, as well as shopfitting and retail design. The Istanbul Expo Center, a modern venue with excellent infrastructure, offers convenient access by both public transport and car. Adding to the appeal, Istanbul itself—an energetic metropolis steeped in history, culture, and culinary diversity—enhances the overall experience and makes attending F Istanbul a standout event in the international trade fair calendar.

With a strong focus on innovative solutions for the food and beverage industry, the exhibition serves as a premier platform for networking, business development, and insights into current market trends. Its extensive range of topics includes fresh and frozen foods, meat, poultry, and seafood products, bakery items, snacks, confectionery, as well as alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages. In addition, it showcases cutting-edge technologies for food processing and packaging.
Particular emphasis is placed on forward-looking themes such as sustainable organic foods, eco-friendly packaging solutions, and advanced safety and quality control systems within the food industry. Specialized sectors including professional kitchen equipment, hospitality supplies, catering technology, as well as ingredients and additives—such as spices, flavorings, and functional components—are also thoroughly represented.
A major highlight of the exhibition is the variety of product presentations and expert talks, which spotlight current developments and groundbreaking innovations. Alongside food and beverage manufacturers, exhibitors include companies from packaging design and technology, refrigeration and storage solutions, as well as shopfitting and retail design.
The Istanbul Expo Center, a modern venue with excellent infrastructure, offers convenient access by both public transport and car. Adding to the appeal, Istanbul itself—an energetic metropolis steeped in history, culture, and culinary diversity—enhances the overall experience and makes attending F Istanbul a standout event in the international trade fair calendar.
This year the F Istanbul takes place on 4 days from Wed., 25.08.2027 to Sat., 28.08.2027 in Istanbul already for the 6th time.

Expo Pesca & AcuiPeru & Seafood Lima is regarded as the most important international trade fair for fisheries and aquaculture in Latin America. Since its debut in 2003, it has established itself as an indispensable industry event and takes place every two years, usually in autumn, at the modern Centro de Exposiciones Jockey in Lima. The name combines the Spanish word “Pesca” for fishing with “AcuiPeru”, referencing Peruvian aquaculture, and thus reflects the close connection to the host country. The event is organized by Thais Corporation S.A.C., an experienced company with in-depth expertise in the sector. The trade fair is distinguished by its targeted focus on all areas of the fishing, aquaculture, and seafood industries. It covers the entire value chain, ranging from advanced fishing technologies, aquaculture systems, and shipbuilding to communication and navigation technology, refrigeration and cooling systems, processing, packaging, distribution, and logistics. Furthermore, it serves as a central platform for trading seafood products of all kinds, including specialized products such as fishmeal and fish oil. Exhibitors showcase a comprehensive range of products and services, from boats and their components to net and fishing gear, machinery for filleting, sorting and preserving, as well as digital solutions for management and efficiency. In doing so, the fair sets new standards for innovation, efficiency, and sustainability in the sector. The thematic focus of Expo Pesca & AcuiPeru & Seafood Lima reflects Peru’s significant role in global fisheries and aquaculture. The event serves as a showcase for technological advancements, new business models, and sustainable approaches that are relevant both within Latin America and internationally. A particular highlight is the technical conference, where decision-makers and industry experts discuss current challenges and future trends—an essential forum for anyone seeking to shape the industry. The expo attracts exhibitors and visitors from a variety of fields, including shipbuilding and shipyard industries, mechanical engineering, logistics, aquaculture, and processing, as well as international seafood traders and service providers. Its primary audience consists of owners, managing directors, managers, technicians, and specialists from fishing companies, aquaculture facilities, and processing plants. The Centro de Exposiciones Jockey, with its modern infrastructure, excellent accessibility, and location in the economic and cultural heart of Lima, offers optimal conditions for the event. As a metropolis steeped in tradition and a historic center of the Peruvian fishing industry, Lima provides the ideal setting for this specialized industry gathering, which sets new standards in fisheries and aquaculture.

The VICTAM LatAm , established in 2023, is among the most prestigious trade fairs in the animal feed production industry. The name "VICTAM" is held in high regard globally in this sector, symbolizing innovation and quality. The fair is organized by the Victam Corporation and takes place biennially at the Expo Center Norte in São Paulo, Brazil. As the economic hub of Brazil and Latin America, São Paulo is the perfect location to showcase the core themes of the fair - animal feed production and grain processing. At VICTAM LatAm, the latest technologies, ingredients, and additives for the production of feed for livestock, pets, and aquaculture are presented. Visitors can also learn about cutting-edge processing techniques for grain, rice, soy, and flour, as well as aspects of storage, preservation, and transportation of grains. The event attracts exhibitors from the feed and grain processing industry and related sectors. The main attendees are professionals from these industries who are looking for the latest trends and developments. This collaboration establishes VICTAM LatAm as a central meeting point in the region. Additionally, industry conferences and technical workshops further enhance the offerings. The fair is part of a global series of VICTAM events, recognized as leading trade fairs in their industry. In conclusion, it's worth noting that the Expo Center Norte in São Paulo is a modern and easily accessible exhibition center, emphasizing São Paulo as an attractive venue for international trade fairs. With its top-notch infrastructure and transportation links, it provides the ideal setting for successful events.

FHT Food & Hospitality Thailand is the leading international trade fair for the food and hospitality industry in the heart of Southeast Asia. The abbreviation “FHT” reflects the focus on the dynamic markets of food, beverages, gastronomy, hospitality, and retail in the region. Held annually at the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center in Bangkok, the event is organized by Informa Markets Thailand, one of the country’s foremost trade fair organizers. A distinctive feature of FHT is its clear structure into eight specialized sectors. These encompass Food & Drinks, Café & Bakery, Hospitality Style, Hospitality Technology, Foodservice Equipment, Sips & Spirits, and Shop & Retail. This organization provides professional visitors with targeted access to innovations, products, concepts, and solutions tailored to their specific business needs. The fair addresses decision-makers and experts from the hotel, restaurant, catering, and specialist retail industries, as well as the coffee and bakery sectors, and also covers retail technology, business equipment, and services. FHT offers a broad range of products and services, from modern POS systems, vending machines, cleaning and hygiene solutions to specialty coffee, craft beer, and international wines, as well as innovative technologies and sustainable concepts. This is complemented by a diverse supporting program. Expert-led seminars and workshops provide insights into current topics such as digitalization, marketing strategies, and sustainability. National competitions—including the Culinary Cup, latte art contests, and “Coffee in Good Spirits”—set professional and creative highlights while encouraging talent and innovation. Concurrent trade shows like “Hotel & Shop Plus Thailand” and “HOTELEX Thailand” further expand the offering, representing the entire value chain of the industry. FHT serves as the central meeting point for decision-makers, traders, consultants, investors, and buyers from the region, as well as for international exhibitors and visitors seeking direct access to the thriving Thai and Southeast Asian market. Through its connection with other HOTELEX exhibitions across Asia, FHT is part of a strong international trade fair network. The Queen Sirikit National Convention Center, one of the most modern venues in Thailand, is centrally located, easily accessible by public transport, and surrounded by top-class hotels, restaurants, and business addresses. FHT Food & Hospitality Thailand is therefore much more than a trade fair: it is the key platform for networking, knowledge exchange, and business development in one of the most innovative hospitality regions worldwide. Anyone interested in future trends, new business opportunities, and the leading players in the industry will find the perfect forum at FHT in Bangkok.

FHM – Food & Hotel Malaysia is Malaysia’s leading international trade exhibition for food, beverages, hospitality, gastronomy, bakery, confectionery, catering, and hospitality technologies. Held biennially at the Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre (KLCC), it takes place in the vibrant heart of the Malaysian capital. The event is organized by Informa Markets Malaysia Sdn Bhd, one of the region’s most experienced and respected trade fair organizers, with a strong network across the Asia-Pacific. What sets FHM apart is its unique blend of culinary diversity, technological innovation, and industry expertise. It serves as a key meeting point for decision-makers in the hotel, foodservice, and food industries – not just from Southeast Asia, but from around the globe. More than just a showcase for products, the event focuses on hands-on solutions and forward-looking trends: plant-based foods, Halal-certified products, biodegradable packaging, Industry 4.0 technologies, intelligent hotel software, and cutting-edge barista equipment. FHM is more than a trade fair – it is a platform for inspiration, knowledge exchange, and competition. A major highlight is the prestigious “Culinaire Malaysia” culinary competition, where the country’s top chefs demonstrate their skills with modern techniques and creative dishes. The Pastry Innovation Lab offers a deep dive into the world of patisserie, featuring themed competitions, masterclasses, and live demonstrations by Malaysia’s leading pâtissiers. The competition among master mixologists, who craft spectacular alcohol-free coffee-based beverages, is also raising the bar in the industry. The range of products and services presented at FHM spans nearly every segment of the hospitality and food industry – from baked goods, confectionery, beverages, and tea and coffee accessories to meat, seafood, fresh produce, refrigeration and freezing technology, cleaning systems, loss prevention solutions, hotel management software, and smart kitchen technologies. Exhibitors include food producers, caterers, hoteliers, technology providers, consulting firms, and system integrators. The core audience comprises professionals from hotel management, foodservice, retail, consulting, and investment sectors – all looking for new business opportunities, product innovations, and international partnerships. In short, FHM is a must-attend event for anyone who wants to not only discover the latest developments in the hospitality and food industries but experience them firsthand. The Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre, located next to the iconic Petronas Towers, offers the perfect setting – modern, centrally located, and easily accessible by public transport or car. Set in the dynamic metropolis of Kuala Lumpur, your visit to FHM is sure to be both inspiring and unforgettable.

Food Matters Live Rotterdam is an international B2B event for the food, beverage and nutraceutical industries, open exclusively to trade professionals. Its central focus is on how emerging scientific insights, innovative ingredients and technologies, and changing consumer needs can be translated into commercially viable food and beverage products and nutrition concepts. The event is particularly aimed at professionals working directly in product development, formulation, nutrition and innovation. The two-day event takes place once a year, usually in September, at the Rotterdam Ahoy Convention Centre. It is organised by Food Matters Live Ltd. London is also part of the Food Matters Live event programme, with annual editions held in both the UK and the Netherlands, creating an international event series for Europe’s food and nutrition community. Food Matters Live focuses on the future of product development across the food and nutrition industries. Key themes include emerging food and consumer trends, positive nutrition and functional foods, metabolic health, the microbiome and gut health, women’s health, personalised nutrition, dietary fibre, and new and alternative protein sources. Other areas of focus include innovative flavour and colour solutions, clean label, sensory science, sustainable and functional ingredients, reformulation, upcycling, whole-food ingredients and emerging technologies such as precision fermentation. New product development (NPD) is another major theme, covering areas such as novel formulation approaches, sustainable ingredient solutions and AI-powered tools for product development. The programme addresses practical challenges faced by food manufacturers when developing new products, including balancing health and indulgence, reducing sugar, creating clean-label products, and improving taste, texture and nutritional value. The range of products and solutions presented at the event reflects this broad scope. Exhibits include functional and natural ingredients, proteins, dietary fibres, flavours and colours, sugar- and salt-reduction solutions, clean-label concepts, and ingredients for functional foods and dietary supplements. Ingredients and technologies for bakery products, beverages, dairy products, desserts, snacks and alternative-protein products are also showcased. The offering is complemented by analytical, product development and technology solutions, as well as services covering product development, quality, sensory science and innovation. One of the distinctive features of Food Matters Live is its emphasis on interactive formats. As part of “Tastes of Better”, international ingredient specialists showcase their solutions in one-hour sessions. These give trade visitors the opportunity not only to discover new ingredients but also to taste them in real product applications and discuss their properties and potential uses directly with technical experts. Exhibitors primarily include ingredient manufacturers and suppliers, food-tech and technology companies, specialists in flavours, colours, proteins and functional ingredients, and providers of product development, analytical and business services. Visitors mainly come from food and nutraceutical brands, food manufacturing, retail, quick-service restaurants and the wider foodservice sector. The event is particularly relevant to professionals and decision-makers working in research and development (R&D), new product development (NPD), nutrition, innovation, quality control, product and brand marketing, and ingredient procurement. Admission is restricted to industry professionals. The event is held at Rotterdam Ahoy, Ahoyweg 10, 3084 BA Rotterdam, south of the city centre. The venue is easily accessible both by car via the A15 motorway and by public transport. Rotterdam Ahoy is approximately a five-minute walk from Zuidplein metro and bus station, while the journey by metro from central Rotterdam or Rotterdam Centraal railway station takes around ten minutes.
