Since its founding in 1950, it has delighted a wide audience every autumn with a blend of information, experiences, and shopping opportunities. After a pandemic-related hiatus from 2021 to 2025, the fair made a remarkable comeback under new management. It is now organized by RW Messen & Events GmbH, which brings fresh ideas while honoring the event's long-standing traditions. The venue is the centrally located and easily accessible exhibition grounds at the Talavera in Würzburg. More than just a trade show, the Mainfranken-Messe offers a vibrant fair experience with a varied supporting program that includes live music, cooking shows, and informative talks. As a public fair, it stands out for its thematic diversity. It targets both private visitors and small to medium-sized enterprises. Rather than focusing on a single industry, it centers on everyday life and the quality of life for people in the region—practical, relatable, and hands-on. A strong regional connection is key: many exhibitors come from Mainfranken, making the fair a platform for direct encounters, personal consultations, and regional sales. Traditionally, the fair focuses on the areas of building, living & energy, as well as health, wellness & vitality. Visitors can find expert information and offers on topics such as construction, renovation, interior design, and energy-efficient home upgrades—from skilled trades and architecture firms to providers of modern heating systems and smart home technologies. Health-conscious attendees will discover a wide range of products and services related to prevention, fitness, nutrition, and medical advice—often in cooperation with regional clinics and professionals. Another highlight is the culinary section. The “Genussmeile” (gourmet mile) offers a rich variety of regional specialties—from wine and cheese to sausages and spirits—showcasing Mainfranken’s culinary culture. Visitors can sample, shop, and enjoy these delights on-site in dedicated dining areas. The fair is further enriched by themes such as leisure, travel, gardening, fashion, jewelry, mobility, and digital technology. Whether it's e-bikes, travel offers, or consumer electronics—the event reflects the lifestyles and interests of its diverse audience. Ultimately, the Mainfranken-Messe is far more than a product showcase. It is a vibrant space for experiences and encounters, attracting tens of thousands of visitors from across the region each year. With its unique blend of tradition, regional focus, entertainment, and practical support for everyday life, it remains an unparalleled platform for exchange, innovation, and personal connection. Anyone who wants to understand what drives Mainfranken meets in autumn at the Talavera—at the Mainfranken-Messe in Würzburg.

The ANUGA in Cologne, the name of which is an abbreviation for the "General Food and Beverage Exhibition," is considered the leading global food trade fair catering to retail, gastronomy, and the out-of-home market. The fair is organized by the renowned Koelnmesse GmbH, recognized for its expertise in coordinating large international exhibitions. Since its inception in 1951, ANUGA has taken on a central role in the Food & Beverage industry. The exhibition takes place every two years in October on the impressive grounds of the Cologne Fair. A highlight of the fair is the ANUGA trend topics, which highlight the current demands in the industry and the market's direction. The fair's international ambiance attracts visitors from almost every country in the world, facilitating cross-border business and networking. Whether by car, train, or plane, the Cologne Fair is easily accessible and offers a unique setting for business encounters and culinary discoveries.

The EATS - held under the name "Process Expo" until 2023 - in Chicago is one of the leading trade fairs for the food and beverage industry and is dedicated to business growth in this sector. Chicago has a deep and historic connection to the food and drink sector, encompassing both economic and cultural facets. In the late 19th and early 20th centuries, Chicago was known as the "world's butcher" and hosted the largest livestock market globally. The Union Stock Yards, which operated between 1865 and 1971, played a pivotal role in the US meatpacking industry. Chicago is also the birthplace of many renowned food companies and brands, such as Kraft Foods, Quaker Oats, and McDonald's. Furthermore, the city significantly contributed to innovations in food processing and packaging. The Process Expo takes place biennially in the fall. It offers manufacturers, buyers, and other professionals a platform for networking and discovering the latest equipment, technologies, and current industry trends. As a global event, it attracts engineers, scientists, R&D specialists, as well as sales and marketing experts from around the world. The organization of the Process Expo is managed by Messe Frankfurt North America, a subsidiary of Messe Frankfurt, headquartered in Atlanta, GA. With its commitment, it supports US companies in showcasing their innovations on a global stage and opens up new investment opportunities for them. Exhibitors at the Process Expo display a wide range of products and services – from machinery and equipment for baked goods, beverages, dairy products, fruits, and vegetables to meat, poultry, and even pharmaceutical products. A special highlight of the exhibition is the Innovation Awards, which honor remarkable advancements in food processing technology. The event is held at the McCormick Place Convention Center, one of the largest and most advanced exhibition grounds in North America, distinguished by its striking architecture and top-notch infrastructure. Here, industry professionals from the food sector, both from the USA and other countries, gather to explore the latest trends in food processing technology. In summary, the Process Expo in Chicago is more than just a trade show. It represents a vibrant hub for innovation, networking, and growth in the food and beverage industry and is an indispensable rendezvous for all committed to the future of this sector.

Since its inception, FHTB has become a key meeting point for innovators, business leaders, and professionals seeking to explore the latest trends, technologies, and business ideas in the hospitality sector and related fields. The fair's offerings encompass a wide range of topics, from food and beverages to wine and spirits, bakery, food service and retail, to culinary and catering equipment, tourism services and accessories, interior decoration, and gastronomy technology. The exhibition showcases both new and traditional products—from fresh ingredients to processed foods, including organic and healthy options. Special attention is given to fine wines, spirits, and other alcoholic beverages, with tastings and presentations of new brands. The bakery industry, innovative food services, and retail solutions are also highlighted, along with the latest technologies and equipment for kitchens and dining establishments. The range is complemented by tourism services, hospitality accessories, and interior design trends. Gastronomy technology, including digital solutions and management software, completes the broad spectrum. FHTB attracts a diverse audience, including hoteliers, merchants, investors, consultants, and buyers, who are interested in learning about innovations and solutions in their fields. A notable feature of FHTB is the accompanying conference with lectures, workshops, and discussion panels that offer participants insights into current market trends and business strategies. The Bali Nusa Dua Convention Center (BNDCC), the event venue, with its modern facilities and picturesque location in Nusa Dua, provides an ideal backdrop for this international event. Thus, FHTB serves not only as a platform for business deals and networking but also as a source of inspiration for all players in the hospitality industry. By combining an exhibition and a conference, it enables participants to stay informed about the latest developments, establish valuable contacts, and forge strategic partnerships that promote growth and success in the dynamic world of hospitality.

The SACHSENBACK is a trade fair held every two years in Dresden, specifically designed for the bakery and confectionery crafts. It is considered the most important event of its kind in Eastern Germany. Since its inception in October 1990, the fair has established itself as a central platform for professional exchange, information on the latest trends and technological developments, and for networking. The organization is handled by Landesmesse Stuttgart GmbH, known for its expertise in organizing trade fairs well beyond regional boundaries. SACHSENBACK offers a wide range of topics from working and operating techniques to raw materials and commercial goods, as well as business furnishings and equipment. Additionally, there is a focus on sales promotion and services relevant to the bakery and confectionery crafts. A highlight is the Backforum, dedicated to the preparation of fruits, canapés, and other delicacies, as well as the presentation of showcase pastries. Moreover, topics such as snacks and the take-away market are gaining importance, underscoring the fair's relevance for current market trends. The diverse supporting program of SACHSENBACK includes hands-on demonstrations, the confectioners' idea market, and competitions, offering a wealth of opportunities for further education and inspiration. This attracts professional visitors from the entire spectrum of the industry, including independent businesses from the traditional bakery craft, confectioneries, and representatives of the bread and bakery products industry. The venue is Messe Dresden, which, with its modern infrastructure and flexible space concepts, provides ideal conditions for a trade fair of this size. Its central location and good accessibility by public transport and car make it an attractive meeting point for exhibitors and visitors from all over Germany and beyond. In summary, SACHSENBACK is more than just a fair; it serves as an industry platform that promotes the exchange of ideas and knowledge and provides a stage for innovations and technological advancements. Its triennial cycle gives each event a special character, eagerly anticipated by the participants.

TUTTOFOOD , the international trade fair, is a key platform for innovation, quality, and diversity in the food and beverage industry. Since its debut in 2007, it has become a major meeting point for the global food sector and takes place every two years at the Fiera Milano exhibition center in Rho, near Milan. The name “TUTTOFOOD” combines the Italian word Tutto (everything) with the English Food, aptly reflecting the fair’s comprehensive scope. The event is organized by Fiera Milano S.p.A., one of Europe’s leading trade fair organizers. TUTTOFOOD is exclusively aimed at professionals from across the food industry, bringing together producers, distributors, buyers, restaurateurs, importers, and decision-makers from over 140 countries. The focus lies on current industry topics such as sustainability, food trends, technological innovation, and developments throughout the entire value chain. TUTTOFOOD is distinguished not only by the wide range of products on display – from fresh and frozen foods, delicacies, pasta, confectionery, dairy and meat products to beverages, functional foods, and plant-based alternatives – but also by the high quality of its exhibitors and its strong emphasis on fostering international exchange. Dedicated areas such as the Startup Area, the TUTTOFOOD Academy featuring top chefs from APCI, and the Bellavita Expo, which celebrates Italian culinary culture, further enrich the trade fair experience. Another highlight is the TUTTOFOOD Street Experience, which takes visitors on a multisensory journey of taste. The Mixology Experience has also established itself as Italy’s largest platform for the beverage and hospitality sectors. In forums such as the Better Future Arena and the Cibus Link Arena, pressing issues related to food, supply chains, and consumer behavior are discussed in a practical, solution-oriented, and forward-thinking manner. TUTTOFOOD exemplifies Italy’s culinary excellence – from traditional craftsmanship to cutting-edge food-tech innovations. The venue, Fiera Milano, is among the most modern exhibition centers in Europe. Its excellent transport connections via highways, public transit, and Milan-Malpensa International Airport make it an ideal location for an event of this scale. TUTTOFOOD is more than just a trade fair – it is the international meeting point for all those who want to help shape the future of food.

Venditalia is the leading international trade fair for the vending industry and was established in 1998. The name "Venditalia" is derived from the Italian words for sale (Vendita) and Italy (Italia), emphasizing the event's central importance to the Italian vending sector. It is held biennially at Rimini Expo Centre, usually in the spring. Organized by Venditalia Servizi Srl, a company wholly dedicated to promoting the vending industry, the fair showcases a wide array of products and services from various sectors of the vending industry. These include food and non-food vending machines, payment systems, IT solutions, security technologies, packaging, personnel equipment, and logistics services. Additionally, fresh produce, ready meals, disposable items, water dispensers, and products and ingredients for hot and cold beverages and confectionery snacks are also presented. A key aspect of Venditalia is its role as a platform for innovation within the industry. Exhibitors and visitors from around the world introduce and discuss the latest products, technologies, and market trends. The main topics include machines for hot and cold beverages, snacks, fresh and prepared meals, as well as various services and technical solutions for vending sales. The fair is also of significant local importance as it represents the economy of the Milan region and the Italian vending industry on an international scale. Highlights include forums and conferences with industry experts, business matchmaking events, and workshops that provide additional expertise and business opportunities. Exhibitors and primary visitors to Venditalia come from diverse sectors, including manufacturers of vending machines and consumables, IT companies, and service providers. The fair serves as an important platform for professionals from these areas to network, initiate business, and stay informed about current trends and technologies. The Rimini Expo Centre, the venue for the fair, is easily accessible via public transportation and major roadways and offers modern facilities that meet the requirements of an international trade fair. In conclusion, Venditalia is an indispensable event for all stakeholders in the vending sales industry, driving innovation and business developments forward.

IFFA – the International Trade Fair for the Meat Industry – is the world’s leading trade show for processing, packaging, and marketing of meat and alternative proteins. Held every three years at the Frankfurt exhibition grounds, it has evolved since its inception into the globally recognized flagship event for the sector. As an exclusive business platform, it is open solely to trade visitors and brings together top-tier exhibitors and decision-makers from across the entire meat processing value chain – from craft and industry to retail. The organizer of IFFA is Messe Frankfurt GmbH, one of the world’s largest trade fair companies, headquartered in the heart of Europe. The company is known for its global reach, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and decades of expertise in hosting specialized trade events. What sets IFFA apart is its distinct focus on the future of the meat and protein industry. At its core are key themes such as peak technological performance, data-driven value creation, practical sustainability, and product innovation. Visitors gain first-hand insights into the use of cutting-edge technologies like artificial intelligence, robotics, and sensor systems to automate and optimize production processes. At the same time, the show highlights sustainable packaging concepts, energy-efficient systems, and alternative protein sources – including plant-based solutions, fermentation, fungi, and cell cultures. These innovations address emerging dietary trends and open up new market opportunities. The exhibition is organized into five thematic zones, known as the “IFFA Worlds”. The World of Processing focuses on machinery and technology for efficient processing. The World of Packaging showcases innovative, often plastic-reduced packaging solutions. The World of Ingredients presents spices, additives, and auxiliary materials for product refinement. The World of New Proteins is dedicated entirely to alternative proteins, providing a platform for start-ups, research, and product development. In the World of Skills and Sales, craftsmanship, sales expertise, and culinary talent take center stage – enhanced by competitions and live demonstrations that make the visitor experience especially dynamic. Exhibitors primarily come from the fields of machinery and plant engineering, food technology, packaging, ingredients, logistics, and research and development. Visitors include professionals from the meat industry, food production, wholesale and retail sectors, as well as from start-ups and innovation departments. IFFA is more than just a trade fair – it is a reflection of a transforming industry, a catalyst for new business models, and a key venue where global trends are shaped. Its location in Frankfurt am Main provides access to a modern exhibition center with excellent connections to Frankfurt International Airport, the railway network, and major highways. For anyone looking to shape the future of the meat and protein industry, IFFA is the place to be.

IPACK-IMA is a leading international trade fair for processing and packaging technologies. Since its inception in 1961, it has established itself as a central platform for innovation, professional exchange, and business development within the industry. Held every three years at the renowned Fiera Milano exhibition center in Rho, near Milan, it attracts a specialized audience from both the food and non-food sectors. The event is organized by Ipack Ima S.r.l., an experienced trade fair operator with deep industry expertise and a strong international network. With its clear focus on professional users, IPACK-IMA showcases tailored solutions across the entire production chain – from industrial processing to packaging and the final product presentation at the point of sale. Particular attention is given to grain-based food products, beverages, pharmaceuticals, and goods from the cosmetics, chemical, construction, and consumer goods sectors. The fair appeals equally to global corporations, mid-sized companies, and innovative start-ups looking to forge new business connections, identify market trends, and gain fresh insights into optimizing their production processes. A defining feature of IPACK-IMA is its emphasis on digitalization, sustainability, and technological innovation. Smart factory solutions, advanced automation, and digitally connected process chains illustrate the path toward the factories of the future. At the same time, sustainable packaging is increasingly brought to the forefront, with the exhibition highlighting cutting-edge materials and machinery that align ecological responsibility with economic efficiency. The event features several highlights that reinforce its practical orientation and forward-looking character. Among them is the “Best Packaging” competition, which honors groundbreaking packaging solutions that combine technological excellence with sustainability. The integrated Pharmintech section provides a dedicated platform tailored to the specific needs of the pharmaceutical industry. Additional special areas, such as the Smart Factory zones, offer live demonstrations of modern manufacturing processes – particularly in the beverage and coffee sectors – delivering an engaging and immersive experience for visitors. IPACK-IMA stands out for its ability to foster cross-industry synergies between processing and packaging while addressing the specific requirements of diverse industrial sectors. It is more than just a trade fair – it is a strategic meeting point for industry professionals, a catalyst for technological advancement, and a showcase for the future of industrial production and packaging.

SNACKEX, initiated in 1985, is the only international trade fair exclusively focused on savory snacks and snack nuts. Organized by the European Snacks Association (ESA), the fair takes place every two years in the summer, hosted in a different major European city each time. This format promotes the cultural diversity of Europe and brings together professionals from the snack industry to discuss current trends and innovations. The fair serves as a central meeting point for the industry, providing insights into the entire manufacturing process of savory snacks – from ingredient selection to laboratory testing, packaging processes, and the final products. SNACKEX showcases a wide range of products, including potato chips, tortilla chips, corn and pellet snacks, as well as a selection of snack nuts such as peanuts and exotic nut mixes. A distinctive feature of SNACKEX is the numerous networking opportunities with industry leaders, qualified buyers, and decision-makers. The fair acts as a platform for trade and exchange, fostering direct contact with industry leaders and supporting the formation of valuable business relationships. The event program includes social events and a conference that provides insights into future industry challenges and opportunities. Each venue contributes its local charm to the unique atmosphere of the fair, highlighting the international character of the event and inspiring both visitors and exhibitors. Thus, SNACKEX is more than just a trade fair – it is a vibrant, culturally enriching industry event that brings the entire snack industry together and creates an unparalleled platform for professional exchange and economic momentum.

The International Baking Industry Exposition (IBIE) is the largest and most influential trade show for grain-based food products in the Western Hemisphere. It serves as the central meeting point for the global baking industry—and is far more than just a traditional trade event. Every three years, the international baking community gathers at the Las Vegas Convention Center (LVCC) to help shape the future of baking. Covering an exhibition area of approximately 40,000 square meters, IBIE provides a major platform for innovation, education, and economic advancement. The event is organized by the leading industry associations: the American Bakers Association (ABA) , BEMA, and the Retail Bakers of America (RBA). This alliance brings together the full spectrum of industrial and artisan baking, with the shared goal of consolidating expertise, strengthening networks, and unlocking new growth opportunities. IBIE addresses all key segments of the modern baking sector—from production and packaging technology to innovative ingredients, hygiene solutions, digitally controlled processes, and logistics applications. The technologies and trends showcased at the expo offer practical solutions that enhance operational efficiency and competitiveness. A central focus of the event is the IBIEducate program, which is dedicated to the industry’s current challenges and future priorities. In targeted learning formats, leading experts share actionable insights on topics such as process optimization, product quality, marketing strategies, and sustainable production. The show also serves as a stage for prestigious competitions. The Americas Selection of the Coupe du Monde de la Boulangerie brings together top bakery teams from across the region to compete in a range of disciplines. The World Bread Awards USA honor outstanding bread creations across numerous categories. Artistic cake design is also celebrated in a dedicated competition featuring wedding cakes, fondant work, sculpted cakes, and buttercream artistry. Exhibitors represent fields including mechanical engineering, ingredient manufacturing, packaging development, logistics, and process technology. Attendees come primarily from industrial and artisan bakeries, as well as from retail, foodservice, hospitality, product development, and grocery sectors. With its strong international connectivity, modern convention facilities, and vibrant atmosphere, Las Vegas offers the perfect setting for this global industry event. Located near Harry Reid International Airport and surrounded by a wide range of accommodations, IBIE is more than a trade show—it’s an immersive experience for all who are shaping the future of baking.

As a modern and spacious center, it provides the ideal backdrop for an event of this size and contributes significantly to the fair's appeal. Melbourne, known for its diverse food culture and passion for good food, thus provides the perfect setting for the Home Cooking Show.

The ASIAEXPO is a trade fair and conference specifically designed for the agricultural industry, held annually at the Park of Science and Art "Sirius" in the federal territory of Sirius. The fair is organized by ASIAEXPO LLC, which is distinguished by its strong network within the agricultural industry and extensive experience in organizing large-scale events. The range of topics at the fair is diverse and includes areas such as feed and additives, equipment for livestock and poultry farming, and veterinary medicine. In summary, the ASIAEXPO in Sochi is an indispensable event for all stakeholders in the agricultural industry, fostering innovation, sharing knowledge, and presenting the latest developments in the sector. The excellent location and top-notch organization make every visit a worthwhile experience.

An experience that remains in memory and delights anew each year.

The " FIRA DE REIS " in Igualada, established in 1373, is one of the oldest and most unique fairs in Catalonia. Its name, which translates to "King's Fair", highlights its traditional significance. Held annually on Epiphany, it becomes a special event. The historic Passeig Verdaguer, serving as the venue, is centrally located and contributes to the festive atmosphere. Organized by the city of Igualada, the fair attracts about 200 exhibitors each year. Across an area of 1,500 meters, they offer a wide range of products and services, including agricultural seedlings, handicrafts, regional foods, wines and spirits, clothing, artworks, decorative items, and garden supplies. This diversity emphasizes the cultural and economic importance of the region. The fair serves not only as a trading platform but also as a social event that strengthens the community and honors Catalonia's cultural heritage. It is particularly noteworthy that the FIRA DE REIS provides a platform for local farmers and craftsmen to present their products and skills to a broad audience. This attracts a diverse range of visitors, from professionals to families, who appreciate the extensive offerings. The significance of the fair extends well beyond the borders of Igualada, drawing visitors from all over Catalonia and beyond. Thus, the FIRA DE REIS is not just a showcase for local products and crafts but also a significant cultural event that honors the history and tradition of the region. The centrally located Passeig Verdaguer not only offers a picturesque setting but is also well-connected, making the fair attractive to a wide audience.

The " Made in Pakistan " is an annual trade show that showcases Pakistan's industrial capacities and economic potential. It is organized by the Trade Development Authority of Pakistan in collaboration with the Ministry of Commerce of Saudi Arabia. The event is held at the Jeddah International Exhibition & Convention Center in Jeddah, a global hub ideally suited for business meetings and with excellent flight connections. The fair focuses on four main sectors: engineering, textiles and apparel, agricultural products, and services. It features products and services from areas such as sports equipment, pharmaceuticals, towels, ready-made clothing, processed foods, and architectural design. This diversity highlights the wide range of high-quality goods and services that Pakistan offers internationally. The Made in Pakistan serves not only as a B2B platform but also as a forum for dialogue and cooperation among entrepreneurs, investors, and government representatives. It provides a unique opportunity for direct networking and initiating collaborations. Participants from various industries, including manufacturing, healthcare, and the textile industry, emphasize the significance and scope of the fair. A highlight of the event is the sector-specific panel discussions and live demonstrations of new technologies, making the fair a dynamic venue for exchange and promoting excellence. Finally, it is worth noting that the Jeddah International Exhibition & Convention Center impresses not only with its modern facilities and excellent accessibility but also with its location in Jeddah—a commercial and cultural center of Saudi Arabia and a gateway to the Islamic world. This underscores the strategic importance of the fair in promoting international trade and economic cooperation. The "Made in Pakistan" is thus a key meeting point for all those interested in expanding global markets and deepening bilateral trade relationships.

Africa Agri Tech is an international fair and conference dedicated to exploring and presenting the latest scientific findings, technologies, and trends in agriculture. Held annually at the CSIR Convention Centre in Pretoria, this event attracts numerous participants from the global agricultural industry, including executives, companies, innovators, scientists, researchers, policymakers, and farmers. The name of the fair, "Africa Agri Tech", highlights the focus on agricultural technologies and innovations in Africa, with a particular emphasis on the development and implementation of new methods to enhance efficiency and productivity in the agricultural sector. The organizer of the fair, the Grain Building in the Agri-Hub Office Park, ensures professional organization and attracts attendees from a wide range of sectors. Key themes of the fair include sustainable agriculture, biotechnological innovations, digital agricultural technology, and global market access. A variety of products and services are presented, ranging from innovative farming techniques to the latest research in seed breeding and soil science. A special highlight of the fair is the "Tech Try Out Zone", where the latest inventions and solutions are showcased. Here, visitors have the opportunity to directly interact with the innovations and gain deep insights into potential applications. Exhibitors and visitors come from a broad spectrum of industries, including agricultural enterprises, technology startups, research institutions, and educational institutions. The fair strengthens the local agricultural economy in Pretoria and South Africa and draws international attention to the agricultural challenges and solutions in the region. The CSIR Convention Centre as the venue is strategically located and has excellent transport links, making it easily accessible to both international and local visitors. Thus, "Africa Agri Tech" serves as a central hub for the agricultural industry and an essential platform for promoting innovation and knowledge transfer.

The event is organized by dmg::events, a global player in industrial event management. Hotel & Hospitality Expo Saudi Arabia serves as a central meeting point, providing opportunities to explore the latest innovations, connect with industry leaders, and deepen business relationships with suppliers. The expo covers a wide range of topics including operational resources and equipment, interior design for hospitality, HORECA, food services, as well as cleaning and hygiene products. It also features technological solutions and services for hotels, including wellness offerings such as gyms and spas. The exhibition showcases advanced products and services, ranging from security systems and communication technologies to customer loyalty programs and parking solutions. Special attention is given to innovative solutions in areas like air conditioning, energy management, sustainability, recycling, and waste disposal. Products such as table and kitchen linens, uniforms, minibars, room service equipment, and bedroom and bathroom textiles are also presented. Hotel & Hospitality Expo Saudi Arabia significantly contributes to the economic development of Riyadh and the entire kingdom by serving as a platform for the exchange of knowledge and technologies. Highlights of the expo include the Hospitality Leaders' Summit, the Mystery Box Challenge for hotel chefs, and the presentation of the Hotel & Hospitality Awards. Exhibitors and visitors come from a diverse range of sectors, including hotel development, architecture, facility management, and gastronomy. Located in the center of Riyadh, the RICEC offers state-of-the-art facilities that ensure a productive and enjoyable expo experience, attracting numerous international visitors annually.

The FOOD TECHNOLOGY trade fair is a symbol of technological progress in food processing and is recognized as the leading professional event for food technology, processing, and safety in the Republic of Moldova. Held annually at the International Exhibition Centre (IEC) MoldExpo in Chișinău—the country's largest and most modern exhibition and congress venue—the event is organized by I.E.C. MOLDEXPO S.A. This experienced organizer of international trade fairs has long been a catalyst for economic exchange and technological advancement in the region. Combining technical depth with regional significance and international appeal, the fair targets trade visitors and industry professionals from the fields of food processing, packaging, gastronomy, storage, and quality assurance. It is especially relevant for manufacturers, distributors, engineers, technologists, food service professionals, and representatives from research institutions and regulatory bodies involved in food safety and production. The spotlight is on cutting-edge technologies for processing baked goods, meat, dairy, and confectionery products, as well as innovative refrigeration and storage solutions, hygiene systems, and specialized software for production control and quality management. Equipment for the food service industry, climate and ventilation systems, and laboratory technology also play a central role. The overarching focus is on sustainability, energy efficiency, and technological advancement—key themes aligned with the current demands of the sector. A diverse supporting program featuring live demonstrations, expert lectures, seminars, and workshops turns the fair into a hands-on knowledge platform. It brings together experts from both home and abroad in Chișinău, the Republic of Moldova’s most economically and culturally significant city. Thanks to its central location in Eastern Europe and well-developed infrastructure, the capital is an ideal venue. The MoldExpo fairgrounds are easily accessible from both the international airport and the city center—creating the perfect conditions to actively shape the future of the food industry.

The Salon de l’Agriculture Nouvelle-Aquitaine is the most important regional agricultural fair in western France. Held annually at the Parc des Expositions in Bordeaux, it is organized by BEAM – Bordeaux Events And More , in close collaboration with the network of Chambers of Agriculture of the Nouvelle-Aquitaine region. This fair is much more than a simple product exhibition: it offers a unique platform that showcases the diversity and innovative strength of regional agriculture — appealing to both industry professionals and the general public. Key themes include animal breeding, food, sustainable farming, the environment, and energy. Special emphasis is placed on educational programs and the promotion of young talent in the agricultural sector. On an exhibition area of over 10,000 m², visitors can experience the presentation of more than 400 cattle, 300 horses, and 100 sheep — including breeding competitions, sheep shearing demonstrations, and herding dog performances. The fair vividly combines agricultural practice with in-depth knowledge-sharing — for farmers, breeders, students, and anyone interested in the future of agriculture. A major attraction is the Marché des Producteurs, where local producers present their specialties. The culinary offerings range from cheese, cured meats, and duck products to oysters, honey, wines, and Armagnac. The tasting experience is enhanced by live cooking shows featuring renowned regional chefs and the Comptoir des Vins, which offers a curated selection of award-winning wines for sampling. This creates a flavorful link between agriculture and regional identity — deeply rooted in the culture of Nouvelle-Aquitaine. Special thematic areas such as Aquitanima (cattle breeding), the Journées Ovines (sheep farming), and Equitaine (horse breeding and equestrian sports) bring the expertise of each sector to life in an engaging and hands-on way. Alongside products and animals, these zones also focus on career paths and training opportunities — with the aim of inspiring young people to pursue a career in agriculture. The majority of exhibitors come from sectors including agriculture, food processing, viticulture, livestock breeding, environmental technology, and renewable energy. The audience is just as diverse: farmers, winemakers, gastronomy professionals, trainees, families, and tourists all find relevant content and engaging offerings. The venue — the modern Parc des Expositions — is conveniently located and easily accessible by car or public transport. Situated close to the city center, Bordeaux provides the perfect setting for a trade fair that combines agriculture with quality of life, innovation with tradition, and regional identity with international appeal.

The Naturally Good is Australia’s leading trade show for natural, organic, and health-focused products. Since its inception in 2015, it has been held annually at the renowned International Convention Centre (ICC) in Sydney. Exclusively open to trade professionals, the event targets retailers, wholesalers, hospitality businesses, healthcare providers, and industry experts seeking to explore the latest trends, developments, and innovations in one of the region’s fastest-growing markets. The expo is organized by Diversified Communications Australia, a company with extensive experience and expertise in producing trade shows and conferences. The Naturally Good features a diverse concept that spans a wide range of products and services—including organic food and beverages, nutritional supplements, natural cosmetics, personal care items, and sustainable household and lifestyle products. A key highlight of the event is its in-depth content. Through the “Pulse Stage” program, visitors gain valuable insights into forward-looking topics such as consumer trends, behavioral analysis, regenerative agriculture, the rising importance of specialty and gourmet foods, and the latest developments in vitamins and supplements. Experts also offer practical knowledge on premium products for everyday shopping and new standards in certified organic goods. One of the standout features is the “Pitch Fest,” where start-ups present their products and business ideas to an audience of industry professionals and potential investors—providing a crucial platform for new market entrants. Centrally located on the vibrant Darling Harbour waterfront, the ICC Sydney offers a modern, easily accessible venue with striking architecture—an ideal setting for this dynamic trade fair. In addition to product showcases and networking opportunities, the event includes expert talks, seminars, and awards, making the Naturally Good a pioneering platform for exchange, growth, and innovation in the natural and healthy products sector.

The "Free From Show", an integral part of the broader "Good Life Show" in Cape Town, was launched in 2024 as an innovative trade fair. Its name reflects its focus on products and foods that are free from allergens, gluten, and other ingredients that often lead to dietary restrictions. This fair takes place annually at the Cape Town International Convention Centre and is organized by Live Events Africa (Pty) Ltd. The "Free From Show" has established itself as a unique platform, demonstrating that dietary restrictions do not have to limit one's enjoyment of life. It emphasizes the variety and quality of products that meet these special needs. The main themes of the fair include allergen-free foods, gluten-free products, and general nutritional innovations that contribute to a healthy and sustainable lifestyle. The fair showcases numerous products specifically aimed at people with special dietary needs or food intolerances. These include products free from common allergens like nuts, soy, milk, eggs, and wheat, a wide range of gluten-free foods such as bread, pasta, snacks, and baked goods – suitable for people with celiac disease or gluten intolerance – as well as lactose-free and dairy-free alternatives. Additionally, vegan and vegetarian products, items made without artificial additives, pesticides, or genetically modified organisms, supplements and vitamins offering health benefits, and foods for special diets like Paleo, Keto, or Low-Carb are also featured. A special highlight of the fair is the testing area, where renowned international and local chefs present their creations. Visitors can participate in cooking demonstrations, taste sample portions, and learn simple methods for preparing healthy, tasty, and sustainable dishes. Moreover, the fair offers lectures and discussion rounds from experts in culinary arts, nutrition science, and sustainability, as well as interactive master classes and yoga sessions. The fair attracts exhibitors from various industries, including food and beverage manufacturers, health and wellness companies, and providers of environmentally friendly products. It serves as a meeting point for professionals from these fields as well as interested consumers. The "Free From Show" has a special connection to the city of Cape Town and to South Africa, highlighting the growing importance of health, sustainability, and allergen awareness in the region. As part of a series of fairs held globally, it represents a significant attraction in the world of fairs. In conclusion, it is important to emphasize that the CTICC-Cape Town International Convention Centre impresses not only with its modern architecture and excellent facilities but also with its central location and easy accessibility. It provides an ideal setting for a fair that promises an unforgettable experience for both visitors and exhibitors.

The Gourmet Festival Mönchengladbach (GFM) was first held in 2019 and has since established itself as a fixture in the city’s event calendar. This annual celebration of fine food provides an exclusive platform for culinary diversity and high-quality delicacies. Organized by the experienced event agency Wellfairs GmbH, the festival caters to both trade professionals from retail, gastronomy, and hospitality sectors, as well as private visitors with a passion for exceptional taste experiences. GFM has come to stand not only as an abbreviation for the event itself but also as a synonym for indulgent variety and sophisticated cuisine. Every summer, Hindenburgstraße in the heart of Mönchengladbach transforms into a bustling gourmet boulevard. The spotlight is on themed culinary zones. Exhibitors showcase fine delicacies, exquisite wines, craft beer, spirits, handmade chocolates, regional cheese specialties, international street food trends, and sustainably produced organic products. The offerings range from traditional artisanal goods from small manufacturers to innovative food start-ups presenting their concepts to the public for the first time. A particular highlight is the accompanying live program, featuring cooking shows, tastings, and workshops where renowned chefs demonstrate their skills—often in direct interaction with the audience. Exhibitors include food producers, beverage manufacturers, gourmet importers, organic vendors, street food concepts, as well as companies from the kitchen technology and food service sectors. Visitors have the opportunity not only to sample and purchase products but also to engage in personal conversations with producers and industry professionals—an aspect that appeals to both culinary enthusiasts and professionals alike. The festival is further enriched by product presentations, tasting formats, and live cooking demonstrations on site. The Gourmet Festival Mönchengladbach is part of a nationwide series of events organized by Wellfairs GmbH, with additional editions held in other German cities. The strong connection to the city is reflected not only in its central location but also in the active involvement of local partners, producers, and restaurateurs who help shape the festival. Hindenburgstraße is easily accessible: Mönchengladbach’s main train station is just a short walk away, and numerous parking options are available nearby for those arriving by car. As such, the Gourmet Festival is more than just a culinary highlight—it is a sensory experience right in the heart of Mönchengladbach.

The OEM Manufacturer is a leading trade fair for Original Equipment Manufacturing (OEM) and digital business solutions in Southeast Asia. It takes place annually at the prestigious Queen Sirikit National Convention Center (QSNCC) in Bangkok and is organized by N.C.C. Management & Development Co., Ltd. in collaboration with the Federation of Thai Industries (FTI). The event serves as a unique platform that brings together manufacturers, suppliers, and digital service providers, creating an optimal synergy between traditional production processes and modern online business models. The exhibition covers a wide range of industries, including cosmetics and beauty products, dietary supplements, organic products, food and beverages, fashion and lifestyle, packaging and printing, as well as pet food and future food. The trade fair is further complemented by innovative business solutions in the fields of e-commerce, digital marketing, logistics, management services, cloud technologies, artificial intelligence (AI), the Internet of Things (IoT), 5G, FinTech, and online payment security. Visitors gain valuable insights into pioneering developments that are shaping the future of the OEM industry and digital commerce. As an international hub for OEM manufacturing and digital business strategies, the OEM Manufacturer attracts companies and industry professionals from around the world. Exhibitors from sectors such as manufacturing, technology, logistics, FinTech, and packaging use the event as a platform to showcase their latest products and services, establish strategic partnerships, and generate valuable business contacts. The trade fair specifically targets entrepreneurs, manufacturers, brand owners, startups, retailers, as well as e-commerce and technology service providers seeking innovative solutions and business partners. A particular highlight of the event includes live demonstrations, product presentations, and networking events, offering participants the opportunity to engage with industry experts and experience the latest trends firsthand. The significance of the fair for Thailand is substantial, as the country is recognized as a leading manufacturing and innovation hub in Southeast Asia. Bangkok's modern infrastructure and the state-of-the-art QSNCC exhibition center provide ideal conditions for international business events. Its central location, excellent public transport connections, and easy accessibility from Suvarnabhumi Airport make the OEM Manufacturer & e-Biz Expo an essential event for anyone aiming for success in the OEM industry and digital commerce.

The event rotates annually among its four partner countries: the Netherlands, Germany, Belgium, and France. The fair is organized by DLG Benelux B.V., which presents a comprehensive range of agricultural machinery, cultivation tips, and new technologies. Key themes include sustainable cultivation, technological innovations in agricultural engineering, and optimization approaches in potato processing. "PotatoEurope" features advanced cultivation methods and state-of-the-art harvesting machines. It attracts professionals from fields such as agriculture, agricultural technology, food processing, and biotechnology. The Ostpro in Berlin was founded in 1991 and has since established itself as the leading sales and order fair for East German products in Germany. Initiated by the Scot Messen & Marketing GmbH, its primary purpose was to serve as a platform for companies from the newly formed German states. Its main objective was to provide a fresh marketing and presentation platform for products from the former East Germany that had fallen into oblivion. The Ostpro typically takes place semi-annually in April and November, consistently drawing visitors to the legendary Berlin-Karlshorst racecourse. This historic venue, renowned for its horse races, imparts a unique atmosphere to the fair, marking it as a standout event on Berlin's cultural calendar. The fair is split into two main events: the "Spring Ostpro" and the "Christmas Ostpro". While the spring edition focuses on the season of renewal, the Christmas Ostpro showcases a festive range of products perfect for the holiday season. Additionally, a subsidiary of the Christmas Ostpro takes place in Erfurt, emphasizing its popularity in East Germany. The central theme of the Ostpro is the presentation and sale of products and services rooted in the former East Germany. Many of these products have found their way back to store shelves thanks to the fair, cultivating a renewed appreciation for regional goods. Another unique feature of the Ostpro is its cult status. It serves as a Mecca for all enthusiasts of East German products. The high demand and sustained interest in these iconic goods underscore the enduring allure of the "East German flair." As a purely public fair, the Ostpro is open to the general public, offering a unique opportunity to delve into the cultural and historical depth of products from East Germany. In summary, the Ostpro is more than just a fair – it's an experience. It connects people, evokes nostalgic sentiments, and celebrates the cultural diversity and legacy of the former East Germany. Nestled amidst the history and charm of the Berlin-Karlshorst racecourse, the Ostpro comes alive anew each year, captivating visitors from near and far.

The "Journées d'Octobre" are a traditional fair held annually in the fall at the Mulhouse Exhibition Center in Mulhouse. This significant event is organized by Parc Expo. The fair celebrates the culture and craftsmanship of Alsace and showcases a wide range of products and services that the region has to offer. Central to the event are various themed villages, such as the Village of Creators, The Housing Village, THE Garden Village, The Local Market, The Chalets of Folie'Flore, and The Folie'Flore Store. Here, visitors can expect an impressive array of items, ranging from jewelry, leather goods, fashion, and decorative items to renovation products and artisanal creations. In addition to these products, culinary specialties from the region also hold a prominent place. From teas, sausages, wines, and cakes to exquisite spirits like rum and cognac – there's much to discover. Environmentally-friendly textiles and natural beauty products are also part of the mix. A special highlight of the "Journées d'Octobre" are the numerous demonstrations and culinary activities, often accompanied by tastings and discussions. Additionally, there's a wide range of entertainment options, including animations, aperitif games, and blind tests. The majority of the exhibitors come from fields such as craftsmanship, gastronomy, and local production. This makes the fair a central attraction for local producers, artisans, and creatives. The main visitors are not only professionals from these sectors but also tourists and locals eager to experience the cultural and culinary highlights of Alsace. The "Journées d'Octobre" are deeply rooted in Alsatian tradition, emphasizing the close connection between the fair and the city of Mulhouse. In conclusion, the Mulhouse Exhibition Center in Mulhouse is the perfect venue for this fair. Thanks to its central location, it's easily accessible and offers the ideal setting to showcase the region's highlights in a vibrant and welcoming atmosphere. Those wishing to experience the diversity of Alsace up close should not miss the "Journées d'Octobre."

The fair's objective is to showcase the latest technologies, highlight the expertise of producers, and facilitate the initiation of business contacts. A diverse range of products and services is presented at the expo: coffee beans in all variations, sauces, spices, chicken meat, eggs and related products, dried fruits and nuts, drinks such as juices and teas, as well as equipment for processing and packaging, and refrigeration technology. Moreover, new inventions and high-tech machines are showcased, making the fair a window to innovation. Glass lids, boxes, cartons of all kinds, coders, packaging, foils, labels, and packaging machines, as well as weighing and filling machines, are also part of the exhibition offerings. The fair reflects Mashhad's and Iran's immense potential for industrial investments in the food sector and contributes to emphasizing the economic significance of the region. It also promotes the exchange between the local market and international trends and technologies. Highlights of the expo include conferences and professional lectures. The exhibitors represent the most diverse segments of food production and processing, including decision-makers and manufacturers. The target audience of the fair primarily consists of professionals from the food industry, suppliers, officials, and manufacturers, who take the opportunity to network, discover the latest products and technologies, and finalize business deals. The Mashhad International Exhibition Center impresses as a modern and easily accessible fair center. Mashhad itself, a significant religious and cultural center in Iran, offers visitors not only business opportunities but also cultural enrichment. In summary, the iFood Expo is an indispensable event for industry insiders and offers a unique insight into the future of food production and technology in a region rich in tradition yet attracting progressive industrial investments.

The Bar & Restaurant Expo is a leading trade fair for the hospitality and beverage industry, held annually at the Colorado Convention Center in Denver. Outstanding achievements in the industry are also recognized with prestigious awards, making the expo an important platform for recognition and prestige. The Colorado Convention Center features state-of-the-art facilities and is easily accessible by car and public transportation. The "Ghana agrofood" is a prestigious trade fair first launched in 2013. It serves as a central platform for business and networking in the fields of agriculture, livestock, food technology, beverages, and packaging in West Africa. The fair is held annually and takes place at the AICC, the Accra International Conference Centre, in Accra. The "Ghana agrofood" is organized by Fairtrade Messe und Ausstellungs GmbH & Co. KG, a company known for staging high-quality fairs and exhibitions. The main themes of the fair are diverse, covering areas such as agriculture and livestock, food and beverage technology, as well as hospitality. Exhibitors showcase products and services in "Agro", "Food + Bev Tec", "Ingredients", and "Food + Hospitality". The range of offerings includes equipment for cattle, fish, and poultry farming, storage systems, feeding equipment, grain systems, irrigation systems, dairy processing equipment, and veterinary syringes, as well as food processing machinery, bottling plants, slaughtering systems, refrigeration and freezing equipment, and packaging machines. Also presented are food ingredients such as flavors, butcher's raw materials, sauces, cocoa butter, colorants, distillates, enzymes, vitamins, and minerals, along with products and services for the catering industry, kitchen appliances, and hotel and restaurant equipment. The fair is of great significance to the West African region as it promotes technological and knowledge exchange in the agricultural industry and brings together foreign exporters with local importers. Highlights of the fair include high-profile conferences and events with over 50 international speakers. Exhibitors hail from various industries such as agricultural machinery, food processing, the beverage industry, and the hospitality sector. The main visitors are professionals from these industries, particularly decision-makers, importers, and technology providers looking for new products, services, and business opportunities. The "Ghana agrofood" is part of a series of fairs that help to foster exchange and growth in their respective regions. In conclusion, it should be emphasized that the choice of the fair's location is made with care, to provide not just an appealing atmosphere but also optimal accessibility for participants.

The Kisaan Putra Expo is an annual trade fair in Damoh, focusing on sustainable agriculture, modern farming methods, and innovative solutions for the agricultural industry. The name "Kisaan Putra", which translates to "Farmer's Son" in English, highlights the deep connection and commitment to farmers and their families. The expo is held at the Tehsil Ground, a central location closely linked with the region's agricultural tradition. The Kisaan Putra Office, which champions the strengthening of the agricultural sector through education, innovation, and direct support, organizes the expo. It showcases new technologies and methods that are introduced in time for the farming year. Key themes of the expo include agro and food processing, sustainable farming techniques, biotechnology, novel irrigation systems, and livestock farming. Additionally, there are special exhibitions on topics such as beekeeping, aquaculture technologies, and e-commerce solutions for the agricultural sector. The Kisaan Putra Expo serves as a platform for exhibitors from various industries, including agricultural construction firms, harvest machinery manufacturers, and providers of agricultural inputs and logistics. It attracts visitors from all sectors of the agricultural industry, from small family farms to large agribusinesses, offering a unique opportunity for exchange and networking. A highlight of the expo is the workshops and seminars that address issues such as water conservation, organic farming, and soil quality. In summary, the Kisaan Putra Expo is a crucial interface for presenting and discussing the latest advances in agricultural technology and economics. It bridges traditional methods with modern technological solutions and is of significant importance, both to the local community and the global agricultural industry. The accessible venue and wide range of topics make the expo an indispensable event for professionals in the agricultural sector.

The "iFresh" Expo, established in 2012, has emerged as an international trade fair and central platform for the fruit and vegetable industry. Organized by the China Fruit Marketing Association, it takes place annually at the Hangzhou International Expo Center, one of China's leading exhibition centers, known for its modern architecture and top-notch facilities. At the heart of the iFresh Expo is the presentation and exchange of knowledge, products, services, and technologies related to fruit and vegetable production. The event attracts professionals from around the globe, including producers, traders, service providers, and distributors, both domestic and international. A standout feature of the expo is its wide-ranging offerings. With space for hundreds of exhibitors and more than 10,000 professional visitors, it provides a dynamic platform for business networking and knowledge sharing. Exhibitors showcase a comprehensive range of products and services, from fresh fruits and vegetables to processing technologies, packaging solutions, and logistics. Another highlight of iFresh is the China Fruit Marketing Congress. It addresses current and pressing issues in the industry, including forecasts for fruit cultivation, analyses of current market trends, and development strategies. The expo is particularly distinguished by its commitment not just to be a platform for business transactions, but also to promote a shared vision for the future of the Asian fruit and vegetable market. It brings together industry experts worldwide and encourages dialogue and collaboration to develop innovative solutions and sustainable practices in the global fruit and vegetable industry.

MEAT DAYS , formerly known as MEAT & GRILL DAYS , is a leading trade fair in Greece, specializing in the meat industry and related equipment. It is part of the larger MEAT/DAIRY/FROZEN Expo and is organized by o.mind creatives . As a biennial event, it primarily caters to professionals from slaughterhouses, butcheries, as well as wholesale and retail sectors. It also offers valuable insights and networking opportunities for engineering firms, researchers, and industry organizations. The exhibition is held at the modern and easily accessible Athens Metropolitan Expo , located near Athens International Airport. It covers the entire value chain of meat production and processing. Its exhibition space showcases a wide range of products and services – from meat and meat products to advanced processing machinery, slaughterhouse equipment, and innovative refrigeration technologies. Additionally, solutions for food logistics and specialized offerings for the foodservice and retail sectors, including high-quality grilling equipment and kitchen appliances, are on display. A key feature of MEAT DAYS is its commitment to sustainability and innovation. The event hosts platforms such as workshops and presentations where topics like meat product traceability, the integration of alternative proteins, and new market demands are discussed. These sessions address both current industry trends and future challenges, presenting innovative approaches within the meat industry. Moreover, competitions and presentations by industry experts enrich the event’s program, making MEAT DAYS an essential meeting point for professionals in the meat, dairy, and frozen food sectors. It fosters the exchange of expertise and best practices. Overall, MEAT DAYS provides a unique opportunity to learn about the latest technologies and trends in the meat industry, strengthen business relationships, and gain insights into the future development of the sector.

Frozen Food Expo is a key component of the biennial Meat/Dairy/Frozen Expo , focusing exclusively on the frozen food industry. Organized by O.Mind Creatives , this significant event takes place at the renowned Athens Metropolitan Expo . The state-of-the-art venue is ideally located near Athens International Airport and offers excellent transport links, making it highly accessible for international professionals and exhibitors. At the Frozen Food Expo , exhibitors from around the world showcase their latest products and services in sectors such as fruits, vegetables, seafood, meat, pasta, and ready-made meals. The event provides a unique platform for presenting frozen products and advanced refrigeration technologies, with a strong emphasis on quality control and maintaining the integrity of the cold chain. A standout feature of the expo is the comprehensive range of refrigeration solutions, including cutting-edge cooling systems such as freezing chambers, refrigeration units, air conditioning and ventilation systems, as well as freezing tunnels and refrigerators for retail use. Additionally, technologies for temperature and humidity control, critical for the storage and transportation of frozen goods, are a key focus. The expo also highlights innovations in food logistics . Solutions for the transportation, storage, and packaging of food are presented, including refrigerated vehicles, isothermal containers, and temperature and humidity control systems, all essential for maintaining product quality throughout the distribution process. In summary, the Frozen Food Expo offers food industry professionals specializing in frozen products valuable insights and solutions. Through a combination of specialized exhibits and expert discussions, the latest technologies and best practices tailored to the needs of the modern frozen food industry are showcased.

The SIAL InterFOOD is a leading international trade fair for the food and beverage industry, held annually at the JIExpo Jakarta International Expo in Indonesia. The name "SIAL" stands for "Salon International de l'Alimentation", which translates to "International Food Salon", emphasizing the global significance of this event. It is organized by the SIAL Group in collaboration with Krista Exhibitions and is part of a global series of SIAL trade fairs. At this fair, manufacturers, traders, and professionals from the gastronomy and retail sectors gather to showcase the latest products and innovations. Key themes include food and beverages, technologies, bakery and confectionery products, and catering equipment and ingredients. Special attention is given to sectors such as wine and spirits, coffee, tea, cocoa, as well as organic and Halal-certified products. Another focus is on services and technologies for hotels, catering, restaurants, and supermarkets, which directly relate to Jakarta's dynamic hospitality scene and Indonesia's growing market infrastructure. Competitions such as cooking contests, pastry championships, and live cooking demonstrations highlight the creative and innovative atmosphere of the fair. Each year, SIAL InterFOOD attracts thousands of professional visitors from around the world, including many decision-makers from food production, retail, and gastronomy. It serves not only as a platform for business deals but also as a venue for exchanging ideas on the latest trends and developments in food technology and production. The JIExpo, as the venue, offers ideal conditions for exhibitors and visitors with its modern infrastructure and excellent accessibility via the international airport and superb transport connections. As part of the vibrant metropolis of Jakarta, the fair provides an excellent opportunity to expand networks and explore new business opportunities. Overall, SIAL InterFOOD is an indispensable event, distinguished by its thematic diversity as well as the quality and variety of the products and services presented.

The World Tea & Coffee Expo, established in 2013, has over the recent years evolved into one of the most prominent trade fairs in India, focusing on tea and coffee. This annual event is organized by the esteemed company, Messe Muenchen India Pvt. Ltd. The expo attracts both national and international exhibitors, including leading manufacturers, traders, exporters, and importers, as well as raw material suppliers and production machinery manufacturers. Tea is an integral part of daily life in India. "Chai" (tea) holds a significant place in Indian culture, and there's scarcely a household where tea isn't consumed at least once a day. The tea and coffee industry plays a pivotal role in India's economy and culture. Assam is renowned for its robust, malty tea varieties. Darjeeling produces a delicate, aromatic tea, often referred to as the "Champagne of Teas". In the hills of South India, Nilgiris is famed for its bright, aromatic tea types. Over 70% of India's coffee production originates from Karnataka, with Kodagu (Coorg) and Chikmagalur being the primary cultivation areas. The Nilgiri hills, as well as the Anaimalai and Shevaroys districts, are also significant coffee-growing regions. These cultivation areas are not only known for production but also serve as tourist attractions, as many plantations welcome visitors and offer insights into the cultivation and processing of these beverages. In a market as dynamic and growth-oriented as India, the World Tea & Coffee Expo provides businesses with a valuable platform to showcase their latest products and services, as well as to establish essential business contacts. Through a variety of accompanying seminars, workshops, and presentations, industry professionals have the opportunity to learn about the latest trends and innovations in the tea and coffee sector. These events not only facilitate knowledge transfer but also provide an excellent networking opportunity. A special highlight of the expo is its co-location with other trade fairs in related industries. These concurrent events complement each other, creating synergies for attendees. This means that visitors have access not just to one, but to multiple fairs that cover all relevant aspects of their industry. In conclusion, the World Tea & Coffee Expo is more than just a trade fair; it's an event that brings industry experts from around the world together to celebrate innovations, boost business, and showcase the best of the tea and coffee world. It's an occasion no one in the industry should miss.

전시회명: Mostra Mercato Nazionale del Tartufo Bianco
박람회설명:
The “Mostra Mercato Nazionale del Tartufo Bianco” in San Miniato celebrates Italy's culinary and cultural diversity in an exceptional way. This national fair, known as the "Festival of Fragrance", takes place annually over three weekends in November, transforming the picturesque town in the Tuscan province of Pisa into a gathering place for truffle enthusiasts from around the world. San Miniato offers ideal conditions for the white truffle, Tuber Magnatum Pico , thanks to its fertile soil and perfect microclimate. This variety of truffle, renowned for its intense aroma and distinctive flavor, is one of the most sought-after globally. It cannot be cultivated, making it especially rare and valuable. The fair provides a platform to explore the world of truffles through a variety of activities. Visitors can experience the captivating scent of freshly harvested truffles and enjoy both pure and expertly prepared dishes. In addition, other local products and wines are showcased, highlighting the region’s rich gastronomic diversity. The Mostra Mercato also serves as a forum for discussions on sustainable truffle hunting and the preservation of truffle forests. It underscores the importance of protecting the local cultural heritage and supports the traditional practice of truffle hunting, deeply rooted in the region’s history. An extensive supporting program, featuring music and art events, makes this fair a true feast for the senses, attracting more and more visitors each year. This reinforces San Miniato’s reputation as one of the world’s capitals of the white truffle.

Organized by BBC Good Food on behalf of Immediate Live, the show has become a cornerstone of the British food scene. Each June and November, the National Exhibition Centre (NEC) in Birmingham—one of the country’s largest and most modern exhibition venues—transforms into a vibrant celebration of culinary diversity. At the heart of the event lies the intersection of enjoyment and knowledge. Sustainability runs as a central theme throughout the entire event, with a clear emphasis on regionality, quality, and conscious consumption. The "Aux Vignobles!" wine fair in Biarritz, held annually in February, has evolved into an indispensable gathering for wine lovers and gastronomy enthusiasts. The NIGERIA HALAL EXPO is the leading trade fair for the Halal industry in West Africa. It serves as a key platform for certified products and services that meet the ethical, cultural, and economic needs of the Muslim community. As the region’s flagship annual event in the rapidly expanding Halal sector, the expo connects international suppliers with the dynamic and growing West African market. The event is held at the prestigious Landmark Centre in Lagos – ideally located on the Atlantic coast with excellent transport links. Organized by Elan Expo , an internationally active exhibition organizer based in Istanbul, the event benefits from decades of experience. Since 1997, Elan Expo has hosted more than 30 B2B events annually across Africa, the Middle East, and Central Asia. Lagos – Nigeria’s economic powerhouse and one of Africa’s most vibrant cities – offers the perfect setting for this trade fair, thanks to its multicultural character and large Muslim population. The NIGERIA HALAL EXPO spans a wide range of sectors – from Halal-certified food and beverages to cosmetics, personal care products, pharmaceuticals, dietary supplements, Islamic finance, Halal logistics, as well as packaging and processing technologies. Exhibitors from over 30 industries showcase their latest products, technologies, and services, all certified to recognized Halal standards. A strong emphasis is placed on innovation and quality: the expo features live demonstrations, networking events, and expert panels with leading certification bodies and regulatory authorities. Key visitors include buyers, retailers, distributors, wholesalers, representatives from the food, cosmetics and pharmaceutical industries, logistics providers, as well as investors and decision-makers from the Islamic finance sector. For many international brands, the Nigeria Halal Expo serves as the ideal entry point into the promising West African market. The Landmark Centre, strategically located on Victoria Island in Lagos, is a modern exhibition venue with direct access to international hotels, airports, and coastal highways. It provides a secure, comfortable, and professional environment for an event that sets standards not only economically, but also culturally and socially. The NIGERIA HALAL EXPO is more than just a trade fair – it is the key platform for shaping the future of the Halal economy in Africa.

Organized by GL Events Exhibitions Opérations, a leading company in event management, this fair attracts visitors from around the world who are interested in high-quality regional products.

A special feature of the fair is the direct sales opportunity, which allows visitors to receive individual advice and purchase products at prices suitable for all budgets. In times of globalization and standardization, visitors particularly appreciate the chance to buy unique and authentic products directly from the producers.
The venue, Le Quai St-Malo, with its modern infrastructure and attractive seaside location, provides the ideal setting for the fair. This location emphasizes the event's connection with the region and its maritime tradition, creating a welcoming atmosphere for exhibitors and visitors alike.
Special features of the Aux Vignobles! Fair in Saint-Malo include not only the diversity and quality of the products but also special events such as tastings, workshops, and presentations that offer visitors deeper insights into the world of wine and French gastronomy. These elements make the fair a must-visit for anyone who appreciates the French way of life and the enjoyment of high-quality food and beverages.
In summary, the Aux Vignobles! Wine Fair in Saint-Malo is an annual event that celebrates the rich culinary culture of France and focuses on promoting regional quality products. With its wide range of offerings, from traditional wines to innovative gastronomic products, the fair provides an important platform for encounters and exchange in today's globalized world.
The Aux Vignobles! takes place annually, and therefore for the thirtieth time previsibly in March 2027 in Saint-Malo.

Aux Vignobles! is more than just a name with a nice ring to it – it’s an open invitation to immerse yourself in the world of French wine and gourmet produce. Held annually at the Espaces Congrès Encan in La Rochelle, right on the harbour of this historic Atlantic city, the event takes visitors to the very heart of France’s culinary and terroir culture. Organised by GL Events Exhibitions Opérations, based in Brest, this seasoned trade fair organiser also brings the “Aux Vignobles!” format to other cities across north-western France. Industry professionals – including restaurateurs, sommeliers and independent retailers – come together with a discerning public eager not just to sample, but to buy directly from producers. This direct interaction is what sets the event apart: visitors meet winemakers, cheesemongers, chocolatiers, butchers and other artisan producers who proudly present their goods in person – knowledgeable, approachable and true to the direct producteur spirit. At its core, the fair showcases wines from across France – from celebrated regions such as Bordeaux, Burgundy and Champagne to distinctive gems from lesser-known areas like the South-West or the Loire Valley. Whether it’s a bold red, a delicate rosé, a crisp white or a luscious dessert wine, the variety of appellations on offer reflects the remarkable breadth of French viticulture. Complementing the wine is a rich selection of regional specialities: aged cheeses, air-dried charcuterie, chocolate, pastries, tea, honey and seasonal delicacies – all rooted in place and crafted with the expertise of small, often family-run producers. Yet “Aux Vignobles!” is far more than a traditional trade fair. Themed zones – focusing on topics such as organic viticulture, sustainable farming or the rise of wine tourism – cater to visitors with a deeper interest in specific subjects. Workshops and panel discussions explore traditional production methods, regional differences and the cultural significance of terroir. The result is a dynamic exchange that weaves together knowledge, flavour and human connection. Most exhibitors hail from the fields of winemaking, fine food, agriculture and artisanal gastronomy – many of them longstanding family businesses. The audience includes hospitality professionals, retailers and tourism experts, as well as wine lovers, food enthusiasts and advocates of the Slow Food movement. As part of a wider series of events under the “Aux Vignobles!” banner, the fair represents a conscious counterpoint to industrial standardisation. It champions authenticity, craftsmanship and the rich regional diversity of France. La Rochelle, with its modern and well-connected Espaces Congrès Encan – just a short walk from the train station and city centre – offers the perfect setting: maritime charm, a historic backdrop, and a city that lives and breathes the art of good living like few others on the French coast. For those who love wine, enjoy discovering new tastes, and want to experience France with all the senses, this is a fair as distinctive, vibrant and flavourful as the products it celebrates.
