The “ Mer & Vigne Dijon ” trade fair, held for the first time in 2024, is a young yet highly promising event dedicated to celebrating the full spectrum of French culinary culture. Its name combines the French words Mer (sea) and Vigne (vine), clearly reflecting its core themes: maritime delicacies and fine wines. This unique pairing appeals to both gourmets and industry professionals seeking premium products and new connections. The venue is the Zénith de Dijon, one of the most modern event locations in the Bourgogne-Franche-Comté region. With its state-of-the-art infrastructure and excellent accessibility, it provides ideal conditions for both visitors and exhibitors. Each year in autumn – the peak season for culinary pleasures – the fair opens its doors and invites guests on a sensory journey through the diverse flavors of France. Organized by Mer & Vigne SARL, a seasoned host of prestigious gourmet fairs across France, the event benefits from a high level of expertise. This is evident in the careful selection of exhibitors, a well-curated supporting program, and an inviting atmosphere that resonates with professionals and curious visitors alike. At the heart of the fair are maritime gastronomy, regional agriculture, and traditional winemaking. The offerings range from fresh oysters and fine seafood to artisanal specialties and distinguished wines from all corners of France. International delicacies further enrich the selection, fostering a culinary dialogue that transcends borders. Beyond its economic relevance, the fair also holds cultural significance for Dijon and the surrounding region. As the capital of Burgundy, Dijon has long been associated with wine and haute cuisine – a legacy that the fair embraces while introducing fresh inspiration. Competitions and awards underscore the quality of the showcased products and celebrate the innovation of participating producers. Exhibitors represent a wide array of sectors, including fisheries, agriculture, winemaking, and artisanal food production. The audience comprises industry experts, chefs, traders, and passionate gourmets – forming a vibrant network united by a commitment to quality and taste. Mer & Vigne Dijon is part of a nationwide series of trade fairs held in several cities across France. Each edition retains a distinct regional character while also attracting a broader audience that values authenticity, craftsmanship, and culinary excellence. With its modern architecture, spacious layout, and outstanding transport links – by car or public transit – the Zénith de Dijon ensures a comfortable and enjoyable visit. As a result, “Mer & Vigne Dijon” is not only a highlight of the culinary calendar but also a gathering place for those who wish to experience the very best of French lifestyle and gastronomy.

Every year, Vannes, the charming city in northwestern France, transforms into a paradise for wine lovers and food enthusiasts when the renowned fair "Aux Vignobles!" opens its doors. Formerly known as "Salon Vins & Gastronomie", this event has grown into one of the region’s most prestigious wine and gastronomy fairs. Organized by GL Events Exhibitions Opérations, based in Brest, it caters to both industry professionals and a discerning public with a passion for French gourmet products. The fair brings together a carefully selected group of winemakers, distillers, and fine food producers from across France. Visitors have the unique opportunity to sample exclusive products, purchase them directly from the producers, and receive expert advice. At a time when mass industrial production dominates the market, "Aux Vignobles!" places a strong emphasis on authenticity, regionality, and artisanal quality. The focus in Vannes is on exquisite wines and premium spirits. From fine red, white, and rosé wines to elegant sparkling varieties and distinctive spirits such as Cognac, Armagnac, whisky, and liqueurs—connoisseurs will find a remarkable selection. Alongside established wineries, up-and-coming winemakers also showcase their latest creations. But "Aux Vignobles!" offers much more than just wine. The Gastronomy & Terroir section is a true paradise for food lovers. Visitors can savor regional delicacies—from aromatic cheeses and flavorful cured meats to exquisite foie gras and fresh seafood. Handcrafted specialties such as fine chocolates, fragrant honey, and traditional jams provide an authentic taste experience. A special highlight of the fair is the direct interaction with the producers. Whether winemakers, master distillers, or gourmet food artisans—they are on hand for personal conversations, offering valuable recommendations on food and wine pairings, deepening visitors' connection to French culinary culture. The experience is rounded off by a series of culinary workshops and tastings, where visitors can discover new flavors, learn the art of pairing food and wine, and gain inspiration from experts. With its unique combination of high-quality products, direct access to producers, and exceptional tasting experiences, "Aux Vignobles!" in Vannes is a must-visit event for anyone looking to explore the richness of the French terroir—whether as a private wine lover, a restaurateur, or simply someone in search of something special.

The "Prager Karlsbörse" is a trade fair in the food and agricultural sector, which has been held annually since its founding in 2015. As the largest trade fair of its kind in Eastern Europe, it attracts professionals from various fields such as traders, cooperatives, analysts, and producers. The fair is organized by the Südwestdeutsche Warenbörse e.V., which provides a platform for exchange and promotion of the industry through this event. The renowned Cubex Centrum Praha in Prague, centrally located and easily accessible by car, train, or plane, serves as the venue. The main themes of the fair include the latest developments in the food and agricultural industry, innovative logistical approaches, and sustainable agricultural practices. A variety of products and services are presented, ranging from agricultural equipment and technologies to food products and marketing strategies. A highlight is the panel discussion with prominent representatives from various European countries, including ministers, ambassadors, and parliamentarians. These discussions provide insights into current challenges and opportunities in the industry and emphasize the importance of the fair as an international dialogue forum. The exhibitors, coming from various sectors of the food and agricultural industry, highlight the diversity and relevance of the fair. The main visitors, professionals from these areas, take the opportunity to learn about the latest trends and innovations and to network. In summary, the "Prager Karlsbörse" is an important meeting point for professionals in the food and agricultural sector and at the same time enriches the city of Prague. The fair at the Cubex Centrum Praha offers the perfect combination of professional exchange and the opportunity to visit one of the most beautiful cities in Europe.

Aux Vignobles! is a consumer-focused wine and gastronomy fair dedicated to showcasing the diversity, quality and authenticity of French wine culture. It takes place at the Parc des Expositions de Caen in the Norman city of Caen. Each year, the exhibition centre becomes a meeting point for wine enthusiasts, industry professionals and curious private visitors who want to do more than simply taste French wines—they seek a deeper understanding of their origins, production methods and distinctive character. The event is organised by GL Events Exhibitions Opérations, an internationally active trade fair organiser based in Brest. Renowned for high-quality, visitor-oriented consumer exhibitions, the company has established Aux Vignobles! as a successful touring format held in several cities across northern and western France. At the heart of the fair is an extensive selection of wines from almost all of France’s major wine-producing regions, including Bordeaux, Burgundy, the Loire Valley, Provence, Alsace and the South West. The wine offering is complemented by a carefully curated range of regional specialities such as cheese, cured meats, foie gras, chocolate and fine food products, bringing the natural pairing of wine and gastronomy vividly to life. A particular highlight is the opportunity for direct exchange with winemakers, producers and artisanal businesses, who present their products in person, share insights into production and terroir, and sell their wines and delicacies directly, without intermediaries. The fair is closely linked to France’s culture of gastronomy and its self-image as a leading wine-producing nation. At the same time, it reflects the role of Caen and the Normandy region as welcoming destinations with a strong openness to culinary discovery. Highlights include guided tastings, themed areas dedicated to organic and sustainable viticulture, and presentations exploring current trends in wine and culinary tourism. Exhibitors primarily represent the wine, agriculture, artisanal food production and fine food sectors. Visitors range from private wine lovers to restaurateurs, retailers, sommeliers and professionals from the food and beverage industry. As part of a nationwide exhibition series, Aux Vignobles! in Caen benefits from strong brand recognition and consistently high standards. The experience is rounded off by the attractive location of the Parc des Expositions, which is well connected to the transport network and easily accessible by car and public transport alike—providing an ideal setting for an event that brings together French lifestyle, craftsmanship and enjoyment in an authentic and engaging way.

The "Aux Vignobles!" trade fair, formerly known as "Salon Vins & Gastronomie", is an annual highlight for wine enthusiasts and gourmets, held in several cities across northwestern France. Organized by GL Events Exhibitions Opérations, based in Brest, the event provides both industry professionals and the general public with a unique opportunity to discover the diversity and authenticity of French wines and gastronomic specialties. For the city of Metz, "Aux Vignobles!" is a significant economic driver. The fair attracts not only professionals, traders, and restaurateurs from across France but also numerous connoisseurs and tourists who travel specifically for the event. Although Metz itself is not a wine-producing region, its proximity to renowned vineyards such as Alsace, Champagne, and Moselle makes it a natural meeting point for winemakers, merchants, and wine lovers. Thanks to its strategic location in the Grand Est region and its close ties to Germany, Luxembourg, and Belgium, Metz is exceptionally well-connected. The TGV links the city to Paris in just 90 minutes, and direct road and rail connections make travel easy both nationally and internationally. At the heart of the event is a deep appreciation for the evolving French terroir, whose regional characteristics give it a distinctive appeal. Artisan producers from across France showcase their creations, invite visitors to tastings, and offer direct purchases of their specialties. Guests benefit from the expertise of winemakers and producers, exclusive trade fair deals, and fascinating insights into the production process. Wine tourism also plays a central role, with wineries welcoming visitors, offering insights into winemaking, and presenting tourism packages that allow guests to experience the cultural heritage of wine firsthand. In addition to an extensive selection of wines, the fair features a carefully curated array of French delicacies. Specialties such as foie gras, fine charcuterie, artisanal cheeses, chocolates, pastries, and exquisite spices invite visitors to indulge. These culinary delights create harmonious pairings of food and wine, highlighting the excellence of French gastronomy. More than just a traditional consumer fair, "Aux Vignobles!" is a tribute to French culinary culture, offering an invitation to experience the country’s rich gastronomic heritage in a convivial atmosphere. Blending tradition with modernity, craftsmanship with innovation, the event provides both connoisseurs and newcomers with the opportunity to expand their knowledge of wine and cuisine. Set against the unique backdrop of each host city, the fair promises an enjoyable and educational experience for all who share a passion for fine wines and exquisite food.

More than just a traditional consumer fair, "Aux Vignobles!" is a tribute to French culinary culture, offering an invitation to experience the country’s rich gastronomic heritage in a convivial atmosphere. Blending tradition with modernity, craftsmanship with innovation, the event provides both connoisseurs and newcomers with the opportunity to expand their knowledge of wine and cuisine. Set against the unique backdrop of each host city, the fair promises an enjoyable and educational experience for all who share a passion for fine wines and exquisite food.
The Aux Vignobles! in Metz took place from Friday, 27. March to Sunday, 29. March 2026.

Aux Vignobles! has been held annually since its launch in 2012 and takes place at the Parc des Expositions Quimper-Cornouaille in Quimper. The name, which translates as “To the vineyards!”, is intended as an invitation, transporting visitors—at least in spirit—to France’s wine-growing regions. The event forms part of a touring exhibition staged in several cities across north-west France. It caters to both private enthusiasts and trade visitors from the hospitality, retail and catering sectors. The organiser, GL Events Exhibitions Opérations, based in Brest, is an experienced exhibition company known for its professional delivery, thematic range and strong regional roots. At the heart of the fair is the breadth and diversity of French wine culture. Producers from renowned regions including Bordeaux, Burgundy, the Loire Valley, Provence, Alsace and Champagne present red, white and rosé wines, alongside sweet specialities and sparkling wines. All products are available for tasting and purchase on site. The format is deliberately practical and dialogue-driven: visitors taste wines in direct conversation with the growers, receive detailed information on grape varieties, vinification methods, vintage characteristics and food pairings, and often benefit from special show offers. As a result, the event serves not only as a retail platform but also as an opportunity to deepen one’s understanding of terroir, craftsmanship and regional identity. The wine offering is complemented by a carefully curated selection of gourmet products. Exhibitors from the delicatessen, cheesemaking, charcuterie, foie gras, chocolate, spice and tea sectors showcase high-quality goods closely linked to their regions of origin. Many are produced artisanally, in some cases using sustainable methods, reflecting growing consumer demand for transparency and quality. Themed visitor trails provide guidance, for example highlighting organic producers or wine tourism operators presenting stays at vineyards and gastronomic travel experiences. The fair is of particular significance to Brittany and to Quimper in particular. It combines French gastronomic heritage with local hospitality and attracts substantial visitor numbers each year from the surrounding area and beyond. Highlights include exclusive tastings, personal recommendations from producers and themed presentations exploring current trends in the wine sector. Exhibitors primarily represent the wine and spirits industries, gourmet food production, farm-direct sales and culinary tourism. The visitor profile ranges from quality-conscious private buyers to trade professionals from the hospitality industry, specialist wine merchants and retail, all seeking new products and suppliers. This blend creates an atmosphere that bridges the gap between a consumer fair and an industry marketplace. As part of a broader touring exhibition programme, Aux Vignobles! enhances the profile of French premium products across multiple cities and supports regional producers. The Parc des Expositions Quimper-Cornouaille offers modern exhibition halls, sound infrastructure and ample parking. It is easily accessible via Brittany’s main roads as well as by public transport from the town centre, providing an appropriate setting for an event that brings together fine food and wine, professional expertise and direct personal exchange.

The VIETNAM EXPO is an annual international fair that has been promoting trade and industry in Vietnam and beyond since 1991. It takes place every April in Hanoi and is organized by the VINEXAD National Trade Fair & Advertising JSC. The fair has evolved into a central meeting point for the business community, attracting exhibitors from all over the world, which underscores its international reach and significance. The VIETNAM EXPO is hosted at the I.C.E. International Center of Exhibition, a leading exhibition center in Hanoi equipped with modern facilities and a generous exhibition space. It provides the ideal setting for exhibitors and visitors to initiate business deals, present innovations, and forge valuable networks. The fair is divided into four main sections: the International Pavilion, agricultural products with food and beverages, DIY (do-it-yourself) and mechatronics. This allows participants to explore a wide range of products and services, from agricultural products to digital technology and e-commerce. A special highlight of the fair are the international pavilions, which give each country the opportunity to showcase its outstanding products and services. This segmentation promotes international exchange and gives visitors a comprehensive insight into global trends and innovations. The primary goal of the VIETNAM EXPO is to strengthen the Vietnamese market and promote exports. It also aims to attract investments and facilitate technology transfer between local and foreign companies, supporting sustainable economic development. As a platform for business developments, cooperations, and the exploration of new markets, the VIETNAM EXPO plays a crucial role for industries and professionals worldwide. The first three days are reserved exclusively to professional visitors.

More than just a trade fair, it serves as a central hub for pioneering solutions and new business opportunities. BioOst is an annual regional trade fair for the organic retail sector, held since 2013 with a clear focus on eastern Germany. It is organised by Matthias Deppe und Wolfram Müller OHG . Established in 2013, the event has quickly become a fixture in the organic industry’s calendar. The fair takes place at Messe Leipzig, a modern exhibition venue in one of Germany’s most dynamic cities. Once a year, the site becomes a key meeting point for manufacturers, retailers, foodservice professionals and industry decision-makers. It is where new products are launched, business relationships are strengthened and fresh market momentum is generated. BioOst positions itself as a specialised ordering and information platform for quality-driven organic retailers. The core focus is on organic food and nutrition, ranging from fresh fruit and vegetables to bakery products, honey and beverages, as well as innovative value-added product lines. The portfolio also includes natural cosmetics and organic health and wellness products, alongside regional specialities such as wines, beekeeping products and artisan cheeses. In addition to reflecting current market trends, the fair actively sets its own. Sustainability, innovative production methods, transparent supply chains and future-oriented retail strategies are central themes of the accompanying conference programme. A defining feature of BioOst is its strong emphasis on personal exchange. As a trade-only event, it is exclusively geared towards professional visitors. Companies from the organic retail sector, health food retail and organic foodservice present their products in a professional environment designed to facilitate efficient networking. Expert talks, panel discussions and themed networking sessions deliver practical insights, covering everything from market developments and category management to positioning strategies in the growing organic market. Most visitors come from organic retail, health food retail and organic foodservice. In addition, trade associations, specialist journalists and political decision-makers use the event as a forum for dialogue on sector-specific developments and for shaping the future of the green economy. BioOst therefore serves not only as a marketplace, but also as a platform for opinion-forming and innovation in eastern Germany. Choosing Leipzig as the host city underlines the fair’s regional focus. Recognised as a major economic and cultural hub in central Germany, the city offers excellent transport links via motorways, long-distance rail services and Leipzig/Halle Airport. The modern exhibition centre provides the infrastructure required for an event of this scale. By combining sector expertise with strong regional roots and national relevance, BioOst creates a clearly structured and efficient setting each year for the continued advancement of the organic retail trade.

It provides a platform to discover innovative solutions that will significantly influence both the market and the lifestyle of consumers.

The ReadyStock Fair in Warsaw is an annual international trade fair that presents a wide range of ready-for-sale products from various industries. A notable feature of the ReadyStock Fair is the opportunity for businesses to access thousands of off-the-shelf products at unbeatable prices. This offers an excellent opportunity to maintain supply chains, implement new solutions, and significantly reduce transportation costs. The fair serves not only as a marketplace but also as a forum for innovation and networking. Exhibitors and visitors have the chance to learn about the latest trends, establish business relationships, and discover products that are immediately available from European warehouses. Another highlight is the numerous special offers and promotions, where products are sold at substantially reduced prices. Overall, the ReadyStock Fair provides a unique platform for trade and exchange, enabling quick and efficient access to a wide range of products. It is a must for everyone active in the mentioned industries and looking for new business opportunities.

DRINK SEOUL is South Korea’s premier trade fair for the national and international beverage industry. Held annually at the renowned COEX Convention and Exhibition Center in Seoul – one of Asia’s most advanced venues for exhibitions and events – the show is organized by the Global MICE Experts Group (GMEG), a seasoned provider of international B2B trade events with a strong focus on networking platforms. As a central industry meeting point for manufacturers, distributors, buyers, and professionals from the beverage, food, and hospitality sectors, DRINK SEOUL offers a high-caliber platform to showcase and discover the latest trends, technologies, and products. Exhibitors range from breweries, wineries, and spirits producers to makers of traditional Korean beverages, as well as suppliers of raw materials, machinery, equipment, franchise concepts, and retail technologies. The fair also features MD products, by-products, and specialized services such as training and consulting. A particular emphasis is placed on the diverse and innovative world of beverages – from craft beer and premium spirits to trending non-alcoholic drinks – and on the fusion of traditional brewing and distilling craftsmanship with forward-thinking product design. DRINK SEOUL positions itself not only as a trade fair, but also as a source of inspiration, a trend monitor, and a professional development hub. Masterclasses, seminars, and tasting sessions covering categories such as wine, sake, mead, and soju provide deep insights into the history, production methods, and sensory characteristics of these drinks. International competitions and cultural showcases – including those held in parallel with the Korea International Beer Expo (KIBEX) – make the event an immersive experience, highlighting Korea’s cultural identity as a country rich in tradition yet open to innovation. The combination of business matching, networking events, and knowledge-sharing opportunities makes DRINK SEOUL especially valuable for decision-makers in sales, retail, gastronomy, hospitality, as well as importers, export agencies, and franchise providers. DRINK SEOUL offers a prominent stage for both local start-ups and global brands to position themselves in the dynamic South Korean market and build sustainable partnerships. The venue – COEX in Seoul’s Gangnam district – is easily accessible via several subway lines and ideally situated amidst hotels, restaurants, and shopping areas, making it convenient for both domestic and international visitors. Anyone who doesn’t want to miss the next big development in the beverage industry can’t afford to overlook DRINK SEOUL.

Organized by PHILFOODEX INC., the expo takes place annually at the World Trade Center Metro Manila, bringing together key industry players. A particular focus is placed on evolving consumer habits, influenced by rising incomes, urbanization, and population growth. The expo highlights the challenges and opportunities of globalization in the food trade while emphasizing sustainable solutions. Companies present strategies to enhance productivity, optimize resource utilization, and ensure a stable market demand. Anuga Select China , formerly known as ANUFOOD China, is a leading international trade fair for food and beverages, held annually in China since its launch in 2014. The event takes place at the impressive Shenzhen Exhibition & Convention Center—one of the largest and most advanced exhibition venues in the world. It is organised by Koelnmesse Co. Ltd. Beijing, an experienced, globally active trade fair organiser based in the Chinese capital. Each year, the show attracts a wide range of trade visitors and exhibitors from across the food and beverage industry. The exhibition covers a broad spectrum of sectors, including dairy products, meat, fish, baked goods, beverages, fine foods, frozen foods and snacks. A particular focus is placed on sustainable and innovative products that cater to the evolving demands of the rapidly growing Chinese market. One of the event’s highlights is its extensive tasting programme, offering visitors the chance to explore new flavours and product innovations. The fair also features a variety of networking events designed to facilitate connections and knowledge exchange among industry professionals. In addition, ANUFOOD China hosts a range of live shows, including cooking demonstrations, product showcases and competitions, where renowned chefs and industry experts demonstrate their skills. These live presentations provide an engaging way for visitors to discover emerging trends, techniques and products, while drawing inspiration from leading professionals. Through these interactive elements, the fair offers a dynamic and varied experience, giving participants a comprehensive insight into the world of food and beverages. In recent years, ANUFOOD China has established itself as a key platform for international trade and for companies seeking to expand into the Chinese market. In summary, ANUFOOD China is a major industry event that showcases and promotes innovation and business opportunities within the global food and beverage sector.

The NIMEATECH Nigeria Meat Tech Expo is an annual trade fair and recognized as a leading platform for innovation and progress in Nigeria's meat industry. It is organized by CEMS Nigeria, an experienced trade fair organizer with proven expertise in professional exhibitions. The event is exclusively aimed at industry professionals from the meat sector and related fields. Its primary goal is to promote the professionalization of the industry, facilitate technology transfer, and create sustainable business opportunities. The event takes place at NIPOLI Village, located within the National Cereal Research Institute (NCRI) in Ibadan—a major economic hub in southwestern Nigeria. As a central node for agriculture and commerce, Ibadan offers ideal conditions for professional exchange and the presentation of modern solutions in meat processing. The choice of venue reflects the expo’s strategic ambition to foster innovation where it can deliver the greatest economic and societal benefit. NIMEATECH Nigeria Meat Tech Expo focuses on technologies and services across the entire meat industry value chain—from slaughtering, processing, and packaging to logistics and quality assurance. Exhibitors showcase advanced processing techniques, innovative slaughtering technologies, cutting-edge packaging solutions, and systems for uninterrupted cold chain logistics that ensure consistently high product quality. The exhibition is further enriched by hygiene and control systems, animal health products, automated processing technologies, and concepts for sustainable production. Feed technologies also play a vital role, as they contribute significantly to animal health and production efficiency. What sets the expo apart is its strong emphasis on innovation and sustainability. NIMEATECH Nigeria Meat Tech Expo positions itself not only as a showcase for products and services but also as a driving force for a modern, competitive, and environmentally conscious meat industry. Given Nigeria’s growing population, rising urban demand, and ongoing challenges in infrastructure and quality control, this role is becoming increasingly important. The Nigeria Meat Tech Expo is thus a market-driven trade fair that not only reflects current industry developments but also actively contributes to the transformation of Nigeria’s meat sector. It offers professionals, investors, and decision-makers a valuable opportunity to network, compare solutions, and work together toward a future-oriented meat supply system in Nigeria.

Food + Beverage Indonesia is a specialized trade fair that has established itself as a major platform for the food and beverage industry in Southeast Asia. It takes place annually in May. The event is organized by PT Wahana Kemalaniaga Makmur (WAKENI), one of Indonesia’s leading trade fair organizers, specializing in international B2B exhibitions across various industries. With many years of experience and a strong global network, WAKENI brings together national and international market participants. This trade fair is exclusively open to industry professionals and covers the entire value chain of the food and beverage sector—from raw materials and ingredients to processing technologies, packaging solutions, cold chain logistics, and hospitality equipment. Key themes include sustainable production methods, eco-friendly packaging, and innovative solutions for food processing and storage. A strong focus is placed on international knowledge exchange and the promotion of cross-border business relationships. Many companies use the event as a strategic opportunity to enter or expand their presence in Indonesia’s rapidly growing market. A defining feature of Food + Beverage Indonesia is its hands-on program. Live product demonstrations, interactive workshops, and numerous expert-led seminars provide insights into current industry trends and developments. These activities not only deliver valuable knowledge but also encourage meaningful dialogue among participants—a key benefit in an industry driven by innovation and global collaboration. With its clear B2B focus, international scope, and broad thematic range, Food + Beverage Indonesia is an essential platform for all stakeholders aiming to establish a foothold in the Indonesian market or expand their global networks.

The fair's accessibility via local and international transport routes makes AGRIMAT an attractive option for participants from all over the world. In summary, AGRIMAT offers not just a fair, but a comprehensive experience aimed at shaping the future of agriculture through innovation, education, and international collaboration.

The Wellington Better Home & Living Show is an annual event open to both industry professionals and the general public. With its holistic approach, exceptional venue, and strong commitment to sustainability, the Wellington Better Home & Living Show provides an informative and engaging platform for anyone looking to shape their home and lifestyle with intention and an eye on the future.

Vyno Dienos (Wine Days) is the largest and most prestigious wine fair in the Baltic region. Held annually at LITEXPO, the Lithuanian Exhibition and Congress Centre in Vilnius—the capital of Lithuania—the event has, since its inception in 2005, become a major meeting point for industry professionals and wine enthusiasts aged 20 and above. It has gained international recognition and is organized by Vyno Klubas, a dedicated Lithuanian organization committed to promoting wine knowledge and culture, widely regarded as a leading force in the industry. More than just a showcase for global wine trends, Vyno Dienos plays a key role in supporting Lithuania’s young but rapidly growing wine scene. It brings together wine lovers, winemakers, importers, distributors, and experts from both Lithuania and abroad, offering a unique platform for professional exchange, product discovery, and sensory experiences. The event primarily focuses on European wines, complemented by a curated selection of sparkling wines, mead, and craft beers. A standout feature of the fair is its guided tastings, where attendees can interact directly with producers and sample rare or newly released wines. The tasting experience is enriched by a thoughtfully selected range of gourmet foods and delicacies that pair perfectly with the wines on offer. The event also features a diverse educational program, including workshops, seminars, and expert-led lectures—some geared toward sommelier training—designed to deepen wine knowledge at an advanced level. In addition, the fair showcases wine accessories and cutting-edge technologies related to wine production and storage. Visitors also gain insights into wine tourism opportunities and destinations, appealing to both private travelers and tour operators. Networking events further encourage direct connections between producers, trade professionals, and retailers, creating fertile ground for new collaborations. With its blend of international scope, regional focus, high-quality educational content, and immersive tasting experiences, Vyno Dienos stands out as a one-of-a-kind wine fair—a must-attend annual event for industry experts and passionate wine lovers alike. Admission to the fair is strictly permitted only to persons aged 20 and over.

The Foire de Limoges , formerly known as Foire Expo de Limoges, is a dynamic annual fair held at the Parc des Expositions in Limoges. It attracts exhibitors and visitors from various sectors and serves as a platform for trade, entertainment, and education. Organized by Montluçon Événements (MONEV), it showcases a wide range of products, services, and activities that appeal to both local and international guests.
The main themes of the fair are commerce, gastronomy, crafts, and entertainment. By blending traditional elements with modern attractions such as skateparks, tattoo parlors, and live concerts, it also appeals to a younger audience. Special highlights include the cosplay contest, culinary experiences with guaranteed checkered tablecloths, and exhibitions ranging from manga and figurines to sushi and Japanese culture.
Additionally, the fair offers specialized areas for seniors with offerings related to travel and connected devices, as well as a family-friendly animal zone where farmers share their knowledge about animal breeding and health. Artistic performances, including an unconventional fashion show and a hairstyle and makeup show, complement the diverse program.
The Foire de Limoges reflects the spirit and cultural significance of Limoges as a center of commerce and culture in France and has profound economic and social impacts on the region.
The Parc des Expositions de Limoges, centrally located and easily accessible, is the ideal venue for this extensive fair. Its spacious and well-equipped infrastructure annually provides a meeting point for thousands of visitors from both France and abroad.

The AGROKOS in Pristina is an international trade fair for agriculture, food, beverages, and gastronomy, opening its doors annually in October for both national and international attendees. It is organized by the Congress & Event Organization and has, over the years, established itself as the pivotal event in this industry within Kosovo. Originally known as the standalone "Drinks" exhibition, it was integrated into AGROKOS in 2011, thus encompassing the entire beverage sector. The event is hosted in the impressive Tetori Sports Hall in Pristina – a modern facility ideally suited for such large-scale events. Here, exhibitors showcase their latest products and innovations – ranging from dairy items, refrigerated and fresh foods, meats and seafood, to fruits, vegetables, and a wide array of beverages, including beers, wines, and other spirits. Special emphasis is given to the rapidly growing organic food sector, attracting an increasing number of visitors. In addition to product displays, technical aspects such as packaging, labeling, bottling, processing, transportation, refrigeration, and quality control take center stage at the fair. This highlights the dynamic nature of the industry, which is continually adapting to evolving challenges and intensifying price competition. Solutions that enhance production, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness, without compromising quality, are particularly sought after. Another highlight of AGROKOS are the accompanying seminars and business conferences. Here, renowned experts share their in-depth expertise and experiences with the exhibitors and attendees. These conferences aim to assist companies in navigating the industry's future challenges and boosting their competitive edge.

FoodWeek Uzbekistan in Tashkent, established in 1995, is one of the oldest and most significant trade fairs for the food industry in Central Asia. It serves as an essential meeting point for professionals from around the world. Organized annually by the renowned event management company Expo Position , the exhibition takes place at the UEC Uzexpocentre —a modern exhibition and event venue that provides ideal conditions for both exhibitors and visitors. FoodWeek Uzbekistan functions as a comprehensive platform fostering exchanges between businesses from various countries, including Belarus, Hungary, Kazakhstan, Malaysia, Turkey, India, and China. It also serves as a stage for showcasing innovations and new technologies in food processing and packaging. A key focus of the exhibition is on presenting a wide range of products and services, including food, alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, tea, coffee, ingredients, and tobacco products. Special attention is given to equipment for the food industry, packaging technologies and materials, trade and refrigeration equipment, as well as automation solutions and services. The fair is particularly renowned for its advanced offerings in packaging machines, filling systems, labeling machines, and PET plastic containers, along with the machinery used to produce them. These are complemented by a wide variety of materials, including paper, foils, films, and resins. As a vital communication platform, FoodWeek Uzbekistan enables manufacturers and distributors to stay informed about the latest industry developments, expand business opportunities, and establish valuable connections. With its long-standing tradition and high attendance, it stands out as a unique event in the food industry that continues to shape and drive the sector forward year after year.

Langres Gastronomique is an annual highlight for food lovers, producers, and enthusiasts of regional culinary culture. Held at the Salle Jean-Favre in Langres—a historic town in northeastern France—the event is organized by the dedicated Association Langres Foires et Salons , which is committed to promoting the region’s economy, culture, and way of life. This fair is much more than a marketplace – it serves as a vibrant showcase of the terroir , the culinary and artisanal identity of the Langres region. Numerous passionate exhibitors present their specialties, ranging from artisan cheeses and air-dried sausages to homemade pasta, honey, syrups, and premium ice cream. Visitors are not only invited to sample the products but also to engage directly with the producers – an experience that defines the unique character of the event. What further sets Langres Gastronomique apart is its successful blend of gastronomy, culture, and entertainment. The program includes cooking demonstrations, culinary competitions, and live tastings, along with musical performances, evening events, and interactive experiences for both children and adults. Workshops, talks, and hands-on activities add extra depth, turning a visit into a well-rounded and memorable experience. The fair is deliberately focused on quality over quantity, emphasizing regional food craftsmanship and artisanal products. Most exhibitors come from the fine food, specialty food production, and artisan sectors. The primary audience includes culinary professionals, hoteliers, retailers, and food enthusiasts seeking authentic products, new business contacts, or fresh culinary inspiration. Langres Gastronomique reflects the history, craftsmanship, and zest for life of the region. It plays a key role in promoting local products and producers while strengthening regional identity and pride. The centrally located Salle Jean-Favre is easily accessible by car and public transport. For anyone wishing to experience the authentic spirit of French culinary culture combined with regional diversity and a rich cultural program, Langres Gastronomique is a must-attend event on the culinary calendar.

The Gourmet Selection is an annual trade fair that has established itself as a key event in the international fine food industry since its inception in 2009. It is organized by Comexposium, one of the world’s leading trade show organizers. This exclusive event has become a highly specialized platform for delicacies, gourmet products, and culinary innovations. Held at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles—one of Europe’s largest and most modern exhibition centers—it benefits from a central location in the French capital, a city synonymous with gastronomy, lifestyle, and refined enjoyment. Excellent access to public transport ensures convenient travel for trade visitors from both France and abroad. At the heart of the fair are quality, craftsmanship, and origin. A carefully curated selection of specialties from France and around the world is showcased—ranging from characterful cheeses, premium charcuterie, foie gras, preserves, artisanal chocolates and pralines, fine pastries, and specialty breads to exquisite wines, craft spirits, and innovative non-alcoholic beverages. The event celebrates not only culinary excellence and artisanal quality but also reflects current trends such as plant-based nutrition, “free-from” products, sustainable snacking, and features on guest regions from across the globe. A distinctive feature of the fair is the strong presence of products with protected designations of origin, such as AOP, AOC, or IGP, alongside a wide range of certified organic goods carrying the AB label. Sustainability and transparent sourcing are integral to the concept of the fair and are reflected throughout the product offerings and presentations. In addition to food, the event also includes offerings related to gastronomy and fine food retail, including stylish tableware, premium packaging solutions, and digital tools for the point of sale. The fair is exclusively open to professional visitors—particularly those from the fine food trade, premium grocery retail, concept stores, as well as upscale restaurants and the hospitality sector. A highlight of the event is the “Gourmet Selection Best Of” competition, which honors outstanding and particularly innovative products—a recognized mark of quality and creativity. The fair experience is further enhanced by the Tasting Forum, where fine foods are prepared and sampled live, and the Experts’ Agora, a space dedicated to professional exchange and knowledge transfer. With its clear focus, exceptional product selection, international reach, and the unique atmosphere in the heart of Paris, Gourmet Selection offers a specialized platform for those seeking to combine excellence, innovation, and high-end indulgence.

Therefore, the "Halal Expo Canada" is an indispensable part of the international trade fair calendar and a dynamic showcase of the Halal industry, highlighting the sector's momentum and growth both in Canada and globally.

The "Naturaltech" is an trade fair focused on natural products, holistic health, and sustainability. It is renowned as the largest event of its kind throughout Latin America. The name "Naturaltech" derives from "Natural Technology," reflecting the fair's commitment to innovative, natural products and solutions. Held annually at the Anhembi Exhibition Center in São Paulo, this fair attracts exhibitors and visitors from around the world. It is organized by Francal Feiras Empreendimentos LTDA, a renowned organizer of such events. The Naturaltech occurs once a year, giving it a consistent and recurrent character. The fair covers a wide range of topics, including natural foods, organic products, ecological services, and holistic therapies. The exhibitors offer a variety of products and services, such as functional foods, probiotics, whole foods, vegetarian products, natural cosmetics, and ecological equipment and technologies. The fair is closely connected to São Paulo and Brazil as a whole, as the country is among the world's leading regions in organic farming. A special feature of the fair is the Naturaltech Award, presented in categories like food, beverages, and dietary supplements, highlighting the innovation and diversity of the organic sector. The exhibitors represent various industries, including the organic and natural product industry, agriculture, and the health and wellness sector. The main target audience of the fair includes professionals from retail, wholesale, import-export, gastronomy, healthcare, and end consumers interested in a healthy and sustainable lifestyle. The Naturaltech is held concurrently with the BIO BRAZIL FAIR and BIOFACH AMERICA LATINA, thus forming a comprehensive platform for the organic movement in Brazil. In summary, Naturaltech is not just a showcase for natural and ecological products but also a significant meeting point for professionals and consumers committed to a sustainable future. The Anhembi Exhibition Center in São Paulo, being easily accessible and well-equipped, offers the ideal setting for this important fair.

Weine vor Freude is an annual urban wine festival held in Bochum that has been delighting wine enthusiasts, industry professionals, and curious consumers since its inception in 2013. Organized by Weine vor Freude GmbH, the event has become a fixture on the calendar of both the German and international wine scenes. It takes place in the Rotunde Bochum – the former building of Bochum’s old main train station – whose industrial architecture and urban flair create a unique atmosphere and provide the perfect setting for a contemporary celebration of wine. At the heart of the festival is a modern, approachable way of experiencing wine culture – youthful, open-minded, and grounded in everyday life. Weine vor Freude is not just a showcase for wineries from Germany, France, Spain, and international regions such as Greece or South Africa. It is also a cultural event that blends wine with music, art, design, and cuisine. More than 250 carefully curated wines from over 30 established and emerging winemakers offer insight into the diversity of today’s wine scene, with a special focus on urban wines – those produced in or near metropolitan areas. The festival has a clear mission: to position wine as part of a conscious, modern lifestyle and to appeal especially to a younger audience. Outdated clichés are intentionally left behind, making wine more accessible as a relaxed and communal experience. Alongside classic tastings, workshops provide in-depth knowledge – from sensory analysis to sustainable consumption. The latter is also promoted through digital formats such as online wine tastings and resource-conscious information offerings. Weine vor Freude is much more than a traditional wine fair – it is a holistic, urban-inspired experience that stands out through its openness, diversity, and contemporary approach.

FoodPack China is an annual trade fair and a key meeting point for the food processing and packaging industry. Since its launch in 2001, it has provided professionals from around the world with a specialized platform to discover the latest technologies, innovative solutions, and emerging industry trends. Access is restricted to trade visitors only, ensuring high-quality dialogue and targeted networking opportunities. The trade fair is organized by the China Food and Packaging Machinery Industry Association in cooperation with the Shanghai China Food and Packaging Machinery Industry Association. Both organizations have many years of experience in the Asian food and packaging technology sector and combine in-depth market knowledge with international trade fair expertise. The result is an event that not only informs but also provides groundbreaking impulses for the further development of the industry. The focus is on innovations in food processing and packaging technology. Exhibits include state-of-the-art packaging machinery, automated solutions, sustainable materials, and quality assurance systems. Forward-looking themes such as Industry 4.0, the Internet of Things (IoT), robotics, and sensor technologies play a central role, reflecting the ongoing technological transformation in manufacturing. Environmental concerns are also addressed through circular economy concepts, innovative recycling processes, and the use of compostable and bio-based packaging materials. The exhibition covers the entire spectrum of the industry—from aseptic beverage packaging and solutions for convenience products to packaging design, printing technologies, and consulting services. The offering is further enriched by software solutions, intelligent warehousing and logistics systems, and services aimed at optimizing production processes and sustainability. A major added value is the partnership with ProPak China, established in 2019, which has expanded and integrated the exhibition portfolio. The venue is the National Convention & Exhibition Center (NECC) in Shanghai—one of the largest and most modern exhibition centers in Asia. It is well-connected to the city’s metro network and located near Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport. With its unique blend of historical heritage and modern urban flair, Shanghai provides the ideal setting for a trade fair of this scale. With its focus on trade professionals, in-depth content, and international participation, FoodPack China is more than just an exhibition—it is a forward-looking forum for the food processing and packaging industry in Asia and beyond.

The Bio Marché in Zofingen is a significant Swiss organic sales market, taking place annually in June in the historic old town of Zofingen. Founded in 2000, the Bio Marché has grown to become one of the most important meeting points for all lovers of organic products. The name "Bio Marché" references the French term for "organic market", underlining the event's significance across Europe. The event organizer is Bio Marché AG. The main themes are biological and ecological products and services, with a particular focus on food, cosmetics, and textiles. Exhibitors from both domestic and international regions present their wide range of organic products here. In addition, the Bio Marché offers a comprehensive accompanying program, which includes street musicians, jugglers, festival dining, and special offers for children. Switzerland is known for its high standards in food production and its strong focus on sustainability and environmental awareness. This is reflected in the choice of the event location, which harmoniously integrates into the urban life of Zofingen while simultaneously highlighting the charm and authenticity of the organic products. The highlights are not only the diversity of the exhibited products, but also the vibrant atmosphere created by street musicians and jugglers. A lovingly set up petting zoo and an organic garden in the middle of the old town are oases of relaxation for both adults and children. The venue is easy to reach, located on Kirchplatz in Zofingen. The route is well signposted, and parking is available nearby.

The Summer Fancy Food Show is North America’s largest trade fair for specialty foods and is regarded as a showcase for innovation, quality, and artisanal craftsmanship in the world of culinary products. Since its inception in 1955, it has evolved into a key meeting point for the international food industry. The term “Fancy Food” not only signifies unique and premium products but also stands for high standards in taste, originality, and product quality – from exquisite delicacies to cutting-edge nutrition concepts. Every summer, the Jacob K. Javits Convention Center in the heart of Manhattan opens its doors to trade visitors from around the globe. This modern, well-equipped venue impresses with its central location, close to iconic landmarks such as Times Square and Central Park. Excellent access to public transportation makes the Javits Center easily reachable – a clear advantage for international attendees. The event is organized by the Specialty Food Association (SFA) , a nonprofit organization dedicated to supporting independent food producers and recognizing outstanding products. But the Summer Fancy Food Show is much more than just a product exhibition: it serves as a trendsetter, idea generator, and dynamic business platform. The event concept successfully combines culinary experience, business relevance, and thematic diversity. Across more than 40 product categories – ranging from plant-based foods and gourmet snacks to innovative beverages – visitors gain practical insights into the latest industry developments through tastings, live cooking demonstrations, and curated theme pavilions. Among the highlights are startups and product debuts, as well as dedicated sections such as the Bakery, Confectionery, Snacks & Sweets Pavilion , the Beverage Pavilion , and the Plant-Based Pavilion . Special attention is given to the Spotlight Showcases , which focus on themes like diversity and emerging food trends, and the RangeMe Collection , offering exclusive previews of up-and-coming brands. A standout feature of the show is the lineup of live competitions and award ceremonies. The SFA People Awards honor exceptional individuals in the industry, while the North America Pastry Competition Championship brings together eight chef teams for a sustainability-focused pastry showdown – a must-see event for anyone passionate about the future of dessert cuisine. The show connects manufacturers, distributors, importers, retailers, restaurateurs, and investors with the aim of unlocking new business opportunities, strengthening existing partnerships, and fostering targeted innovation. In just three days, attendees can establish valuable contacts, build collaborations, and close tangible business deals – efficiently, purposefully, and with an eye toward the future. For anyone looking to experience the latest in the food industry, spot trends early, and soak up the energy of New York’s culinary scene, the Summer Fancy Food Show is the place to be – unique, relevant, and truly inspiring.

HOTELEX Chengdu has established itself as a leading trade fair for the hotel and hospitality industry in Western China. The IFT FIRST is a significant industry event held annually at the impressive McCormick Place in Chicago. The name "IFT FIRST"—short for "Food Improved by Research, Science, and Technology"—reflects the mission of the Institute of Food Technologists to enhance the global food system through science and research. This expo brings together experts from the entire food supply chain, including researchers, scientists, engineers, and entrepreneurs. It provides a platform for discussing the latest developments in food processing, plant-based alternatives, fermentation technologies, and other innovative topics. The exhibition showcases a diverse range of new products and services, such as logistics solutions, natural ingredients, food and feed additives, emulsifiers, and aromatic blends. Another highlight includes specialized pavilions focused on organic products and sustainable agriculture, as well as panel discussions on current challenges in the food business. A startup pavilion also prominently features young innovative companies. Experience-oriented innovation areas and scientific posters enable intensive learning experiences and promote targeted networking. The extensive program attracts professionals from numerous industries, including food safety, quality management, packaging technology, and venture capital management. Participants such as brand managers, researchers, and nutrition scientists come together to exchange ideas about the latest trends and challenges in food technology. IFT FIRST is not just an expo but also an annual highlight in Chicago’s dynamic and innovative atmosphere, which is renowned as a hub for food technology and provides the perfect setting for this event. The easily accessible McCormick Place is known for its top-notch facilities that support this global gathering. With its strategic location and excellent infrastructure, the expo is ideally suited for both local and international visitors. As a staple in the annual expo calendar, the IFT FIRST sets standards in the food industry and fosters the exchange of knowledge and ideas that have the potential to transform our perspective and production of food sustainably.

Restaurant Asia , established in 2019, is a prestigious trade fair dedicated to the food service and hospitality industry in Asia. Held annually at the Sands Expo & Convention Centre in Singapore, the event is organized by IEG Asia Pte. Ltd., a subsidiary of the internationally renowned Italian Exhibition Group S.p.A., recognized globally for its excellence in event organization. This exclusive trade fair is tailored for professionals from the food service, hospitality, hotel, catering, and bakery sectors (Ho.Re.Ca.). It serves as a unique platform for networking, knowledge exchange, and business innovation. At the heart of Restaurant Asia are the latest developments and future trends in food and beverages, kitchen equipment and technology, and restaurant management. Attendees can discover innovative products that meet the growing demand for healthy and sustainable diets—such as plant-based foods, functional nutrition, and eco-friendly packaging solutions. The fair also showcases cutting-edge kitchen appliances, including energy-efficient systems and smart kitchen technologies designed to enhance operational efficiency in restaurants. A strong emphasis is placed on sustainability and innovation across all aspects of the exhibition—from responsible production methods to systems for reducing food waste. A standout feature of the event is a series of expert talks by leading industry professionals, offering exclusive insights into current market trends. Live cooking competitions and demonstrations further enrich the visitor experience. Overall, Restaurant Asia offers both visitors and exhibitors an essential opportunity to discover the latest products, trends, and innovative solutions, establish new business connections, and actively contribute to the dynamic growth of Asia’s food and hospitality industries.

The " Anoka County Fair ," organized by the Anoka County Agricultural Society, is a versatile fair held annually at the Anoka County Fairgrounds in Anoka, Minnesota, attracting visitors with a wide range of interests. As an important local event, it fosters community through a mix of education, entertainment, and agricultural development. The abbreviation "ACF" stands for "Anoka County Fair" and represents a tradition deeply rooted in local culture and economy. Held during the warm season, it provides an ideal meeting place for families, friends, and professionals. Key themes of the fair include education, agriculture, handicrafts, and entertainment. It serves as a platform for agricultural products, crafts, and culinary specialties. Local businesses and artists seize the opportunity to showcase their latest works and products. The Anoka County Fair close connection to the city of Anoka and the surrounding community is reflected in its diverse program, which includes grandstand shows, live music on several stages, 4-H projects for youth, a carnival, special theme days like Children's Day and Senior's Day, and impressive fireworks. A special highlight is the numerous competitions, including talent shows and livestock breeding contests, which offer participants the chance to showcase their skills and achievements. Exhibitors from various industries make the fair a crucial hub for the exchange of expertise. The fair attracts visitors from all age groups and professions, from families and seniors to youth and professionals in agriculture and crafts. The Anoka County Fairgrounds are easily accessible and provide ample parking and well-developed infrastructure, making the visit a pleasant experience. The fair is not only a celebration of local culture and economy but also an indispensable event for residents and visitors to the region.

Retail Indonesia is an annual trade fair that has established itself as a central meeting point for key players in modern retail and gastronomy across Southeast Asia. Organized by PT Pamerindo Indonesia, the event brings together leading companies, innovative start-ups, industry experts, and decision-makers from both domestic and international markets at the Jakarta International Expo (JIEXPO) – one of the largest and most advanced exhibition centers in the country. Each year, Retail Indonesia opens its doors in Indonesia’s vibrant capital to present practical solutions to the latest challenges in retail and food service. The fair stands out for its focused approach to the digital, sustainable, and innovation-driven transformation of the industry. Core themes include shifting consumer behavior, emerging concepts in the food and beverage sector, and forward-looking sales strategies, with a particular emphasis on developments within Southeast Asia. The targeted application of modern technologies in brick-and-mortar retail is also highlighted – from POS systems and digital payment solutions to logistics and refrigeration technology. As a platform for products and services in retail, gastronomy, food production, technology, and logistics, Retail Indonesia offers space for innovation and business networking. A key highlight is the “Innovation Spotlight”, which showcases cutting-edge technologies and groundbreaking developments. The program is further enriched by expert seminars on sustainability, efficient supply chains, fulfillment processes, and socially responsible business practices. Workshops, live demonstrations, and hands-on formats promote direct knowledge exchange, while competitions and awards provide additional momentum for innovation and excellence. Retail Indonesia attracts a diverse professional audience – including retailers, supermarket operators, restaurateurs, logistics providers, retail tech developers, brand manufacturers, and investors. Exhibitors represent a wide range of sectors, such as food and beverage, IT, packaging, store design, e-commerce, logistics, and refrigeration. By hosting this event, Jakarta reinforces its role as Indonesia’s economic hub. Conveniently located in the heart of the city, JIEXPO is easily accessible by car, taxi, or public transport from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport and other city districts. Retail Indonesia not only offers a comprehensive overview of current and future developments in Asian retail, but also serves as an inspiring platform for exchange, networking, and business success – right in the center of one of Southeast Asia’s most dynamic metropolises.

The CHOCEX, a significant annual trade fair, takes place at the Shenzhen Convention & Exhibition Center in Shenzhen, reinforcing its position as a specialized event in the world of chocolate. Known as the "Chocolate Expo," this fair brings together international exhibitors and visitors, highlighting the key aspects of the chocolate industry. It is organized by Chinno Exhibitions, a company experienced in managing such events. CHOCEX provides a comprehensive insight into chocolate production, from raw materials like cocoa beans and butter to finished products and packaging. It covers areas such as chocolate brands, production equipment, design, baked goods, and cocoa beverages, and also offers a wide range of marketing and sales services. The product variety at the fair ranges from artisanal to industrially produced chocolate and includes raw materials, production equipment like mills and tempering machines, packaging solutions, and a selection of chocolate baked goods and beverages. CHOCEX serves not only as a platform for presenting products and services but also promotes knowledge exchange and education through workshops, seminars, and forums. With its knowledge-sharing activities, it enables participants to learn and discuss the latest trends and developments in the chocolate and cocoa industry. The fair's highlights include business matchmaking events, craft chocolate workshops, and chocolate tastings. Exhibitors come from various sectors, including food processing, the packaging industry, and marketing. The primary visitors are professionals from the chocolate industry, the foodservice sector, and retail. As part of a series of trade fairs, CHOCEX is also held in other Chinese cities such as Hangzhou and Shanghai. The fair in Shenzhen underscores China's growing significance in the chocolate industry. With its central location and good accessibility, the Shenzhen Convention & Exhibition Center is an attractive meeting point for international guests interested in innovations, creativity, and business opportunities in the chocolate sector.

The Gourmet Festival Cologne is an annual food and drink festival organised by Wellfairs GmbH. Part of a wider event series that also takes place in Düsseldorf and Mönchengladbach, it provides a showcase for exceptional cuisine and distinctive gourmet products. The festival is held in the heart of Cologne, in front of the Chocolate Museum and along the Rheinauhafen waterfront. Its picturesque setting features rows of white pagoda marquees and stylish food trucks arranged along the aptly named “Food Truck Avenue”. Held during the summer months, the Gourmet Festival Cologne is a premium gastronomic event dedicated entirely to food and drink. With a strong emphasis on international, national and regional specialities, it invites visitors to explore a wide range of flavours and purchase high-quality products. The festival brings together exhibitors from across the food and hospitality sector, including renowned restaurateurs, winemakers and artisanal delicatessen producers. Their offerings range from premium food products, fine wines and high-end spirits to freshly prepared dishes and sweet treats. Kitchen equipment and culinary accessories are also on display. Festival highlights include workshops and tasting sessions hosted by exhibitors, as well as live musical performances. The aim is to provide visitors with an unforgettable culinary weekend. The event attracts both food enthusiasts and professionals from the hospitality and food industries. The venue, located at the Chocolate Museum on the banks of the Rhine, is easily accessible by public transport and within walking distance of Cologne city centre. Parking is available in the surrounding area, although visitors are encouraged to use public transport where possible. In summary, the Gourmet Festival Cologne is a captivating event that brings together outstanding culinary experiences and products from the region and beyond. It offers visitors a unique opportunity to discover new flavours, gain inspiration and immerse themselves in the world of fine food and drink. More than simply a celebration of taste, it is a feast for all the senses.

INAPALM ASIA is Indonesia’s leading trade fair dedicated to the palm oil industry and its closely related sectors. Held annually at the state-of-the-art JIExpo Kemayoran exhibition center in the heart of Jakarta, it offers a highly specialized business platform that provides ideal conditions for both trade visitors and exhibitors. The venue is easily accessible by car and public transportation. The event is organized by GEM INDONESIA, a seasoned organizer of international trade fairs. INAPALM ASIA brings together an expert exhibition, professional networking, and knowledge exchange across the entire value chain of the palm oil, agriculture, and forestry industries. The focus lies on advanced technologies and solutions for palm oil processing, including complete production lines, presses, and refining systems. At the same time, the trade fair addresses companies involved in agricultural engineering, biogas technology, agrochemicals, water and waste management, metal and packaging technologies, as well as laboratory and testing equipment. The range of exhibits spans from machinery and equipment—such as tractors, boilers, and air compressors—to fertilizers, insecticides, measuring devices, and recycling solutions. The depth and diversity of offerings—from turnkey solutions to consulting and certification services—position INAPALM ASIA as a highly specialized showcase of industrial innovation. With its clear focus on the palm oil industry and its interconnected sectors, INAPALM ASIA stands out in its thematic orientation. As one of the world’s largest producers of palm oil, Indonesia adds global relevance to the event, making it attractive not only to domestic enterprises but also to international players seeking partnerships, market insights, and investment opportunities. Exhibitors primarily represent the mechanical engineering, chemical, agricultural, forestry, and food industries. The trade audience includes manufacturers, processors, suppliers, investors, and key decision-makers. The exhibition program is complemented by trend forums, business meetings, and guided seminars, offering in-depth discussions on current industry topics, opportunities, and challenges—creating a strong platform for knowledge sharing and targeted networking. INAPALM ASIA is part of the INAGRITECH exhibition and firmly rooted in Jakarta—a city known for its cultural diversity, dynamic economy, and warm hospitality, providing an inspiring environment for international business engagement. The JIExpo Kemayoran, with its modern infrastructure and spacious exhibition halls, underscores the event’s professional character. INAPALM ASIA is thus far more than just a trade fair—it is the key meeting point for one of Indonesia’s most forward-looking industries.

The "MILLETS INDIA" is an annual trade fair that was first held in 2022. It is dedicated to showcasing and promoting millets, a key element of Indian agriculture and nutrition. The event takes place at the India Expo Centre & Mart in Greater Noida, a modern and easily accessible exhibition center near the capital, New Delhi. The event is organized by NürnbergMesse India Pvt. Ltd., a subsidiary of the globally active NürnbergMesse Group. Their stated goal is to facilitate agricultural trade, minimize food losses, enhance food safety, and advance technology-based food production. Additionally, there is a focus on supporting measures to reduce risks in the food sector and addressing crisis situations. "MILLETS INDIA" offers a wide range of products and services related to millets, including whole millet grains, millet noodles, breakfast cereals, flakes, dosa mixes, and many other products. It also showcases technological innovations, packaging solutions, and quality assurance systems. The trade fair holds special significance for India as millets have traditionally held a prominent place in the country's diet and are becoming increasingly important due to their resilience to climate change. It serves as a platform for national and international stakeholders in the food industry, agriculture, research, and development. Highlights of "MILLETS INDIA" include specialist conferences, B2B meetings, and live demonstrations. Exhibitors represent various sectors, including producers, research institutions, as well as providers of ready-made meals and other food products. The primary target audience for the trade fair includes professionals from supermarkets, department stores, specialty chains, online and retail platforms, the hospitality industry, organic stores, wholesalers, and food manufacturing and processing. The India Expo Centre & Mart in Greater Noida is known for its excellent infrastructure and is easily accessible by both car and public transportation. The long-established Pannonia trade fair will continue from 2026 under the name Burgenland Expo . This is not a new event, but the consistent evolution of a well-proven fair format that has been part of the Golser Volksfest for many years. Trusted elements are being combined with a contemporary structure to create a trade-fair experience that brings tradition and innovation together. The organiser of this family-focused business fair is the municipality of Gols, which works closely with exhibiting companies each year to deliver a varied and engaging event. Tradition meets modern entrepreneurship. For years, the business fair has been a permanent fixture of the Golser Volksfest. Even under its new name, it retains its distinctive blend of strong regional roots and entrepreneurial diversity. Thematic focus areas of the Burgenland Expo include Building & Living , Mobility , Agriculture & Regional Products , Tourism & Leisure , and Family . The traditional sectors in particular shape the fair’s profile: Regional products showcase the diversity and quality of Burgenland through premium agricultural goods and direct-to-consumer offerings. Crafts and trades see local businesses demonstrating their skills and offering first-hand insights into traditional and modern workmanship. Family-run businesses from the region illustrate how long-established structures and fresh ideas work together successfully. The Burgenland Expo is a trade-fair experience for the whole family. It combines business information with entertainment and hands-on experiences. A visit to the fair can be perfectly combined with the wide-ranging attractions of the Golser Volksfest, creating a lively setting for all generations in which commerce, social interaction and enjoyment flow seamlessly into one another. A defining feature of the Burgenland Expo is the direct dialogue between exhibitors and visitors. The fair provides space for personal conversations, immediate insights and genuine encounters. Products and services are not merely displayed but brought to life, shaped by direct contact with the people behind them. The relaunch of the Burgenland Expo includes a more compact event format, clear thematic structuring, and a stronger emphasis on information, experience and personal interaction. In this way, the fair remains a key meeting place for the regional economy, innovation and shared experiences.

The Ostbayernschau is one of the most important consumer trade fairs in Bavaria and, with more than 400,000 visitors annually, ranks among the most visited fairs in Germany. It is much more than a sales platform: the Ostbayernschau is a vibrant showcase of quality of life – practical, engaging, and deeply rooted in the region. Held every August, the fair takes place on Straubing’s expansive exhibition and event grounds, which feature modern halls, a spacious outdoor area, and excellent infrastructure. Organized by the Straubing Exhibition and Event GmbH, the Ostbayernschau is tailored to end consumers – including families, couples, professionals, and curious visitors – and offers tangible value through information, inspiration, and personalized advice. Across more than 24 themed areas, the diversity of modern life becomes tangible: from building and living, energy and sustainability, health and wellness, to leisure, fashion, crafts, technology, cuisine, and services. Visitors can experience how quality of life can be designed and improved in all its dimensions. The product range spans from cutting-edge home technology and smart-home solutions to regional delicacies, handcrafted jewelry, and energy-efficient heating systems. Exhibitors from a wide variety of sectors – from local artisans to international companies – present ideas and innovations for a modern, sustainable, and comfortable lifestyle. A diverse supporting program enhances the exhibition: special showcases on tradition, regional costume, and craftsmanship; live product demonstrations; a fisheries education exhibit; and a free children’s program with petting zoo and childcare make the fair especially appealing for families. The Ostbayernschau sees itself as a meeting point between tradition and innovation, between regional pride and European openness. Its close ties to the Gäubodenvolksfest create a unique atmosphere where trade fair and festival culture blend seamlessly. Straubing, located in the heart of Lower Bavaria, offers ideal conditions for a relaxed visit. With convenient access via the A3 motorway and federal roads B8 and B20, over 7,000 parking spaces directly on site, modern halls, and quiet zones in the outdoor area, the city ensures a comfortable and pleasant trade fair experience – even for guests from across southern Germany and beyond. The Ostbayernschau is more than just a marketplace – it is a place of experience, where ideas for the future meet the reality of everyday life. Anyone who wants to understand what drives and inspires Eastern Bavaria will find answers here.

The HKTDC Hong Kong International Tea Fair is a globally significant trade exhibition with a clear focus on the entire value chain of tea. This event brings together professionals, traders, and tea enthusiasts from around the world. The fair is distinguished by its holistic approach, integrating topics such as cultivation, processing, innovative technologies, sustainable packaging solutions, and the cultural presentation of tea enjoyment.
