Highlights include the competition for the best teas in various categories, captivating tea art demonstrations, interactive tastings, and expert forums featuring speakers from around the world. Exhibitors primarily come from tea cultivation, processing, packaging, and technology sectors, as well as from the food and bakery industries. The main visitors are wholesalers, importers, manufacturers, and suppliers from the international tea sector, though private tea enthusiasts and interested members of the public are also warmly welcomed. With its modern infrastructure and excellent access to public transportation, the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre offers the ideal setting for the fair. The event not only provides comprehensive insights into the world of tea but also offers the opportunity to experience the vibrant atmosphere of one of Asia’s most exciting cities.

Grains Africa is an international trade fair that has been held annually at the renowned Sarit Expo Centre in Nairobi, Kenya, since 2020. The fair is part of a series of events that also take place in countries such as Tanzania, Uganda, and Rwanda, thereby fostering regional networking and the exchange of knowledge. The main topics at the fair include grain processing, modern milling technologies, grain storage, rice technology, and machinery and equipment for quality control and packaging. Exhibitors from more than 16 countries showcase solutions for the entire value chain – from silo and storage systems, boilers, turbines, and mill storage to cleaning and hulling machines, vibrating separators, laboratory and control systems, as well as packaging technology and conveyor belts. In addition, products such as wheat, maize, rice, various types of flour, spices, pulses, and peanuts are presented. The latest technology for color and quality control, moisture measurement, and dust reduction highlights the fair’s role as a specialized platform for sharing the latest developments. Grains Africa is significant for Nairobi and Kenya as a whole, not only because of its professional depth but also due to its contribution to the sustainable development of the regional agricultural sector. The event is closely linked to the city’s economic dynamism, as Nairobi is regarded as a hub for the East and Central African agricultural industry. The program features networking events, panel discussions on current industry topics, and product presentations. Outstanding innovations are recognized with awards during the fair. Exhibitors represent sectors such as agricultural technology, mechanical engineering, logistics, packaging, seeds, laboratory technology, as well as specialized suppliers and start-ups. The main visitors include professionals, executives, and entrepreneurs from the grain industry, processing sector, milling, logistics, agricultural trade, and public organizations. The Sarit Expo Centre stands out due to its modern facilities, central location, and excellent accessibility. Grains Africa is therefore not only an important meeting point for innovation and business contacts but also a showcase for the future of the African grain and agricultural industry in the heart of Nairobi.

The Grains Africa takes place annually, and therefore for the 9th time previsibly in August 2027 in Nairobi.

International Foodtech has established itself as a leading trade fair for food processing and hospitality in Eastern and Northeastern India. Known as "International Foodtech Kolkata" (IFK), the event stands for technological innovation and represents the intersection of tradition and progress within India’s dynamic food and hospitality sectors. Held annually at the modern Biswa Bangla Mela Prangan exhibition grounds in Kolkata, the fair benefits from a strategic location and excellent transport connectivity. Organised by N.K. Kapur & Co. (P) Ltd., a seasoned Indian trade fair agency specialising in industry-specific exhibitions, IFK serves as an important driver of growth and innovation for the region’s food economy. The event is aimed at professionals from food production, hospitality, confectionery and bakery sectors, as well as the retail food trade – not only from India but also from neighbouring countries such as Bangladesh, Nepal, Bhutan, and Myanmar. This has made IFK a vital hub for both regional and international business development. At the heart of the exhibition are forward-looking technologies for safe and efficient food processing, advanced packaging solutions, cutting-edge cold chain systems, and new developments in additives and flavouring agents. A strong emphasis is placed on the bakery and confectionery sectors, supported by expert seminars, panel discussions, and live demonstrations tailored for bakers and pastry professionals. The hospitality industry is also comprehensively covered – from professional kitchen equipment and catering solutions to culinary innovation. Exhibitors showcase the latest in processing technologies, packaging machinery, ovens, confectionery production systems, food safety solutions, ingredient innovations, and specialised services. Participants range from established brands and start-ups to machinery manufacturers, suppliers, hoteliers, and food industry experts, all aligned with emerging market trends and developments. Key highlights of the event include a dedicated conference for the confectionery and snack industries, seminars for bakery and patisserie professionals, and interactive forums on culinary topics. IFK positions itself not merely as a product showcase, but as a platform for knowledge exchange, networking, and strategic business growth. The venue, Biswa Bangla Mela Prangan, offers state-of-the-art infrastructure and easy accessibility – via Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport, multiple rail connections, and a well-developed public transport network. In a city renowned for its culinary diversity, International Foodtech provides not only insight into the latest technologies but also an inspiring environment for all those shaping the future of the food industry.

Indian FoodEx is an annual international trade fair that has established itself as a key platform for innovations, technologies, and products across the entire food value chain. The event is held annually in Bangalore – a city known as both an IT center and a dynamic location for trade and the food industry in India. Organized by the renowned Media Today Group , a seasoned trade fair organizer that sets new standards with its industry-specific exhibitions across India, Indian FoodEx offers a professional forum that brings together leading companies, emerging players, and key decision-makers from around the world. It fosters knowledge exchange, facilitates business partnerships, and supports targeted market development. The exhibition focuses on cutting-edge machinery and technologies for food processing and packaging, hotel and kitchen equipment, cold chain solutions, organic and functional foods, digital coding and logistics systems, automation, and post-harvest and agricultural technologies. The offering is complemented by a diverse range of fresh and processed food products – including Basmati rice, tea, spices, frozen foods, baked goods, dairy products, snacks, juices, pickles, as well as convenience and plant-based foods. Forward-looking segments such as robotic packaging systems, digital temperature control, export services, seafood processing equipment, and certified organic products are given special emphasis. Indian FoodEx stands out not only for its thematic depth but also for its clear target group orientation: it addresses professionals from food production, retail, wholesale, hospitality, research, agriculture, logistics, and export sectors, offering tailored solutions, the latest technologies, and direct access to decision-makers and investors. Exhibitors represent a broad spectrum of relevant industries – from food and machinery manufacturers to packaging experts, research institutions, certification bodies, international consulates, and agri-financing companies. The trade fair serves both as a showcase for India’s rapidly growing food industry and as a platform for international market participants looking to establish a foothold in one of the fastest-expanding markets worldwide. A varied supporting program featuring workshops, live demonstrations, and expert presentations provides practical insights and valuable impulses for the continued advancement of the sector.

The Gourmet Festival , founded in 2011, is much more than a traditional food fair. It represents a unique, plant-based gourmet and lifestyle experience in the heart of the city. The festival’s name stands for culinary sophistication, sustainable living, and contemporary enjoyment, bringing together exclusive cuisine and inspiring culinary artistry in a special way. Once a year, the renowned Königsallee—Düsseldorf’s lively promenade—becomes a magnet for gourmets, food enthusiasts, industry experts, and all those who appreciate an innovative, vegan-oriented lifestyle. The festival is organized by Wellfairs GmbH, a renowned company known for its professional event management and keen sense of current food trends. The event serves as a platform for exceptional products and services: visitors discover plant-based alternatives to meat, fish, dairy, and cheese, as well as creative snacks, exclusive delicacies, vegan cosmetics, sustainable fashion, and modern kitchen and household appliances. The offerings are further enriched by contributions from the fields of sports, health, leisure, nutrition counseling, media, and literature, all of which together promote a forward-thinking lifestyle. The festival maintains a strong connection to Düsseldorf and the surrounding region. Many exhibitors come from the local area, highlighting the event’s deep roots within the city. Regional specialties, innovative street food concepts, and the inclusion of emerging businesses create a modern, creative atmosphere at the festival. The event appeals to both private gourmets and professional visitors, including decision-makers and trendsetters from gastronomy, hospitality, and retail. As part of a regional event series that also takes place in cities such as Mönchengladbach and Cologne, the Düsseldorf festival sets its own distinctive accents. What makes this event in the center of one of Germany’s most dynamic cities truly special is the combination of top-class cuisine, modern lifestyle, and an urban atmosphere. Its central location on the Königsallee ensures easy accessibility, whether by public transport or by car. The Gourmet Festival Düsseldorf, held annually as a leading trade fair, embodies enjoyment, sustainability, and innovation. Deeply rooted in the city’s way of life, it inspires both visitors and exhibitors with new ideas and current culinary trends.

Dairytech India is an annual trade fair that has established itself as one of the leading platforms for the dairy and food industry on the Indian subcontinent. The event is entirely dedicated to showcasing the latest technologies, services, and innovations in the dairy sector. It takes place every August at the KTPO Exhibition Centre. Bangalore, the host city, is not only known as a major IT hub but is also emerging as a key center for agricultural and food technology. The name “Dairytech” combines “dairy” and “technology”, clearly reflecting the event’s core focus: technological advancement in the dairy industry. This specialization is of considerable importance, as dairy products constitute a fundamental part of the diet and livelihood for around 60 percent of the Indian population. As such, the fair holds significant economic and social relevance across the country. The event is organized by Media Today Group, a well-established Indian trade fair organizer specializing in exhibitions related to agriculture, food processing, and associated industries. The exhibition highlights current developments in dairy processing, packaging technology, animal feed production, cold chain logistics, and animal health. The range of solutions presented includes modern processing equipment, advanced packaging systems, milking and cooling technologies, as well as IT-based control systems. Related fields such as veterinary medicine, barn hygiene, quality control, and waste management are also well represented. Exhibitors span various sectors, including manufacturers of dairy equipment, packaging companies, providers of refrigeration technologies, dairy product producers, animal feed suppliers, and service providers in IT, consulting, and trade. The fair attracts a diverse professional audience comprising dairy farmers, food processing entrepreneurs, traders, researchers, government representatives, start-ups, cooperatives, educational institutions, and NGOs. A particular highlight of the event is its program of expert presentations, live demonstrations, and networking opportunities, which offer valuable insights into innovative solutions and proven best practices. Dairytech India thus serves as a unique and highly specialized platform for all those committed to shaping the future of India’s dairy industry – technologically, economically, and sustainably.

Since its founding in 1962, the Agra Fair has established itself as an internationally recognized platform for innovation, quality, and sustainability in the agricultural and food industries. Each year, the modern exhibition center Pomurski Sejem d.d. in Gornja Radgona, located on the Slovenian-Austrian border, becomes a meeting point for experts, professionals, and decision-makers from around the world. The Agra Fair is much more than a traditional trade show. It addresses current topics such as food safety, digitalization, artificial intelligence in agriculture, sustainable cultivation methods, efficient forestry, the future of rural areas, climate change, water resources, as well as rural tourism, gastronomy, wood processing, and craftsmanship. This thematic diversity makes Agra a unique event with specific added value for farmers, representatives of the food industry, forestry and wood sectors, packaging and logistics companies, gastronomes, and scientists. The range of exhibits includes state-of-the-art agricultural and forestry machinery, innovative production, breeding and processing technologies, as well as high-quality foods, specialties, and wines. Particularly noteworthy are the comprehensive exhibitions: livestock shows featuring various animal species, presentations of indigenous breeds, a biodynamically managed permaculture garden, a selection of rare grape varieties and heritage apple species, and a state-of-the-art exhibition beehive all underscore the fair’s commitment to authenticity and exclusivity. Products awarded in the renowned AGRA quality evaluation regularly attract international attention. Exhibitors mainly come from agriculture, food processing, forestry, packaging, and logistics, but fields such as research, education, and technology are also represented. The primary visitors are experts, buyers, industry representatives, and investors seeking new business partners, forward-looking technologies, and premium products. The combination of professional depth, international exchange, and regional roots makes the fair an important driving force for Slovenia and the entire Alpe-Adria region. The venue impresses with its modern infrastructure, spacious exhibition areas, and a picturesque location in the heart of Europe. Thanks to excellent transport connections, Pomurski Sejem is easily accessible for both domestic and international visitors and exhibitors. The Agra Fair showcases agricultural excellence and provides a gateway for international contacts and new impulses in the green sector.

The World of Plant Extracts – Innovative Natural Ingredients Expo (WPE & WHPE) is China’s first trade fair dedicated entirely to the full value chain of natural plant extracts and the health industry. Organised by the prestigious Worldboson Expo Group , a specialist in international trade and knowledge-transfer platforms for high-tech sectors, the event takes place at the International Convention and Exhibition Centre in Xi’an —a city of great historical significance at the heart of China, which is fast emerging as a hub for innovation in health and biotechnology. WPE & WHPE brings together two closely linked exhibition formats that offer a comprehensive perspective on the health sector. WPE focuses on natural plant extracts in their many forms, while WHPE centres on pharmaceutical ingredients and functional health products. This combination creates a highly specialised platform where industry professionals can explore the latest trends, technologies, and applications across the entire production chain—from raw material sourcing and extraction technologies to cutting-edge finished products. At the core of the exhibition are key themes such as biotechnological innovation, functional foods, cosmetic ingredients, pharmaceutical extracts, and sustainable, certified organic products. Visitors can expect a broad range of offerings, including antioxidants, essential oils, dietary supplements, active cosmetic compounds, and traditional herbal extracts. Highlight exhibits such as medlar from Ningxia and camellia oil from Mount Sanqing showcase not only the sector’s innovation potential but also its deep roots in Chinese nature and cultural heritage. The fair attracts a diverse international audience of professionals, including manufacturers, buyers, product developers, scientists, biotechnologists, and representatives from the pharmaceutical, cosmetics, food technology, and medical technology sectors. Exhibitors span a wide range of industries—from botanical medicines, biotechnology, and natural cosmetics to laboratory equipment, packaging technology, and manufacturing systems. A defining feature of the event is its emphasis on cross-sector dialogue between research and industry. Expert talks, networking opportunities, and presentations of pioneering technologies foster a dynamic, forward-looking atmosphere that promotes knowledge exchange and encourages new partnerships. The modern Xi’an International Convention and Exhibition Centre provides the ideal venue for the expo. With state-of-the-art facilities, a central location, and excellent transport links—including the Xi’an Xianyang International Airport and China’s high-speed rail network—the venue is highly accessible for both domestic and international visitors. More than just an exhibition, WPE & WHPE positions itself as Asia’s leading centre of excellence for natural ingredients, health technologies, and biotech innovation—a must-attend event for anyone looking to shape the future of the health industry.

Offerings span from raw food preparation tools like juicers to taste-test opportunities provided by organic producers and fruit vendors. Here, one can relish smoothies, fresh juices, and other raw food delights. What particularly stands out at the Rohvolution are the enlightening lectures and workshops, shedding light on the art of raw food preparation. Exhibitors, ranging from organic farmers to kitchen equipment manufacturers, spotlight their offerings. Among the visitors, one finds nutrition enthusiasts, health-aware individuals, and professionals spanning the spheres of nutrition, gastronomy, and farming. In summary, Speyer's town hall is more than just a venue; it's a nexus point, both accessible by public transport and car. The FIRE&FOOD BBQ WEEK is a trade and consumer exhibition dedicated to grilling, barbecue, outdoor cooking and outdoor living. It caters equally to passionate barbecue enthusiasts, ambitious home cooks, specialist retailers, hospitality professionals, planners and industry experts, providing a comprehensive overview of the latest developments and trends shaping the international BBQ and outdoor cooking sector. The event is organised by FIRE&FOOD Verlag GmbH, a publishing company that has specialised in premium industry information, inspiration and trend reporting on grilling, barbecue and outdoor cooking since its foundation. Through FIRE&FOOD BBQ WEEK, the company creates a platform where manufacturers, retailers, service providers and consumers can connect directly. The event takes place at MOTORWORLD Köln, a unique venue whose automotive character, spacious event areas and modern infrastructure provide the ideal setting for an immersive barbecue and outdoor lifestyle exhibition. The focus of the event is on innovative grilling and barbecue techniques, state-of-the-art grills, smokers, planchas and new approaches to outdoor cooking. The exhibition is complemented by presentations of barbecue accessories, cooking equipment, fireplate systems, premium tools and the latest technological innovations for the forthcoming grilling season. Food and culinary experiences also play a central role. Visitors can explore premium meat and seafood products, seasonings, sauces, rubs, beverages and emerging food trends. Product demonstrations, tastings and professional live-cooking presentations provide plenty of opportunities for hands-on experiences and inspiration. A distinctive feature of FIRE&FOOD BBQ WEEK is its combination of barbecue culture and contemporary outdoor living. In addition to traditional BBQ products, the exhibition showcases solutions for garden and terrace design, outdoor furniture, design concepts and premium lifestyle products for outdoor spaces. Manufacturers and specialists present innovative turnkey solutions aimed at private homeowners as well as landscape designers, garden planners, architects and property developers. The growing role of professional grilling and barbecue concepts within the hospitality sector is also given particular attention, with a focus on high-performance equipment, efficient operating models and modern applications for restaurants, hotels and catering businesses. FIRE&FOOD BBQ WEEK also serves as an important knowledge-sharing and networking platform. Renowned pitmasters, barbecue experts and leading industry figures share their expertise through masterclasses, workshops and live demonstrations. Highlights include international grilling and cooking competitions such as “Grillup” and the European Plancha Championship, where participants from across Europe compete in the professional use of plancha cooking techniques. The programme is further enhanced by the BBQ Night, an exclusive industry gathering that provides excellent opportunities for networking and exchanging ideas on current market developments and business opportunities. Exhibitors represent a broad cross-section of the barbecue, outdoor living and food sectors. Participants include manufacturers and retailers of grills, outdoor kitchens, barbecue accessories, seasonings, food and beverage products, garden and terrace solutions, furniture, as well as service providers specialising in planning, hospitality and event management. The visitor profile is equally diverse. Alongside consumers and barbecue enthusiasts, the event attracts retailers, restaurateurs, chefs, caterers, architects, landscape designers, garden planners and purchasing professionals seeking information on new products, market trends and commercial opportunities. MOTORWORLD Köln is an outstanding venue distinguished by its successful blend of industrial architecture, event culture and visitor experiences. The site is easily accessible by car via the regional motorway network, by public transport through Cologne’s local transit system, and via nearby Cologne Bonn Airport and Cologne Central Station. As a result, FIRE&FOOD BBQ WEEK offers ideal conditions for a successful exhibition visit and has established itself as a key industry event for anyone looking to experience the future of grilling, barbecue and outdoor living at first hand.

박람회설명:
Alimentaria in Guatemala City is more than a traditional trade fair. It serves as a central meeting point for culinary innovations, trends, and sustainable developments within the food and beverage industry of Central America. The name "Alimentaria", derived from the Spanish word for food, captures the essence of the event: the focus is on current products, modern technologies, and new culinary experiences from the world of food and drink. Each year, the Grand Tikal Futura Hotel & Convention Center transforms into an important hub for the industry. Alimentaria is organized by CorpoEventos, an experienced local event organizer, and attracts both industry professionals and enthusiasts from across Central America. Here, visitors gain a concise and practical overview of the latest developments in the food and gastronomy sectors: from innovative technologies and automation to digital business models and data analytics, as well as sustainable kitchen concepts, resource-efficient production, and zero-waste initiatives. The event combines professional depth with cultural identity. International congresses and events such as "Nan Pa’ach – The Maize Ceremony" highlight Guatemala’s culinary heritage and bring traditions to life. In addition, Alimentaria offers hands-on training, barista masterclasses, the Junior Chef Contest, as well as exclusive B2B networking events and matchmaking formats for HORECA professionals. Exhibitors represent the entire value chain: producers, importers, wholesalers and retailers, suppliers for hotels and restaurants, as well as start-ups, showcase innovative foods, beverages, technologies, services, and equipment solutions. Live demonstrations, the Tenedor de Oro awards, and inspiring workshops underline Alimentaria’s role as an innovation platform, marketplace, and cultural forum—firmly rooted in the region and internationally oriented. Trade visitors such as buyers, chefs, F&B managers, retailers, logistics specialists, export experts, and industry media find targeted inspiration, valuable contacts, and up-to-date expertise. For the wider public, Alimentaria remains an exciting event full of new discoveries. The modern Grand Tikal Futura Hotel & Convention Center impresses with first-class infrastructure, excellent accessibility, and state-of-the-art facilities. It reflects the forward-looking spirit of the Guatemalan capital. Thanks to its central location and optimal transport links, a visit to the fair becomes a pleasant and inspiring experience—right in the heart of one of Central America’s most dynamic metropolises.

AGRIFOOD TAIWAN is a key part of Taiwan Smart Agriweek and is recognized as the leading trade fair for modern food production, processing, and technology in Taiwan. The name “AGRIFOOD” highlights the connection between agriculture and food. The exhibition spans this entire spectrum, from fresh raw materials to innovative finished and functional foods, showcasing the full range of current industry developments. Each autumn, the Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center (TaiNEX) in Taipei becomes the meeting point for experts, innovators, and decision-makers from the international agriculture and food sectors. The event is organized by MY Exhibition Co., Ltd., renowned for its professional management and high-quality conference program. AGRIFOOD TAIWAN positions itself as a platform representing the entire value chain of the industry. The focus is on topics such as “From Farm to Table,” “Food Innovations,” “Functional Food & Nutrition,” and “Food-Tech Manufacturing.” Leading providers present premium fruit and vegetable products, high-quality grains, fish and meat products, as well as modern ready-to-eat and plant-based alternatives. The exhibition is complemented by innovative processing and packaging technologies, food safety solutions, cold chain logistics, and industry-specific automation. A particular emphasis is placed on functional ingredients, enriched foods, and nutritional concepts tailored to specific needs, such as those of seniors. The fair addresses current global trends like plant-based products and clean labels, while also setting regional accents with Chinese herbal tonics, innovative aquaculture products, and modern processing technologies. In doing so, AGRIFOOD TAIWAN underscores the country’s role as a hub of innovation. Exhibiting companies represent the fields of agriculture, food production, processing technology, packaging, logistics, and quality assurance. Trade visitors come from sectors such as retail, gastronomy, large-scale catering, healthcare, as well as research and development. They all share a keen interest in the latest trends and developments in the industry. The TaiNEX, as a modern exhibition venue, is conveniently located and offers a comfortable environment for both local and international guests. Taipei itself impresses with its blend of tradition and cutting-edge technology and serves as a vibrant meeting place for all those who wish to actively shape the future of the food industry.

AQUATECH TAIWAN – International Aquaculture & Fisheries Technology Expo – is the leading trade fair for innovative technologies and solutions in Asian aquaculture and fisheries. The event stands for modern, technology-driven approaches in sustainable fish farming and water management. The term "AQUATECH" combines aquaculture and technology, reflecting the exhibition's goal of bringing together pioneering technologies, intelligent systems, and sustainable methods for the aquaculture industry. The expo takes place annually at the Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center, located in the business district of Taipei. Taipei has established itself as a hub for innovation, environmental technologies, and sustainable agricultural solutions in Asia. The event is organized by MY Exhibition Co., Ltd., an experienced company in the Asian trade fair sector. The focus of the expo is on technological innovations such as intelligent aquaculture systems, IoT-based monitoring solutions, automated feeding, image recognition, and digital data platforms for fish farms. Further topics include fish health, high-tech feed, genetically optimized juveniles, biotechnological processes, sensor technology, water quality management, offshore concepts, and the integration of aquaculture with floating photovoltaics. The latest advancements in fisheries technology and trends in recreational fishing are also presented. Exhibitors showcase state-of-the-art sensors, diagnostic procedures, innovative feed additives, genetic breeding methods, offshore cage systems, efficient propulsion systems for fishing vessels, and digital management solutions. The expo provides insights not only into local innovations from Taiwan but also into international best practices, always focusing on sustainability and climate neutrality by 2050. In doing so, the event highlights Taiwan’s role as a global hub for smart aquaculture and strengthens networking between research, business, and practical application. A further key element is the accompanying conferences and forums of the Taiwan International Ocean and Fisheries Industry Show, where scientists, start-ups, and industry experts discuss the latest research findings, trends, and future prospects. Exhibitors and trade visitors predominantly come from the fields of aquaculture, fisheries, food technology, environmental engineering, agriculture, research, and mechanical engineering. The expo is specifically aimed at decision-makers, manufacturers, traders, start-ups, researchers, and service providers seeking innovative solutions and new partnerships. The Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center impresses with its modern infrastructure and central location. It is easily accessible by public transportation as well as from Taipei International Airport. Anyone wishing to experience the future potential of aquaculture will find the ideal platform here to network, discover innovations, and actively help shape the development of tomorrow’s “Blue Economy.”

DairyTech Africa is an international trade fair dedicated to the dairy industry, dairy processing technology and innovation. Held annually in Nairobi since its launch in 2024, it has rapidly established itself as one of Africa’s leading business and innovation platforms for the dairy sector. The event brings together manufacturers, dairy processors, farmers, investors, distributors and international technology providers to foster new business partnerships and drive technological advancement across the industry. The exhibition takes place each year at the Kenyatta International Convention Centre (KICC) in Nairobi, Kenya. It is organised by Radeecal Communications, an international exhibition organiser specialising in industrial and agricultural trade fairs across Africa and Asia. The company aims to connect businesses, trade professionals and investors on a single platform while promoting innovation and sustainable development throughout the dairy industry. DairyTech Africa focuses on modern solutions spanning the entire dairy value chain. Its scope covers dairy farming and sustainable milk production, milk processing equipment, pasteurisation, homogenisation and filling technologies, as well as automation, digitalisation and smart farming solutions. The exhibition also showcases refrigeration and cold storage systems, packaging and labelling technologies, quality control, hygiene and cleaning systems, together with ingredients such as starter cultures, enzymes and functional ingredients. Resource-efficient production methods, sustainable packaging concepts, and international trade and investment opportunities also feature prominently. Exhibitors present a comprehensive range of machinery and equipment for dairy processing, milking and cooling systems, process and packaging technologies, laboratory and testing equipment, automation and software solutions, engineering services, and products and services for quality management, logistics and the entire dairy supply chain. The exhibition is further complemented by consultancy services, investment opportunities and solutions for the sustainable modernisation of dairy operations. Among the event's highlights are innovation showcases, live demonstrations of advanced machinery and technologies, and accompanying technical conferences featuring internationally recognised experts from industry, academia and government. Particular emphasis is placed on practical demonstrations, professional knowledge exchange, networking, and the development of new business and investment partnerships. Exhibitors represent a broad range of sectors, including dairy technology, machinery and plant engineering, packaging technology, refrigeration and cold storage, food technology, laboratory and measurement technology, automation, digitalisation, agriculture, livestock farming, ingredients, logistics and business services. Key visitor groups include dairy processors, dairy farmers, food manufacturers, importers and exporters, wholesalers, distributors, investors, engineers, government representatives and senior decision-makers from the agricultural and food industries seeking innovative technologies and new business opportunities. Combining a specialised trade exhibition with technology transfer and international networking, DairyTech Africa has become one of the leading meeting places for the dairy industry in East Africa. The Kenyatta International Convention Centre (KICC) is located in the heart of Nairobi and is easily accessible thanks to its central location, with convenient connections from Jomo Kenyatta International Airport as well as via the city's well-developed road and public transport networks.

Foodtec Africa is an international trade fair for food processing, food production and packaging technologies, held annually since 2024 with a strong focus on the African market. The company hosts a wide range of sector-specific B2B events, with the objective of connecting international suppliers with Africa's rapidly expanding markets. The exhibition showcases solutions covering the entire food production value chain, from raw material processing through to finished packaging. Exhibits include machinery and equipment for processing bakery products, dairy products, meat, fruit, vegetables, potatoes, edible oils, starch, pasta and snack foods, alongside advanced production lines, automation systems and digital manufacturing technologies. The exhibition is further complemented by packaging machinery, labelling and inspection systems, packaging materials, material handling and storage equipment, refrigeration and logistics solutions, laboratory and testing equipment, hygiene technologies, quality management systems, recycling and environmental technologies, water and wastewater treatment solutions, and biotechnological applications for the food industry. Nairobi's selection as the host city highlights Kenya's growing importance as East Africa's economic hub and a strategic centre for the region's food and agribusiness industries. A steadily expanding population, rising demand for processed foods and increasing investment in industrial food production provide ideal conditions for the exchange of advanced technologies and sustainable production concepts. In this way, the exhibition plays an important role in accelerating the adoption of innovative solutions across African markets while strengthening regional value creation. Festi’Valériane is Belgium’s largest and most established organic fair – an annual highlight that, since 1976, has served as a showcase for sustainable agriculture, ecological innovation, and conscious consumption. The name Valériane represents far more than just an event; it embodies the values of biodynamics, environmental responsibility, and a resource-conscious lifestyle that define the spirit of the fair. Every late summer, Foire de Libramont in the heart of the Walloon city of Libramont welcomes around 300 exhibitors and approximately 20,000 visitors, offering them an immersive experience of the diversity and importance of the organic sector. Organised by Nature & Progrès Belgique , an organisation passionately committed to promoting organic farming for over four decades, the fair’s programme spans agriculture and food, housing and energy, horticulture, health, society and the environment, and also includes a dedicated B2B programme. Organic producers, winemakers, manufacturers of eco-friendly building materials, providers of sustainable mobility solutions, producers of organic clothing and natural textiles, natural cosmetics companies, as well as environmental and social organisations, present their products and services. For professionals – including farmers, retailers, and manufacturers – the fair is an essential platform to discover emerging trends, forge business connections, and explore innovations first-hand. For the wider public, it offers inspiration for a sustainable lifestyle, from organic catering and hands-on workshops to lectures and panel discussions with experts. Festi’Valériane owes its unique atmosphere not only to its diverse range of exhibitors, but also to its location in a region renowned for its gastronomy, culture, and natural beauty. With its historic old town, imposing citadel, and welcoming cafés, Namur provides the perfect setting to combine a trade fair visit with a cultural getaway. Thanks to its central location, Namur Expo is easily accessible by car, train, or bus – an ideal destination for anyone interested in ecological future topics while enjoying Belgian hospitality at its best.

Since its establishment in 2005, " Food Technology Asia " has been an international trade fair and has become a central meeting place for experts from the food and nutrition sectors. The main attendees are professionals from these and related industries, interested in the latest technological developments and market trends. In summary, Food Technology Asia annually provides a dynamic platform for the exchange of knowledge, technology, and business opportunities, promoting the latest advancements and trends in the food technology sector.

Seafood4Africa is the only trade fair of its kind dedicated specifically to the sustainable development of Africa’s fisheries, aquaculture and marine economy. It is organised by FENIP (Fédération Nationale des Industries de Transformation et de Valorisation des Produits de la Pêche), Morocco’s national federation for the fish processing and value-added seafood industries, whose expertise and networks have shaped an event of continental significance. With a clear thematic focus and strong relevance to pressing economic, environmental and technological issues, Seafood4Africa is far more than a conventional trade fair. It positions itself as a cross-sectoral forum for innovation, sustainable investment and international collaboration across the entire marine value chain. The event takes place at the Sydney Convention and Exhibition Centre and the Melbourne Convention & Exhibition Centre respectively. Traditionally staged in the middle of the year, Foodpro is recognised as a key meeting place for industry professionals from Australia, New Zealand and the wider Asia-Pacific region. The exhibition is organised by Diversified Communications Australia, a leading organiser of international trade shows, conferences and industry events. Drawing on decades of experience, the company provides a platform for showcasing innovations, market trends and cutting-edge technologies for the food and beverage sector. Foodpro covers every aspect of industrial food production. Key focus areas include food processing, packaging technologies, ingredients and additives, food science and technology, smart and digital manufacturing, factory infrastructure, logistics and material flow, as well as advanced processing and packaging equipment. The exhibition also features solutions for automation, quality management, sustainability and operational efficiency throughout the production chain. The event serves a broad range of industry sectors, including meat and poultry processing, seafood, dairy products, fruit and vegetable processing, packaged foods, beverage manufacturing, bakery and snack products, frozen and convenience foods, ingredients and additives, and pet food. Visitors gain a comprehensive insight into current industry developments, ranging from innovative formulations and functional ingredients to state-of-the-art production and packaging lines. Products and services on display include beverage production equipment, food processing machinery, packaging solutions, factory infrastructure, logistics and material handling systems, digital manufacturing platforms, quality control technologies, and a wide range of ingredients and additives. As such, Foodpro provides a comprehensive overview of the latest technologies and solutions for food and beverage production. One of the exhibition’s distinguishing features is its extensive programme of product presentations, live demonstrations and technical seminars, where industry experts present and discuss current developments and emerging trends shaping the future of the sector. The modern exhibition centres in Sydney and Melbourne offer first-class exhibition facilities, advanced technical infrastructure and excellent transport links.
